tei:div.tei:p: rmo//dzihonezla'i thon/ rdzi sto nya chiri paṭartekyi/che brgyung song rleju/ t+nam/sa/ kyi t+nam/ thar 55 ma /gāsrari 'bupa t+narle/sa/ phyo sas/ snge ma zhus/ nga/'i snge/ tshan ne ne/hūṃs /gresas) brlogyu/ gsum/ pa/ rje btsun sno/ la/ ras nga/'i rnam thaza bzhugs/ //

7/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kye blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lama'akhrul pa sel bar byin gyis brlab tu bdenal/ /'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu bzhesal/ /du'i①—90—9'i sbyi161'ibro5smogo bu'ipu('ikro 25spuspusmo'i 51smo'i1'isduspo'ikro'i76smo5’ smo'i༈smo①'ismopupu’ khodzi9'i1

ra༅༅/ /dpal rje btsun chen yo mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam stoni zhes bya ba 'di nyid kyi dkar chag ni/she) macesad ba11da snye snye te te lo ske ske snye ske te te d+ku rko jithun mong srid pa 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa la gsum las/pe/ dang po/ gleng gzhi dang ska bltams pasnye ske rka ske snye snye ske d+ku snye ske ske snye 23) gnyis pa/ sdug bsngal rnyu bden pa phul phyin thugs nyams su bzhes paske snye snye snye snye rka rka snye 32

4sku/ gsum pa/ dgra bo tshar bcad pa snye te snye snye ske te snye snye te ske rka slosgru mchog gyur zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa la dgu las/ 76snyen dang po/ bla ma dang zhal mjal ba ske ske rka rka snye te snye snye snye te rka ske 78༷) gnyis pa/ sdig sgrib ma lus sbyangs pa ske snye ske khe snye ske snye snye snye te ske snye 9 7) gsum pa/ dbang dang gdams ngag thob pasnye snye ske snye snye snye ske ske ske te snye rka 46

༷) bzhi pa/ nyams rtogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa 559nga/ lnga pa/ rang sngo/la du phebs pa ske rko ske te snye snye te — ske rka rka ske ske 8 1༷'i/ drug pa/ sgrab pa la yi dam bcas pa snye te snye snye rka ske ske ske snye snye snye snye snye 2041dzo) bdun pa/ yengs med du ri la bsgoms pa snye rko snye ske snye ske te ske te ske ske ske 2 61she) brgyad pa/ sgrub 'bras kyis bstan pa dang / sems can la phan btags pa'i mdzad pa ske ske snye snye te ske ske snye 2slo

9) dgu pa/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan pa'i mdzad pa snye ske rka snye rka ske te snye khe 308 —407de ltar thun mong srid pa 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa gsum dang / mchog gyur zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa dgu ste/ ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa bcas la 31ga ldeb 204 bzhugs pa lags sku(//
ra༅༅/ /rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dang 'brel ba'i par skrun gsal ghod bzhugs//
py-iḥ —rko yostsu k+ṣiṃ rdzer+ṇa myir+ṣa.a+yau 〉phordo ༵ zhusprehrūchostoji — rilngepon (

༄༄/ 'i 'i /rnaṭā saX gyi dbyāng phyug hūm̐n tso btsun bzhudu pa r+sā lngam smo ti sa pa zheswā tsha gcag lus gcagā gās sku bzha ya shasa'i lnga' bdag nyad khyabyā bdag rda rja 'changachakropasmogasaphangabagās ta/ sangs rgyas kya zhang thams cad byang zhang dag pa dang / sams can thams cad sman cang gral bar mad

pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam stoni mgur chings dang bcas pa/ gtsang spyod he ru ka sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nam rnal 'gyor pa rus pa'i rgyan can mchog gi zhal snga nas mdzad pa 'di bzhin/ shrī gau tam bud+dha wi har gyi gsung rab rgyun spel khang du kom pi'u ṭar nang btsud skabs kyi ma dpe/la stod ding ri'i nye 'dabs bde skyid khang gsar du bzhugs pa'i shing par gzhir bzung thog /gtsang bkris lhun po'i par ma dang / mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par ba'i deb gzugs/ sde dge'i chos mdzod chen mor bzhugs pa'i par ma dang / ku lu ma na li grub dbang ye shes rang grol gyi sgrub sder 'khod pa'i shing par sogs la yang khungs bcol te lan grangs du mar gang thub zhus skabs/ bla ma rdo rje lags dang dge skos tshe dbang rdo rje sogs phyag rogs gnang mi dang / kom pi'u ṭar las mi tshe dbang lha mo dang karma

ra༅༅/ /rnam rgyal/ yol mo ba seng ge sogs la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ gsung rab rgyun spel khang 'di nyid du thog mtha' bar gsum gyi mthun rkyen cha tshang rogs skyor mdzad pa po/ bla ma phrin las rnam rgyal mchog la yang bkrin shin tu che zhes zhu ba dang chabs cig /rnam thar dpe grangs nyis stong 2000 tham pa par skrun zhus te phyogs mthar spel ba'i dge bas/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang rin po che bde blag tu 'thob pa'i smoni pa bzang po'i mtshams sbyor dang bcas/ rnam dkar gyi 'du byed po mkhan ming bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin pas/ bal yul 'phags pa shing kun rang byung mchod rten rin po che'i nye 'dabs/ dpal go'u ta ma sangs rgyas kyi gtsug lag khang nas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me pho khyi lo'i zla ba 1 tshes 14 phyi lo 2sku6 zla 3 tshes 'a rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug chen po

rje btsun mi ras pa'am gu ru ha sa badz+ra mchog dgongs pa chos kyi dbyengs su thim tshul bstan pa'i dus chen khyad par can gyi nyin bris pa dge legs su gyur cig gu/ //lto/ bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba 'di dag gis/ /sdig dang sgrib pa ma lus byang byas nas/ /rtag par dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin shog /'di nas bzung ste skye dang skye ba ru/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi mgoni dang skyabs/ /lam ston dgeba'i bzhes su bdag gyur nas/ /ma lus rnam grol mchog la 'god par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon to rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog/ //sarba maṅga lam̐//
ra༅༅/ /rnal 'gyor gyi dbang phyuX dam zlo rje baspyo sdi la ras pa'i rnam skya thar pa/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyan pa' lam stan zhas bya ba bzhugs sa//
k+ṣisau ngame/rnyismirngophodro d+nghad+nghadze1tshormya ོ phro spro 4stor+sha

ra༅༅/ /lam rgyad dbang po skye gnas dus kyis bsdus pa'i srog lngan kun gyi chos la rmongs pa'i glo bur mun pa mtha' dag༄ rab bsal nas/ /dug mda'i darbang gis sgo me me dge phyogs dang mtshams bral phung pos 'phangs pa'i lam du zhugs dang 'jug 'gyur zhugs 'bras tshor ba nyams myong kun las

phyir stor+shag bde bar ngal bserdzos te/ /slar yang rnam byang rgyu lam dag la bkod nas 'bras bu dbang phyug klu ldan tshe 'dir dzā(la mdzad mkha' mnyam 'grerdzo ba'i dpal mgoni mi la zhes grags stobs bcu mnga' ba de la 'dud/ /khyod thugs thugs rje'i chu gter 'phrin las 'gro jon rba rlabs 'thor las ye shes thigs dang dad sogs nor bus bdag blo rmig rjes rab gang nyon mongs tshad gdung dbul phongs kun bsal bas/ /sred ldan skye bos rgyan spras bzang mo dben par btus tshe tshangs spyod snrod yang lang tsho'i dpal gzis bgrod pa phyir bsnur tsam la'ang bzod glags bral phyir 'phral du dga' bas dga' ba ltar/ /rnam thar yid 'phrog mdzes ma thugs rje'i rgyan spras skal ldan rna bar lhung tshe gab par :rdzom yang ngo mtshar dpal gzis khong 'dzum gad rgyangs shor phyir 'phral du yi ge'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /de phyir rnam thar nor bu gab rgya'i dri ma dad brtson spos chus byi dor bgyis nas 'gro ba'i don du

ra༅༅/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod pas bla ma mkha' 'gros gnang du gsol/ /de yang bod gangs can gyi khrod 'dir dang por me 'obs lta bu'i 'khor ba mtha' dag gi nyes dmigs la thugs skyo zhing nges par 'byung bas mtho ris kyi lha tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi bde ba la yang spyod pa skad cig tsam yang med pa'i zhen 'ordzog dang ldan pa / pad tshal lta bu'i thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yone tan mthong bas yid phrogs te chos phyir du lus srog gtong ba la nyam nga dang bag tsha cung zad tsam yang med pa'i dad ba:ni shes rab snying rjer ldan pa/ bar du bla ma dam pas rjes su bzung zhing zhal nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi dben pa'i ri khrod du myangs pas nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol te nyams dang rtogs pa'i myu gu 'khrungs pa/ 'jig rten blos btang gi zhe bcad drag pos sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan lhur mdzad pa'i mig rkyen mchog gis rjes 'jug gi skal ldan rnams 'jig rten gyi

snang zhen dang le lo med par lam sgrub pa'i lcag thebs pa/ yi dam mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung nas lam gyi gegs sel zhing bogs bton pas nyams rtogs gong 'phel du rgyas te chos la rang byan tshud pa/ brgyud pa bosgong ma la mosnas gus mthar phyin pas thugs rje'i bka' babs te brgyud pa mtha' yas shing mnyam pa med pa'i byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan dang ldan pa /0 byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed rgya che zhing shugs drag pas rnam dkar gyi bag chags med pa'i skye bo rnams kyi rna bar yang gsung sgros dang mtshan lhung ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur nas dad pa'i spu long g.yo shing mchi ma 'khrug bzhin pa'i ngang nas byang chub kyi sa bone bskrun te 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa mtha' dag las skyobo nus pa gsang sngags pho nya'i lam gyi gnad zin pas ye shes mkha' spyod kyi rig ma rnams kyis sku la dga' bzhi ye shes kyi bde ba bskyed cing lam sgrub pa'i grogs su gyur pa/ mthar sgrib gnyis la sogs pa'i

ra༅༅/ /spang bya mtha' dag dbyengs su dag pas chos rna mas zad sar skyol ba/ mkhyen brtse la sogs pa'i yod tan ma lus pa thugs la rdzogs pas rang byung gi sangs rgyas su gyur te grub mtha' phyi nang gi gang zag kun gyi rtsod pa dang bral zhing kun gyi nang na rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur gyur pa/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam la myur du bslabs shing nyams dang rtogs pa mthar phyin pa/ che ba dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros brjod phyir snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten phyogs bcu kun tu g.yo ba/ yas byon gyi dga' bas rkang mtheb yan khyab cing mas brtan gyi dga' ba spyi gtsug tu soni pas 'bras bu'i dga' ba la reg ste rtsa gtso mo gsum dang 'khor 'ordzo bzhi'i mdud/ pa phra rags thams cad rang sar grerdzol bas dbu ma'i ngo bor gyur pa/ de'i phyir gsung rab mdo sde bcu gnyis dang rgyud sde bzhi'i dgongs don mtha' dag rdo rje'i glur len pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ snang ba thams cad chos skur shar

bas blo gnyis 'dzin gyi skor mgo nas bud pa/ nang rig pa sems la slob gnyer byas pas phyi snang srid kyi dngos po thams cad dpe char shar ba/ mkhyen brtse'i nus pa dpag tu med pas dud 'gror gyur pa'i sems can la yang khrid btab pas smin grol la 'god nus pa/ chos brgyad kyi 'dor len dang gang zag gi ngo 'dzin bral bas skye 'gro kun gyi spyi bos btud de lha mir bcas pa'i 'a〈sna ba kun gyi mchod gnas su lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa/ zab mo'i lam 〉rdzom pa'i brtson 'grus mchog tu gyur pas rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phyag gi gnas su gyur te 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ nyams su 〈snang ba'i bdag med kyi seng ge'i ngar skad chen pos lta ngan gyi ri dwags mtha' dag zil gyis mnan pas nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa'i gangs ri'i klong na seṅge dkar mo srab med du 'gro ba/ nang zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pas phyi 'byung bzhi'i

༄༅༅/ /gnod pa thams cad zil gyis mnan zhing dbang du mdzad de grogs su shar ba/ rlung sems kyi dbang dam pa'i pha rol tu sod pas nam mkha' la bya ltar lding ba dang 'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug pa'i spyod lam ston cing / sku las me 'bar zhing chu 'khrug pa dang 'dod dgur bsgyar ba la sogs te bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung du mas log lta can gyi lta can sun dbyung nas yang dag pa'i lta sgom spyodi 'bras la 'god nus pa/ dbang bzhi'i nyams len rmothar phyin pas rdo rje'i lus kyi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin du 'du zhing de dag gi tshogs kyi bdag po he ru kar gyur pa/ nyam nga med pa'i gdeng dang ldan pas lha ma srin sde brgyad zil gyis mnan te bka' bsgrubs pas phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa/ dngos po'i rnam pa thams cad stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngo bor mkhyen cing slob pa'i bzo bo/ ye shes lnga'i sman sbyor gyis dug lnga'i gcong

nad sun 'byin par mdzad pa'i sman pa/ 'byung ba phyi nang gi rang sgras legs nyes kyi done stoni pa kun dgongs shing de thams cad grag stong du mkhyen pa'i sgra mkhan/ gzhan sems la sogs te lkog gyur gyi chos bzang ngan thams cad sa ler mkhyen cing shes bya mtha' dag bdag med du mngone sum du gtan la phebs pa'i tshad ma mkhan/ phyi dngos po'i chos thams cad nang rig pa sems su mkhyen la sems gdod nas 'od gsal skye med stong par kho thag chod cing de 'gag med du shar ba'i rang rtsal sku gsum 'bral med du rang grol ba ste snying po don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dag pa rab 'byams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' dag rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig la nyul nus shing rnam byang gi mdzad pa la brten nas/ zhing de dag gi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos 'chad pa dang nyan pa'i gleng gzhir gyur pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' dag byang zhing dag par mdzad pa/ rigs drug gi sems can rnams la

ra༅༅/ /rang rang gi skal ba dang mthun pa'i skur bstan nas blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos/ dpe 'jig rten gyi snang ba dang bstun zhing / don rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang sbyar te bstan pas smin cing gyol bar mdzad/ pa ste/ mdor na tshe gcig dang lus gcig la sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang brnyes te/ tshad med kyi thugs rje'i ngang nas bla med kyi chos 'khor bskosnar bas gzhal med kyi sems can rnams bcod med kyi sdug bsngal las bsgral te/ bde chen sku bzhi lhun grub thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du skyel zhing gnas par mdzad pa'i skyes bu mchog rab dam par gyur pa/ dpal rje btsun mi la bzhad pa rdo rje zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa/ mchog gi gdul bya'i snang ngor bstan pa rnams brjod na bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang na'ang / mdor bsdu na gong gi rnam thar gyi che brjod

ltar yin la// thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor bstan pa rnams kyang bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang bar gyur kyang / mdor bsdu na gnyis yin te/ thun mong srid pa 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa dang / mchog gyur zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa'o// //dang po la gdung la mi lar btags pa'i rgyu mtshan yab mes brgyud pa'i byung khungs dang bcas te sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa/ gzhon nu la yab sku thim pas nye du dgrar langs te phyi nang gi 'ordzongs spyod kun dang bral zhing sdug bsngal gyi bden pa phul phyin thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i mdzad pa/ yum gyi bkas bskul te mngon spyod kyi phrin las bsgrabs nas dgra bo rnams tshar bcad pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum gyi dang po nas brtsams te/ ngo mtshar can gyi rnam par thar pa'i thog ma gleng gzhi dang bcas te stoni pa ni 'di ltar ro/ /e ma ho/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ rnal 'gyor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la bzhad pa rdo

ra༅༅/ /rje zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i he ru ka chen po de nyid/ yul gnya' nang grod pa phug ces bya ba'i bsti gnas dam pa na/ skyes bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa dang / ras pa zhi ba 'od/ ngan rdzong ras pa/ se ban ras pa/ khyi ra ras pa/ 'bri sgom ras pa/ glan 〉snam ras pa/ ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs/ gshen 〉(ma ras pa / dam pa rgyags phu ba dang / ston pa shākya gu na la serdzogs te/ thugs sras rnal 'gror pa sar gnas kyi sems dpa' rnams dang / legs se 'bum dang gshen rdor mo la sogs te skal ldan gyi nya ma pho mo rnams dang / jo mo tshe ring mched lnga la sogs te/ 'ja' lus mkha' spyod grub pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / gzhan yang rgyud yongs su dag pa'i lha mi'i rnal 'gror pho mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i dbus na theg pa chen po chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe skyes bu ras chung pa khong rang gi bsam gtan/ khang bu

na thugs dam la bzhugs pa las/ mtshan thog thag gcig gi mtshan lam na/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling yin zer ba'i yul yid du 'ong zhing nyams su dga' ba/ khang khyim gyi rgyu dang sa gzhi thams cad rin po che du ma las grub pa'i grong khyer chen po zhig gi nang du phyin pas/ grong khyer de'i mi thams cad dar gyi gos rgyan zhing rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ bzhin bzang zhing lta na sdug pa kho na 'dug ste/ de thams cad bdag la tshig ni mi smra bar dga' ba'i 'dzum dang ldan pas mig phar cher tshur cher lta zhing 'dug pa las/ de rnams kyi nang na sngar bal por mjal ba'i bla ma ti phu pa'i slob ma bha ri ma de yang gos dmar po zhig rgyane te gtso mo'i tshul du 'dug pas/ tsha bo 'ongs sam 'ongs pa legs so zhes brjod nas rin po che'i khang khyim 'dod yode zad mi shes pas gang ba zhig gi nang du khrid nas/ mgroni gyi tshul du bza' btung gi bsnyen bkur bzang zhing gya nom pa byas

ra༅༅// /te/ da lta u rgyan na sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa chos gsung gin yod pas tsha bo rang yang chos zhu na ngas gnang ba zhu'o zer ba la/ shin tu nyan par 'dod nas legs so byas pas/ 'o na 'dong zer mo dang bsdebs te phyin pas/ grong khyer de'i dbus na rin po che'i khri stan mtho la yangs pa'i steng na/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa sngar yid kyis bsgoms pa bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na chos stoni pa mthong bas dga' ba dang bde bas rgyudas te brgyal 'gro ba lta bu zhig thob/ de nas bha ri ma na re tsha bo rang 'dir re zhig 'dug cig /ngas sangs rgyas la gnang ba zhus 'ong gis zer song ba las gnang ba thob ste/ yang mos khrid nas sangs rgyas kyi zhabs drung du phyin phyag btsal/ byin rlabs zhus nas spyan lam du chos nyan zhing bsdad pas/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i ngang nas cung zhig bdag la spyan ce re bzhugs 'dug pa

las bdag la brtse bas dbordzongs pa yin snyam pa byung / chos gsung ba thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi gdung rabs dang 'khrungs rabs mdzad pa dang rnam thar kho na gsung zhing 'dug pas ba spu g.yo ba'i dad pa thob/ mjug tu tai lo nā ro mar pa gsum gyi rnam thar sngar rje btsun gyis gsungs pa bas kyang rgyas shing ngo mtshar che ba rnams gsung byung bas 'khor thams cad mchog tu dad par gyur 'dug /chos kyi mjug tu nang par gong du bshad pa de rnams las kyang mchog tu gyur pa mi la ras pa'i rnam thar 'chad pas nyan du shog gsung zhing 'dug pa la/ 'khor rnams kyi nang nas kha cig na re/ gong gi de rnams las mchog tu gyur pa bya thabs yodi dam/ yodi na ngo mtshar tshad las 'das pa zhig yod par 'dug zer/ yang kha cig na re/ gong gi de rnams kyi yone tan ni/ sku skye ba mang por tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyangs pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin/ mi la ras pa ni tshe

ra༅༅/ /gcig lus gcig la yon tan gong ma rnams las mi zhan pa thob pa zhig yod pa 'dug zer/ yang snga ma na re/ 'o na de lta bu'i chos ngo mtshar che ba yod nas sems can gyi don du ma zhus na rang re bu slob rnams zhan pas sgo gsum brtson 'grus dang spobs pa bskyed de 'gro ba'i don du zhu bar rigs so zer/ yang gcig na re/ mi la ras pa de da lta gang na bzhugs zer/ gcig na re mngone dga' 'am 'og min gang rung na yode par 'dug zer ba las/ ras chung pa'i thugs la/ rje btsun bzhugs dag bod na bzhugs te/ gang ltar na'ang 'di rnams kyi zer lugs 'di nga la ngar ldud par 'dug pas/ rje btsun gyi rnam par thar pa zhig 'gro ba'i don du cis kyang zhu dgos snyam pa byung ba'i tshe/ bha ri ma des ras chung pa'i phyag nas bzung ste/ cang cang khrug khrug mdzad bzhin tsha bos bordzo bar 'dug /tsha bos bordzo bar 'dug zer ba'i ngang nas ras chung pa mnal sad pa

las nam tho rangs khar serdzong 'dug ste/ sngar bas rig pa dwangs/ shing dge sbyordzor rtsal che bar byung ba'i ngang nas/ mnal lam gyi rjes su thugs 'phros pa las/ ā/ rgyan mkha' 'gro'i tshog sa dbus su mi bskyodi pa las chos nyan pa'ang ngo mtshar che mod de/ de bas kyang bla ma rje btsun dang mjal ba 'di gang nas bsams rung ngo mtshar che/ mi bskyodi pa las chos nyan pa'ang rje btsun gyi bka' drin yin/ khong rnams rje btsun mngon dga' 'am 'og min gang rung na bzhugs zer ba la/ bod na bzhugs snyam pa bla ma la brnyas bcos kyi sgo nas mnyam 'grogs byed pa'i dred po khyod rang gi snang ngor yin mod/ spyir rje btsun sangs rgyas yin pas sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ khyad par du rje btsun rang gang na bzhugs pa de ka 'og min dang mngon dga' yin par yid mi ches pa'i phung po log lta mkhan khyodi 'dra yong ba zhes rang la ngan smras mang du mdzad rjes/ rmi lam gyi chos 'chad

ra༅༅/ /mkhan dang nyan mkhan bha ri ma dang kun gyi brda de rnams nga la 'gro ba'i don du rje btsun gyi rnam thar zhus kyi brda ru 'dug pas cis kyang zhu dgos dgongs nas/ bla ma la resnas gus thun mosnang ma yin pa zhig skyes nas gserdzol ba snying khong rus pa'i dkyil nas btab ste/ dar cig thugs dam gyi ngang la bzhag pas/ yang mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i nyams kyi ngang la ā/ rgyan gyi rgyan dang cha lugs can gyi na chung mdzes ma dkar sngerdzo ser dmar ljang ba lnga ras chung pa'i mdun na tshur bsgrigs te 'dug pa'i gcig na re/ nang par mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gsung ba yod par 'dug pas nyan du 'gro zer/ gcig na re zhu ba po su yod zer/ gcig na re thugs sras bu chen rnams kyis zhus te 'ong zer ba'i tshe/ kun ras chung pa la mig 'dzum shig shig 'dug skad/ gcig na re ngo mtshar can gyi chos nyan pa la kun sngerdzo bas rang re rnams kyang gserdzol ba btab pa drag

zer/ gcig na re rnam thar zhu ba bu chen rnams 'os/ rang re rnams la de'i bstan pa spel ba dang skyong ba bab pa yin zer nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin song / de rjes ras chung pa yang 'edi gsal las bzhengs pas/ mkha' la nam langs nyi ma lhag gis shar 'dug ste/ ras chung pa'i thugs la tshe ring mched lnga'i brda de rnams kyang skusna bar 'dug gis daskurdzongs nas/ thugs dam rjes thob kyi ngang la 'tsho ba'i sta gos byas te tshim par rol nas/ bla ma'i drung du byon pas 'khor grwa pa bu slob nya ma dang bcas pa rnams kyang bla ma'i drung na khra me re 'dzom 'dug skad/ der ras chung pas rje btsun la phyag btsal/ snyun dris nas/ rje btsun gyi drung du pus mo btsugs thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces gsol ba btab bo/ /bla ma rje btsun rin po che sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sems can gyi doni du gsungs pas 'jig rten

༄༅༅/ /na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba lags shing / tai lo nā ro mar pa la sogs te bla ma grub thob gong ma rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi rnam thar gsungs pas da lta skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'aspod nus pa lags na/ da rje btsun rin po che khyed kyis kyang bdag cag bu slob rnams spro ba bskyed pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skal ldan gdul byar gyur pa rnams rjes su gzung zhing / gzhan yang skye 'gro mtha' dag smin grol la 'god par bya ba'i phyir thugs brtse ba chen pos/ rje btsun rin po che khyed rang gi gdung dang rigs kyi byung khungs dang bcas te/ rnam par thar pa dang mdzad pa rnams gsung du gserdzol zhes gserdzol ba btab pas/ der rje btsun chen po zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ ras chung pa kho bo'i cha rgyus khyod che na'ang / 'dri na dri ba la lan btab par bya ste/ nga'i rus khyung po/ rigs jo sras/ nga rang mi la ras pa/ dang po ni las nag po

yang byas/ bar du dkar po yang byas/ da lta las dkar nag gnyis ka dang bral zhing / las kyi gzhi zad pas ma 'ongs pa na byed par mi 'gyur ba zhig yi na cing / de rnams rgyas par bshad na/ la la ni ngu bro/ la la ni dgod bro ba'i rgyu mtshan mang po yod de/ bshad rung don chung bas mi rgan sos dal du nyal du chug ces gsungs pas/ yang ras chung pas phyag btsal nas gsol ba btab pa/ rje btsun rin po che lags/ khyed kyis dang por dka' thub dang zhe bcad drag pos gdams ngag zab mo rnams nyams su len cing / rtse gcig gi sgrub pa lhur mdzad pas da lta gnas lugs mngon du gyur te/ chos rnams zad sar 'khyol bas/ ma 'ongs pa na 'ching 'gyur gyi las mi mdzad cing mi myong ba kun gyi mthun grub lags mod/ gdung khyung po/ rigs jo sras/ de la mi lar mtshan gsol ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / sku 'khrungs nas dang po las nag po mdzad tshul/ bar du dkar po mdzad tshul la

ra༅༅/ /brten nas ngu bro ba dang dgod bro ba'i rgyu mtshan de la dgos don bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa lags pas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs te/ sku gsung thugs snyoms las su mi bzhugs par rgyas par gsung du gsol/ khyed 'dir 'tshogs kyi mched lcam rdo rje spun rnams dang / dad 'dus kyi nya ma rnams kyis kyang nga'i gserdzol ba 'debs pa'i grerdzogs mdzad par zhu zhes gserdzol ba btab nas phyag mang du btsal bas/ der thugs sras bu chen rnams dang / dad can gyi nya ma rnams kyis kyang phyag mang du btsal nas/ skyes bu dam pa ras chung pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin bkas gnang ste/ chos kyi 'khor lo bsnyor du gsol zhes gsol ba yang yang btab pas// rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyed rnams de tsam du do gal dang nan tan du yang 'dri na/ gsang dgos med pas bshad par bya ste/ nga'i rus dang rigs ni dbu ru byang

phyogs kyi 'brog sde chen po zhig gi khrod nas rus khyung po/ rigs sngags rnying ma pa'i bla ma jo sras zhig gi bu rnal 'gyor pa yi dam gyis rjes su bzung bas ngag nus dang ldan pa zhig rgyal khams kyi gnas bskor ba dang rten mjal ba la phyin pas/ gtsang la stod byang gi phyogs gcung ba spyi zhes bya bar phyag phebs te/ yul der 'dre gdon 'dul ba dang / byin rlabs byas pas nus pa dang ldan phyir phan pa shin tu mang bar byung nasatshogadul bya dang phrin las che bar 'byung ste/ mtshan khyung po ༄rngo sras su gserdzol nas 'o( 'ga' bzhugs pas/ yul der nad gdon sogs rkyen ci byung yang gdan 'dren pa zhig yod pa las/ nam zhig gi tshe yul de na sngar jo sras kyi phyogs su 'ong ye ma nus pa'i gdon gzhan su gang gis kyang mi thub pa'i 'jigs su rung ba zhig yodi pa de/ jo sras la shin tu mi dad pa'i mi tshang zhig la zhugs nas gnod du byung ba la/ bla ma gzhan gdan drangs nas drag 'dul dang byin rlabs

ra༅༅/ /byas pas/ gdon des tshur col lo dang bzhad gad sun 'byin byas nas phan pa ma byung ba'i tshe/ dad log can gyi mi de la nye du zhig gis/ gdon gyi phag tu khyung po jo sras gdan 'dren pa'i gros btab pas/ kho na re rma la phan na khyi'i tshil na'ang tshil gyis bos shig ces zer skad/ der mi des jo sras gdan drangs pas/ gdon gyi sar phebs su 'cha' ba dang / jo sras nga rgyal langs te/ gsung chen pos nga khyung po jo sras 'ong gin yod do/ /gdon bgegs rnams kyi sha za khrag 'thung ba yin pas sdod ang gsung zhing myur du byon pas/ jo sras rtsar mar phebs pa la gdon de 'jigs shing skrag ste ha las nas/ pha pha mi la mi la zhes yang yang zer zhing 'jigs pa'i skad du ma cerdzor jo sras rtsar phebs pa dang / mi khyed 'ong sar ngas 'ongs pa med pas bdag la srog stsol cig zer/ jo sras kyis kyang gdon de la phyis su la'ang mi gnod pa'i mna' blangs te btang

bas/ gdone de rang bsten pa'i mi tshang zhig la babs nas/ yang mi la mi la da lan pas sdug pa dang nyen pa ma byung zer zhing 'dug pa la/ mi tshang de rnams kyis mi su byung byas pas/ khyung po jo sras byung nas srog la bab pa'i sdug btang / mna' shor zer song skad/ de nas jo sras kyi yon tan dang che ba brjod pa'i ched du/ mi kun gyis jo sras la mi la zhes brjod pas gdung gi mtshan la mi la zhes grags so/ /gdon de yang phyis gnod pa ye ma byung bas tshe 'phos par kun kha 'cham mo/ /de nas khyung po jo sras kyis yum khab tu bzhes pas sras gcig byung / de la sras gnyis byung ba'i tshe ba la mi la mdo ston seng ger grags/ de la sras mi la rdo rje seng ge zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ phyis de'i brgyud pa rnams la sras re re yod pa zhig byung / mi la rdo rje seng ge de sho la shin tu brtsi zhing mkhas pas rgyal mang po thob 'ong zhing yod pa las/ dus nam zhig gi tshe yul de na mi g.yoni can

༄༅༅/ te la shin tu mkhas pa pha tshan rags la mang ba zhig yod pa des mi la rdo rje seng ge'i tshod bgam pa'i phyir rgyal chung ngu btsugs te cerdzo brtses pas tshod smyopong sa te/ de'i nyin khos rgyal rang bzhin gyis thob pa ltar byas pas/ mi la rdo rje seng ge yi ma rangs te nang par sho lan len byas pas rung zer/ rgyal sngar bas che ba btsugs te cerdzo rgyab pas kha drang phyir khos lan gsum gyi bar du pham pa ltar byas pa'i mthar/ nga yang cerdzo lan len zer bas rung zer/ rgyal che chung la gnyis ka kha 'chams nas zhing khang nor gsum se'i rgyal du btsugs/ zhu 'chag med par 'ba' yi ges bsdams nas 3( brtses pas khos thob ste zhing khang nor gsum kho'i pha tshan rnams kyis rtsis blangs nas mi la yab sras yul gzhis kun dang bral nas yul thon byon te/ mang yul gung thang gi skya rnga rtsa zhes bya bar phyag phebs nas gzhi bcas te/ yab mdo ston seng ges yul pa rnams kyi klog

sgrogs/ gtor ma/ ser bsrungs/ sri'u gso ba la sogs grong chog rgyugs pas shin tu brin par byung ba'i yone dang / sras rdo rje seng ges tshong che ba la dgun lho bal blan/ dbyar byang 'brog blan/ chung ba la mang yul dang gung thang gi bar blan pas/ yab sras gnyis kyis nor mang po bsogs/ de'i tshe yul pa'i gces phrug ma zhig dang sras rdo rje seng ge gnyis dga' 'dus kyi bza' mir serdzong / de gnyis la sras gcig 'khrungs pa la mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan du mtshan gsol nas bskyed bsring zhing yode pa'i tshe/ mes po mdo ston seng ge sku yal ba'i gshegs rdzongs rgyas par byas rting / mi la rdo rje seng ge sbong gi sgo nas nor spel bas sngar bas kyang phyug par gyur te/ rtsa'i nye gsor na 'or ma zhes bya ba'i yul mi zhig la rtsa na zhing dga' mo gru gsum pa zhig yod pa de/ gser dang lho byang gi rdzas mang po bcal te nyos pa la 'or ma gru gsum du grags/ zhing de'i 'gram na gnas

ra༅༅/ /tshang dbang ba'i khang ro zhig 'dug pa de yang nyos nas mkhar las kyi 'gram bting ste mkhar las byed bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan lo nyi shu 'od pa dang / rtsa'i mi drag rer gyur pa rus myang yin pa zhig la/ dkar mo rgyan zhes bya ba'i bu mo gzugs mdzes la mi chos pher ba/ dgra gnyen gang la'ang chags sdang gi rus thon pa zhig yod pa de bag mar blangs te myang tsha dkar rgyan du grags so/ /de nas mkhar las kyi 'phro mthud/ sum thog gi steng khang du lag mdzod dang g.yos khang zur na yod pa'i tshoms ka bzhi gdung brgyad yod pa'i khang pa skya rnga rtsa na dga' ba zhig brtsigs pa la ka bzhi gdung brgyad du grags te/ de na bde skyid snyan grags dang bcas te gnas so/ /de nas gcung du mi la mdo stone seng ge yab sras kyi snyan grags nye grogs rnams kyis thos pa las/ mi la rdo rjes seng ge'i pha spun gyi bu g.yung drung rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba bu smad dang

sring mo khyung tsha dpal 'gran dang bcas pa yang yul thon nas skya rnga rtsa ru sleb byung ba la/ mi la rdo rje seng ge gnyen sred che bas dga' tshor chen po byung ste/ sna len dang sna rten byas gzhi chags pa la tshong gi byed lugs rnams bslabs te tshong byas pa las/ khong rnams kyis kyang nor mang du bserdzogs serdzo/ /de nas skabs shig gi tshe/ myang tsha dkar rgyan sprum dang ldan par gyur nas/ mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan lho rdzas mang po khyer te/ byang stag rtse'i phyogs su tshong la song nas yun ring 'gor ba'i tshe/ chu pho 'brug gi lo ston zla ra rbe'i nyer lnga skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i nyin a ma la nga skyes pas yab kyi sar bang chen brdzangs te/ 'dir stod las kyang thug nga la bu zhig kyang skyes pas/ bu la ming 'dogs pa dang ming stone byed pa la myur du cerdzog bya ba'i yi ge bskur ba bang chen pas kyang yab la sprad/ 'o/ rgyus rnams brjod pas/ yab shin tu mnyes te/ 'o lags so nga'i bu la ming btags tshar/ nged

ra༅༅/ /kyi brgyud pa 'di la bu re re las mi 'ong ba yin pas/ da lan bur skyes yod 'dug pa de/ thos pa'i gtam la dga' ba zhig byung bas nga'i bu'i ming la thos pa dga' zer/ da sbong rnams kyang tshar bas 'gro zer nas yul du byon/ nga'i ming thos pa dga' rang du btags/ ming ston bzang po byas nas gces par bskyed bsrings/ phyis nga la skad snyan po thos tshad sems dga' ba zhig byung bas/ mi rnams kyis thos pa dga' de ming btags legs shig byung 'dug zer ba byung / de nas nga lo bzhi 'one pa'i tshe/ a ma la bu mo zhig skyes pa mgoni mo skyid du ming btags/ gces ming be tar chags pas pe ta mgon skyid du grags te/ nged ming sring gnyis ka la gser ral dang g.yu ral nyil le ba sku(da pa dran/ yul na'ang kha drag cing dbang btsan pas yul mi drag pa rnams dang gnyen sdeb/ zhan pa rnams 'bangs su khol bas chog pa byung ba'i tshe/ yul

mi rnams kyi lkog lab la 'khyam po yul du chags pa la 'di tsho bas pho rgod pa dang nor che ba mi 'ong / phyi'i khang zhing nang gi rdig /pho mo'i rgyan gang la bltas rung chog par 'dug zer/ kun smon di re ba'i ngang nas mi la rdo rje seng ge sku gshegs te/ thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs rnams rgyas par bsgrabs pa yin gsungs/ sku bltams pa'i mdzad pa ste dang po'o// //gnyis pa ni/ yang ras chung pas zhus pa/ bla ma lags/ dang po yab dang bral bas 'o brgyal mang po rothugs nyams su bzhes gsungs pa ci 'dra bzhes lags zhus pas/ de nas nga lo bdun tsam 'gro ba'i tshe/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan de snyung gzhi drag po rang zhig gis zin nas/ sman pa dang mo ma rnams kyis kyang mi 'tsho bar lung bstan cing bor/ gnyen nye 'brel rnams kyis kyang mi 'tsho bar shes/ khong rang yang mi 'tsho bar kho thag chod nas/ a khu dang a ne+e la sogs gnyen nye ring grogs dga' bshes

ra༅༅/ /yul mi khyim mtshes drag pa kun bsags te/ bu smad nor dang bcas pa bcol/ btams byas nas/ mthar pha shul bus 'dzin du 'jug pa'i kha chems yi ge rgyas par byas te/ kun gyis thos par bsgrags/ don bsdu la ngag tu nga da lan gyi nad 'dis mi gtong ba 'dug cing / des na nga'i bu 'di yang da lta chung 'dug pas/ a khu dang a nes gtso byas pa'i gnyen bshes kun la bcol btams bya rgyu la/ nga'i phu na nor gnag rta lug gsum/ mda' na 'or ma gru gsum gyis gtso byas pa'i zhing sprang mig tu mi tshud pa 'ga'/ khang pa'i 'og na phyugs ba ra bong gsum/ steng khang na rdig gser dngul zangs lcags g.yu dang gos dar 'bru'i bang mdzod la serdzogs te/ mdor na mi nor gzhan la smon mi dgos pa yod pas/ 'di rnams kyi steng nas cha shas shig nga rang gi rjes su thongs/ de lhag rnams khyed 'dir tshogs kun la nga rang gi bu 'dis khyim so ma zin gyi bar la

bcol lo/ /khyad par du a khu dang a ne gnyis la bcol lo/ /bu 'dis khyim so pher ba dang / mdzes se dang chung gnyen bsgrigs yod pas/ mo rang mna' mar bsu nor rnams lhag lus med par phog la pha sdos bus 'dzin du chug cig /de bar la nga'i bu smad gsum gyi skyid sdug khyed a khu dang anes gtso byas pa'i gnyen tshan kun shes so/ /sdug tu ma 'jug cig /nga shi dur khung nas blta'o zhes gsungs nas grongs so/ /de nas yab kyi gshegs rdzongs rnams byas/ de lhag gi nor rnams kun kha 'cham par/ myang tsha dkar rgyan rang tshags byed du chug /kha 'dzin dgos pa kun gyis zur nas ci legs gyis zer ba la/ a khu dang a ne+e gnyis na re mi nye byas rung drung po nyi/ khong ma smad nged kyis sdug tu mi 'jug /nor rnams kha chems bzhin nged kyis tshags byed zer nas/ nga'i zhang po dang mdzes se'i pha ming gis lo rgyus byas rung ma nyan par tho nor rnams a khus byas/ mo nor

ra༅༅/ /rnams a nes byas/ gzhan rnams phyed mar bgos te/ khyed ma smad rnams gso res byed zer nas/ nged ma bu gsum la nor dbang rgyu ma byung ba'i khar/ dgrar zhing las byed dus a khu'i g.yog /dgun bal las byed dus a ne'i g.yerdzog /lto khyi'i lto las bong las/ gos hrul phrag thag chad pa la dres ma'i ske rags bcings pa rgyan nas/ las dal med byed dgos byung bas yan lag rnams ser kar song / sto gos ngan pa'i stobs kyis kha mdog skya la sha rid pa/ skra dang po gser g.yu'i ral pa nyil le ba la/ phyis skya bo bseng bseng shig sre'i ral pa nyil le ba byung bas/ mthong ba dang thos pa'i mi sems chung kun mchi ma 'chor ba dang / a khu dang a ne la lkog lab dir re ba byung rung 'dzem med byas/ nged ma smad la sdug po rang btang bas/ a mas a ne+e la khyung tsha dpal 'gran du mi 'dug bdud mo rdzostag 'gran du 'dug byas pas/ a ne la

bdud mo stag 'gran du ming chags/ de dus 'jig rten pa'i gtam dpe la/ mi bdag bdag tu re bdag po sgo khyir 'done zer ba de nged ma smad la byung / sngar yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mi drag zhan kun nged kyi zhal 'dzum dkar nag lta ba yin te/ phyis nor 〈snad rgyal po'i tshul du sku1nga nas/ a khu dang a ne'i zhal 'dzum dkar nag lta ba byung / a ma la yang mi rnams kyis skosnag lab tu khyo phyug chung ma grung / bal 'jam snam bu legs zer ba de bden par 'dug ste/ mi tre chod re med tsa na dpe 'di dang 'dra/ dang po myang tsha dkar rgyan khyo bzang gis mgo 'don dus/ mo blo khog che la grung / lag bcud che zer ba yod de/ da grung zhan gyis shan phyed nas gda'o zer/ sdug res byung na lab res kyi dpe der/ rang las zhan pa kun gyis rgyab nas 'phya ba byung / nga la mdzes se'i pha mas gos lham so ma re byin nas/ mi nor du ma song na/ nor mi rtag rtswa kha'i

ra༅༅/ /zil pa bya ba yin pas nor med snyam pa mi dgos/ dang po yab mes rnams la'ang nor sting sor byung ba yin/ khyed rang tsho la'ang nor yod pa'i dus 'ong zer nas sems gso yang yang btang / de nas nga lo bco lnga tsam 'od pa'i tshe/ a ma la pha mas byin pa'i zhing skal bre pe stan chung bya ba ming mi snyan rung stoni thog gzhun po 'ong ba zhig yod pa de/ zhang pos so nam byas pa'i nas skyed 'phel du ci 'gro byas nas phag tu sog gin yod pa yang mang rab tu song ba la sha mang po nyos/ nas dkar mo mang po la phye byas/ nag po mang po chang du btsos pas myang tsha dkar rgyan ma smad nor slong byed pa yin pa 'dug zer ba byung / de nas nged rang gi khang pa ka bzhi gdung brgyad ma der gdan mang po g.yar nas bting ste/ a khu dang a nes gtso byas pa'i gnyen nye 'kherdzor/ grerdzogs dga' bshes yul mi khyim mtshes rnams dang / khyad par yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan sku

gshegs khar zhal chems kyi yi ge rgyus yod pa rnams bos te/ a khu dang a ne la sha khog 'dzugs/ gzhan gzug thob pa la gzug /lhu thob pa la lhu/ chang dkar yol gyi g.yang tshe dang bcas pa'i stoni mo bzange po drangs nas/ a mas gral gyi dbus su langs te/ 'o lags so/ /bu skyes pa la ming chang drangs pa la gtam bya bar gda' bas/ nga yang gtam tshig gsum pa zhig gtong ba lags pas/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan sku thim khar zhal chems gsungs pa rgyus yod kyi mi bgres pa a khu dang a ne+es gtso mdzad/ 'dir bzhugs kyi gral pa rnams snyan gsan par zhu zhes brjod nas/ zhang pos yab kyi zhal chems kyi ye ge bklags pa'i mthar/ a mas yi ge 'di'i done gsung ngag dang bcas pa 'dir bzhugs kyi bgres pa kun gyi thugs la gsal bas rgyas par zhu mi dgos par gda'/ done dril ba la sngar phan a khu dang a ne gnyis kyis nged ma smad gsum la

ra༅༅/ /mgo 'don yang dag mdzad pa thugs la btags/ da nga rang gi bu dang / mdzes se gnyis kas khyim se zin par 'dug pas/ nged rang gi nor bcol rnams sprod pa dang / mdzes se yang mna' mar bsus nas yab kyi zhal chems bzhin pha shul bus 'dzin du 'jug par zhu byas pas/ a khu dang a ne gnyis ci la mi 'cham rung sto la 'cham pa dang / nga bu gcig por song ba dang / a khu la bu mang po yod pa'i stabs kyis/ a ne dang a khu gnyis gcig tu dril nas khyed kyi nor ram de gang na yod pa yin/ dang po mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan kho rang khams bzang ring la khang zhing gser g.yu mdzo rta gnag lug rnams nged kyis g.yar btang ba/ kho rang 'chi kar nor bdag po la sprad pa yin/ khyed rang dbang ba'i nor gser se gcig gam/ nas 'phul gang ngam/ mar nyag gcig gam/ gos dar rkyang sna gcig /dud 'gro tshe 'dzugs gcig kyang mig

gis ma mthong ba la da 'di 'dra zer ba/ khyedi kyi kha chems kyi yi ge sus bris/ sdug smad tsho stogs grir ma bsad par gsos pa nged rab yin/ lar mi ngan la dbang bskur na chu la bres 'jal byed bya ba de 'di 'dra la zer ba yin zer/ sna bus stan las har langs byas/ se bosgol gtogs/ thu ba sprugs/ rkang pa brdabs nas nan tar ma serdzong na khang pa yang nged dbang bas/ ma smad tsho phyir song zer zhing a mar thal lcag gis brdungs/ nged ming sring gnyis phu dung gi lcag gis brdung / de'i tshe a ma ni/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nged ma smad kyi las ba〉snas la gzigs dang / nga shi dur khung nas blta'o/ /gsungs pa de gzigs pa'i dus la bab gda' 'o zer/ ngu zhing 'gyel nas 'gre 'ordzog log byed cing 'dug /nged ming sring gnyis kyis ni ra mda' ngu ba min pa ma byung / a zhang gis ni a khu la bu mang po yod pas rgelo ma nus/ gzhan yul mi nged rang la dkar ba

ra༅༅/ /rnams ni nged ma smad tsho'i snying rje ba la zer ba mi ngu ba mi 'dug /gzhan rnams kyang shugs ring nar nar 'dug /a khu dang a ne ni nged la nor dgos zer/ nor khyed rang la 'dug pa/ yul mi khyim mtshes la sha chang phangs med bshams nas stone mo bsham rgyu 'dug pa/ khyed kyi nor ram de nged la med/ yode na'ang mi gtong bas ma smad tsho mang na dmag drongs/ nyung na mthu thong zer zhing thon song / de'i phyi bzhin khong la dkar mi rnams kyang thon song / a ma ni de nas kyang ngu thag ma chod par 'dug pa la /0 zhang po dang mdzes se'i pha ming sogs nged rang gi dkar mi kun a ma'i sems gso phyir bsdad nas/ chang lhag rnams 'thung zhing a ma la da ma ngu ngus pas mi phan/ de ring 'dir ston gral du tshogs pa kun la nor slong re gyis/ nged 'di na yod pa kun gyis kyang ci drag re ster/ a khu dang a ne+e gnyis kyis kyang ci drag re ster 'ong zer ba la/ a zhang

na re de ka gyis la bu 'di yon tan zhig slob tu thong / khyed rang ma smad nga'i sar sdod la zhing gi so nam gyis/ ci phan byed pa las 'os med/ gang na'ang a khu dang a ne la ngo mi tsha ba zhig byed dgos zer ba la a ma na re rang gi nor la dbang rgyu ma byung ba'i slong byas pa'i nor gyis bu tsha mi gsos/ a khu dang a nes nged rang gi nor gyi cha gcig sprad rung ster dbesnas med/ bu 'di skusnan tan zhig slob tu cis kyang gtong / nged ma smad a khu dang a nes gsha' ma rang ma bcol ba'i rting la/ rnga gdang rgyug dang dud pa lang rgyug byas nas/ khong gnyis kyi mngon blo 'phyar ba yin/ zhing gi so nam yang 'di ka nas byed zer nas/ rtsa'i mi thod gad kha bya ba na sngags rnying ma pa'i slob dpon klu brgyad mkhan grong chog la shin tu brin pa zhig yod pa der nga klog slob tu btang / de dus gnyen rnams kyis kyang nor slong sna re sna gnyis byin 'dug /khyad par mdzes se'i pha mas rgyags chu sdor me shing

ra༅༅/ /yan bskur nas nga klog slob sar mdzes se mo rang sems gso la yang yang btang byung / a zhang gis a ma dang sring mo mi las dang sprang du mi 'gro ba'i dus kyi lto byin/ a ma sprang du a zhang gis ma bcug par mi'i las nyin 'khal nyin thags byed cing / nged ming sring la ci phan dang nor ci gsog byas/ sring mos ci lcogs kyis mi g.yog dang / rnga gdang rgyug dud pa lang rgyug byas nas lto gos ci rnyed byas rung / sto skya la gos hrul ba yid pham pa las skyid po rang ma myong gsungs pas/ de'i tshe chos nyan du gyur tshad thugs skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi 〉rdzo nas mchi ma 'don zhing dar cig kun kha rog par 'dug go/ /sdug bsngal gyi bden pa phul phyin thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i mdzad pa ste gnyis pa'o// //gsum pa ni/ yang ras chung pas rje btsun lags/ rje btsun gyis dang po las nag po mdzad gsungs pa ci lta bu zhig mdzad zhus pas/ mthu

dang ser bas sdig bsags pa yin gsungs/ rje btsun mthu dang ser ba slob pa'i nye bar len pa'i rkyen ci lta bu zhig byung zhus pas/ nga mi thod gad kha na klog slob dus rtsa'i mda' ru/ skyid ston gyi chang sa chen po zhig byung ba de'i gral dbu la slob dpon spyan drangs pa'i phyag phyi la ngas kyang phyin/ der chang mang ba dang slob dpon la zur nas kyang chang 'dren mang rab byung ba kun nas btung bas bzi ber song 〈snad pa la/ slob dpon gyis nga la khyos ma rnams bskur te sngoni la brdzangs pas/ chang gis bzi ba dang / de'i nyin glu len mkhan rnams la sems 'phros nas/ glu len snying 'dod pa zhig byung ba dang / gre ba bde mo zhig yod pas/ glu len zhing 'ongs pas/ nged rang gi khang pa'i mdun na yar lam yode pas sgo'i thad du sleb rung glu blangs pas/ a ma nang na yos rjod kyin yod pas thos nas/ ci zer skad 'di ni nga'i bu'i skad 'dra/ nged ma smad bas sdug pa ni sa thog na med pas kho ni

ra༅༅/ /glu len mi thang snyam nas yid ma ches par bltas pas/ nga yin par shes nas ha las te/ skam pa g.yas su sor/ yos dkrugs g.yon du bor/ yos brngod 'phro rtsig tu bcug /lag pa g.yas su yog pa zhig khyer/ g.yoni du thal ba spar gang khyer/ skas ring ba la babs/ thung ba la mchongs nas phyir thoni byung ste/ thal ba de gdong la btab/ skusnag pa de mgo la lan 'ga' brgyab nas/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan khyed la bu 'di 'dra skyes se(/ /khyed rabs chad gda' ba/ nged ma smad kyi las bskos la gzigs dang zer a ma yug cig brgyal nas 'gyel 'dug pa'i tshe/ sring mo yang thon byung ste/ a khro'i bsam blo la a ma la stos dang zer ngu zhing 'dug pa la bden snyam nas/ nga rang yang mchi ma mang po cerdzor/ nged ming sring gnyis kyis ngu ba'i ngang nas a ma'i lag pa mnyed bzhin bos pas dar cig nas brgyal ba sangs te langs

byung nas/ ngu ba'i gdong gis nga la ce re bltas nas/ bu rang nged ma smad bas sdug pa sa thog na med pa la khyod glu len pa dran pa rang 'dug gam/ nga ma rgan mo shi bsam mno gtong gin yi mu ga pa dang ngu bro ba min pa mi 'dug zer/ smre sngags 'don zhing nged ma smad gsum kas ngus so/ /de nas ngas a ma la a ma bden te/ de tsam gyi sdug pa ma byed/ ngas a ma gang 'dod pa'i las bya'o byas pas/ a ma na re nga dag khyod kyi steng du ber rgyan/ 'og tu rta zhon pa'i yob chen sdang ba dgra 'di tsho'i gnya' thog na phar shud de ba zhig 'dod pa yin te/ de rang mi 'ong ba 'dra/ ngan ga〈sna che rab 'ong ba 'dra ba 'dug pas/ mthu gtad ser gsum mthar phyin pa zhig bslabs nas/ a khu dang a nes gtso byas pa'i yul mi khyim mtshes rang re ma smad la sdug po gtong mkhan 'di kun rtsa ba dgu brgyud nas rabs chad pa zhig 'dod de/ e 'ong stos dang zer ba la/ ngas e 'ong blta'o a ma

ra༅༅/ /rang bla ma'i 'bul ba dang nga rang gi rgyags ci 'gror grabs gyis shig byas pas/ a mas mthu slob pa'i cha rkyen du zhing bre pe stan chung gis phyed btsongs pa'i rin la g.yu skar chen 'od 'phro bya ba zhig dang / rta dkar po seng ge srab med bya ba yul na dga' ba zhig dang / tshos ltang gnyis bur ltang gnyis khugs 'dug pa'i bur ltang gnyis 'phral dbosgos la spyad nas grabs tshar ba dang / ngas gung thang gi lhun grub mdzad khang bya bar zhag 'ga' bsdad nas lam gregos btsal bas mnga' ris dol nas yin zer ba'i gces phrug lnga dbus gtsang gi phyogs la chos dang mthu slob tu 'gro ba yin zer sleb byung ba la/ nga yang mthu slob tu 'gro bas rang re rnams sdeb 'gro byas pas/ rung zer ba dang / gung thang smad du khrid phyin nas zhag shas nged kyis zhabs tog byas/ de bar la a mas khong rnams la nga'i phag tu nged kyi bu 'di la snying rus ye med do/ /khyed grogs po

rnams kyis bskul lcag gyis la mthu shin tu mkhas pa zhig slobes cerdzog cig 'dir sleb dus sna len dang bya dga' gzab pa byed do zer ba byas 'dug /de nas rta la tshos ltang gnyis bkal/ g.yu lus la bcangs te/ nged rnams kyis lam du chas pa la/ a mas thag ring gi bar du skyel du phyin pa'i lam bar dang / skyel chang 'thung sar/ a mas nga'i grogs po rnams la kha brda mang po byed cing 'dug /khyad par du nga rang zur du bkar nas/ ma gcig dang bu gcig 'bral mi phod par a mas nga'i lag pa nas bzung ste bcang bcang byas shing / gdong mchi mas gang ba'i ngu / ngag gis bu 'u cag ma smad kyi las bskos la stos la/ yul du mthu'i rtags thon pa zhig cis kyang gyis shog cig /khong tsho'i mthu dang 'u cag gis mthu mi 'dra'o/ /khong tsho gces phrug rang dga' rgyags pa'i mthu yin par 'dug /'u cag ma smad sdug thug pa'i mthu yin pas khyod snying rus skyed 3snag cig /

ra༅༅/ /brgya la gal te bu khyod kyis yul du mthu'i rtags ma thon par log byung na/ nga ma rgan mo khyod rang gi mdun du lcebs nas shi sdod do zer/ dam bca' bsgos nas nged ma smad serdzo sor gyes pa las/ nga a ma la sems 'phreng drags te/ yang yang phyi mig blta ba dang mchi ma mang po cerdzor/ a ma yang nga bu gcig po la sems 'phreng bas/ nged rnams mthong mthong gi bar du nga la mig ce re ngu zhing bsdad 'dug pa la/ nga yang a ma dang yud tsam zhig phrad pa la phyir 'ordzog gam 'ordzog gam snyam pa'i sems shin tu 'phreng ba zhig byung ste/ nged ma smad phyis mi phrad pa de sems kyis tshor ba yin par 'dug /mi mthong ba dang a ma yul du ngu zhing 'ordzog phyin pas/ zhag 'ga' nas myang tsha dkar rgyan gyi ngu mthu slob tu song 'dug zer ba'i grags pa chen po byung 'dug /nged rnams kyis dbus gtsang gi lam du zhugs nas phyin pas/ gtsang rong gi g.yag sde zhes bya bar

sleb/ der phyug po chen po gcig la rta dang tshos rnams btsongs pas rin gser du byung ba lus la bcangs te/ gtsang po rgyab nas dbus phyogs la gtad phyin pas/ thon lug ra kha bya bar dbus pa'i ban btsun mang po dang phrad de/ de rnams la dbus phyogs na mthu gtad ser gsum la mkhas pa ji skad bya ba yod dris pas/ ban+de gcig na re yar lung skyor po grong bya ba na bla ma gnyags g.yung stod khro rgyal bya ba bzhugs te/ khong mthu gtad sogs drag sngags la grub pa thob pa yin zer te/ ban+de de khong gi slob mar 'dug /de nas nged rnams kyis bla ma g.yung ston khro rgyal rang la gtad phyin pas yar lung skyor po grong du sleb/ bla ma dang mjal ba'i tshe/ khong grogs po rnams ni phyag rten sna re tsam las mi gtong bar 'dug /ngas gser g.yu kun phul te/ 'di min lus ngag yid gsum yang 'bul/ bdag la yul mi khyim mtshes skyid du phangs pa 'ga' bdog pas/ yul du rtags thoni

༄༅༅/ /pa'i mthu phul du phyin pa zhig thugs rjes 'dzin pa zhu zhing / de bar gyi lto gos kyang thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas/ khyod kyi gtam de rnams la brtag par bya gsung / de nas nged rnams la mthu mthil phyin pa ni ma bslabs/ gnam sa kha rdeb pa lta bu'i kha pho yod pa'i ngan sngags sna re tsam dang / yang phan byed kyi gdams ngag phyag len dang bcas pa sna re tsam gnang nas lo gcig tsam song ba dang / nga'i grogs po kun log 'gro grabs byed cing 'dug pa la/ bla mas dbus phrug gi besnas legs pa re kun la btsems nas gnang gin 'dug /nga ni yid cig ma ches te/ mthu de dag gi yul du rtags thon pa yang dka' bar 'dug /mthu'i rtags ma thon par yul du 'ordzog rung a ma lcebs te 'chi ba min pa mi 'ong snyam nas grabs ma byas pas/ grogs po rnams na re/ thos pa dga' yar mi 'gro'am zer/ nga 'gro ba la mthu ma

'ordzobs byas pas/ khong rnams na re rang res bsten pa skyel nus na gdams ngag de kun zab mo rang 'dug /bla ma rang la'ang de bas lhag pa med gsung gin 'dug pas/ nged rnams kyis mthu'i sgro 'dogs chod/ khyodi rang lhag ma 'dra e gnang ltos sgordzog zer/ khong sbos bla ma la gtang rag dang phyag phul nas chas 'dug pa la/ ngas kyang bla mas gnang ba'i gos de rgyane nas khong rnams gro lam zhig gi bar bskyal/ khams bde byas nas khong cho yul du log song / ngas bla ma'i drung du log 'ongs pa'i lam la/ rta bong gi sbangs/ ba glang gi lci ba/ khyi lud rnams 'thu zhing 'ongs pas thu ba khrig pa gang rnyed nga// bla ma'i gsol zhing gzhin po rang zhig yode pa de'i khar sa khung brus shing sbas pa/ bla ma gzims khang gi steng na yod pas gzigs te/ grwa pa 'ga' la nga la sngar slob ma ji snyed cig byung ste/ ma gi bas sha tsha ba ma byung / da dung yang mi 'ong / kho da nang nga la khams

ra༅༅/ /bde zhur mi 'ong ba de yang log 'ong ba'i rtags su 'dug /kho dang po nga'i sar sleb 'ongs pa'i tshe'ang nga la yu la mi khyim mtshes skyid du phangs pa tsho zhig yod pas/ mthu gnang bar zhu lus ngag yid gsum 'bul zer/ glen pa ma gi 'dra zhig 'ong ba/ kho'i gtam de rnams bden na ni mthu ma byin na snying yang rje bar 'dug gsungs pa grwa pa zhig gis nga la bskyar bas/ go bcad mthu zur pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug snyam dga' nas/ bla ma'i drung du phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal da la thos pa dga' khyod 'ordzog mi 'grerdzo ba ci yin gsungs/ der ngas bla ma rang gis gnang ba'i gos des phyag rten byas phyag phul/ zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag nged ma smad gsum yodi pa la.a khu dang a nes gtso byas pa'i yul mi khyim mtshes 'ga' dgrar langs te/ mi 'tsham pa'i spyod khyer sna tshogs kyi :rdzo nas sdug po rang btang / de la lan gzhan glan pa'i stosnabs med

par/ a mas bdag mthu slob tu brdzangs pa lags/ bdag gis mthu'i rtags ma thoni par yul du 'ordzog na/ bdag gi mdun du a ma lcebs nas 'chi ba yerdzod pas ma phyin pa lags/ des na mthu mthil phyin pa zhig gnang bar zhu zhes zhu ba phul nas ngus pas/ khyod la yul mis sdug po ci 'dra btang gsung / ngas yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan sku gshegs tshul nas/ a khu dang a nes sdug yo btang tshul rnams ngu ngag gis rgyas par zhus pas/ bla ma yang spyan chab nyil mdzad nas/ de ltar bden na ha cang mi 'os par 'dug pas/ mthu ngas byas kyang chog par 'dug ste/ tab tob lar mi 'dren/ lar nga'i mthu 'di la stod mnga' ris snyor gsum nas gser g.yu brgya 'bul stong 'bul/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum nas ja sigs dang gos dar brgya 'bul stong 'bul/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi nas snam phrug dang mar nas brgya 'bul stong 'bul/ byar dwags kong

ra༅༅/ /gsum nas mdzo rta dang gnag lug brgya 'bul stong 'bul byung ste/ lus ngag yid gsum 'bul zer ba khyod las ma byung bas/ mi khyod kyi gtam de la brtag pa myur ba zhig byed gsungs nas de'i tshe bla ma la grwa pa rta bas bang mgyogs pa/ glang po che bas stobes che ba zhig yod pa de nga'i yul du bltar btang bas/ khong myur du 'khor byung ste/ bla ma rin po che thos pa dga' bden par 'dug pas/ mthu shin tu gnang dgos par gda'o zhu zhing 'dug pa la/ nga la bla ma'i zhal nas/ dang po nas tsab tsob la mthu byin na glen pa khyod kyis gyod byas kyis dogs pa yin/ da bden pa yod 'dug pas/ mthu ster mthu slob tu gzhan zhig tu 'gro dgos te/ nga la mthu gza' gdong dmar nag ces bya ba hūm̐ shi dang phaṭa 'gyel thongs pa zhig yod pa de/ gtsang rong gi gnubs khu lung bya ba na bla ma khu lung pa yone tan rgya mtsho bya ba sman yang shes sngags kyang shes pa zhig yodi pa

de la byin/ khong la ser ba mdzub khrid thongs pa zhig 'dug pa de nga la byin nas/ nged gnyis mthun pa'i grogs po byas te/ nga la mthu slob tu byung tshad khong can du btang bar byas/ khong la ser ba slob tu byung tshad nga can du btang bar byas yod pas/ des na khyod kyang khong gi drung du nga rang gi bu 'di dang bsdebs nas gtong ba yin gsungs/ khong rang gi sras che ba dar ma dbang phyug bya ba dang / nga gnyis la rgyags zong du dbus kyi phrug dang ther ma 'dres pa mdzo khal gcig dang / phyag rtags rten dang bcas pa bskur nas/ gtsang rong gi gnubs khu lung du byone pas/ bla ma gnubs chung ba dang mjal te/ snam bu bubs re'i phyag rten dang / bla ma'i phyag rtags rten dang bcas pa phul nas/ der yang rgyu mtshan 'ordzo rgyus zhib par zhus te mthu thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga'i grerdzogs po phyi thag ring / lab rjes btsan/ khyed gnyis la mthu'i gdams ngag

ra༅༅/ /cis kyang ster ba yin pas/ ri sna ma kir lag mthus glags mi cha ba'i sgrub khang rtsigs gsungs/ der 'og tu thog rim gsum yod pa/ steng du thog rim gcig skurdzod pa la gdung bzang po nya gzhib gzhib btang / mtha' pha bong g.yag ro tsam gyis go mtshams med par gtams nas/ sgrub khang gi 〉sna gzhan gyis mi shes pa dang / lag mthus glags mi rnyed pa byas/ de nas mthu'i gdams ngag gnang ste/ mthu bsgrubs nas zhag bdun song ba dang / bla ma byon nas/ sngar yin na zhag bdun res chog gi skurdzod/ da lan yang des chog 'ong gsung pa la/ ngas thag ring gi mthu lags pas da dung yang zhag bdun bsgrub par zhu zhus pas/ 'o na sgrubs shig gsung bsgrubs pas/ zhag bcu bzhi 'gro ba'i nub mo/ yang bla ma byon te/ do nub dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mthu'i rtags yong ba yod do gsungs/ de'i nub mo bka' srung dam can rnams kyis mi

mgo sum cu so lnga don snying dang bcas pa dmar tsa re khyer byung nas/ kha sang nas nged 'bod rang 'bod cing bskul ba de 'di ka dgos pa yin 'ong zer dkyil 'khor gyi mthar spungs serdzong / nang par yang bla ma byone nas da dung bsgral rgyu gnyis 'dug pa sgrol lam 'jog gsung / der ngas snying tshim dang bden gshags bdar ba'i rten du 'jog par zhu zhus nas bzhag pas a khu dang a ne lus 'dug /der dam can chos skyodang rnams la gtang rag gi tshogs gtor phul nas mtshams grerdzol 'o// /khu lung na da lta yang sgrub khang gi shul yotshed do/ /de'i dus nga'i yul skya rnga rtsa ru/ mthu'i rtags ci 'dra zhig byung snyam na/ a khu'i bu che ba la bag ma blangs pa'i bag ston gyi sar/ a khu'i bu rnams dang mna' mas thog drangs nged ma smad la shin tu sdang ba'i mi mda' sum cu so lnga nang du 'dzom/ mdzad po gzhan rnams dang nged la dkar mi rnams chas 'ong ba'i lam bar gyi gleng mo la/ mi bdag

ra༅༅/ /bdag tu re/ bdag po sgo khyir 'don zer ba'i gtam dpe ji bzhin byed mkhan snying ma sdug 'di tsho la thos pa dga'i dag mthu mi 'ong rung / dkon mchog gi bden mthu zhig 'ong 'thad pa la zer 'dus 'ong ba rnams nang du ma tshud tsam gyi bar der/ a khu dang a ne gnyis kyis mi 'di la za ma 'di ster dang lan 'di bsdog gi gros byed cing phyir bsdad pa'i dus su/ sngar nged rang gi g.yog mo phyis a khu'i g.yog byed pa zhig gis chu bcu ru phyin pas/ ra ba na rta mang po btags yod pa ma mthong bar/ sdig pa dang / sngerdzom dang / sbrul dang / sbal 〈snang la serdzogs pas gang ba'i nang na sdig pa rwa can g.yag shad tsam zhig gi rwa bar na ka ba bcug ste phyir 'then pa mthong bas 'jigs drags bros te phyir thon ma thag tu/ ra ba na rta rgod ma tshan ma dang gseb 'dres pa mang po btags yod pa las/ gseb kyis rgod ma rtses pas/ rta kun 'grogs pa'i 'phra tho dang / rgod

mas gseb la 'phra brgyab pa ka ba la phog pas ka ba 'gyel te khyim gtibs pa'i gtibs 'og tu a khu'i bu rnams dang / mna' ma serdzogs mi mda' sum cu serdzo lnga shi bas khang pa'i nang sa tshub dang ros gang / phyi ngu chong gis gang ba de pe tas mthong ste/ myur du a ma'i sar phyin nas/ a ma a ma a khu'i khyim gtibs nas mi mang po shi 'dug ltos dang zer ba'i gtam bshad pas/ a mas bden nam mi bden snyam dga' drags langs te bltas pas/ a khu'i khyim sa tshub phyur re ba dang / lung pa ngu tsi theg theg pa mthong ste/ ha las pa ltar dga' nas/ de'i tshe a mas dbyug pa ring po zhig gi rtse la gos hrul bskyon te 'phyar nas/ skad chen pos gsol lo mchod cig lha bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ kho de yul mi khyim mtshes pa kun mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan la bu skyes e 'dug /nga myang tsha dkar rgyan gyis gos hrul rgyane/ lto ngan zos nas bu'i rgyags sbyangs pa la don byung e 'dug

ra༅༅/ /ltos dang / dang po a khu dang a ne gnyis na re nged ma smad kun mang na dmag drongs/ nyung na mthu thong zer ba byas so/ /da nyung ba'i mthu btang bas mang ba'i dmag las lhag pa zhig byung ngo / /steng gi mi la ltos/ 'og gi phyugs la ltos/ bar gyi nor la stos/ lar ma shi tshe ring tsa na/ bus bstan pa'i ltad mo 'di 'dra mthong ba'i dus byung ba yin/ nga myang tsha dkar rgyan la da lan las nyams dga' ba e 'ong stor+shas dang zer/ snying tshim dang gzhag bdar ba khyim du ma tshud pa kun gyis thos pas la la na re mo bden byed du 'ong zer/ la la na re bden pa bden te da lan ha cang drags zer/ de stobs kyis mi shi byung ba kun gyis thos nas 'tshogs te/ mos da lan gyi phung chen 'di gamardzos pas ma chog par snying tshim de byas/ ma 'tsham drags pas/ sdug sna dgu btang rjes gserdzon snying la dmar 'don byed zer ba la/ rgan pa rnams na re mor+sha bsad pas ci la

phan/ yang rang re tsho la mo'i bus 'di 'dra ba zhig 'ong ba de ka yin mod/ de bas dang por mo'i bu btsal te lag mthus gsod ci thub gyis/ de nas mo rang gsode lugs sla zer ba la kha 'cham/ a khus thos pas/ nged la bu 'chi rgyu dang bu mo 'chi rgyu med/ nga rang ni shi na dga' zer/ a ma gsede par chas pa la/ yul mi rnams kyis bzung ste/ dang po yang khyed kyi kha phyir 'grol bas yul 'dir phung 'di byung ba yin/ da yang mo'i bu ma sedi par las 'di byed na rang re tsho 'thab byas pas/ a khu la bya thabs ma byung bar lus/ de nas yul mi rnams kyis nga gsod du gtong ba'i gros byas pas/ zhang po a ma'i sar 'ongs nas/ kha sang gi gtam de dang byed lugs des/ da yul mi rnams kyis khyod rang dang bu lag mthus gserdzod par 'dug gis/ nus pa rang ci yod dam mthu byung ba rang gis chog mod zer mang po 'bar du byung ba la/ a mas zhang yo rang gi thog tu ma byung ba

ra༅༅/ /lags/ de tsam gyi go ba zhig dag nga la yang yod de/ nga'i nor tshan de phrogs pa'i khar byed lugs de byas pas bsran bzod pa dka' mo ka gda' zhes lan gzhan ma bcal bar ngus pas/ zhang po yang bden pa khyod ka bden/ da gsod mkhan byung dogs yod pas sgo dam du chug zer thon song / steng sgo dam pa'i ngang nas bsam blo mang po gtong zhing yod pa'i skabs su/ a khu'i g.yog mo sngar nged rang gi yin pa des/ khong tsho gros byed pa thos nas mos rus zhen gyis ma bzod par/ a ma la khong tsho gros 'di ltar byed cing 'dug pas sras kyi srog zen mdzod cig ces bya btang bas/ a ma'i bsam pa la/ khong tsho'i gros de nga re zhig blo bde tshar snyam nas/ zhing bre pe stan chung gi phyed po yang btsongs pa'i rin la gser srang bdun byung ba/ yul pa'i mi btang bas ni ma byung / gzhan bang chen ni ma 'gyor pas/ a ma rang nga la phrad pa dang hrugs skyel ba dang kha ta

'jug pa la 'ong snyam pa'i tshe/ dbus phyogs kyi rnal 'gyor pa bal po bskor nas log 'gro ba zhig ldom bu byed du byung ba la/ lo rgyus rnams zhib par dris pas/ bang chen gyi 'os su byung ste/ zhag 'ga' 'dir bzhugs/ dbus gtsang gi phyogs na nga'i bu zhig yod pas/ de la phrin re tsam bskur ba yin pas/ de rnams kyang sprod grogs gyis byas nas/ de bar la zhabs tog skyid du tshor ba byas/ a mas mar me zhig spar te/ nga'i bsam pa bzhin grub na mar me 'di yun ring du gnas pa dang / mi 'grub na myur du 'chi ba'i phrin las thos pa dga'i bla ma dang chos skyong rnams kyis mdzod cig byas dmod bor bas/ mar mes nyin zhag phrugs gcig thub ste/ bsam pa grub par yid ches nas/ rnal 'gyor pa rgyal khams bsterdzor ba la treres lham gal che bas/ lhan pa dang krad pa gyis byas lham gyi krad rgyun rnams kherdzo rang la sprad/ bordzos bem po zhig 'dug pa de la a ma rang gis lhan pa

ra༅༅/ /rgyab/ bem po'i nang gi rgyab gzhung du/ rnal 'gyor pa la rgyus med pa'i gser srang bdun po sbas pa'i steng du lhan pa nag po kha gang gru bzhi pa zhig rgyab/ dbus su skud pa dkar la sbom pa'i gzer tshom skar ma smin drug gi dbyibs 'dra ba phyir mi mngon pa zhig gis mnan te/ rnal 'gyor pa la yang rngan pa chen po byin nas/ yi ge gab yig la rgya la dam yod pa zhig bskur nas brdzangs so/ /de nas a ma'i bsam pa la yul mi 'di rnams kyi gros byed lugs 'dis/ ci byed mi shes pas sdigs mo zhig byed dgos snyam/ pe ta la bslabs nas/ kha sang gi rnal 'gyor pa de la a jos yi ge bskur byung bya ba kun la bsgrags/ a mas ngas bskur ba ltar byas pa'i yi ge/ a ma dang sring mo khams bzang ngos nas mthu'i rtags mthong las che/ da dung yul mis khyed ma smad la sgos su sdang po byed mi byung na ming rus yi ge la bris la bskur thong / ngas mthu la brten

nas mi'i srog gcod pa za ma'i phud mchod pa bas sla bar 'dug pas rabs dgu brgyud nas bcad pas chog /yul pa spyis sdang po byas na khyed rang ma smad 'di phyogs su thon 〈snag /ngas yul de byung ba'i rjes kyang med pa zhig bzo ba yin/ nga longs spyod dang 'asbo ba thogs med kyi ngang nas sgrub pa byed cing yod pas nga'i sems las ma byed/ bya ba zhig bris nas rgya byas te/ thog mar zhang po sogs nged rang la dkar mi rnams la bstan/ de nas yi ge zhang po'i lag tu bzhag nas kun gyis mthong bar byas pas/ khong rnams kyi gros 'gyur te/ lag mthu'i bsam sbyor bor nas/ zhing 'or ma gru gsum yang a khu'i lag nas blangs te/ a ma la sprad 'dug /rnal 'gror pa des kyang nga rtsad gcod cing 'ongs pas nga gnubs khu lung na 'dug zer ba thos nas/ nga'i sar byung ste/ a ma dang sring mo skurdzogs yul gyi 'ordzo rgyus rnams rgyas par bshad/ yi ge sprad pa zur zhig tu bklags pas/ thos

ra༅༅/ /pa dga' khams bzang bar skurdzod las che/ ma rgan mo la bu skyes pas bsam pa grub/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rabs zin/ yul du mthu'i rtags thon/ mi mgo sum cu so lnga khang pa gtibs pa'i 'og tu shi/ de'i phyir yul pa 'di pas nged ma smad la gsha' ma rang ma byas pas/ da dung ser ba gyang rim dgu yod zer ba zhig phobs/ des ma rgan mo'i bsam pa mthar phyin pa yin/ yul pa 'di pas khyod tshol du btang nas bsad rting nga yang gsod zer bar 'dug pas/ rang re ma bu gnyis ka'i phyir du srog zon dam par gyis/ rgyags chad na lung pa kha byang du lta ba/ sprin nag po lding zhing / skar ma smin drug 'char ba'i 'og na rang re'i nye tshan grong pa bdun yod pas/ de nas rgyags ci 'dodi 'ong pa yod pas long / rtsad ma chod na lung pa de'i nang na rnal 'gror pa 'di rang bzhugs pa yin pas gzhan du ma 'dri bya ba zhig 'dug pas/ yi ge'i

don ni ma besna/ yul dang a ma ni dran/ rgyags chad pa la shin tu mkho ba zhig skurdzod par 'dug kyang / lung pa dang nye tshan rgyus med pas mchi ma mang po 3(ra/ rnal 'gyor pa de la khyod la nga'i gnyen rnams yod pa'i lung pa rgyus yod par 'dug pa gang yin dris pas/ mnga' ris gung thang yin zer/ de min rgyus med dam khyed rang gi yul gang yin byas pas/ de min lung pa mang po rgyus yod de/ khyod kyi gnyen gyi lung pa rgyus med/ nga rang dbus nas yin zer/ 'o na khyed rang 'dir cung zad cig bzhugs shig /nga da lta rang 'ong gis byas nas/ yi ge de bla ma la phul/ 'o( rgyus rnams zhus pas/ yi ge de tshar gcig gzigs nas/ thos pa dga' khyodi kyi a ma de zhe sdang chen po rang zhig yode par 'dug /mi de tsam shi sting yang da dung ser ba phob zer ba byas gda'/ khyod la byang na nye tshan ci 'dra yod gsung / sngar yod zer ba ni ma thos/ yi ge ni de 'dra gda'/ rnal 'gror pa la

༄༅༅/ /dris pas yang rgyus ni mi gda' zhus pas/ bla ma'i jo mo ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mtshan dang ldan pa zhig yod pa des yi ge tshar gcig bsgrags nas/ rnal 'byor pa de nang du bos shog gsung / bos nas me chen po btang / chang zhim po byin te/ rnal 'gyor pa'i rgyab nas bem po phud de yum gyis rgyan nas/ bem po 'di 'dra rgyani nas rgyal khams bskor ba'i mi la skyi/da 'ong gsung zhing / phar cam tshur cam mdzad/ de nas khang thog la 'dzegs song ste/ yum gyis bem po'i nang nas gser bton/ lhan pa sngar bzhin btsems te/ bem po rnal 'gyor pa rang la g.yogs/ de nub kyi za ma byin nas gnas su bskyal lo/ /de nas yum na re thos pa dga' 'dir bla ma'i drung du shog dang gsung / phyin pas gser srang bdun po gnang byung / gser gang na gda' zhus pas/ rnal 'gyor pa'i bem po'i nang na 'dug /thos pa dga' la ma grung po rang zhig yod par

gda'/ lung pa kha byang du lta ba la nyi ma mi 'char ba ltar rnal 'gyor pa'i bem po'i nang la nyi ma mi 'char ba la zer bar gda'/ sprin nag por lding ba lhan pa nag po kha gang btab pa la zer bar gda'/ skar ma smin drug 'char ba skud pa dkar po'i hab btsems la zer bar gda'/ de'i 'og gi nye tshan grong pa bdun po gser srang bdun ngo la zer bar gda'/ rtsad ma chod na lung pa de'i nang na rnal 'gyor pa 'di rang bzhugs pas gzhan du ma 'dri bya ba/ ma trere na gser rnal 'gyor pa'i bem po la yod pas gzhan du ma tshol bya bar gda' gsung / bla ma'i zhal nas khyed bud med blo sno zer ba bden par gda' gsung shin tu dgyes 'dug /de nas ngas rnal 'gror pa la gser zho gang byin pas dga' song / jo mo la gser zho bdun phul/ bla ma la gser srang gsum phul nas da dung bdag gi ma rgan mosnas ser ba dbertes zer ba gda' bas/ ser ba'i gdams pa thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus

ra༅༅/ /pas/ ser ba dgos na bla ma g.yung ston khro rgyal can du song zhig gsung / bla ma'i yi ge rten dang bcas pa bskur te/ yang yar lung skyor po grong du phyin/ bla ma dang mjal gser srang gsum gyi phyag rten dang / bla ma'i yi ge rten dang bcas pa phul/ ser ba dgos pa'i lo rgyus zhus pas/ mthus skyurdzo chod nga/ra byung ngam gsung / mthus go chod par byung mi mgo sum cu serdzo lnga bsad lags te/ da dung ser ba dgos zer yi ge byung bas thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ de ltar bya gsung gdams ngag gnang nas sgrub khang rnying pa zhig tu bsgrubs pas/ zhag bdun nas thun dong gi nang du sprin 'khrigs/ glog 'khyug /'grug dang gza' rā hu la'i skad 'done pa byung bas/ da ngas ser ba la mdzub khrid byas pas chog pa 'dug snyam pa byung / bla ma'i zhal nas kyang / da ser ba thongs bar 'dug pas khyod kyi yul na 'o glog mtho dman ci 'dra yod rim par

gsung ba la/ ngas yur ma ran pa tsam dang / ljang pa phug rone nub pa tsam yod ces rim par zhus pas/ cung sngas gsung / da ci tsam yod gsung pa la/ snyim 'thoni tsam yod zhus pas/ 'o na ser ba gtong du 'gro ran gsung / nga'i grogs la sngar bang chen la phyin pa de btang ste/ nged gnyis kyis rnal 'gror par brdzus nas phyin pas/ yul du rgan dran ma myong ba'i lo legs byung ba la/ gang dgar rnga rgyu med pa'i lo khrims byas/ rtsas ma sang rnga gnangs rnga dang thug byung / der ngas lung pa'i phu ru thun gsos/ sngags bgrangs pas nam mkha' la sprin byi'u'i ro tsam yang 'dur ma 'dod pa la/ dam can rnams kyi ming nas bos/ yul mis sdug btang tshul gyis bden pa bdar/ bem po brdabs nas mang po ngus pas/ nam mkha' la sprin nag po bsam gyis mi khyab pa glo bur du 'dus nas/ gcig tu 'khrigs te skad cig de nyid la/ 'bru sna gcig kyang lung par ma lus pa'i ser ba

ra༅༅/ /gyang rim gsum tsam yod pa babs te/ ri thams cad grog por song / yul pa thams cad 'bru mig gis mi mthong bas ngu chong du song 'dug /de'i rjes la char rlung chen po zhig byung ste/ nged rang gnyis kyang grang nas brag phug kha byang bstan zhig tu spen ma'i me btang nas bsdad pas/ yul pa'i skyes pa lo'i gtang rag gi sha la ri dwags gsod du phyin pa rnams thos pa dga' 'dis yul pa la sdug btang ba tsam sus kyang ma btang / sngar mi de tsam bsad/ da lo'i 'ordzo legs la 'gru mig gis mi mthong ba bcos/ da kho lag tu tshud na gseni snying la dmar 'done byas/ sha kham re dang khrag thigs pa re btang rung snying na ba mi sangs par 'dug zer zhing / phug pa'i mdun na mar 'gro zhing 'dug pa la/ rgan pa zhig na re/ kha rog kha rog skad chung du chug /brag phug ya gi na dud pa zhig 'dug ci yin mi shes zer ba la/ gzheni pa rnams na re thos pa dga' kho

yin thag chod/ khos 'u cag mthong ba med pas/ yul pas dmag g.yabs te ma bsad na 'dis da dung yul mi 'di phung du 'jug zer zhing log song ba la/ nga'i grogs po na re khyod rang sngon la song / ngas khyod rang yin pa ltar byas te/ snying tshim btab la 'ong gi zer/ nged gnyis kyis zhag bzhi'i nub ding ri'i mgroni khang du 'dzom dus byas/ kho rtsal che ba rgyus yod pas ya mi nga bar bzhag /nga de dus a ma dang lan cig phrad snyam pa la/ dgras 'jigs te myur du bros te gnya' nang skor phyin pas/ rkang pa khyis phug ste 'dzom dus sar dus lam sleb/ grogos po khong tsho'i dmag gis bskor byung ba la/ dkyil gzhags nas 'ongs te/ nye ba'i tshe mgyogs su phyin/ 'gyang ba'i tshe dal du bcug /mtshone rgyab byung ba'i lan du rdo chen po re tsam 'phangs nas/ nga la sgos su su bsdos pa de la mthu gtong ba yin/ ngas snga sor mi de tsam zhig bsad snying tshim po min nam/ da lo'i lo legs

ra༅༅/ /la 'gru mig gis mi mthong ba bcos/ de yang snying tshim po min nam/ de yin pas kyang nga'i a ma dang sring mo la gzha' ma ma byas na/ ngas lung pa 'di'i phu ru gtad 'jug /mda' ru sel 'jug /mi shi ba'i lhag ma rnams kyang rabs dgu brgyud nas bcad de/ yul 'di phung shi skya ther la ma btang na nga min pas/ khyod tsho sgur cig sgur cig zer zhing 'ongs 'dug pa la/ khong tsho skrag nas khyod kyis lan khyod kyis lan zer gcig la gcig rgyad 'jal zhing log song zer/ der grogs pos nga'i sngon la ding rir sleb nas khang gnyer ba la rnal 'gror pa 'di 'dra zhig byung nge dris pas/ ma byung khyed rnal 'gror pa bya ba skyar dad che ba yin/ yul pha gi na chang ston yod der song / snod med na ngas g.yar bas chog zer/ phor pa gting ring la mdog skya ba gshin rje'i gdong 'dra ba zhig g.yar byung ba khyor nas stod mo byed pa'i sar nga gral 'gab cig na yod pa'i 'gram

du byung ste/ khyed kha sang nas mi sleb pa ci yin zer/ ngas kha sang nas bsod snyoms shig la phyin pas/ rkang pa khyis ngug ste mgyogs po ma sleb/ da mi sto ba yod kyis byas 'grogs te log 'ongs pas/ yar lung skyor po grong du sleb/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyed gnyis la khar che chen po rang zhig byung ang gsung / bdag gnyis kyi sngone la mi ni med su las gsan zhus pas/ dam can srung ma rnams zhal ngo tshes bco lnga'i zla ba tsam 'phyar nas sleb byung bas gtang rag yang btang yerdzod gsung dgyes dgyes ltar mdzad cing 'dug ste/ ngas de lta bu'i sgo nas dgra 'thab byas pas las nag po bsags pa yin gsungs/ dgra bo tshar bcad pa'i mdzad pa ste gsum pa dang / thun mong 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa'o// //gnyis pa mchog gyur zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa la'ang skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi 〉( nas mtshan ldan gyi bla ma btsal ba'i mdzad pa/ zhal mjal nas ci

ra༅༅/ /gsung dang du len cing sdug bsngal yi chad kyi dka' ba la brten nas sdig sgrib ma lus sbyangs pa'i mdzad pa/ brtse bas rjes su bzung nas smin grol gyi gdams ngag thobe pa'i mdzad pa/ de nyid bla ma'i drung du ba〉stoms pas nyams rtogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa'i mdzad pa/ gdams ngag la rang byan tshud tshe mnal lam gyi brdas bskul bas chig rgyud kyi gdams ngag thob ste bla ma'i drung nas byon pa'i mdzad pa/ slar yang rkyen gyis 'khor ba la snying po med par gsal thebs pas sgrub pa la yi dam bcas pa'i mdzad pa / bla ma'i bka' sgrub phyir tshe 'di blos btang ste snying rus dang dka' spyad drag pos yengs med du ri la bsgoms pa'i mdzad pa/ de ltar bsgoms pas nyams rtogs gong 'phel du song nas mthar phyin te bsgrubs 'bras kyis bstan pa dang sems can la phan gdags pa'i mdzad pa/ rnam byang gi mdzad phrin rnams rdzogs nas 'grerdzo rnams chos la bskul phyir

gzugs sku chos dbyengs su thim pa'i mdzad pa dang dgu'i dang po ni/ yang ras chung pas bla ma lags/ las dkar po mdzad gsung ba dam pa'i chos las 'os med pas/ rje btsun chos dang mjal ba'i rkyen ci lta bu zhig byung zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga mthu dang ser ba'i sdig la 'grod nas/ chos dran drags nyin zas mi dran/ phyin na sdod snying 'dod/ bsdad na 'gro snying 'dod/ mtshan gnyid du mi 'gro ba'i skyo shas dang nges 'byung yod rung chos la 'gro zer ni ma nus/ bla ma'i zhabs tog byed cing bsdad pa'i ngang nas chos byed pa'i thabs shig ji ltar bya snyam pa'i bsam pa drag po rgyun chags su yodi pa'i tshe/ bla ma la med pa thams cad zad len byas pas chog pa'i yod bdag /zas nor du 'dzom la dad gus che ba zhig yode pa de/ nad drag po zhig gis zin nas/ bla ma sngas srung la gdan drangs song / de nas zhag gsum 'od pa dang / bla ma zhal 'dzum nag rog ge ba zhig byas

ra༅༅/ /byoni byung ba la/ bla ma lags/ de 'dra'i zhal 'dzum nag pa ci lags/ zhus pas/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par 'dug /mdang nga'i yod bdag dga' mo de yang shi song bas gsor ba 'di la yid cig skyo ba yin/ lar mi rgan ngas kyang gzhon so dkar nas rgan skra dkar gyi bar la mthu gtad ser gsum zhig la las byas/ bu khyod kyis kyang gzhon nu nas mthu dang ser bas sdig chen po bsags/ de kun kyang nga rang gi thog tu 'ong bar 'dug gsung / sems can de rnams bla ma rang gis mtho ris dang thar par mi 'drongs pa lags sam zhus pas/ sems can rnams ngo bo chos nyid yin pa dang / rnam pa mtho ris dang thar par 'dren pa'i go yul zhig dag yodi/ cho ga zhig kyang shes te/ de rnams go ba dang tshig tu lus nas/ rkyen byung tshe phan thogs pa'i gdeng thob pa zhig rang mi 'dug pas/ da nga rkyen thub pa'i chos shig byed pa yin pas/ khyod

kyi nga'i bu slob rnams skyongs/ ngas khyod kyis mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam sna zin pa zhig bya'o/ /yang na khyod rang chos gyis la nga yang mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam sna zin pa zhig gyis/ ngas mthun rkyen rnams sbyar gyis gsungs pas/ nga'i 'dod pa grub ste bdag gis chos byed par zhu zhus pas/ 'o na khyod lo yang gzheni snying rus dang dad pa yang che rab cig 'dug pas/ chos rnam dag rang zhig gyis shig gsungs nas yar lungs kyi ther phrug 'dres pa mdzo khal gcig mdzo dang bcas pa gnang ste/ gtsang rong gi snar zhes bya ba na / bla ma rong stoni lha dga' zhes bya ba dam chos rdzogs pa chen po la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zhig bzhugs/ der serdzong la sgrub pa yang dag cig gyis shig gsung / ngas kyang bla mas lung bstan pa ltar gtsang rong snar du 'ongs nas rtsad bcad pas/ bla ma'i jo mo dang grwa pa 'ga' 'dug pa rnams na re/ 'di ma dgoni yin te/ bla ma da lta 'di na mi

ra༅༅/ /bzhugs/ myang stod ri nang bya ba'i bu dgon zhig na bzhugs zer/ 'o na nga bla ma g.yung ston khro rgyal gyis 'dir gtad nas brdzangs pa zhig yin pas mjal ba'i grogs dan gyis dang byas lo rgyus rnams rgyas par bshad pas/ jo mos grwa pa zhig nga'i lam sna la btang bas/ myang stod ri nang du bla ma dang mjal/ ther phrug dang mtsho'i phyag rten phul/ bdag nyi ma la stod nas 'ongs pa'i mi sdig po che zhis/ lags pas/ gsor ba las tshe 'dir grol ba'i chos shig zhu byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga'i dam chos rdzogs pa chen po 'di rtsa ba byung rgyal/ rtse mo thebo rgyal 'bras bu yog rgyal/ nyin bsgoms na nyin sangs rgya/ nub bsgoms na nub sangs rgya/ skal ldan las 'phro can la sgom mi dgos par thos pas grol ba dbang po yang rab kyi chos skal yin pas ster gsungs/ dbang dang gdams pa gnang ba las nga'i bsam pa la ngas dang po mthu byas pas zhag

bcu bzhi la rtags chen po ༄ni/ ser ba la zhag bdun gyis chog pa byung / da mthu dang ser ba bas kyang sla ba'i chos nyin bsgoms na nyin sangs rgya/ nub bsgoms na nub sangs rgya/ skal ldan las 'phro can la thos pas 〉rdzom mi dgos pa 'di 'dra dang 'phrad lugs kyis nga yang las 'phro can zhig yin pa 'dug snyam nga rgyal dang bcas ma ba〉(mas par nyal bsdad pas/ chos dang gang zag tha dad du song ba'i tshe/ zhag 'ga' song ba dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod la stod nas 'ongs pa'i mi sdig po che yin zer ba bden par 'dug /nga'i chos kyi kha pho de yang cung zad ches pa zhig byung 'dug pas/ ngas khyod mi 'drongs par 'dug pas/ da khyod rang lho brag gro bo lung zhes bya ba'i dgon pa na/ rgya gar gyi grub chen nā ro pa'i dngos slobe/ skyes mchog sgra bsgyur gyi ༄la po mar pa lo ts+tsha zhes bya ba sngags gsar ma'i grub thob/ sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig bzhugs/ de dang khyod rang tshe

ra༅༅/ /snga ma nas las 'brel 'dug pas der serdzong zhig gsungs/ der nga la sgra bsgrur mar pa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis sems la smra mi shes pa'i dga' ba dang / lus la ba spu kun g.yo ba'i bde ba/ mchi ma 'khrug pa'i mos gus tshad med pa zhig byung bas4/ blo rtse gcig tu dril nas/ lam rgyags dang yo ti 'dra yod pa khyer te/ bsam pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bla ma dang mjal te zhal mthong ba zhig nam 'ong na nam 'ong na bsam zhing phyin pas/ nga gro bo lung du nang par sleb 'ong ba'i do nub mar pa'i mnal lam du paṇa chen nā ro byone te dbang bskur/ rgyu baiḍār+ya las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dri mas cung zad gos pa zhig dang / gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba zhig gnang nas/ rdo rje 'di'i dri ma bum chu 'dis khrus la/ rgyal mtshan gyo rtse la phyor cig /des rgyal ba gong ma rnams mnyes shing / sems can rnams mgu bar byas pa yin pas rang gzhan

gyi don grub pa yin no gsungs nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang / bla ma'i bka' bzhin bum chus rdo rje bkrus te/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la 'phyar bas/ rdo rje'i 'od kyis 'jig rten kun khyab cing / rigs drug gi sems can rnams la phog pas sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba'i ngang nas rje btsun mar pa rang dang rgyal mtshan la sems can kun gyis phyag 'tshal zhing mchod ba3rtod 'bul ba dang / rgyal ba rnams kyis rgyal mtshan la rab gnas mdzad pa zhig rmis pas/ thugs rgyal cung zad 'khrungs pa'i ngang nas mnal sad pa dang / thugs dgyes shing spro ba zhig byung ba'i ngang nas/ yum tsha ba 'dren du byung ste/ bla ma lags/ mdang nga'i rmi lam du nub phyogs u rgyan nas yin zer ba'i bud med gnyis kyis shel gyi mchod rten phyi dri mas cung zad gos pa zhig khyer byung ste/ yab la bla ma nā ro pa'i bka' lung yin pas/ mchod rten 'di la rab gnas gyis la ri'i rtser zhog zer ba la yab kyi

ra༅༅/ /zhal nas kyang mchod rten 'di'i rab gnas paṇa chen nā ros grub grub pa zhig yin na'ang / bla ma'i bka' sgrub dgos gsungs nas/ mchod rten bum chus 'khrud pa sogs rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas par mdzad de/ ri rtser bzhag pas mchod rten de las nyi zla lta bu'i 'od chen po dang / mchod rten de 'dra mang po 'phros te/ ri rtse kun gang ba'i dkon gnyer bud med de gnyis kyis byed cing 'dug pa zhig rmis/ ci yin nam zhus pas/ rmi lam gyi don mthun pa 'dug dgongs te thugs shin tu dgyes pa zhig byung rung / rmi lam la 'byung sa med pas ci yin mi shes/ nga lam kha ma gir phru slog tu 'grerdzo bas chas gyis gsungs/ las mi 'di tsam zhig byas nas khyod bla ma chen po zhig las la byone na/ nged rnams la kun gyis 'phya ba zhig 'ong bas bzhugs par zhu zhes zhu ba phul rung / ma gsan par bla ma rang byon nas nga la chang mang po khyer sgordzog gsungs/ bum pa gang

khyer phyin pas/ 'di nga rang 'thung ba yin da mgrod chang khyer cerdzog gsungs/ yang bum pa gang khyer phyin pas/ de sa la bskungs dbu zhwa bkab ste/ phru slog pa'i ngang nas so rang mdzad pa dang / phud bzhes rung bzhugs par 'dug /ngas kyang lho brag gi mda' nas/ mi phrad tshad la skyes mchog mar pa 'ordzo ts+tsha gang na bzhugs zhes 'dri zhing phyin pas/ rgyus yode zer ba zhig kyang ma byung ba la/ gro bo lung mthong ba'i la khar sleb pa'i tshe mi zhig byung ba la sngar ltar dris pas/ mar pa zer ba ni yod/ skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā zer ba ni med zer/ 'o na gro bo lung gang na yod byas pas/ gro bo lung pha gi yin zer bstan byung / pha gi na su bzhugs byas pas/ mar pa zer ba de ka yod zer/ de la gzhan mtshan med dam byas pas/ la las bla ma mar pa'ang zer zhing 'dug zer/ bla ma'i gdan sa yin par thag chod de/ la kha 'di la ci zer byas pas/ 'di la chos la sgang zer/ choso la sgang

ra༅༅/ /nas bla ma'i gdan sa mthong ba rten 'brel shin tu legs snyam dga' ba zhig byung / de nas kyang yar 'dri zhing 'ongs pas/ phyugs rdzi mang po zhig 'dug /de rnams la dris pas/ rgan pa rnams na re rgyus med zer ba la/ de rnams kyi nang nas byis pa yid du 'ong la bzhin dang rgyan bzang ba/ smra lce bde ba/ snum gyi ral pa shig ge ba zhig na re/ nged kyi pha jo la zer ba yin nam/ de yin na nged kyi pha jo ni nged rang gi nor gang yod kyis gser nyos nas rgya gar la khyer 'gro/ tshur 'khyos ma la po ti phra ring ba mang po khyer nas sleb 'ong ba zhig yod/ sngar las rgyu nas mi byed pa'i de ring pha jo phru slog gin yod zer ba la/ rigs pas brtags na 'dra mo yin te/ khong lo tsā ba chen po zhig phru hrīsnag gin rang med dam snyam nas 'ongs pas/ lam kha zhig na ban+de sku che la sku sha 'byor pa/ spyan yangs la zil che ba zhig phru :rdzog cing 'dug pa la/ mthong ma thag tu smrar
