med pa'i dga' bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la/ tshe 'di'i snang ba tur tur po de 'gags nas dar cig lus 'dug /de nas ngas drung pa lags/ yul 'di na dpal nā ro pa'i dngos slob/ sgra sgyar mar pa lo tsā zhes bya ba bzhugs zer ba de gang na bzhugs zhus pas/ ban+de des nga'i mgo mjug med pa la yun ring ba zhig bltas te/ khyod sang nas yin/ ci byed gazlungs pas/ bdag gtsang la stod kyi mi sdig po che zhig lags te/ khong snyan pa shin tu che bar gda' bas dam pa'i chos shig zhu ru 'ongs pa lags zhus pas/ 'o na ngas mar pa dang sprad kyis/ khyod nga'i phru 'di slogs shig gsungs dbu zhwa'i 'og nas chang sa la skungs pa bton te gnang byung bas phan la zhim pa zhig byung / phru 'di rem la slogs shig zer ban+de de log song ba dang / chang lhag ma lus par btung ste phru rem nas bslogs pas/ dar cig nas phyugs rdzi'i gseb nas cha stod pa'i bu chung de 'bod du

ra༅༅/ /byung ste/ bla ma'i zhal ta la nang du shog gsung gin 'dug zer bas dga' ste/ khong gis nga'i mjal sna'i go chod 'dug pas/ ngas kyang khong gi phru slog 'phro 'di go chod cig byed byas lhag cung zad cig 'dug pa de bslogs/ zhing des nga bla ma dang mjal ba'i mthun rkyen byas pas/ zhing gi ming la'ang mthun rkyen du chags te/ dbyar zhing gi mtha' dgun dkyil la lam yod pa zhig yod do/ /de nas ngas bu chung de dang bsdebs te nang du phyin pas/ snga nas kyi ban+de des gdan gyi steng na 'bol nyis rtseg grum rtse dang sum rtseg snyes 'bol dang bcas pa'i steng na snum phyis shig byas pa la smin phrag dang sna'i bya gshog gi gshongs/ sma ra dang ag tshom rnams 'phyi ba ma byung bar sa kha le ba zhig byas nas zhes tshil lhug ge 'dug pa la/ 'di ni sngar gyi de ka yin par 'dug /bla ma gang na bzhugs pa na snyam bltas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ngo mi shes pa bden

'ong / mar pa nga rang yin phyag 'tshol cig gsungs/ der phyag btsal zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ bla ma rin po che bdag nyi ma la stod nas kyi mi sdig po che zhig lags pas/ lus ngag yid gsum yang 'bul/ lto gos chos gsum yang bla ma la zhu/ tshe 'dir sangs rgya ba zhig thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ sdig po che yin pa'i yus nga la mi 'gro/ nga'i ched du sdig pa gsog tu btang ba ni min/ khyodi kyis sdig pa ci byas pa gsungs/ rgyu mtshan rnams rgyas par zhus pas/ 'dug gang ltar na'ang lus ngag yid gsum 'bul ba de bzang / lto gos chos gsum kun mi 'ong / yang na sto gos ster chos gzhan nas tsholo/ yang na chos ster sto gos gzhan nas tshol/ de gnyis 'doms ngas chos ster ba 'dams na tshe 'dir sangs rgya mi rgya khyod rang gi snying rus la rag las gsungs/ 'o na bla ma'i drung du chos la gtad 'ongs pa lags pas/ sto gos gzhan nas tshol

ra༅༅/ /bar zhu zhus nas dbe cha gcig yod pa de mchod khang du bskyal bas khyod kyi dpe gog de phyir thon/ nga'i rten mchod rnams la cham pa 'ong gsungs/ nga'i dpe cha'i khrod na mthu'i dpe cha yod pas lan snyam pa byung / nga rang 'dug sar tshags byas nas zhag shas der bsdad de/ yum gyis za ma skyid ngo byin gsungs/ bla ma dang zhal mjal ba'i mdzad pa ste/ mchog gi mdzad pa dang po'o// //gnyis pa ni der lho brag gi lung pa phu mda' kun la bsod snyoms byas pas/ lho brag bre bo che'i nas khal nyer gcig rnyed pa las/ bcu bzhi la zangs ru bzhi ma phyi nang gnyis ka la dreg dang g.ya' sogs skyone gyis ma gos pa zhig nyos/ khal gcig sha chang du sbyar/ khal drug sgye che ba zhig tu blugs/ de'i khar zangs de drags te khyer 'ongs pas/ bla ma'i gzim khang du sleb pa dang / thang chad nas ling bskyur du phog pas/ gzim khang mer ba zhig byung / der bla ma

bzhes pa mdzad cing 'dug pa/ 'phro la bzhengs nas ban chung shed po che zhig 'dug ste/ khyod nged rnams kyang gtibs 'og tu lag mthus gserdzod snyam pa yin nam/ nan tar ma 'tsham pas/ nas do phyir thon gsungs zhabs kyis phul bas/ re zhig phyir 'don dgos byung ba la/ bla ma thugs gtum ngo rang zhig 'ong rigs su 'dug pas/ sku drung du de lugs kyi zhabs tog dang spyod lam byed dgos snyam pa ma gtogs log lta ma skyes/ de nas zangs de stong par de ka phyag rten du phul/ phyag btsal bas/ zangs phyag tu bzhes pa'i ngang la/ yug cig spyan zim me dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i mthar/ spyan chab nyil mdzad de/ rten 'brel bzang / paṇa chen nā ro la 'bul lo gsungs phyag tu yer ba zhig mdzad nas/ zangs de'i lung rnams 'khrol ba dang dbyug pas brdungs te skad ci thoni mdzad nas mchodi khang du bsnams te/ mar me'i mar khus bkang bzhag par gda'/ de'i tshe nga yid

ra༅༅/ /skyo zhing chos kyi 'dod pas gdungs te/ yang yang chos dang gdams ngag gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga la dbus gtsang nas slob ma dad pa can mang rab 'ong gin yod pa/ yar 'brog stag lung pa dang / gling pa'i mis brdungs nas rgyags chu dang 'bul ba mgo thon du ye ma bcug /de gnyis su ser ba re phob shog /de yang chos ka yin zhing / gdams ngag kyang ster gsungs pa la/ de gnyis su ser ba chen po phab gdams ngag zhus pas/ khyod kyis ser ba rdog po gsum phab pa la ngas rgya gar nas dka' ba spyad pa'i chos e 'ong ngam/ cis kyang chos dgos na lho brag la kha ba 'di pas nga'i gnyal lo ro nas 'ong ba'i bu slobo rnams brdungs/ nga la yang brnyas pa chen po rang byas pas/ khyod la mthu chen po yod zer ba/ khyod rang la kha ba 'di rnams la mthu thong / mthu'i rtags thon na paṇa chen nā ro'i tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i

gdams ngag yode pas ster gsungs/ der mthu btang bas la kha ba rnams nang 'dzings byung / thugs bsnyung ba'i mi mang po gri khar shi ba gzigs nas/ khyodi la mthu chen po yodi zer ba bden par 'dug gsungs nas nga la ming mthu chen du brtags/ da sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ he he khyod kyi sdig pa bsags pa'i rngan par ngas lus srertog la ma bltas par rgya gar la phyin/ nor la ma bltas par gser phangs med du phul nas zhus pa'i gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thol le ba 'di tsho dbordzos zer ba de ku re yin rung cung drags pas dgod bro/ nga min gzhan zhig yin na gsod du'ang 'ong / da khyod rang yar 'brog pa rnams kyi lo skyin chug /la kha ba rnams kyi mi kun gsos shog cig de byung na gdams ngag ster/ de min nga'i phyogs la ma 'khor gsungs phyag 'bebs gnang ba tsam gyis bka' bskruni mdzad/ de nas yi chad drags mang po ngus pas/ yum gyis

ra༅༅/ /sems gserdzo mdzad/ nang par bla ma rang phebs nas mdang ngas khyod la mang po rang 'thabs 'dug /ma dga' ba ma byed/ ga le byed gdams ngag ster bas ngang ma thung / khyod las rem po rang zhig 'dug pas/ nga dar ma mdo sde 'bogs pa'i mkhar zhig rtsig grogs gyis/ de tshar nas gdams ngag kyang ster la/ sto gos kyang nga rang gis sbyor gsungs/ de bar la bdag chos med du shi na ji ltar byed lags zhus pas/ de bar la mi 'chi ba'i khag kyang nga rang gis theg kha pho med pa'i chos med de/ khyod rang snying rus che rab cig 'dug pas nga'i gdams ngag sgom nus na/ tshe 'dir sangs e rgya mi rgya yang stone pa yin te/ nga'i brgyud pa 'di la gzhan dang rang ye mi 'dra ba'i byin rlabs kyi bka' babs shig yode gsung zhal ta bzang po gnang bas sems dga' bar byung ste/ 'o na mkhar gyi zhal bcos mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ mkhar de pha tshan kun

gyis mna' bskyal nas mkhar rtsig sa med pa'i sa 'gag dam po zhig yod pa de la/ mar pa mna' khongs na med pas der rtsig dgongs pa'i g.yo thabs dang / nga'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs su/ shar phyogs kyi ris sna zhig la mkhar 'di lta bu zhig rtsigs shig gsungs/ zlum po zhig brtsigs pas/ phyed tsam 'ordzongs pa dang / bla ma byone nas kha sang bsam mno ma thongs par 'dug /mkhar 'di rtsa ba nas bzhig la sa sa mal dang / rdo rdo mal du skyol cig gsungs/ de ltar byas pas/ yang nub phyogs kyi ri sna zhig la bla ma phud kyis bad pa ltar mdzad nas/ da mkhar 'di lta bu zhig rtsigs shig gsungs zla gam zhig brtsigs/ de yang phyed tsam longs pa dang / yang bla ma byon nas 'dis kyang mi 'ong bar 'dug /'di yang sa sa mal dang rdo rdo mal du skyol cig gsungs/ de ltar byas pas/ yang byang gi ri rtse zhig la byone nas/ a bo mthu chen kha sang nga chang gis bzi nas kha ta de

ra༅༅/ /tsam zhig ma byung bar 'dug /da 'dir mkhar dga' mo shig rtsigs gsungs pa la/ mkhar brtsigs shing bzhig pa 'di 'dra bdag sdug la phyag rdzas gzan pa las mi gda' bas/ thugs bsam yang dag btang nas mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ da lan chang gis bzi ba yang med/ bsam ble rdzoyang btang btang ba yin/ sngags pa'i mkhar zhes bya ba gru gsum pa zhig dgos pa yin pas rtsigs shig 'di bzhig kyang mi dgos kyis gsungs/ gru gsum pa zhig brtsigs/ de yang sum cha tsam longs pa'i tshe/ yang bla ma phyon nas/ mthu chen khyod brtsigs pa'i mkhar 'di su'i yin/ kha ta sus byas gsungs pa la/ bla ma rang gis zhal ta mdzad pa'i sras mkhar lags mosnad zhus pas/ ngas 'di 'dra'i kha ta byas pa mi dran/ khyod kyi de bden pa rang yin na nga smyo ba'am dran pas ma zin pa zhig dang thug pa yin 'ong gsungs/ de dus bdag gis 'di 'dra byung

gis dogs nas thugs bsam legs par gtong bar zhu zhes snyan bskal phul bas/ thugs bsam btang btang ba yin/ da lan gyi 'di bshig kyang mi dbo sa gsung thugs dran gsal po rang gda' zhus pas/ 'o na de dus kyi dpang po la su yod/khu lar mkhar gru gsum hom khung 'dra ba 'dir nged rnams bcug ste mthu byed bsam pa yin na/ nged kyis ni khyod kyi gzhis 'phrogs pa yang med la/ pha nor zos pa yang med do/ /de ltar min pa chos 'dod pa yin na/ gzhi bdag mi dga' bar 'dug pas/ 'di'i sa rnams sa mal dang rdo rnams rdo mal du skyol cig /chos dgos na ster ro/ /de bzhin min na song gsungs thugs rgyal bzhengs 'dug pas/ sems sdug pa la tshad med pa zhig byung rung chos 'dod pas bla ma'i bka' bzhin mkhar gru gsum de yang sa sa mal dang rdo rdo mal du bskyal/ de dus nga'i ro stod la sgal pa zhig byung bas/ bla ma la gzigs phul rung bskruni pa las mi

ra༅༅/ /'ong / yum la gzigs phul rung las yus su 'gro bar 'dug snyam gzigs ma phul bar ngus nas chos zhu grogs su sbran pas/ yum bla ma'i drung du byon nas/ don med kyi mkhar las kyis mi sdug thag gcod pa 'dug /mthu chen la chos thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ za ma bzang ba zhig gyis la nga'i rtsar khrid 3snag gsung / yum gyis za ma dang bcas te bla ma'i drung du bskyal bas bla ma'i zhal nas/ mthu chen kha sang gis ngas ma byas pa'i ham pa de 'dra ma byed/ chos 'dod na ster gsungs/ thun mong gi skyabs 'gro'i lung dang sdom pa zhig gnang ste/ de kun thun mong gi chos bya ba yin/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag dgos na/ 'di 'dra byed dgos gsung nā ro'i rnam thar dka' ba spyad tshul rnams mdor bsdus pa zhig gnang nas/ khyod kyis 'ong ba dka' mo yin gsungs pas mchi ma 'chor ba'i dad pa drag po skyes

te/ bla mas ci gsung sgrub dgos snyam yid dam bcas/ de nas zhag 'ga' song ba dang / bla ma zhabs 'chag pa'i phyag phyir 'gro gsungs phyin pas/ pha tshan rnams kyis srung ba'i sa 'gag der byon nas/ da khyod rang 'dir mkhar gru bzhi skya bo dgu thog gañdzi ra dang bcu thog yod pa zhig brtsigs/ de bzhig kyang mi bzhig /grub pa dang gdams ngag sbyin sgrub pa la bzhag nas sgrub rgyags sbyar gyis gsungs/ 'o na zhal bzhes 'di rnams kyi sku dpang duyum bzhugs par rung lags sam zhus pas/ rung gsungs/ der bla mas rtsig rmang gi ri resna mdzad/ ngas yum gdan drangs nas yab yum gnyis ka bzhugs ser/ sngar mkhar gsum brtsigs shing bzhig pa la/ gcig la thugs bsam ma thongs gsungs/ gnyis pa la phud kyis bad gsungs/ gsum pa la smyo ba'am/ dran pas ma zin pa yin nam byas pa mi dran gsungs/ zhal ta gnang tshul zhus pas khyodi la dpang po su

ra༅༅/ /skurdzod gsungs pa dang gzhan yang bka' bskruni mang du byung bas/ da lan zhal bzhes 'di rnams kyi dpang por yum spyan drangs pa lags pas/ sku dpang mdzod cig zhus pas/ yum gyi zhal nas/ ngas dag dpang po byas pas chog ste/ yab sku dbang btsan pas rtsi ba dka' mo yin/ lar rang yab mkhar las mdzad don med par mdzad/ bzhig don med par bzhig gin 'dug /khyad par sa 'di rang re min pa kun gyi mna' ri yin pas/ rgya 'dre'i gzhi zhig 'ong ste/ zhus pas ni yab mi gsan gsung ba la / bla ma'i zhal nas yum la khyod rang bcol ba'i dpang po de gyis/ ngas kyang khas blangs pa bzhin byed/ ma bcol ba'i dogs pa de ma slong bar song gsungs/ der ngas mkhar gru bzhi'i rmang bting nas waṃgs pa'i tshe/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor/ dol gyi tshur ston dbang nge / gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po rnams kyis sku rtsed la rdo chen po rang gcig

sgril zhing byung ba meng rdor bcug nas sked sgo'i thad thog so gnyis tsam longs pa'i tshe/ mar pa byon nas kun la gzigs rtog dga' mo mdzad pas/ bu chen gsum pos bsgril ba'i rdo de la phyag mdzub btsugs te mthu chen rdo 'di ga nas byung gsungs/ thugs sras bu chen rnams kyi sku rtsed la bsnams byung ba lags zhus pas/ 'o na khong tsho'i rdos khyodi kyi mkhar las kyi go mi chod rdo 'di thon la dang po'i sar skyol gsungs/ mkhar 'di mi bzhig pa'i zhal bzhes yod zhus pas/ de yod de nga'i bu slob rim gnyis kyi rnal 'gror sgom pa rnams khyod kyi g.yog tu bkol bar ma tshad/ kun bzhig pa ni min rdo 'di thon la rang gnas su skyol gsung / der rtse mo nas bzhig ste rdo rang gnas su bskyal bas/ da yang khyod rang gis long la rmang rdor chug gsungs/ blangs pas khong gsum gyi shed nga rang gcig po la 'don dgos byung bas/ sbyong po rang byung rung sngar ltar brtsigs pa la nga'i gyad rdor

ra༅༅/ /grags pa yin/ ri sna der rtsig rmang bting ba'i tshe/ pha tshan kun gyi gros la/ mna' ri lamar pas mkhar brtsig par 'dug pas bsrungs pa drag zer ba la/ la la na re mar pa rang smyo nas la stod phyogs kyi ban chung shed po che zhig 'dug pa de/ sa 'bur tshad dang ri sna yod tshad la mkhar gyi bzo lung ma bstan re brtsigs/ phyed tsam longs pa dang / yang kho rang bzhig tu bcug nas sa rdo rnams rang gnas su skyel du 'jug gin 'dug /'di yang bzhig 'ong / mi bzhig na bsrung bas chog /bzhig mi bzhig blta'o zer ba la/ ma bzhig par mkhar las nar mar byas pas/ bdun thog tu serdzong ba dang nga'i rked pa la'ang sgal pa gcig byung / de dus pha tshan rnams na re/ da mi bzhig par 'dug /dang po bzhig pa de rnams 'dir rtsig pa'i ngan g.yo yin par 'dug /da rang re tshos bzhig zer dmag chas pas/ de'i tshe bla mas sprul pa mdzad nas dmag

khrab can mang pos mkhar gyi phyi nang kun bkang bas/ mar pa 'ordzo tsās dmag de tsam gang nas bos pa na zer kun skrag ste 'dzing ma nus par re re nas phyag 'bul dang zhu 'bul la phag tu byung bas/ kun yone bdag dang 'bangs su chug go/ /de dus gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po bde mchog gi dbang mo che zhur byung bas/ yum gyi zhal nas da lan khyod rang yang dbang zhigacis kyang thob pa byed gsungs/ nga rang gi yid la yang ngas 'di tsam gyi mkhar zhig brtsigs pa la/ rdo ra mgo tsam zhig gam/ sa tsel po gang ngam/ chu phogs gcig gam/ 'jim pa khyem gang skyel ba'i grerdzogs med par brtsigs pa yin pas/ da lan dbang bskur gnang 'ong sems pa byung ste/ phyag btsal nas dbang gral la bsdad pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mthu chen khyede la dbang yoni ci yod gsungs/ bla ma'i sras mkhar gyi zhabs tog bsgrubs pas/ dbang dang gdams pa gnang ba'i zhal bzhes 〈snad pa des gnang du

ra༅༅/ /re bsdad pa lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis spe'u lag ngar tsam zhig brtsigs pa la/ ngas rgya gar nas dka' las byas pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mi thob/ dbang yod yod na khyer shog /de min gsang sngags zab mo'i dbang gral du ma sdod gsungs/ 'gram lcag rgyab/ skra nas bzung phyir bton pas/ da lta rang shi na dga' ba la bsam mtshan thog thag tu ngu zhing bsdad/ de dus yum byon nas/ bla ma khong ngas rgya gar nas blangs pa'i chos 'di rnams sems can la phan du re nas blangs pa yin gsungs/ sku mdun du khyi cig byung rung / chos gsung zhing mjug bsngo bas sdud pa zhig 'dug pa yin te/ khyod la thugs mi 'dogs pa 'di ci yin mi shes par 'dug /'on kyang log lta ma skyes pa gyis gsungs/ sems gso mdzad song / nang par bla ma rang byon nas/ mthu chen khyod rang da re zhig mkhar gyi rtsig 'phro zhog la/ zhol gyi rnam pa'i

khyams ka ba bcu gnyis yodi pa gtsang khang dang bcas pa zhig rtsigs/ de longs pa dang dbang dang gdams ngag ster gsungs/ der khyams kyi rmang bting nas brtsigs/ yum gyis dus rgyun du za ma la bya na ma chag pa dang / chang bzi ber re ba rgyun du gnang nas sems gso btang byams po rang mdzad/ khyams longs su cha ba'i tshe/ dol gyi tshur stone dbang nge gameng 'dus kyi dbang mo che zhur byung bas/ yum gyi zhal nas da lan bur dbang zhig cis kyang thob pa byed gsungs/ mar ltang gcig /snam bu bubs gcig /zangs chung gcig rnams gnang ba phyag rten la phul nas dbang gral la bsdad pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mthu chen khyedad dbang gral la sngerdzod pa'i dbang yoni ci 〈snad gsungs/ mar ltang dang snam bu dang zangs de rnams lags zhus pas/ de rnams nga la yone bdag che ge mo dang che ge mo rnams kyis phul ba'i nor lags/ nga'i nor gyis khyod kyi dbang yoni mi 'ong / khyod

ra༅༅/ /rang la yod na khyer shog de min nga'i dbang gral du ma sdod gsungs bzhengs nas bka' bskruni mang po gsung zhing / zhabs thos brdungs te bton pas/ sa la thim na dga' ba la snyam pa dang / ngas mthu btang nas mi mang po bsad/ ser bas 'ordzo mang po bcom pa'i rnam smin yin nam/ chos ye mi 'ong ba mkhyen pa yin nam/ bla ma thugs rje chung nas mi gnang ba yin nam/ gang na'ang chos med pa'i mi lus sdig gserdzog pa 'dis ci byed/ lceb bam lceb bam snyam pa'i tshe/ yum gyis tshogs skal cig bskyal/ sems gso mang po mdzad nas song rung / tshogs la rol ba'i 'du shes kyang stor nas/ mtshan yal ngu zhing bsdad pas/ nang par yang bla ma byoni nas/ da khyod rang khyams dang spe'u'i 'phro slong la mthar skyol/ de nas dbang dang gdams ngag ster rang ster gsungs nas mkhar las byas pas/ khyams mthar phyin du 'ordzongs/ de'i dus nga'i

tshang ra la yang sgal pa gcig byung ste/ sgal mig gsum ka nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang / rgyab rma ru song ba yum la gzigs phul te/ mkhar gru bzhi 'gram 'ding dus kyi zhal bzhes rnams bsnyel gsos nas/ chos dran drags chos zhu grogs su sbran pas/ yum gyis legs par gzigs nas spyan chab bsil te/ ngas bla ma la zhu gsung / bla ma'i drung du byoni nas zhus pa/ bla ma rin po che/ mthu chen gyis 'di tsam gyi mkhar las byas pas yan lag thams cad me dang ser kar song / rgyab la sgal mig gsum byung ba nas rnag khrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dzag gin gda'/ sngar rta bong la sgal pa byung zer ba rna bas kyang thos/ mig gis kyang mthong ste/ mi la sgal pa byung zer ba thos kyang ma thos mthong yang ma mthong / 'di 'dra mi gzhan gyis mthong ba dang thos pa byung na nga ngo yang tsha bar gda'/ yab rang bla ma chen po lags pas zhabs yang 'dren par gda'/ kho snying yang rje

ra༅༅/ /bar gda' bas/ da bu 'di la chos shig gnang bar zhu/ dang po mkhar longs nas chos gnang bar mdzad pa lags mod zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas de ka nga zer/ mkhar bcu thog 'ordzongs nas chos ster bar byas pa yin pas bcu thog ga re gsungs/ bcu thog las lhag pa'i khyams brtsigs pa lags mode zhus pas/ lab lab mang kha na med/ bcu thog khel na chos ster ba yin sgal pa rang byung 'dug gam gsungs pas/ des na yab sku dbang gis gcod par gda' bas gang dgyes yin/ sgal pa byung ba tsam du ma lus par rgyab sgal par song gda' zhes zug ge ba zhus nas myur du byon pas/ 'o na yang 3(ga gyis gsungs/ chos gnang ba yin nam snyam phyin pas/ mthu chen sgal pa ston dang gsungs/ gzigs phul bas legs par gzigs pa'i mthar/ khyod kyi 'di bas lhag pa nga'i jo bo nā ro pa des dka' chen bcu gnyis/ dka' phran bcu gnyis

te/ dka' ba mi 'dra ba nyer bzhi sku lus rang gi thog tu spyad pa yin/ ngas kyang gces pa'i srog dang phangs pa'i nor la ma bltas par jo bo nā ro pa bsten pa yin/ de'i phyir chos 'dod na yus ma che bar mkhar las kyi 'phro gyis gsung ba la de yang mad snyam pa byung / gos la sgal tshags mdzad de/ rta bong la yang 'di bzhin byed kyin 'dug pas sgal tshags gyis la sa rdo skyol gsungs/ rgyab rmar song ba la sgal tshags kyis ci la phan zhus pas/ sa mi 'chor ba la phan gsungs/ der bla ma'i bka' yin snyam sa snedi mdun du khyer nas sa bskyas shing zhal ba byas pa bla mas gzigs pas/ bla mas ci gsung sgrub pa'i skyes bu ngo mtshar che snyam/ mar pa rang yang lkog tu spyan chab cerdzor 'dug /der rma rnams 'grams nas shin tu na ba'i tshe/ yum la zhus nas rab chos gnang ba/ tha ma'ang rma serdzos serdzos bar bsdad rgyu 'ong ba'i zhu ba yum gyis phul bas/ mkhar ma tshar bar chos mi 'ong las

ra༅༅/ /nus na ci lcogs gyis/ mi nus na sdod pa las 'os med gsungs/ yum gyi zhal nas/ rma dang sgal pa rnams ma sos bar las ma byed par sdod gsung / bsdad pa'i bar la za ma bcud che la bza' che ba gnang bas zhag 'ga' chos ma thob pa'i sems las min pa skyid du tshor ba byung / der rma dga' rab se(sa pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas chos kyi sgros med par/ mthu chen da yang mkhar las ran gsung pas byed grabs yod tshe yum gyi zhal nas/ da rang re gnyis chos thob pa'i thabs shig byed gsungs/ nged gnyis kyis gros byas nas/ ngas phye sgye chung ngu ma zhig gi khar dpe cha dang chas phran tshegs yod pa drags te/ bla mas gzigs sa zhig tu da nga gtong grogs mdzod zer zhing 'gro ba ltar byas/ yum gyis da ngas bla ma la zhus nas chos 'ong rang 'ong bar bya'o/ /cis kyang sdod gsung zhing 'dzin pa ltar mdzad pas/ bla mas gzigs te/ bdag

med ma khyed gnyis ci byed cing yod pa yin gsungs/ mthu chen kho dang po sa thag ring nas bla ma'i drung du chos la gtad nas 'ongs pa la/ chos mi gnang ba'i khar bka' bkyen dang phyag 'bebs mang ba las ma byung bas/ chos med du shi yis dogs da bla ma gzhan tshol du 'gro zer chas gda' ba la/ bdag gis chos gnang ba'i khag khur dang ngo chen byed byas bshol btab pa lags zhus pas/ skusna gsung phyir byon byung ste/ nga la 'gram lcag mang po brgyab nas/ khyod dang po nga'i sar sleb ma thag lus ngag yid gsum nga rang la phul tshar ba la da khyod gang du 'gro ba yin/ nan tar ma song na nga rang dbang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dum bu brgyar gtubs kyang nga rang dbang che mod/ cis kyang khyod thon 'gro na/ nga'i nang nas phye khyer ba'i rgyu mtshan cerdzod gsungs/ sgyel zhing brdungs/ phye phrogs te nang du bsnams song ba dang / sems pham pa la tshad med pa bu gcig pu shi ba'i ma lta ngu byung

ra༅༅/ /rung / yum dang gros yod pa dang / bla ma zil che bas zil ma bzod par nang du log nas ngu zhing bsdad pas/ yum gyi zhal nas re zhig thabs ci byas rung / bla mas khyod la chos mi gnang bar 'dug ste/ 'on kyang nam gzhug gnang ba zhig cis kyang 'ong / de bar la ngas cig bya gsungs/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgom thabs shig gnang bas kyang / nyams rgyudang ma skyes rung sems la shin tu phan pa dang zid thung bar byung ste/ yum rang gi sku drin bsab pa dang / bla ma'i yum yin pas sdig pa 'dag bsam/ mnang chung dbyar yum ba 'jo ba'i 'jo stegs/ go gar yos rngod pa'i rngod stegs tshun mdzad cing zhabs tog bsgrabs/ de'i tshe nges par bla ma gzhan tshol du 'gro dgos snyam pa la / bsam mno legs par btang bas/ tshe gakhog lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag /bla ma 'di main pa gzhan la med par thag ཿsgod 'dug /da lan sangs rgyas ma

thob na ngas phyi ma ngan song du skye ba'i las bsags tshar yod pas/ chos phyir nā ro pa'i dka' ba tsam spyad nas/ bla ma 'di ci mnyes shig gis gdams ngag thob par byas la / bsgoms nas tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob pa zhig byed dgos snyam nas/ yang sa rdo bskyas nas khyams dang gtsang khang gi zhal pa'i 'phro byed cing yod pa'i tshe/ gzhung gi rngog stod chos rdor 'khor dang bcas pa 'bul ba mang po khyer te dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang mo che zhur byung bas/ yum gyi zhal nas/ yab mkhar las kyi zhabs tog 'di tsam gyis mi chog par nor rang la dgyes na/ da lan 'bul ba phul te/ dbang thob rang thob pa zhig byed pas/ 'di phul la sngon la khyod rang gis zhus shig /ma gnang na ngas zhu yis gsungs/ yum rang gi phag nor gyi g.yu drug dmar che la legs pa zhig gnang ba de phul nas/ da lan gyi dbang 'di bdag la'ang cis kyang gnang bar zhu zhus te/ dbang gral la

ra༅༅/ /bsdad pas/ g.yu slog cing gzigs nas/ mthu chen la 'di gang nas byung / bdag la yum gyis gnang ba lags zhus pas/ zhal 'dzum mdzad de/ bdag med ma bos cerdzog gsungs/ yum spyan drangs pas/ bdag med ma 'o skol la g.yu 'di ga nas byung gsung ba la/ der yum gyis phyag mang po phul nas/ g.yu 'di la yab kyi the reg ye med lags/ 'di dang po nga pha mas yab kyi drung du rdzong ba'i tshe/ bla ma yang thugs gtum me ba zhig yod par 'dug pas/ gal te bza' tsho bye bral la song na dgos pas 'di su la'ang ma stod par tshags gyis shig zer bdag rang gi phag nor du gnang ba lags na'ang / da bu 'di snying rje drags ma bajodi par byin pa lags pas/ g.yu 'di yab bzhes la mthu chen la dbang bskur thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu/ sngar dbang gral nas bton pa'i yi chad mang po rang myong bas da lan bla ma rngog pa 'khor bcas kyis kyang nga'i zhu ba

'bul grogs mdzod cig gsungs/ phyag mang du phul bas/ bla ma thugs gtum pa'i stabs kyis rngog pa 'khor bcas kyis kyang zhu ba gzhan 'bul ma nus par de ltar lags so zhes yum dang mnyam por phyag phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bdag med ma'i byed lugs kyis g.yu bzang po mi la 3(ra tshad tshad pa byung 'dug gsungs/ g.yu mgul du bzhes nas bdag med ma khyod bsam mno ma chung / khyod rang ril po nga dbang na/ g.yu nga yi dbang yin mod/ mthu chen khyod rang la nor yod na khyer shog dbang bskar gyis/ g.yu nga rang gi yin par 'dug gsung rung / yum gyis g.yu phul ba'i yus kyis da dung zhu ba 'ong ngam snyam bsdad pas/ bla ma thugs khros nas har gyis bzhengs te༄/ thon byas rung mi 'gro ba'i khyod kyi yus ci yod pa gsungs/ kha bub tu sa sros pa 'dra ba zhig brdabs/ gan rkyal du nam langs pa 'dra ba zhig brdabs nas phyag dbyug bzhes byung ba/ rngog gis

ra༅༅/ /bzung ba'i bar la 'jigs drags rgya mthongs shig yod pa de la mchongs phyin pas/ bla ma rang yang thugs las byung rung thugs rgyal bzhengs pa ltar mdzad 'dug /nga la ci yang ma byung ste/ sdug drags lceb dgos snyam yod pa'i tshe/ yum yang spyan chab 'don zhing byung nas/ mthu chen sems sdug po ma byed cig /khyod bas sha tsha ba dang snying nye ba'i slob ma mi 'ong bas/ bla ma gzhan la chos zhu rung ngas mjal ba'i mthun rkyen byas nas chos rgyags dang 'bul ba yang sbyin gyis gsung sems gso mdzad/ sngar yin na tshogs 'khor ci byed kyi gral la yum bzhugs dgos pa la/ de'i nub mo nga mtshan yal ngu ba'i zla la bzhums shing bzhugs/ nang par nga la bla ma'i drung du 31ga gsungs/ choso gnang ba yizha nam snyam phyin pas mdang ngas khyod la dbang ma bskur ba la ma dga' ba dang 'o(ga lta ma byung ngam gsungs/ bla ma ladad 'ordzog dag ma byung lags

te/ bdag rang las sdig sgrib che bas lan snyam sdug po rang byung lags zhus nas ngus pas/ nga la ngu ma shags byed pa'i yus rang ci yod/ phyir song gsungs/ phyir thon phyin te/ snying rlung ldang ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi ngang nas bsam blo la/ nga sdig byed dus rgyags yone 'gror nas/ chos byed dus nor ci yang med pa 'di 'dra byung / sdig byed dus kyi gser de'i phyed tsam zhig 〈snad na'ang dbang dang gdams ngag thob par 'dug ste/ da bla ma 'dis ni 'bul ba med par gdams ngag mi gnang bar 'dug /gzhan du phyin rung 'bul midagos pa ni mi 'ong / nor med pas chos ni mi thob par 'dug /chos med kyi mi lus sdig gsog pa las ni lceb pa dga'/ da ci drag na ci drag na snyam pa la/ yang phyug po chen po zhig gi gaskusnag byas pa'i gla bserdzogs nas chos zhu ba'i rgyags yod 'dra 'gyor ram/ yang na las ngan pos mthu btang yodi pas yul du phyin rung chog par 'dug /a ma yang phrad

ra༅༅/ /pas dga' 'ong / nor khug pa'ang srid/ gang ltar na'ang chos tshol ba'am nor tshol ba gang rung zhig la 'gro dgos par 'dug /bla ma'i phye khyer rung thugs khrel las mi 'ong snyam/ nga rang gi dpe cha rnams khyer te/ yum la yang ma zhus par thoni phyin pas/ lam bar la yum gyi bka' drin dran pas shin tu 'phreng ba zhig byung / grerdzo 'o lung nas tsha lam rgyang ba zhig gi sar sleb pa dang sto ran te/ dang por phye slong / de nas snod spyad g.yar/ chu me shing rnams bsogs nas lto g.yos te zos pas/ nyi ma phyed yol song / der bsam pa la/ ngas las byas pa rnams kyi phyed tsam bla ma'i zhabs tog tu song rung / phyed tsam nga rang gi sto rin du 'dug /da nang gi sto nam gcig po 'di'i dka' las 'di la/ yum gyis stosto g.yos ga〈snas pa bya na dang bcas pa kha tsha ring nge ba rgyun du gnang ba yin pa la/ da nang ngas yum la khams bde zhig zhus mi 'ong ba de nga mi ngan

par 'dug /da dung log gam snyam na'ang / log 'gro rang ma spor+shas/ snod spyad rnams sprod du phyin pas/ mi rgan zhig na re/ mi gzhon las 'ong 'ong 'dra mo 'dug pa la/ slong ba las rab klog shes na chos thon/ mi shes na g.yog byas na'ang lto gos gnyis ka 'ong / khyod kyis klog shes sam zer ba la/ nga rgyun du slong ba zhig min/ klog shes byas pas/ de ka tsam ka gzha'/ 'o na zhag 'ga' nga'i klog thon yon smar po ster zer bas dga' ste/ rung byas bsdad nas brgyad stosnang pa bklags pas/ rtag tu ngu'i rnam thar mthong ste/ nor med mnyam po la khong gis chos phyir du lus srog blos gtong nus 'dug ste/ snying bton na 'chi ba las 'os med/ snying yang 'tshong ba la thag bcad 'dug /'di'i rtsis btang na ngas chos phyir du dka' ba ye ma spyad par 'dug //bla mas chos gnang ba'ang srid/ ma gnang rung yum gyis bla ma gzhan dang sprod pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po yang yod snyam

ra༅༅/ /log 'gro ba'i spobs pa zhig skyes te/ log nas phyin/ nga thon pa dang yum gyis bla ma la/ yab kyis ma thub pa'i dgra de thon nas mi gda'o/ /thugs bde lags sam zhus pas/ su gsungs/ 'o na dgra mi sha tho zin pa ltar yab kyis sdug gtong ba de mthu chen min lags sam zhus pas/ zhal ras nag 'ordzog mdzad nas spyan chab nyil byung ste/ bka' brgyud bla ma/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong / nga'i skal ldan gyi bu khug shog cig gsungs dbu gtums te bzhugs par gda'/ der ngas yum gyi drung du sleb/ phyag phul bas/ yum shin tu dgyes nas/ de ka los drag /da khyod la bla mas chos shig ga nang ba 'dra/ ngas khyod thon 'dug zhus pas/ nga'i skal ldan gyi bu khug 3snag gsungs/ spyan chab bsil zhig 'dug /khyod bla ma'i thugs rjes bkug pa 'dra gsungs/ nga'i bsam pa la de yum gyis nga'i sems gserdzo ba yin/ nges par bden nas spyan chab

'don pa dang / skal ldan gsung ba yin na dag nga 'tsheng ste/ de min khug cerdzog gsung ba dang / dbang dang gdams ngag mi gnang lugs kyis skal ldan min tshar 'dug pas/ gzhan du 'gro sa yang med/ 'dir chos kyang mi thob pa'i sdag po 'ong ngam snyam pa byung / der yum gyis mthu chen gyis 'o cag blos ma thongs par log byung phyag 'bul du 'ongs pas chog lags sam zhus pas/ 'o cag blos ma thongs pa min/ kho rang blos ma thongs pa yin/ phyag 'tshal du thong na'ang thong gsungs phyag 'bul la phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ mthu chen tsab tsob dang blo ma mang bar snying nas chos 'dod pa yin na/ chos phyir srog kyang gtong dgos pas/ mkhar la da thog gsum khol/ de nas gdams ngag ster/ de min nga'i sto grone pa min pa med/ khyod rang la 'gro sa yod par 'dug pas song gsungs pas/ lan zhu ma nus par phyir thon 'ongs te/ yum la da a ma yang dran po rang

ra༅༅/ /gda'/ bla mas chos kyang mi gnang bar gda'/ mkhar las kyi 'phro tshar nas chos gnang na bsdad rin chog pa gda' ste/ mkhar las tshar sting yang chos mi gnang ba'i bsnyad ci mdzad khungs mi gda' bas/ bdag yul du 'a〈sna bar zhu/ yab yum sku khams bzang bar spyod lam 'debs byas/ phyag phul te dpe cha khyer nas 'ong grabs byas pas// yum gyi zhal nas/ bu bden ngas dang po khas blangs pa ltar/ bla ma rang gi bu chen yang yin/ gdams ngag kyang yod pa'i rngog stod las chos thob pa'i thabs shig rgya'o/ /re zhig sdod la las byed pa ltar gyis shig gsungs der dga' drags las byed cing bsdad pas/ paṇa chen nā ro pa de tshes bcu la tshogs gtor gyi mchod pa rgya chen mdzad kyi yod 'dug pas/ de'i stobes kyis mar pa yang tshes bcu mdzad cing 'dug /de dus yum gyis nas khal re yod pa'i chang tshod chen po gsum btsos pa la/ gar sla 'bring

gsum du byas nas/ yang la yang bsings byas pa'i phud gar ma de/ yum gyis grwa pa rnams bla ma la yang yang btud nas 'dren du bcug yum dang ngas kyang yang yang drangs/ 'bring po grwa pa rnams kyis gsol/ sla ba nas yum gyis zhal reg pa re mdzad nas mang po mi gsol bar 'dug /ngas kyang yum bzhin byas pas ma bzi/ grwa pa rnams kyang bad 'dug /bla ma ni phud gda' ba dang / zhu mkhan mang ba'i stobs kyis shin tu bad nas mnal mthug por song ba'i tshe/ yum gyis gzim khang nas/ bla ma'i phyag rtags/ nā ro'i sku rgyan/ thugs dam pad+ma rā ga rnams blangs te/ bla ma'i bka' 3(ga ltar byas pa'i yi ge/ yum gyis sngar nas mdzad mdzad pa zhig 'dug pa de la phyag rtags skyone rgya byas te/ rten rnams na bza' bzang pos dril/ la ca'i dam khas mnan nas nga la gnang ste/ yum gyi zhal nas/ 'di rnams bla mas skur ba ltar gyis la/ bla ma rngog pa'i

ra༅༅/ /drung du phul la chos zhus shig gsung nga gzhung du brdzangs te/ ngas bla ma rngog pa la blo gtad nas phyin/ de nas zhag gnyis tsam song ba dang / yum la bla ma'i zhal nas/ da lta mthu chen las ci byed cing 'dug gsung ba la/ kho 'gro zhing yod 'ong / de min bdag la rgyus med zhus pas/ gar song gsungs/ kho mkhar las sadi tsam zhig byas rung chos mi gnang ba'i khar bka' bskruni dang phyag 'bebs mang bar byung bas/ da bla ma gzhan du tshol du 'grerdzo zer chas pa la/ yab la zhus rung ni thugs brtse mi 'dug pa dang / yang phyag 'bebs byas snying rje ba las mi 'ong snyam nas ma zhus/ ngas ni bshol ci btab rung ma thebs par sku(nga zhus pas/ zhal ras nag thing ba zhig mdzad nas ji tsam la song gsungs/ kha sang song zhus pas/ dar cig dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i mthar/ da lan nga'i bu de thag ring zhig tu ma song bar 'dug gsungs/ der ngas gzhung

gi ri bo khyung lding du sleb ste/ bla ma rngog pas grwa pa mang po la brtag gnyis 'chad cing 'dug pa la/ chos mtshams/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan po nga / /'jig rten stoni pa bsgrub bya nga / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga / /lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin nga / /zhes bya ba gsungs pa'i skabs su/ ngas kyang rgyang nas phyag btsal bas/ bla mas dbu zhwa phud nas phyag lan mdzad cing / bla ma mar pa'i slobo rgyud kyi phyag 'tshal lugs su 'dug /chos mtshams kyi rten 'brel yang shin tu legs te/ kherdzong rang chos kun gyi bdag por 'ong bar 'dug pas/ su yin dris shog gsung / grwa pa zhig nga'i sar byung bas ngo shes te/ khyod 'dir gang la byon zer ba la/ ngas bla ma mar pa thugs brel ches nas nga gcig pu la chos gsung skabs ma byung bas/ 'dir chos zhu ru 'ongs pa yin/ de'i phyag rtags su nā mo'i sku rgyan/ thugs dam pad+ma rā ga rnams gnang yode

ra༅༅/ /byas pas/ grwa pa des bla ma'i drung du/ a po mthu chen yin par 'dug /des zhu don rnams phul bas/ bla ma shin tu mgyes te/ nga'i gdan sar jo bo nā ro pa'i sku rgyan dang thugs dam 'ong ba u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar darkani zhing ngo mtshar che bas bsu ba byed dgos/ des na da lan gyi chos mtshams legs sar zhog /khyed grwa pa rnams song la gdugs rgyal mtshan dang rol cha rnams khyer la myur du cerdzog /a bo mthu chen la phyir khyed pa zhig gyis gsung / nga phyag btsal sa de kar bsdad yod pas/ grwa pa zhig byung nas zhal ta bsgyar serdzong / ngas phyag btsal sa de la phyis phyag 'tshal sgang du grags/ ngas kyang phyir bskyed pas/ de ma thag gdugs rgyal mtshan dang rol cha bsam gyis mi khyab pa khyer ba'i ser phreng gi bsu ba mdzad nas/ gzim khang du sleb pa dang / ngas phyag btsal phyag rtags rten dang bcas pa phul bas/ spyan chab bsil zhing dbu thog tu bzhag

nas byin rlabs zhus te/ rten rnams mchod pa bzang po bshams nas rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs su bcug /phyag rtags de bklags pas/ rngog chos sku rdo rjes bsgrub bya la 'dir nga mtshams dam po rang zhig la chug nas mthu chen ngang thung bar 'dug pa/ kho khyodi la chos zhur btang ba yin pas/ dbang bskur gdams ngag stoni cig /de ltar byas pas chog pa'i brdar nā ro'i sku rgyan/ thugs dam pad+ma rā ga rnams bskur ba yin bya ba zhig 'dug /der bla ma'i zhal nas/ bla ma'i bka' yin pas/ dbang dang gdams ngag cis kyang 'ong / nga khyed 'apod du rang gtong dgos snyam pa yod pa la/ byon pa de bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ nga la khams dang dwags kong yar lung rnams nas grwa pa mang po 'ong zhing yod pa la / dol gyi ya sa pho yas mo bya ba'i mi ngan rnams kyis chos rgyags mgo thon du ye ma bcug pas/ der ser ba zhig 'ob cerdzog /de nas dbang dang gdams pa bya yis

ra༅༅/ /gsungs/ der nga'i bsam pa la/ las ngan pa nga 'dra ba zhig 'ong ba/ ser ba btang na/ 'ongs pa dam pa'i chos la 'ongs pa la/ 'ong ba sdig pa'i las zhig 'ong bar 'dug /ma btang na ni bla ma'i bka' bcag par yang 'gro zhing chos kyang mi thob par 'dug pas/ ser ba mi gtong thabs mi 'dug snyam/ rdzas bsags sngags kyis brabs pa'i thun khyer nas yul der phyin te/ las la sbyar nas ser ba 'bab tu cha ba dang / yas phor rgan mo zhig gi nang du gnas g.yar te char yib byas pas/ blosnag 'khyug /'brug ldir/ sprin nag 'dus te ser ba'i mgo re re gnyis gnyis byung ba dang / rgan mos lo ser bas brdungs rting ngas gang za zer ngu zhing 'dug pas/ ngas sdig cig rang bsags snyam/ gnas mo zhing ci 'dra zhig yod pa myur du ri mor bris dang byas pas/ yod dag 'di 'dra yod de zer/ gru gsum mchu ring zhig bris byung bas/ lta stangs

byas sla nga bkab pas mchu'i ri mo cung zad cig ma kheb pa de rlung tshub cig gis subs song / der ser thag chod nas bltar phyin pas/ yul gnyis kyi ltag gi ri thams cad grog por btang / zhing gzhan thams cad ni lhag med du serdzong 'dug pa la/ rgan mo'i zhing ma skyone pa snum rug ge 'dug /mchu ser bas brdungs rting chu 'ordzog gis mnan te 'dug /zhing de la phyis kyang ser ba ci byung rung mi 'bab pas mo la ser khral mi dgos la/ chu log gis mnan pa'i mchu la ser khral dgos kyin yod skad/ de nas ngas log yongs bas/ lam du phyugs lug rnams chu log gis khyer ba'i rdzi bo rgan byis gnyis dang phrad de/ de gnyis la nga yin te bla ma rngog pa'i grwa pa rnams ma bcom zhig /bcom na ser ba 'di 'dra rtag tu 'bebs so bya ba'i phyi than bskur bas/ yul de gnyis kyis gus pas btud de yoni bdag tu gyur pas phyis bla ma'i zhabs tog tu song 'dug /der ngas tsher phung zhig

ra༅༅/ /rang gi 'og nas kyang bye'u'i ro mang po rnyed pa dang / lam bar kun la bya dang byi ba'i ro byung tshad 'thu zhing 'ongs pas/ char khebs kyi steng g.yogs shig dang thu ba gang byung ba/ bla ma'i drung du spungs te/ bla ma rin po che da bdag gis 'ongs pa dam pa'i chos la 'ongs nas byung ba sdig pa'i las las ma byung bas/ sdig po che la thugs rjes gzigs 'tshal zhes zhus nas ngus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ a bo mthu chen de tsam skrag mi dgos/ rang re nā ro mai tri'i brgyud pa la sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgya ba/ bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis 'ded pa'i gdams ngag yodi pa yin/ da len ser bas bsad tshad kyi sems can thams cad ma 'ongs pa'i tshe/ khyed rang mngone par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i zhing der 'khor gyi thog mar skye ba yin/ de bar la nga'i mthus ngan song du mi skye bas dga' bar gyis shig /yid mi ches na 'di ltar yin gsungs/ dar cig

dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i mthar se gol zhig gtogs pas/ ro thams cad sos nas har langs te/ skad cig de nyid la gnam la 'phur dgu dang sa la 'dzul dgu rnams rang rang so so'i gnas su song ba dang / bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ste/ re rang dga' na re rang dga'/ da lan sems can mang po rang zhig shi na 'tsheng ste snyam pa byung / de nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil gsor du dbang bskur/ gdams ngag gnang nas/ bla ma'i gdan sa mthong ba'i grog ldan kha lhor lta ba zhig na phug ron zhig 'dug pa de gsos te 'dag sbyar la bsdad pa'i bug sgor/ bla mas chosatsaganang zhing yengs med du bsgoms rung / mar pa'i bkas ma grol bas nyams myong ci yang ma skyes pa la/ lan gcig bla ma'i zhal nas/ a bo mthu chen/ rtags 'di 'dra dpa'adi 'dra byung nge gsungs/ ci yang ma byung lags zhus pas/ ci zer nga'i brgyud pa 'di la dam tshig gi sel med na nyams rtogs kyi

ra༅༅/ /yon tan myur du mi skye ba'i mthu med pa zhig yin te/ khyed rang ni nga la dad nas 'ongs pa yin/ bla ma'i bkas ma grol na ni phyag rtags gnang don yang med ci yin nam/ gang ltar na'ang snying rus bskyed la 〉rdzoms shig gsungs pas/ 'jigs chum pa zhig byung ste/ dngos gnas zhu'am snyam pa la/ zhu rang ma 〉bos par/ bla ma mar pa'i thugs zin pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa 'dug snyam pa byung / snying rus bskyed nas 〉snam zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma mar pas sras mkhar gyi 'phro 'ordzongs nas/ rngog pa'i sar gsung yig byung ba la/ 'dir nged kyi sras mkhar la spen pad dgos pa byung bas/ khyed kyis de nas spen khur gyi 'bul ba ci lcogs shig sngoni la khyer 〈snag /spen pad dang gañdzi ra khel ba dang / mkhar gyi rab gnas/ mdo sde 'bum gyi che 'don rnams dus mnyam du byed pa yod pas/ de la khyed rang yang shog /de na nged kyi mi ngan de yod 'dug

pa / de yang de dus khrid shog gsungs pa zhig 'dug pas/ bla ma rngog pa nga'i bug sgor byon nas/ gsung yig bstan te/ nged la phyag rtags 'di bzhin 'dug /mi ngan de yodi 'dug pa gsung lugs kyis bla ma'i bkas rang ma grerdzol ba 'dra gsungs pas/ bdag la bla ma rang gi bka' lung dngos ni med lags te/ phyag rtags rten dang bcas pa yum gyis gnang nas 'dir brdzangs pa lags zhus pas/ e e des na rang re gnyis kyis done med kyi las shig byas 'dug /bla ma'i bkas ma grol na yoni tan mi skye ba las 'os med de bya thabs med/ khyed rang la sgo(ga gsung ba 'dug pas 'gro'im mi 'gre rdzogasungs pas/ da lan bdag kyang phyag phyi la 'grerdzo bar zhu zhus pas/ 'o na spen ma rnams brdzangs nas/ dus nges pa can sgrig tu song yod/ de bar la mtshams gyis gsungs/ de nas dus sgrig pa'i mi des 'khor nas nga'i bug sgor byung ste/ mkhar gyi rab gnas dang / sras kyi che 'don

ra༅༅/ /byed tshul gyi gleng mo rnams zhib par bshad byung / nga'i gleng mo 'dra 'dug gam byas pas 'dug /yum gyi zhal nas nged kyi mi de ci byed cing 'dug gsungs/ mtshams dam po la gda' zhus pas/ de min ci byed cing 'dug gsungs/ mi med sa rang na sdod kyin gda' zhus pas/ kho'i 'di lus pas lan/ kho 'dir stodi tshe 'di rang rtse ba yin pas/ 'di sprod cig gsung 'di gnang ba yin zer/ kho'i ska rags kyi mdud pa bkrol nas 'jim pa'i sho shig sprad byung / der yum gyi phyag reg yod snyam byin rlabs zhus/ kho song ba dang sho rtse snying 'dod pa zhig byung nas rtses pas/ bsam blo la ngas sngar yum gyi drung du sho rtses pa ni med/ da yum yang thugs rjes mi 'dzin pa yin las che/ 3( 'dis dang po pha mes kyang yul bton pa yin snyam/ klad la bskor te brdabs pas/ chag pa'i nang nas 3(ga ril zhig byung ba bklags pas/ da bu rang la yang bla mas

dbang dang gdams ngag gnang ba yod pas/ bla ma rngog pa dang bsdebs la sgordzog bya ba zhig 'dug pas/ dga' drags nas phug pa'i nang du phar rgyug tshur rgyug bro khrabs so/ /de nas nga la bla ma rngog pa'i zhal nas/ a bo mthu chen rang yang rkang pa phyogs la 'gro grabs gyis shig gsung ba ltar byas/ bla ma rngog pa ni/ bla ma mar pa rang gis gnang ba'i byin rlabs kyi rten rnams ma gtogs/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten yod tshad dang / gser g.yu dang gos dar sogs nang gi rdig kun dang / ra ma rgan mo rkang chag ma zhig 'dug pa de phyugs khyu'i rjes mi zin pa 'dug pas zhog gsungs/ de ma gtogs phyi nang gi nor yod dgu kun khyer nas 'byon grabs mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla mas nga la yang / khyod kyis nged la yang phan thogs po rang byas pas bla ma mar pa dang mjal ba'i phyag rten gyis shig gsung dar yug cig gnang / jo mos kyang yum bdag med ma dang mjal ba'i phyag rten gyis shig gsung

ra༅༅/ /thud rkyal zhig gnang / de nas bla ma rngog pa yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa chas te gro bo lung gi mdar sleb pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ a bo mthu chen sngon la song la yum gyi drung du nged rnams 'ong zhing yod zhus la chang zhig e gnang ltos la shog gsungs pas/ ngas sngon la phyin pas/ thog mar yum dang mjal/ phyag dang thud rkyal phul nas/ bla ma rngog pa 'byon zhing bdog pas bsu chang zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ yum shin tu dgyes nas bla ma gzim khang na bzhugs yod pas de skad zhus cerdzog cig gsungs zhur phyin pas/ bla ma gzim khang gi yang thog na zhal shar la gzigs nas thugs dam la bzhugs 'dug pa la/ phyag dang dar yug phul bas zhal nub tu gzigs song / nub nas phul bas lhor gzigs song ba la/ ngas bla ma lags/ bdag la bka' bskrune gnang phyir phyag mi bzhes rung / bla ma rngog pas sku gsung thugs kyi rten

dang / gser g.yu dang mdzo rta sogs nor yod dgu cog 'bul bar khyer nas 'gron grin yod lags pa/ de la bsu chang zhig re ba 'dra lags pas gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ thugs rgyal bzhengs te phyag se gol gtogs shing gsung drag pos/ ngas rgya gar nas bka' sde snedi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang nas rgyud sde bzhi'i done snying phyung ba'i man ngag khyad par can rnams khyer 'ongs pa'i tshe/ bsu mkhan byi'u theng ma zhig kyang med pa'i kho dud 'gro kyal kyol 'ga' ded nas 'ong ba la/ nga lo tsā ba chen po zhig gis bsu ba dgos na mi 'ong bas da lta rang log gyis gsungs/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin yum la zhus pas/ bla ma thugs gtum pas lan/ jog mi chen po yin pas bsu ba byed dgos/ rang re ma bu gnyis kyang 'dong gsungs pa la/ bla ma rngog pa bla ma yab yum gyi bsu ba 'ong du re ba mi gda'/ phud cig gnang bar zhu zhus rung nga rang yang 'grerdzo gsungs/ grwa pa 'ga' la

ra༅༅/ /chang mang po bskur nas yum gyis bsu ba mdzad/ de nas lho brag lung pa'i mi mang po bsags te/ sras kyi che 'don/ gzim khang gi rab gnas stone mo bzang po dang bcas pa mdzad pa'i stoni gral du/ bla ma mar pas bkra shis mnga' gserdzol gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma bka' drin can la gserdzol ba 'debs/ /nga'i brgyud pa rin chen 'di nyid la/ /nyes ltung med pa'i bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis 3(ga /gdams ngag zab mo'i nye lam la/ /nor 'khrul med pa'i bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /nga rang mar pa lo tsā la/ /zab mo gnad kyi bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /byin rlabs dngos grub bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu chen slob ma'i 'khor tshogs la/ /dad pa dam tshig bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis

shog /yon bdag yul mi nye ring la/ /mthun rkyen tshogs gsog bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis cerdzog /las dang bya ba thams cad la/ /'gre 43 byang chub bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la/ /chad mdo btsan pa'i bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /'dir tshogs khrom gyi lha mi la/ /bde skyid smon lam bkra shis yod/ /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /ces gsungs pa'i rjes su/ bla ma rngog pas 'bul ba rnams phul nas/ bla ma rin po che/ spyir gyis bdag rang gi sgo gsum bla ma dbang lags na'ang / da lan khyad par du yul na ra ma zhol mo rkang chag ma zhig yod pa de spyir gyis ra rnams kyi phyi mo yin pas rgas pa dang / khyad par rkang pa chag nas 'dir 'ong ma pher bar lus/ de min nor skurdzod dgu kun bla ma la 'bul ba lags pas/ dbang gdams ngag zab khyad thoni pa kun dang / khyad par

ra༅༅/ /snyan gyi shog ril gyi gdams ngag thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus nas/ phyag phul bas/ bla ma mar pa dgyes bzhin 'o de ltar lags na/ nga'i zab khyad can gyi dbang dang gdams ngag rnams kyang / spyir gyi rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam bskal pa grangs med kyi bar du bsgug mi dgos par tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag yin pa dang / khyad par ce(ga ril gyi gdams ngag la/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya dam po yod pas/ rgas pa dang rkang pa chag na'ang chag ra ma ma phul na 'ong ba dka' mo lags/ de min gyi gdams ngag gzhan rnams khyod rang la byin tshar ro gsungs pas/ gral pa kun bzhad gad theg pa zhig byung / yang bla ma rngog pas zhol mo yang blangs te phul na bka' rgya bkrol nas gnang du rung lags sam zhus pas/ khyod rang gis blangs te phul na rung gsungs/ der mi rnams gyes pa'i nang par bla ma rngog pa gcig pur byone nas/ ra ma rgyab tu

bsdams nge/ bla ma la phul bas/ bla ma shin tu dgyes te/ gsang sngags kyi slobo ma dam tshig can bya ba khyodi 'dra ba la zer ba yin/ nga ra ma zhig rang gis dgos rgyu chung ste/ chos kyi che ba 'don pa la dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ dbang dang gdams pa khyad par can mang po gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes te/ phyis gnang ngo / /de nas thag ring gi grwa pa rnams dang / nang mi nyung bsdus 'ga' bsags nas/ bya dga'i tshogs mchod cig byas pa'i gral du/ bla ma mar pa'i sku 'khris su seng ldeng gi dbyug pa ring po zhig yod pa de bzhag nas/ bla ma rngog pa la spyan 'bru tshugs su gzigs shing phyag sdigs mdzub tu mdzad nas/ rngog stoni chos rdor khyod thos pa dga' zer ba'i mi ngan 'di la dbang bskur nas gdams ngag bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin gsungs spyan dbyug pa la hrig hrig 'dug pa dang / bla ma rngog pa thugs skrag ste/ phyag 'bul ba'i ngang nas/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bla ma rang

ra༅༅/ /gis mthu chen la dbang bskur gdams ngag stod gsung ba'i phyag rtags/ nā ro'i sku rgyan/ thugs dam pad+ma rā ga rten dang bcas pa gnang byung bas bka' bsgrubs pa lags/ des na bdag la gnong 'grod med pas bka' bskruni dang thugs khrel med pa zhig mjen zhus nas spyan rig rig 'dug pas/ thugs khros pa'i phyag mdzub nga la gtad de/ khyod la de kun gang nas byung gsung pas/ nga ni snying thon 'gro ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal dang / 'jigs skrag skad mi thon pa lta bu byung ste/ 'dar ba'i skad kyis bdag la yum gyis gnang ba lags zhus pas/ har gyis bzhengs te/ seng ldeng gi dbyug pa 'phyar nas/ yum la phyag 'bebs su chas pa las/ yum gyis snga sku( nas dgongs te/ bzhengs nas phyir rgyangs bskyed de bzhugs 'dug pa/ mchod khang nang du bros te sgo bcad pas/ bla ma sgo la phyag hrad hrad pa 'ga' mdzad pa'i mthar/ bzhugs

gdan gyi khar byon nas/ rngog ston chos rdor zer ba'i ma bcol ba byed mkhan khyod rang / nga'i nā ro'i sku rgyan dang thugs dam rnams da lta rang longs shog cig gsung dbu gtums nas bzhugs pa la/ de ma thag bla ma rngog pas phyag phul nas sku rgyan dang thugs dam len par chas nas phyir byone byung ba/ ngas kyang yum dang dus mnyam du phyir bros te bsam bzhin ngu bro ba zhig byung nas phag tu ngu zhing bsdad pas mthong ste/ phyag phyir khrid par zhu ba phul bas/ bla ma'i bkas ma grol bar ngas khyed khrid rung da lan gyi 'di dang 'dra ste/ rang re gnyis ka la mi dga' bas da lan sdod/ phyis nges par rjes su mi 'dzin zhing bkas grol na phan ci thogs byed do gsungs pa la/ 'o na bdag sdig sgrib ches pa'i zhor la bla ma dang yum la yang 'o brgyal 'di 'dra byung bas/ da lan gyi lus 'di chos mi thob pa'i khar sdig pa che la mang ba gsog par gda' bas lceb nas shi sdod/ phyi ma chos thobe pa'i mi lus shig

ra༅༅/ /tu skye bar thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu byas lceb grabs byas pas/ bla mas nga bzung ste/ spyan chab bsil zhing / a bo mthu chen de 'dra ma byed cig /rgyal ba'i bka'i mthar thug gsang sngags kyi lugs la/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lha las 'da' sa med pa zhig skusnad pa yin/ dus la ma bab par 'pho ba byas rung lha bsad pa'i nyes pa yod na/ lcebs na de bas sdig che ba ci yod/ mdo lugs la'ang rang srog rang gis bcad pa las sdig che ba med pas de rnams trere bar gyis la lceb pa'i bsam rjodar ngor cig /da dung bla mas chos gnang ba'ang srid/ ma gnang rung bla ma gzhan la chos thob pa zhig nges par 'ong gsungs zhal ta gnang ba'i bar la/ grwa pa gzhan rnams kyis kyang / nga la thugs kyis ma bzod par/ res yar byon nas bla ma la zhu skabs e 'dug bltas/ res 'ga' mar byon nas nga la sems gso mdzad rung / nga'i snying

'di lcags las byas pa yin nam/ min na gas te 'chi thang snyam pa'i sdag bsngal byung ste/ tshe stode la sdig pa chen po byas pas chos zhu ba rang gi phyir yang de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong gsungs/ de'i tshe chos nyan pa kun gyi nang nas mchi ma drag po mi gtong ba ni gcig kyang med de/ skyo shas dang nges 'byung gis brnangs te brgyal ba yang 'ga' byung ngo / /sdug bsngal yi chad kyi sgo nas sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i mdzad pa ste gnyis pa'o// //gsum pa ni/ yang ras chung pas/ 'o na rje btsun bla ma mar pas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rkyen ci lta bu zhig byung zhus pas/ der grwa pa rnams kyis yar 'byon mar 'byone mdzad pas dar cig nas mar pa dgongs pa las bzhengs te/ thugs zhi ba'i ngang nas 'o da bdag med ma la 'dir 31ga gyis shig gsungs/ yum gdan drangs phyin pas/ rngog chos sku rdo rje la sogs pa'i grwa pa gzhan tsho gar song gsungs pa la/ bla ma rngog pa/ bla ma rang gi bkas nā ro'i sku rgyan

ra༅༅/ /dang thugs dam da lta long shog gsungs pa ltar len du 'byon par chas nas sgo phyir phebs te/ a bo mthu chen gyis zhu ba 'di ltar 'bul ba la zhal ta 'di ltar gnang zhing da lta bzhugs gda' zhes zhib rgyas zhus pas/ mar pa spyan chab nyil mdzad de/ gsang sngags kyi slob ma zhes bya ba de 'dra zhig dgos rgyu yang yin/ yin pa bzhin byung gis/ da nga'i bu slob rnams snying rje bas bos shog cig gsungs/ der grwa pa 'ig gis bla ma rngog pa gdan 'dren du phyin/pas/ da bla ma thugs zhi nas nga gdan 'dren du btang ba yin pas phebs par zhu zhus 'gyon pa la/ ngas mi las 'phro can tsho'i dga' ba la/ las ngan po nga la ni bla ma thugs zhi rung drung du 'gro ba'i skal ba med pas phyin rung bka' bskruni dang phyag 'bebs las mi 'ong byas ngu zhing bsdad pas/ bla ma rngog pa yang bzhugs nas grwa pa de la/ bla ma'i drung du a bo mthu chen gyi rgyu mtshan rnams zhus la/ sku

drung du 'grerdzor rung ngam rnyasnas 31ga /de bar la ngas 'dir ma bsdad na/ 'dis gang min byas nyen 'dug gsungs/ grwa pa des bla ma mar pa la rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas/ sngar yin na kho bden/ da de 'dra byed mi dgos/ da lan 'bod pa'i mgron gyi gtso bo mthu chen yin pas/ bdag med ma song la bos shog cig gsungs/ der yum zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas byon te/ a bo mthu chen da rang bla mas khyod rjes su 'dzin pa 'dra/ thugs rje gting nas g.yos pa'i rtags la da lan mgron gyi gtso bo kho yin pas nga rang la bos shog cig gsungs/ nga rang la'ang bka' bskrune yang ma byung / dga' bar gyis la 'dong ngo gsung pa la/ da dung bden nam rdzun snyam pa'i the tshom 'ordzog ge ba zhig la nang du phyin pas/ gral 'grig pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ brtags na rang re kun la gyod med de/ ngas ni mthu chen gyi sdig pa sbyong thabs su sdug btang ba ma gtogs rang 'dod kyi mkhar las yin na zhi

ra༅༅/ /ba'i sgo nas bcol bas chog pas nga bden/ bdag med ma ni spyir bud med du song ba dang / sgos su snying rje che rab cig 'dug pas ma phod pa bden na'ang / rten dang bcas pa'i yig rdzus de gnang ches/ jog chos sku rdo rje ni khyod rang zer ba ltar bden te/ zhon kyang rten rnams re zhig tshur longs shog /rjes su khyod rang la ster ba yin/ mthu chen ni chos kyi 'dod pas gdungs 'dug pas ci thob kyi thabs byed pas bden/ da lan rngog la bdag med mas yig rdzus bskur ba ni ma go/ rngog ston gyis mthu chen la dbang bskur gdams ngag byin pa'i rkyen gyis/ da yi chad btang thabs ma rnyed pas/ tshig pa log pa gros kyi chu log ltar byung rung 'jig rten pa'i de dang mi 'dra ste/ rnam pa cir snang rung thams cad chos phyogs nas yus theg pa yin pas/ ngo bo byang chub kyi lam du 'grerdzo bas/ gral pa chos ma bordzo ba rnams dad pa ma 'o(ga cig /lar rang nga'i bu 'di la yi

chad chen po lan dgu thongs na/ phyis mi lus len mi dgos par phung po lhag med du sangs rgya ba yod pa yin te/ de ltar ma byung bas sdig sgrib kyi lhag cung zad cig lus pa bdag med ma blo chung bas lan/ 'one kyang sdig pa tshabs chen 'dag pa'i yi chad chen po brgyad dang snang chung mang po'i sgo nas tshar bcad song ba yin/ da rjes su bzung nas mi rgan nga rang gi snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams ngag rnams byin te/ sgrab rgyags yang nga rang gis sbyangs nas 〉snam du 'jug pa yin pas dga' bar gyis shig gsung byung ba dang / de'i tshe nga'i yid la / nga'i 'di rmi lam yin nam mngoni sum yin/ rmi lam yin na gnyid ma sad na dga' ste snyam pa'i dga' spro tshad med pa zhig byung ste/ yang dga' drags ngu cerdzor ba'i ngang nas phyag phul bas/ yum dang bla ma rngog pa serdzogs tshogs pa kun bla ma la tshar gcod pa'i tshe thabs mkhas pa'am/ rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshe thugs rje che ba'am/ bla ma rang sangs rgyas

༄༅༅/ /dngos su 'dug snyam lhag par dad pa skyes pa dang / nga la thugs brtse bas spyan chab bsil zhing bka' drin che zhes phyag phul ba'i mthar tshogs pa kun bzhad gad theg ge ba'i ngang nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ro/ /de'i nub mo tshogs pa kun 'dzom sar mchod pa bshams nas/ thun mong so thar gyi sdom pa ster gsungs/ nga'i skra bregs/ lus bsgrur nas ming dang po nas phrad dus kyi rmi lam du nā ros btags tshar yod gsungs/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan du btanas te dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslabo bya gnang ste/ nang mchod kyi ka pā la la ched gnyer gyi thugs gtad pa'i byin rlabs mdzad pas/ nang mchod 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan du khol ba kun gyis dngos su mthong / de nas thog mar bla ma yi dam mchod/ de nas mar pa rang gis bzhes/ de nas nga la gnang byung ba/ ngas lhag ma ma lus par 'thungs pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas rten

'brel bzang / brgyud pa gzhan 'ga' zhig gi dbang bzhi rdzogs pas nga'i nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi myong ba lhag na'ang / gsang sngags smin byed kyi dbang nang par nas bskur ro gsungs/ de nas bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bzhengs nas dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor stoni pa'i tshe/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la phyag mdzub gtad de/ 'di mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor bya ba yin/ mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor 'di na gsungs/ nam mkha' la phyag mdzub gtad byung bas/ 'khor lo sdom pa la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros bskor nas khra lam me bzhugs pa dngos su mthong / de'i tshe bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lhas mgrin gcig tu gsang mtshan dpal bzhad pa rdo rjer btags te/ rgyud kyi lung rnams rgyas par gnang nas/ man ngag gi nyams len dang / phyag len rnams mthil phyin par bstan

ra༅༅/ /te/ bla ma'i phyag nga'i spyi por bzhag nas/ bu khyod slob ma snod ldan du dang po nas shes te/ khyod nga'i sar 'ong ba'i nub mo/ nga la rmi lam 'di 'dra byung ba khyodad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan thogs pa'i rtags su 'dug /bdag med ma la rmi lam 'di 'dra byung 'dug pa yang 〈snang dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par dkod gnyer bud med kyi byed pa de/ chos bdag mkha' 'gros byed pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ des na khyod nga la bla ma mkha' 'gros gnang ba'i slob mar byung bas ngas kyang phru slog pa ltar byas nas bsur 'ongs pa yin/ khyod kyis ngas byin pa'i chang rdzogs par 'thungs pa dang / phru rdzogs par bslogs pa de gdams ngag gi snod du gyur cing rdzogs par khong du chud pa'i rtags su byung / de nas zangs phul ba de la lung bzhi 'dug pa de/ nga la yongs grags kyi bu chen bzhi 'ong ba'i rtags su 'dug /dreg pa la sogs pa'i dri ma med pa de/ khyod rang

sems nyone mongs pa'i dri ma chung zhing lus gtum mo'i bde drod la dbang ba'i rtags su 'dug /stong par phul ba des khyod sgrub pa byed pa'i tshe/ 'tsho ba bkren tsam 'ong bar 'dug ste/ 'on kyang tshe smad dang / bu rgyud la longs spyod chen po 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir dang / snedi ldan gyi slob ma gdams ngag gi bcud kyis tshim par bya ba'i phyir/ ngas mchod me'i mar khus bkang bzhag /snyan grags chen ngo 'byung ba'i phyir zangs la skad ci thoni byas/ khyod rang gi las sgrib sbyang phyir ngas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi mkhar las bcol ba dang / dbang gral nas bton pa sogs mi 'tshams pa du ma'i sgo nas yi chad mang po btang ba la log lta ma skyes pa des/ khyodi kyi bu brgyud rnams dang por dad brtsone shes rab snying rje che ba sogs slob ma'i chos kun tshang ba dang / bar du tshe 'di'i 'dod yoni la zhen pa chung zhing dka' spyad snying rus kyis ri la sgom bsran che ba dang / mthar nyams myong dang byin

ra༅༅/ /rlabs mkhyen brtser ldan phyir mtshan ldan gyi bla ma sha stag 'byung bas bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar byed pa yin pas dga' bar gyis shig gsung lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung / gzengs bstod/ spro ba skyed pa mdzad de skyid pa'i 'go tshugs pa yin gsungs/ dbang dang gdams ngag thob pa'i mdzad pa ste gsum pa'o// //bzhi pa ni/ yang ras chung pas/ rje btsun gyis gdams ngag gsan ma thag ri khrod la byone nam/ bla ma'i drung du bzhugs zhus pas/ der nga la bla ma'i gsung gis sgrub pa rem la gyis shig gsungs/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad bzang po dang bcas te/ lho brag stag nya'i brag la sgom du bcug /de'i tshe ngas mchod kong mar khus bkang ba la me spar nas/ spyi bor bzhag ste mar me ma rdzogs bar du lus mi 'gul bar nyin mtshan thog thag 'da' bar byas te bsgoms nas zla ba bcu gcig song ba dang / bla ma yab yum tshogs kyi

'khor lo'i yo byad bzang po bsnams nas byon te/ bla cha/'i zhal nas bu kho de zla ba bcu gtsig tsam stan gyi drod ma yal bar sgom nus pa dga' rab yin/ da re zhig bug sgo bzhig lapha rgan nga'i 'gram du khams dub pa bsang ba dang / nyams skye tshul gyi gleng mo byed pa la cerdzog cig gsung ba la/ khams dub gso ba rang de ka yin te/ bla ma'i bka' yin pas 'gro dgos snyam nas/ bug sgo bzhig par brtsams pas phangs pa'i snang ba zhig byung ste bzhig ma phod par yug cig de gar bsdad pas/ yum phebs nas/ bu 'ong gin yod de gsungs/ bug sgo bzhig ma phod lags zhus pas/ mi skyone gsang sngags zab mo rten 'brel gyi che ba yin zhing / khyad par bla ma yang thugs gtum pas rten 'brel 'phyugs pa sogs byung na mi 'ong bas/ a mas bug sgo bzhig gis myur du byon cig gsungs/ bzhig byung ba la/ mad snyam phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas rang re pha bu gnyis mngon rtogs

ra༅༅/ /sgom/ cho ga gyis/ bdag med mas tshogs kyi sta goni gyis shig gsungs/ tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu gdams ngag rnams la nges shes ci skyes/ nyams rtogs dang go yul ci 'dra shar ba rnams blo lhod gyis la shod cig gsungs pa la/ bla ma'i drung du yid dad gus chen po'i ngang nas/ lus pus resna btsugs thal resna sbyar/ mig mchi ma 'khrug bzhin nyams rtogs 'bul ba'i thog mar ngag gi mgur la snga ba bla ma la yan lag bdun pa 'di phul 'o(/ /ma dag gdulabya'i snang ngo la/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur ston cing / /dag pa'i 'khor gyi gdul bya la/ /rje longs spyod rdzogs skur 'char la 'dud/ /yan lag drug cu'i tshangs dgrangs kyis/ /rang rang skad du dam pa'i chos/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gsung mdzad pa'i/ /grag stong dbyer med gsung la 'dud/ /'od gsal chos sku'i nam mkha' la/ /mtshan ma'i sgrib g.yogs

med bzhin du/ khes bya kun la khyab mdzad pa/ /'gyur med chos sku'i thugs la 'dud/ /chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang na/ /mi 'gyur bdag med sgru ma'i sku/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ /yum chen bdag med zhabs la 'dud/ /khyed kyis bsdus pa'i sras rnams dang / /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i slobo ma'i tshogase/ /'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /zol med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad na/ /mchod pa'i yo byad ci yode dang / /bdag lus khyed kyi spyan sngar 'bul/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor rgya chen bskor du gsol/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni/ /dpal ldan bla ma bzhugs su gsol/ /dge tshogs sems can don du bsngo/ /de ltar yan lag bdun pa zhig sngon du gsol nas/ skabs kyi zhu don la/ rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i bla mayab yum sras

no༅༅/ /dang bcas pa'i phrin las rnam par dkar ba dang / thugs rje tshad med pa'i byin rlabs kyi nus mthu dang / 'khor ba med pa'i bka' drin la brten nas 'bangs bdag la/ go yul gyi rtogs pa cung zad yod pa rnams 'bul bas/ thugs chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nas snyan cung zhig gsan du gsol/ thog mar ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed la sogs pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i lus/ rnam smin sha khrag gdos bcas rnam par shes pa'i 'dzin pa dang bcas pa 'di bsod nams can thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyidal 'gyor lus kyi gru chen/ las ngan can sdig pa gsog pa rnams kyi ngan 'gror khrid pa'i sna 'dren/ yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams/ mdun ma gtan legs dang gtan nyes kyi khe nyen shin tu che ba'i dus kyem pa zhig yin par go shing / de yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas shin tu thar dka' ba 'di la/ da lan rje 'gro ba'i

ded dpon khyed kyi mthu la brten nas sgrol du re byed pa la/ thog mar bla ma daskad mchog gsum la skyabs zhus nas bslab bya tshul bzhin du slob pa dang / de'i nang nas kyang bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma yin par 'dug pas/ ci gsung dang du len cing dam tshig ma nyams par byed pa 'di gal che ba'i gnad ka dang po yin par besna lags/ de rjes dal 'gyor rnyed dka' dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa las rgyu 'bras 'bor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams drag tu bsams pas blo rang dbang med par 'khul nas/ gsor ba las thar par 'dod pa'i bsam pas rten so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gang yang rung ba zhig la brten dgos te/ rten sa gzhi dang 'dra la/ de la brten nas theg pa rim gyis 'dzeg cing khas blangs pa'i bslab bya mig 'bras ltar bsrung ba dang / gal te nyams na phyir 'chos shing / rang zhi bde done du gnyer ba theg pa dman par 〈snal bas/ sems can thams cad 'kherdzor ba mtha'

ra༅༅/ /dag las sgrol bar 'dod pas byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ byams dang snying rjes ci byed thams cad gzhan done du bsngo ba theg chen sems bskyed yin par go lags/ nyan rang gi lam spangs nas/ theg pa chen po'i lam du 'jug pa la lta ba rnam dag gis gzhi bzung nas bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam du 'jug ste/ de yang lta ba rnam dag rtogs par byed pa la/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis/ dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa'i cho ga tshang zhing ma nor ba la brda 'phyod pa'i thabs shes dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ dbang zhes pa zab mo lta ba la dbang bas/ da gzod rim pa bzhin sgom ste/ de yang mtshan nyid theg pa dang thun mong ba gang zag gi bdag med tshol ba la 'bad de/ lung dang rigs pa gnyis ka la dbe dang rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas btsal bas bdag ma rnyed pa dang gang zag gis bdag med rtogs/ de ltar gang zag ma rnyed pa dang sems mnyam par

'jog dgos te/ rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ rnam rtog rgyun chad nas sems rtog med du lhan song ste/ lo dang zla ba zhag la sogs pa ji tsam song yang rang gis mi shes par gzhan gyis tshod 'dzin dgos pa byung ba ni zhi gnas skyes pa yin/ de la dran shes kyis bskyangs nas bying rmugs su ma song bar/ rig pa'i ngar 'don byas pas/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la rtog pa med pa/ rjen ne yer re/ sal le sing nge ba de zhi gnas kyi nyams yin/ de la lhag mthong du 'dzin rung / so so skye bo la lhag mthong mtshan nyid pa mi 'char bas/ sa dang po bi pa dang lhag mthong dang mjal ba yin snyam lags/ des na dmigs pa la brten nas rnam pa lam du byed pa yin/ gzhan zhi gnas kyi nyams snang lha sku sogs mthong snang sna chogs byung ba rnams bsgoms pa'i rtags tsam yin gyi/ snying po gang yang med snyam lags/ mdor na zhi gnas bzang po'i nyams ngar 'don dang

ra༅༅/ /bcas pa dang / so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab zab mos dasad pa dang bcas pa 'di/ lhag mthong thob par byed pa'i thabs med mi rung / skas la 'dzeg pa'i skas them 'og ma dang 'dra bsam lags/ zhi gnas sgom pa sogs mtshan bcas mtshan med gang byed thams cad kyi sngon du byams snying rjes kun nas slong ste/ ci byed gzhan don du dmigs pa'i sems bskyed kyis zin pa dang / bar du lta ba rnam par dag pas dmigs med du sbyong ba dang / tha ma gzhan don du bsngo ba rnyed lam gyi rgyas 'debs dmigs med kyi ngang nas byed pa lam thams cad kyi mchog yin par go lags/ mi stogs pa la zan go bas mi phan za dgos pa ltar/ stong nyid rtogs pa la don go bas mi chog sgom dgos par go lags shing / khyad par lhag mthong rtogs pa'i thabs rjes thob tu bsag sbyang gnyis la yengs med du 'bad dgos par go lags/ don dril ba la/ da lta rnal 'gyor pa

nyams su len pa'i stong nyid/ mnyam nyid brjod med mi rtog pa rnams dbang bzhi dang mthun pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim gyi lta ba yin par go lags/ go ba rnams mngone du byed pa la lus la bab bskur/ lto la gyong bskur/ sems la las bskur nas snang ba gdong 'ded/ 'chi nus thog 'gel ci byung ro snyoms nas/ bka' drin 'khor thabs med pa'i bla ma yab yum gyi drung du/ zang zing gi zhabs tog 'bul rgyu ma byung bas/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'bul zhing / mthar thug gi rtogs pa 'og min chos kyi pho brang du 'bul bar zhu/ rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i bdag med yum/ /rgyal sras sprul pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /rga swār+shags yid yul shar ba yi/ /tshig 'ga' snyan du phul ba la/ /ma rtogs log rtog 'khrul rtog sogs/ /nyes tshogs thams cad bzod par gsol/ /slar yang chos bzhin 'chos par zhu/ /rje khyed kyi

ra༅༅/ /thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor las/ /byin rlabs kyi tsha zer 'phros pa yis/ /bdag blo'i pad+mo kha phye ste/ /nyams rtogs kyi dri bsung 'phro ba 'di/ /drin lan la 'kherdzor thabs ma mchis pas/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pa rgyun du 'bul/ /sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa dang / /bsgrubs 'bras kyis 'dzato la phan par mdzod/ /'bangs zhu phod ches na bzod par gsol/ /zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu khyod la de tsam zhig re yang re ste byung 'dug gsung mnyes mnyes mdzad/ yum gyi zhal nas/ nga'i bu 'di la 'di tsam zhig 'ong ba'i blo stobasatre dang nus pa zhig yod gsung shin tu dgyes te chos kyi gleng mo mang du gnang nas yab yum gnyis gzim khang du byon/ ngas kyang sngar ltar 'dag sbyar la bsgoms/ de'i tshe bla mas kyang dbu ru byang phyogs su 'gro don la byon nas/ mar pa mgo legs kyi sar tshogs 'khor zhig mdzad pa'i nub mo sngar paṇa chen nā ro'i brda'i gsung ma

go ba zhig yod pa de/ mkha' 'gros bkrol zhing / brdas bskul te/ nā ro pa dang mjal du 'byon par dgongs te/ gro bo lung du phebs nas zhag 'ga' bzhugs yod pa'i tshe/ nub gcig nga'i rmi lam du bud med sngo bsangs ma dar gyi na bza' dang / rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ser khyug ge yod pa zhig byung nas/ bu khyod la yun du bsgoms pas sangs rgya ba phyag rgya chen po dang / chos drug gi gdams ngag de 'dug ste/ skad cig ma gcig bsgoms pas sangs rgya ba khyad par gyi 'pho ba krong 'jug gi gdams ngag de mi 'dug pa zhus shig zer song ba la/ ngas bsam mno zhig btang bas/ bud med de mkha' 'gro ma'i cha byad du 'dug rung / mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yin nam/ bdud kyi bar chad yin mi shes/ gang yin na'ang nga'i bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis mi mkhyen pa'am/ ma rtogs pa gcig kyang med de/ ya gi sangs rgyas thob pa'i

ra༅༅/ /gdams ngag man chad nas/ ma ki rdza gtugs byed pa'i gdams pa yan yod pa yin pas/ brgya la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yin na grong 'jug cis kyang zhu dgos snyam nas/ 'dag car bzhig ste bla ma'i drung du phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mtshams dam po la mi sdod par/ bar chad byung nyen yang yod ci la 'ongs gsungs pa la / bdag la bud med 'di 'dra zhig gis 'di skad zer byung ba bar chad yin nam lung bstan yin ma shes/ gal te lung bstan yin na grong 'jug zhur 'ongs pa lags pas gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ yug cig dgongs pa la bzhugs nas/ de mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yin par 'dug ste/ nga rgya gar nas tshur 'ong dus/ paṇa chen nā mo'i zhal nas/ grong 'jug gi gsung sgros shig byung ba las zhus su tshor ba mi 'dug pas/ rgya dbe rnams bklags te tshol ba yin gsungs dpon slobe gnyis kas nyin mtshan phrugs gcig tu grong 'thug

gi dpe btsal bas/ 'pho ba'i yig cha mang du rnyed de/ grong 'jug gi yi ge 'gru gcig kyang ma rnyed pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ dbu ru byang phyogs su byung ba'i brda de yang 'di zhu ba la bskul bar 'dug /gzhan yang gdams ngag ci yode mi shes par 'dug pas zhu ru 'dzato gsung pa la/ sku na bgres pa'i rgyu mtshan serdzogs phul nas bzhol ci btab rung ma thebs par/ slobo ma rnams kyi 'bul ba gser du sgrilabs/ gser dkar yol gang byung ba bsnams te rgya gar la byon pas/ nā ro pa spyode pa la gshegs pa dang thug /srog la ma stos par tshol snyam rten 'brel mang po bsgrigs pas mjal ba'i lung bstan kho na thob ste/ gsol ba 'debs shing btsal bas/ nags gseb cig tu mjal te/ pū la ha ri'i dboni par gdan drangs nas/ 'pho ba grong 'jug gi gdams ngag zhus pas/ paṇa chen nā ro'i zhal nas/ 'di khyod rang dran nam lung bstan byung gsung ba la/ 'di bdag rang dran pa

ra༅༅/ /min/ bdag la lung bstan byung ba'ang min/ bdag la slob ma thos pa dga' zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung nas zhur 'ongs pa lags zhus pas/ ngo mtshar che/ bod mun nag gi gling na skyes bu gangs la nyi ma shar ba 'dra ba yang yod par 'dug gsungs/ phyag gnyis spyi bor thalamo sbyar te/ byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum na/ /gangs la nyi ma shar 'dra ba'i/ /thos pa dga' zhes bya ba yi/ /skyes bu de la phyag 'tshal 'o(/ /zhes gsung zhing spyan btsum te/ dbu gug gug pa lan gsum mdzad pas/ rgya gar gyi ri dang rtsi shing rnams kyang bod kyi phyogs la mgo gug gug pa lan gsum byung zhing / dus da lta'i bar du yang pū la ha ri'i ri dang shing rnams bod kyi phyogs la mgo gug ge yod par 'dug /de nas mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang nas/ paṇa chen nā ros rten 'brel zhig bsgrigs pa las/ mar

pa'i phyag 'tshal lugs kyi rten 'brel gyis gdung brgyud thung ba tsam byung na'ang / nga'i phrin las kyi chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung las ring ba 'ong ba'i lung bstan thob ste/ bod du gdan phebs/ de nas phyag 'tshal lugs kyi rten 'brel gyis sras dar ma mdo sde sku yal ba'i lo mchod kyi mchod 'bul la/ grwa pa bu slob kun 'dzom pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs gral du/ bla ma la slob ma bu chen rnams kyis zhus pa/ bla ma rin po che/ sras dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas lta bu de ni bdag cag sems can rnams kyi bsode nams kyis ma thub/ bla ma rang ni sku na bgres gda' bas/ da bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che ji ltar dar bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag cag slobe ma rnams la gdul bya dang phrin las ji ltar 'byung ba'i lung bstan zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga nā ro paṇa chen gyi bu brgyud 'di rten 'brel dang rmi lam la mnga' brnyes pa yin zhing / bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la paṇa chen nā ro'i

ra༅༅/ /lung bstan bzang po yang yod/ khyed bu chen rnams kyis rmi lam sgugs la shog cig gsungs/ der bu chen rnams kyis rmi lam bzung nas zhus pas/ kun la rmi lam bzang po 'ga' byung 'dug na'ang / lung bstan phog pa ma byung ste/ nga la ka chen bzhi'i rmi lam byung tshul rnams bla ma'i drung du phul ba 'di ltar ro/ /rje rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du/ /mdang sum nyal ba'i rmi lam na/ /byung tshul bla ma'i drung du 'bul/ /snyan dar cig bdag la gsan par zhu/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i byang phyogs 'dir/ /lhun stug gangs ri chags pa rmi/ /gangs rtse mo dgung la reg pa rmi/ /rtse la nyi zla 'khor ba rmi/ /'od kyis nam mkha' gang ba rmi/ /rtsa bas sa gzhi khyab pa rmi/ /phyogs bzhir chu rgyun 'bab pa rmi/ /chu des 'gro kun tshim pa rmi/ /chu sna rgya mtshor 'bab pa rmi/ /me tog sna tshogs bkra ba rmi/ /spyir gyis rmi lam de ltar rmi/ /bla ma dus gsum

sangs rgyas la zhus pa lags/ /sgos lhun stug gangs ri mthon po de'i/ khar du ka chen btsugs pa rmi/ /ka thog tu seng chen 'gying ba rmi/ /seng g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa rmi/ /sder bzhi gangs la bgrad pa rmi/ /spyan mig spyon du gzigs pa rmi/ /seng gangs dkar gyi ltongs su 'gyo ba rmi/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la zhus pa lags/ /lto ru ka chen btsugs pa rmi/ /ka thog tu stag mo ngar ba rmi/ /stag grwa 'dzum mtha' nas rgyas pa rmi/ /khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa rmi/ /sder bzhi nags la bgrad pa rmi/ /spyan mig gyen la gzigs pa rmi/ /stag nags kyi gseb la 'gyo ba rmi/ /nags thang shing rgyud du sbrel ba rmi/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la zhus pa lags/ /nub tu ka chen btsugs pa rmi/ /ka thog tu khyung chen lding ba rmi/ /khyung gshog sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa rmi/ /khyung rwa gnam du gzengs pa rmi/ /spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa rmi/ /khyung nam mkha'i mthong la

ra༅༅/ /'phur ba rmi/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la zhus pa lags/ /byang du ka chen btsugs pa rmi/ /ka thog tu rgod po lding ba rmi/ /rgod rtse sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa rmi/ /rgod tshang brag la bcas pa rmi/ /rgod de la bu gcig byung ba rmi/ /bya phran gyis nam mkha' gang ba rmi/ /spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa rmi/ /rgod nam mkha'i mthongs la 'phur ba rmi/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la zhus pa lags/ /de ltar rmis pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /bzang ba'i dge ltas yin nam snyam/ /bdag ni nyams dga' shes pa spro/ /ngo sprod lung bstan gnang du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas/ bla ma shin tu mnyes te/ rmi lam bzang 'dug gsungs/ yum la bdag med ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzang po zhig gi grabs gyis gsungs/ der yum gyis yo byad rnams 'dzom pa dang / slob ma bu chen rnams bsags nas tshogs 'khor bzang po zhig mdzad pa'i gral du/ bla ma'i zhal

nas/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan la rmi lam 'di 'dra byung 'dug pa ngo mtshar che ang gsung ba la/ bu chen rnams kyi rmi lam de dag gi brda don bkrol nas lung bstan gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ skyes mchog sgra bsgrur chen pos bu slob rnams la rmi lam brda grol gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /paṇa chen nā ro'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir bzhugs rgedan gang bu slobe kun/ /rmi lam brda las byung ba yi/ /ngo mtshar ma 'ongs lung bstan 'di/ /pha gon nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs sa steng de/ /bod nang dar ba'i thub bstan yin/ /de steng gangs ri chags pa de/ /pha rgan mar pa lo tsā dang / /bka' brgyud yongs kyi bstan pa yin/ /gangs rtse mo dgung la reg pa de/ /lta ba 'gran zla med pa yin/ /rtse la nyi zla 'khor ba de/ /sgom pa 'od gsal mkhyen brtse yin/ /'od kyis nam mkha' gang ba de/ /thugs rjes ma rig mun sel

ra༅༅/ /yin/ /rtsa bas sa gzhi khyab pa de/ /phrin las kyis sa gzhi khyab pa yin/ /phyogs bzhir chu rgyun 'bab pa de/ /smin grol dbang bzhi'i gdams ngag yin/ /chu des 'gro kun tshim pa de/ /gdul bya smin cing grol ba yin/ /chu sna rgya mtshor 'bab pa de/ /'od gsal ma bu mjal ba yin/ /me tog sna tshogs bkra ba de/ /'bras bu skyone bral nyams myong yin/ /spyir rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang / /'dir tshogs grwa pa bu slob kun/ /sgos lhun stug gangs ri mthon po de'i/ khor du ka chen btsugs pa de/ /dol gyi tshur ston dbang nge yin/ /ka thog tu seng ge 'gring ba de/ /kho mi gzhi seng dang 'dra ba yin/ /seng g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa de/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin/ /sder bzhi gangs la bgrad pa de/ /tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa yin/ /spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa de/ /'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin/ /seng gangs dkar stongs su

'gro ba de/ /thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin/ khor rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang / /'dir tshogs grwa pa bu slob kun/ /lho ru ka chen btsugs pa de/ /gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor yin/ /ka thog tu stag mo ngar ba de/ /kho mi gzhi stag dang 'dra ba yin/ /stag grwa 'dzum mtha' nas rgyas pa de/ /snyan brgyad kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin/ /khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa de/ /sku gsum rang ngo 'phrod pa yin/ /sder bzhi nags la bgrad pa de/ /phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa yin/ ༄/spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa de/ /'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin/ /stag nags kyi gseb tu 'gyo ba de/ /thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin/ /thang shing rgyud du 'brel ba de/ /bu tsha bos brgyud pa 'dzin pa yin/ /rnyasna rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang / /'dir tshogs grwa pa bu slob kun/ /nub tu ka chen btsugs pa de/ /gtsang rong gi mese ston tshon po yin/ /ka thog tu khyeng chen lding ba de/ /kho mi gzhi khyung

ra༅༅/ /dang 'dra ba yin/ /khyung gshog mtha' nas rgyas pa de/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin/ /khyung rwa gnam du gzengs pa de/ /lta sgom gyi gol sa chod pa yin/ /spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa de/ /'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin/ /khyung nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phur ba de/ /thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin/ /nub rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang / /'dir tshogs grwa pa bu slob kun/ /byang du ka chen btsugs pa de/ /gung thang gi mi la ras pa yin/ /ka thog tu rbod po lding ba de/ /kho mi gzhi rgod dang 'dra ba yin/ /rgod rtse sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa de/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thebs pa yin/ /rgod tshang brag la bcas pa de/ /tshe srog brag las sra ba yin/ /rgod de la bu gcig byung ba de/ /'gran gyi do med cig 'ong ba yin/ /bya phran gyis nam mkha' gang ba de/ /bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin/ /spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa de/ /'khor

ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin/ /rbode nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phur ba de/ /thar pa'i gling du gshegs pa yin/ /byang rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang / /khyed 'dir tshogs rnams la bshad pa yin/ /nga pha rgan gyi bya ba byas shing tshar/ /da khyed bu slobo kyi dus la bab nas gda'/ /nga mi rgan gyi kha la gtad yode na/ /phyis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar nas 'ong / /zhes gsungs nas/ tshogs pa kun gyis dga' spro dpag tu med pa thob bo/ /de nas bla mas bu chen rnams la chos dang gdams ngag gi dkor mdzod rnams kha phye ste/ nyin 'chad cing / mtshan sgom du bcug nas kun thugs dam smar bar yode pa'i tshe/ bdag med ma'i zab dbang zhig mdzad pa'i nub mo/ thugs dgongs la/ bu slobo 'di rnams la khyad par du chos gang la gang gi bka' babs dang phrin las yod pa de la de ster dgos pas/ nang par tho rangs kyi rten 'brel la brtag par bya dgongs nas/ tho rangs 'od gsal gyi ngang

ra༅༅/ /nas bu chen rnams la gzigs pas/ gzhung gi rngog r+sā chos rdor dgyes rdor gyi rgyud 'grel 'ga' la ghor sbyang mdzad/ dol gyi tshur r+sā dbang nge 'pho ba sgom/ gtsang rong gi mes ston wo po 'od gsal sgom/ nga gtum mo sgom pa gzigs pas/ chos so so'i bka' babs dang phrin las gang yod mar+ṣa pas/ bla ma rngog pa la mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo nas rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu zhig yod pa de dang / nā mo'i rgyan drug /thugs dam pad+ma rā ga /dgang gzar blugs/ rgya 'grel gyi phyag dpe dang bcas pa gnang nas bshad pa'i sgo nas 'gro ni/ gyis shig gsungs/ dol gyi tshur stod dbang nge la 'pho ba rgya mthongs kha phye ba la bya 'phur ba lta bu zhig yod pa de dang / nā ro'i dbu lo/ phyag sen/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rnams gnang ste/ 'pho ba sbyongs shig gsungs/ gtsang rong gi mes ston wo po

la / 'od gsal mun nang du mar me spar ba lta bu zhig yod pa de dang / nā mo'i rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nya phyis kyi ka pā la rnams gnang nas/ bar do chod cig gsungs/ nga la gtum mo'i khyad chos shing gzhags la me sbar ba lta bu dang / mai tri pa'i dbu zhwa/ nā mo'i na bza' rnams gnang nas/ g.ya' khrod dang gangs khrod 'grims la lta 〉snam nyams su 'ordzongs shig gsungs/ de nas grwa pa kun 'dzom pa'i tshogs 'khor zhig mdzad pa'i gral du/ ngas khyed rnams la rten 'brel dang mthun pa'i gdams ngag byin pa bzhin/ slob brgyud rnams la yang gtso bo1ri rang rang gi gdams ngag gi phan thogs dang phrin las rgya cher 'byung ba yin no/ /da mdo sde 'bum ni med/ nga'i bka' brgyud kyi pha rabs kyi gdams dzag dang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa khyed rnams la gtad pa yin pas 'bungs shig /'gro zhe 'phel bar yodi do gsungs/ de nas bu chen rnams rang rang gi gdan sar phebs nga la bla
