ra༅༅/ /ma'i zhal nas/ khyod rang lo shas nga'i sar sdod/ dbang dang gdams ngag khyad par ba yang ster rgyu yod/ nyams rtogs kyang bla ma'i drung du gtan la 'bebs dgos pa yin pas/ mtshams dam po la sdod gsungs/ nā ros lung bstan pa'i zangs phug gi phug par bsdad pas/ yab yum gnyis kyis gtor phor re btang ba'i tshogs skal tshun gnang ste/ thugs shin tu brtse bar mdzad gsungs/ bla ma'i drung du ba〉sgoms pas nyams rtogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa'i mdzad pa ste bzhi pa'o// //lnga pa ni/ yang ras chung pas rje btsun bla ma mar pa'i drung nas 'byon pa de rkyen ci lta bu zhig gis bskul/ mar pa'i gsung gis 'ordzo shas sngerdzod gsung ba 'dug pa ji tsam bzhugs zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ngas der lo mang ma bsdad/ nga yul du 'ong ba'i rkyen/ nga mtshams kyi ngang nas dge sbyor smar bar yod cing / sngar yin na gnyid du ye mi 'gro ba

la / lan zhig tho rangs gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam na/ pha yul skya rnga'i rtsa na slebs pas/ khang pa ka bzhi gdung brgyad de bong gon gyi rna ba bzhin ral/ nang gi nor dam chos daskad mchog brtsegs pa de thigs pas gdungs/ phyi'i zhing 'or ma gru gsum de 'jag skyas 'phyur/ nye du ma rgan mo de shi/ sring mo de sprang ba la 'khyar ba rnams byung bas/ ma bu rnams nye du dgrar langs pa'i stabs kyis chung ngu nas sdug gyes la song ma phrad pa la brten nas/ skyo ba la tshad med pa zhig byung ste/ a ma dang sring mo'i ming nas bos nas mang po ngus pa zhig rmis pa las/ gnyid sad pa dang sngas mchi mas bangs 'dug /bsam mno zhig btang bas/ a ma dran du rang song / ngu mang po 〈snar te da ma rgan mo dang cis kyang phrad pa byed bsam nam langs pa dang / bug 〉sna bzhig nas bla ma'i drung du zhur phyin pas/ bla ma mnal du serdzong ba dang thug byung / der dbu'i sngas ma〈snar dman cha bzung ba'i lus ngag

ra༅༅/ /gis/ rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can/ /sprang lan zhig yul du gtong bar zhu/ /yul ngan rtsa yi ko wo na/ /nye ba dgrar langs kyi ma bu gsum//so sor gyes nas lo 'ga' thal/ /nga sems la 'phreng ste bzod glags med/ /lan zhig phrad du gtong bar zhu/ /phyin chad drung du myur du 'ong / /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma mnal sad pa dang / mkha' la nyi ma shar te/ dbu sngas kyi skar khung nas dbu la nyi ma shar ba dang / yum gsol 'dren du byung ba rnams dus gcig tu 'dzom pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas bu khyodi mtshams dam po la har 'don byas 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ bdud dang bar chad 'jug pa'i rgyu yin/ da lta rang log la mtshams la sdode gsungs pa la/ rmi lam du byung tshul dang slar yang zhu ba 'di ltar phul lo/ /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can/ /sprang lan zhig yul du gtong bar zhu/ /yul skya rnga rtsa yi ko phro na/ /nor lus pa'i dngos

po ma mchis te/ /sems 'phreng bar bya ba 'di 'dra bdog /khang pa ka bzhi gdung brgyad de/ /dus da lta 'gyel lam ma 'gyel lta/ /dam chos dkoni mchog brtsegs pa de/ /da lta thigs pas e gdungs lta/ /bzhos zhing 'or ma gru gsum de/ /da lta 'jag skyas e phyur lta/ /ma rgan lus kyi sbrom bu de/ /da lta sku khams e bzang lta/ /sring mo pe ta mgoni skyid de/ /da ltar 'khyar ram ma 'khyar lta/ /las kyis bskos pa'i mdzes se de/ /da lta khyim so e zin lta/ /khyim mtshes a khu g.yung rgyal de/ /da lta 'dug gam mi 'dug lta/ /a ne bdud mo stag 'gran de/ /da lta shi 'am ma shi lta/ /mchod gnas dkone mchog lha 'bum de/ /da lta bzhugs sam mi bzhugs lta/ /khyad par lus sems bskyed pa'i ma / /dran nas bzod glags mi gda' bas/ /lan zhig yul du gtong bar zhu/ /zhabs phyir myur du 'ong bar zhu/ /zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu kho de khyod dang por nga'i sar

ra༅༅/ /sleb pa'i tshe/ yul dang nye 'khor 'phreng dgos med pa'i gtam zhig 'dug pa la/ da yodi do mang po rang 'dug ste/ yul du phyin rung a ma dang phrad pa dka'/ gzhan rnams kyang thad kar e 'ong mi shes/ dbus gtsang gi phyogs su yang 'o/ 'ga' serdzong 'dug /'dir yang 'o/ mang po rang so/nga / da 'grerdzo na'ang btang bas chog ste/ phyis 'dir 'ong rtsis byas rung / khyod 'dir zhu ba 'bul du 'ongs pa dang / nga gnyid du song ba thug pa de/ rang re pha bu tshe 'dir mi 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel yin/ 'on kyang mkha' la nyi ma shar ba 'di/ khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mosnar byed pa'i rten 'brel yin/ khyad par nga'i mgo la nyi ma shar ba 'di sgrab brgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su byed pa'i rten 'brel yin/ bdag med mas tshogs 'khor khyer 'ongs pa 'di/ khyod ting nge 'dzin gyi zas kyis 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel yin/ da gtong ba las 'os mi 'dug pas/ bdag

med ma mchod pa bzang po zhig cerdzoms shig gsung / bla mas dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ yum gyis mchod pa bshams nas/ mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi smin lam brda'i dbang dang / grerdzol lam gyi gdams ngag gzhan la ma grags pa'i chig brgyud rnams rdzogs par gnang nas/ 'o lags serdzo/ /gdams ngag 'di rnams nga la jo bo nā ro pas khyodi rang la ster dgos pa'i lung bstan yod pas byin pa yin/ khyede kyis kyang mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i slob ma thog mar gang byung ba zhig la brgyud pa bcu gsum ma rdzogs kyi bar du chig brgyud kyi rgyas thob la byin cig /gzhan yang gdams ngag rnams zas nor dang tshe 'di'i ngo dga'i phyir du byin na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'ong bas dam par gyis la nyams su lorjas/ skal ldan gyi slob ma byung na zang zing gi 'bul ba med rung dbang dang gdams ngag gis rjes su zungs la bstan pa spel cig /tai los jo bo nā ro pa tshar bcad

ra༅༅/ /pa'am/ ngas khyod rang tshar gcod pa ltar byas na blo dman rnams la phan mi thogs pas de lugs kyi chos stoni 'tshams gyis/ rgya gar na chos 'di'i cha lag bka' rgya cung lhod pa lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu yod pa las/ bzhi ngas khyod rang la bstan pa ltar yin/ da dung lnga yod de nga rang gi brgyud pas phyin nas nā mo'i bu brgyud cig la zhus na longs shing sems can la phan thogs pa yod pas/ khyod kyis ci longs gyis/ khyod kyi bsam pa la nga zang zing gi 'bul ba med pas gdams ngag rnams rdzorges par ma byung ngam snyam na/ zang zing gi 'bul ba rang gis nga mi mgu/ khyod kyi sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang snying rus la mgu ba yin pas snying rus bskyed la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs shig /ngas jo bo nā ro pa'i gdams ngag rnams kyi nang nas bu chen gzhan rnams la med pa'i khyad chos/ mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag 'di khyod la mchog tu byin pas

bum pa gang byo'i tshul du yode do/ /nga'i tshig rnams la rdzun dang gdams ngag rnams la lhag chad skurdzod re zhes bla mas yi dam dpang du btsugs pa'i dbu snyung bzhes nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /na mo bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin can gong ma'i rnam thar la/ /bsams na gdams ngag de nyid rang / /mang po thob 'dod g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ /gnad kyi gsung ngag snying la chongs/ /de de mang yang 'di nyid med/ /sdong po mang yang 'bras bu med/ /yon tan yin kyang don dam min/ /de 'dra bslabs kyang 'di mthong med/ /bshad rgyu mang yang phan rgyu med/ /phan snying la thogs pa dam pa'i nor/ /nor phyug po 'dod na 'di la dril/ /chos nyon rer+shangs 'dul ba thabs kyi lam/ /lam btsan sa 'dzin na 'di la dril/ /sems kho thag chod pa chog shes dpon/ /dpon bzang po 'dod na 'di la dril/ /'khor bar ngu bro sgyid lug bskyar/ /mi med kyi rdza brag pha yi mkhar/ /

ra༅༅/ /grogs med gcig pu lha yi yul/ /sems la sems zhon chad med rta/ /rang lus dgon pa lha yi khang / /yengs med kyi dge sbyor sman gyi mchog /don dang ldan pa'i skyes bu la/ /don la thogs med kyi gdams ngag byin/ /nga dang gdams ngag khyod dang gsum/ /ma rul ma sungs ma skam par/ /bu yi lag tu bzhag pa 'dis/ /'bras bu lo 'dab rgyas par shog /ces gsungs nas/ phyag nga'i mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ bu khyod 'gro ba 'di sems la shin tu gcags pa zhig byung ste/ 'dus byas thams cad 'dis mtshon pa yin pas bya thabs med/ 'on kyang zhag 'ga' sdod/ gdams ngag rnams la bsam blo sang la dogs pa rnams chod gsungs/ der ngas kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin zhag 'ga' bsdad/ gdams ngag gi sgro 'dogs rnams chod pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ bdag med ma tshogs dang mchod pa bzang po zhig cerdzoms shig /da mi la

'gro ran pas gtong ba yin no gsungs/ yum gyis bla ma yi dam la mchod pa/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma/ rdo rje spun rnams la tshogs 'khor bzang po bshams pa'i tshogs gral du/ bla mas sku dgyes pa rdo rje/ 'khor lo bde mchog /gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs te yi dam gyi ska dang / rdo rje/ dril bu/ 'khor lo/ rin yo che/ pad+ma/ ral gri la sogase te phyag mtshan dang / tshu1 āḥhūṃ dkar dmar mthing gsum la sogs te yig 'bru dang / snad 'tsher ba'i thig ler snang ba dang / gang du'ang mi snang ba la sogs te du mar bstan nas/ de rnams bkode pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul bya ba yin te/ byung rgyal du bstan kyang dgos pa chung / da lan mi la ras pa 'grerdzo ba'i rdzongs su bstan pa yin gsung ba la/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong nas dga' ྅sne dpag tu med pa zhig byung ste/ nga rang ba〉snams nas rdzu 'phrul 'di lta bu thobe pa byed dbesnas snyam pa byung / bla

ra༅༅/ /ma'i zhal nas bu mthong ngam/ yid ches sam gsungs/ mthong lags/ yid mi ches pa'i rang dbang mi gda' bas/ bdag rang yang bsgoms nas 'di 'dra byed dgos snyam pa byung lags/ zhus pas/ bu de yin da 'gro na'ang song la/ ngas khyod la chos rnams sgru ma lta bur ngo sprad pas de bzhin du nyams su 'ordzong / gnas g.ya' khrod gangs khrod nags khrod rnams bsten/ ri khrod rnams kyi nang nas kyang la stod rgyal gyi shrī 'di rgya gar gyi spyob chen rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i ri yin pas de la sgoms/ gangs ti si sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i ri bo gangs can dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang yin pas de la sgoms/ la phyi gangs rwa yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal gau dā wa ri yin pas de la sgoms/ mang yul gyi ri bo dpal 'bar dang / bal yul gyi yol mo gangs rwa mdo phal po che nas lung bstan pa'i gnas yin pas de la sgoms/ brin gyi chu

dbar zhing skyedang gi mkha' 'grerdzo bzhugs shing 'du ba'i gnas yin pas de la 〉snams/ gzhan yang mi med kyi gnas mthun rkyen gang 'dzom du 〉rdzoms la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs shig khor phyogs na gnas chen de wī rka shi dang / tsā ri 'brel nas yod de/ de da lta zhal 'byed ma ran/ ma 'ongs pa na khyod kyi bu brgyud kyis 'dzin pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ khyod rang lung bstan pa'i gnas de rnams su sgrub pa gtso bor thon cig /sgrub pa nus na bla ma'i zhabs tog /pha ma'i drin lan/ sems can gyi 'gro don rnams de ka rang gis grub pa yin/ sgrub pa ma nus na tshe ring po las ngan gserdzog che ba las med pas/ tshe 'di'i 'dun thag bskyangs la/ tshe 'di'i don du gnyer ba'i mi dang lab ma byed par sgrub pa la 'bungs shig gsungs spyan chab nyil mdzad nas/ bu da rang re pha bu gnyis tshe 'dir mi phrad par 'dug paso/ ngas kyang khyod ma brjed par byed/ khyod rang yang nga ma brjed par gyis/ de

ra༅༅/ /ltar byas pas phyi ma dag pa mkha' spyod du phrad par the tshom med pas dga' bar gyis/ dus re zhig na rtsa rlung gi gegs shig 'ong bar 'dug pas de byung tshe 'di la stor+shas/ de bar ma lta gsung / thum byas pa'i cesag dril la cha'i dam kha 'byar ba zhig gnang / de'i dus kyi bla ma'i gsung rnams shin tu sems la phan zhing yid la 'jags pa zhig byung bas/ phyis gsung re re dran pa tsam gyis dge sbyor shed je che la song / de nas bla ma'i zhal nas bdag med ma/ nang par mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i grabs gyis/ yid skyo mo zhig 'ong rung skyel ma la 'gro dgos gsungs/ nga la khyod rang do nub nga'i sar nyol/ pha bu gleng mo byed pa yin gsungs/ ngas kyang bla ma'i drung du nyal bas/ der yum yang phebs byung ste/ thugs skyo ba'i nyams mang po mdzad cing bzhums pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bdag med ma ngu don ga la yod/ kho bla ma'i drung du snyan brgyud

kyi gdams ngag zab mo rnams thob nas/ ri khrod la sgom du 'gro ba la ngu ci dgos/ de bas spyir sems can rnams sangs rgyas yin pa la rang gis rang ma rig par sdug bsngalagyi ngang la 'chi ba rnams dang / khyad par mi lus thob nas chos med du 'chi ba 'di rnams la bsams na ngu bro/ de la ngu na khyodi la rtag tu ngu dgos par 'dug gsungs pas/ yum gyi zhal nas/ de dag lags te/ de lta bu'i snying rje rtag tu 'ong ba dka' mor gda'/ da lan rang las skyes pa'i bu 'khor 'das gnyis ka la blo gros rgyas shing / rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don grub pa de dang shi bral byung / dad brtson shes rab snying rjer ldan pa/ gang zer gyi kha la nyan pa'i bu gang nas bsams rung skyoni med pa 'di dang gsoni bral byung bas sems skyo ba la bzod thabs rang mi gda' zhes zhus nas cher bzhums pas/ nga ni mchi mas brnangs brnangs par yod/ bla ma yang spyan chab bsil bas/ dpon slob kun gcig la

ra༅༅/ /gcig 'phreng phyir thugs skyo ste spyan chab shor bas gsung gleng ma byung / nang par nam langs pa dang / tshogs chas bzang po bsnams nas dpon slob bcu gsum tsam gyis/ tsha lam gcig gi bar skyel ma mdzad pa'i lam bar la kun gyis thugs 'phreng ba'i skyo shas/ gsung 'phreng ba'i snying gtam/ sku 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur mang po mdzad cing byon/ de nas chos la sgang zhes bya ba phyogs kun gsal ba'i la kha zhig tu tshogs 'khor bzang po mdzad pa'i gral du/ bla mas nga'i lag pa phyag gis bzung ste/ bu khyod dbus gtsang phyogs su 'gro ba la/ gtsang sil ma la la sogs pa 'di kun jag nyen chen po yod pas/ grogs bzang po zhig dang bsdebs nas gtong snyam pa yin te/ gcig pur 'gro ba zhig shar byung / zhon kyang ngas bla ma yi dam la gsol ba btab/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la bka' bsgos/ bu'i lam bar la bar chad mi 'ong ba byed/ khyod rang yang spyod

lam gzab pa gal che/ da khyod 'di nas bla ma rngog pa'i drung du song la/ gdams ngag rnams la go bsdur gyis la khyad par ci 'dug ltos/ de nas yar myur du song la/ yul du'ang zhag bdun las mang ba ma sdod par/ ri khrod la sgrub pa gtso bor thon cig /rang gzhan kun gyi don yin no gsung ba la/ ngas zhu ba gtsang la yar 'gro'i glu 'di phul lo/ /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /sprang lan zhig gtsang phyogs yar la 'gro/ /'bangs lan zhig yul du 'gro ba la/ /pha bla ma rje yi bka' drin gyis/ /gtsang sil ma la yi la rtse na / /brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi bsu ba yod/ /rje byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyab rten daskad mchog gsum la 'chol/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i skyel ma yodi/ /grogs byang chub sems dang 'grogs nas 'gro/ /bsu mar lha srin sde brgyad yod/ /sdang ba dgra yi 'jigs dang bral/ /zhon kyang zhu ba 'bul ba la/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi skyel bsu

ra༅༅/ /zhu/ /bar chad rkyen gyi bzlog pa zhu/ /lus ngag sems la bsrung ba zhu/ /〉ni lam thugs khur rten 'brel zhu/ /thugs rje nus pa'i dbang bskur zhu/ /rgyud lung man ngag gi rgyab rten zhu/ /tshe ring nad med kyi bkra shis zhu/ /sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang mkhyen/ /ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu de rnams yin/ pha rgan ngas khyod rang la 'chad pa'i snying gtam gyi tha ma 'di rnams ma brjed par sems la chongs shig gsungs/ phyag nga'i masku rwa1ga tu bzhag nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las can chos dang mthun pa'i bu/ /chos sku sangs rgyas grub par cesag /ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa bdud rtsi'i ros/ /rten 'brel longs skur grub par shog /sems rtsa ba byang chub sdong po la/ /sprul sku'i lo 'dab rgyas par shog /bla ma'i bka' tshig rdo rje'i gsung / /snying la brjed med

gnas par shog /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs de/ /srog gi rtsa bar gnas par shog /chos skyong srung ma'i rgyab rten des/ /'bral ba med par skyong bar shog /rten 'brel zab mo'i spyod lam de/ /myur ba nyid du grub par shogo /chos mdzad kun gyi thugs rje des/ /dus gsum kun tu 'dzin par shog /gtsang sil ma la yi la thog tu/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi bsu ma yod/ /sang wo 'gro ba'i lam bar la/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i skyel ma yod/ /pha yul zhen pa'i mkhar zhing na/ /mi rtag sgru ma'i slob dpon yod/ /a ne sring mo'i nye 'khor la/ /rgyom zhig pa'i slob daphro yod/ /mi med lung pa'i brag phug na/ /'khor 'das brje ba'i tshong 'dus yod/ /snying rus luso kyi dgon pa na/ /lha bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchod khange yod/ /nad med za yi tshogs gsor la/ /mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i bdud rtsi yod/ /'khrul 'khor gnad kyi kha bskrur la/ /'bras rin chen skye ba'i so nam

ra༅༅/ /yod/ /yul mi rtsis chung ba'i rang yul der/ /'phral g.yeng ba med pa'i dge sbyor yod/ /mtshams dam po mi med khyi med na/ /rtags myur du mthong ba'i sgron me yod/ /zas dkor zas med pa'i rang zas la/ /bde ba lha yi pham phab yod/ /grib med lha yi gzhal yas na/ /rang don grub pa'i ltad mo yod/ /ngo lkog med pa'i lha chos la/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i phrin las yod/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i so nam la/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter kha yod/ /dam chos mkha' 'gro'i srog snying la/ /'khor 'das gyes pa'i so mtshams yod/ /mar pa lo tsā'i bu brgyud la/ /gtam snyan mang po'i 'ong sgo yod/ /mi la ras pa'i snying rus la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing yod/ /srog shing 'dzin pa'i skyes bu la/ /brgyud pa bzang po'i bkra shis shog /bka' brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /yi dam bzang po'i bkra shis shog /bde dgyes gsang gsum bkra

shis shog /dam chos bzang po'i bkra shis shog /mkha' 'gro'i srog snying bkra shis shog /mkha' 'gro bzang po'i bkra shis shog /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /chos skyong bzang po'i bkra shis shog /dud sol lha mo'i bkra shis shog /bu slob bzang po'i bkra shis shog /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyud nas brgyud bcas bkra shis shog /bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog /don de dag ma brjed nyams su longs/ /zhes gsung zhing dgyes dgyes mdzad/ de nas yum gyis lam chas bzang po dang gos lham so ma rnams gnang ste/ bu 'di rnams zang zing gi rdzongs mtshoni pa tsam yin/ 'di 'o cag ma bu gnyis kyi tshe 'di'i 'brel thag gi mjug ma gyis/ bu dge legs phun tshogs kyi ngang nas bzhud par zhu/ phyi ma u rgyan mkha' spyode du mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ chos kyi rdzongs la a ma'i snying gtam 'di rnams kyang ma brjed pa gyis shig gsung / ka pā

ra༅༅/ /la bdud rtsis bkang ba'i snod bcud dang bcas pa gnang ste/ yum gyis mgur 'di bzhes so/ /drin can mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu snying rus can gyi sdug bsran can/ /phyi thag ring zhing ngang ring po/ /skal ba can gyi bu khyod ni/ /bla ma'i bdud rtsi ye shes chang / /ngoms par 'thung la bzhud par zhu/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /ngo shes bzhin du phrad par spyod/ /pha dang ma gnyis ma brjed par/ /gserdzol ba yang yang 'o dod bos/ /snying la phan pa'i gdams ngag zas/ /'grangs par za zhing bzhud par zhu/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /ngo shes bzhin du phrad par smon/ /drin can pha ma ma brjed par/ /bka' drin sems shing snying rus mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs zab mo'i gos/ /gro bar rgyani zhing bzhud par zhu/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /ngo shes bzhin du phrad par smen/ /ma nus sems can ma brjed par/ /rang sems byang

chub lam la chug /theg chen sems bskyed bstan pa'i khur/ /che bar bsnams la bzhud par zhu/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /ngo shes bzhin du phrad par spyod/ /skal ba bzang mo'i bdag med mas/ /bu la snying gtam bskul ba rnams/ /bus kyang ma brjed snying la zung / /mas kyang yid la tur re byed/ /sems yid mthun pa'i ma bu gnyis/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /ngo shes bzhin du phrad par smon/ /smeX pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /drin lan chos kyis 'khor bar 〈snag /ces gsung zhing spyan chab mang po bsil/ der tshogs pa kun spyan chab bsil zhing thugs skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur mang po mdzad cing gda'/ ngas kyang yab yum gnyis la phyi phyag phul zhabs spyi 'or blangs/ dbang zhus smoni lam btab nas/ ji srid bla ma'i zhal ras ma mthong gi bar la phyi 'gros kyis 'ongs pas/ 'khor bcas kun spyan chab nyi le nga la gzigs pa mthong bas 'ong mi phod pa tsam pa

ra༅༅/ /zhig byung / de nas bla ma yab yum ma mthong ba dang thad sor phyin nas lung pa zhig brgal te phyi mig cig bltas pas/ bla ma 'khor bcas la kha de ka na smug phung nge ba bzhugs 'dug pas/ sems 'phreng drags log gam snyam pa'i ngang nas/ yang bsam mno zhig btang bas/ gdams ngag rnams ni rdzogs par thob chos min pa'i las ni gang du'ang mi byed/ bla ma ni 'bral med gtsug tu bsgoms pas chog cing / phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du mjal ba'i zhal shes bzang po yang yod/ re zhig lus sems bskyed pa'i ma dang phrad par byas nas yang bla ma'i drung du 'ongs pas chog snyam/ yid skyo chod de ba zhig la lam du zhugs nas/ bla ma rngog pa'i drung du phyin/ gdams ngag rnams go bsdur bas/ rgyud kyi bshad pa la khong lhag par 'dug /nyams len la nga rang zhan rgyu mi 'dug /khyad par mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyis nga rang lhag par 'dug /de nas phyag byas spyod lam

btab nas nga rang gi yul du 'ongs pas/ zhag gsum la sleb ste/ rlung gi nus pa yang dga' rab yin snyam pa'i rang mthong byung gsungs/ gdams ngag spyi la rang byan tshud nas mnal lam gyi brdas bskul bas/ chigabyubargyud kyi gdams ngag thob ste/ bla ma'i drung nas rang yul du phebs pa'i mdzad pa ste lnga pa'o// //drug pa ni/ yang ras chung pas/ bla ma rje btsun 'khrungs yul du phebs dus mnal lam bzhin byung ngam yum dang mjal zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ngan pa'i rmi lam mthong ba bzhin ma dang phrad pa'i skal pa ma byung gsung / yang ras chung pas/ 'o na rje btsun gyis gzim khang du 'byone lugs gang ltar mdzad/ thog mar yul mi ji 'dra dang mjal zhus pas/ ngas thog mar lung pa'i phu der rang gi khang pa mthong sa zhig tu phyugs rdzi mang po 'dug pa la/ yul mi rnams kyi ming dang / de na yoni bdag ci 'dra yod ces 'dri ba ltar byas pas/ zhib par

ra༅༅/ /bshad byung / de nas nged rang gi khang pa la gtad nas/ yul ma gi la ci zer/ yon bdag ji skad bya ba yod byas pas ma ki la ka bzhi gdung brgyad zer te/ yod bdag 'dre min pa ci yang med zer/ ma ki'i mi rnams shi ba'am yul thon zhes zhib tu dris pas/ ma gir dang po mi lung pa 'di na phyug pa zhig byung ba yin par 'dug ste/ bar du bu gcig po rang zhig byung ba'i pha 'chi ba sngas pa dang / kha chems 'jog lugs ma byung bar/ pha shi sting bu gcig po'i nor kun pha tshan gyis phrogs bu gcig po cher song nas sprod byas rung ma sprad pa'i lan du khos mthu btang ser ba phab nas yul 'di phung du bcug /des da nged lung pa'i mi kun kho'i chos skyong la 'jigs drags nas/ zhing khang gi phyogs la 'gro ba dag a cang che ste/ mig kyang lta mi phod pa tsam yod/ des na khang pa ma ki'i nang na bu gcig po'i ma'i ro dang 'dre sdod cing yod/ sring mo zhig yod pa de a

ma'i ro bor nas ga shed sprang du song nas med/ da kho rang shi ba yin nam skad ci yang mi 'dug /rnal 'gror pa rang 'gro nus na khang pa ma ki'i nang na chos yod zer stos shog dang zer bas/ de 'dra byung nas ci tsam serdzong byas pas/ ma shi nas 'ordzo brgyad tsam serdzong / mthu dang ser ba byung ba dran tsam 'dug /gzhan thos 'ordzo las med zer bas/ khong rnams nga'i chos skyong la 'jigs par yode 'dug pas/ nga la gnod pa byed mi nus par 'dug snyam pa dang / ma rgan shi ba dang sring mo 'khyar bas kho thag chod nas/ yid shin tu skyo ba zhig byung ste/ nyi ma ma nub bar lkog cig tu ngu zhing bsdad/ nyi ma dmar thag chod pa dang yul du phyin pas/ rmi lam du ji ltar byung ba ltar phyi'i zhing 'jag skyas 'byur/ khang pa lha khang 'dra ba de ral/ nang du phyin pas/ dam chos dkoni mchog brtsegs pa de thigs pa dang sa phud kyis gdungs/ bya dang byi ba'i brun dang tshang gdan byas 'dug ste/ gang la bltas shing

ra༅༅/ /bsams rung yid skyo ba zhig byung / de nas go khar phyin pas/ lhan pa dang sa 'dres pa'i phung po zhig la sngo mang po skyes 'dug pa de blangs pas/ mi rus mang po skya khrol thon byung bas/ ma'i rus pa yin par shes te/ dran drags yid skyo bas bzod glags med par bsam mi shes shing smra mi thub pa'i snying rlung langs nas dran med du 'gro tshad byung bas/ de ma thag bla ma'i gdams ngag dran nas/ ma'i rnam shes dang nga rang gi sems bsres/ de bka' brgyud bla ma'i thugs ye shes dang bsres te/ a ma'i rus pa la sngas byas/ sgo gsum skad cig kyang ma g.yos par 'od gsal la bsdad pas/ pha ma gnyis ka 'khor ba'i sdag bsngal las grol ba'i bden pa mthong / zhag bdun serdzong ba dang / ting nge 'dzin las langs te/ bsam blo zhig btang bas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la snying po med par kho thag chod nas/ ma'i rus pa 'di la tshwa tshwa zhig btab/ de'i yoni du

dkon brtsegs 'di phul la/ nga rang brag dkar rta sor shi ma shi dang nyin mtshan med par sgrub pa byed dgos chos brgyad kyi snang ba shar na lcebs nas shi sdod/ skyid chos kyi snang ba shar na mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis kyang nga'i srog chod cig byas yid kyis dam bca' drag po yang yang byas nas/ ma'i rus pa de rnams btus dkon brtsegs kyi sa dang bya brun rnams bsal te zhabs tog legs pa cig phul bas/ thigs pas cher ma skyone par yi ge rnams khra lam me 'dug pas/ dbu dum de rgyab tu khyer/ ma'i rus pa rnams thu bar khyer nas yid skyo ba la tshad med pa zhig gi ngang nas 'khor ba la snying po med par kho thag chod nas/ snying po'i chos byed par dam bca' ba phya ma phyo'i rgyu 'di blangs so/ /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can/ /sgra sgyar mar pa'i bka' lung bzhin/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra ru/ /mi rtag sgya ma'i slob dpon byung / /slob dpon sdizang po 'di nyid la/ /nges shes

ra༅༅/ /'drongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyir snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /mi rtag mi brtan 'gyur zhing 'gro /sgos 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med/ /snying po med pa'i bya byed pas/ /snying po'i lha chos byed du 'gro/ /dang po pha yod tsa na bu nga med/ bu yod tsa na pha yang med/ /gnyis ka 'dzom rung snying po med/ /bu nga snying po'i lha chos byed/ /brag dkar rta sor sgom du 'gro/ /ma yod tsa na bu nga med/ /bu ngas sleb tshe ma rgan gum/ /gnyis ka 'dzom rung snying po med/ /bu nga snying po'i lha chos byed/ /brag dkar rta sor sgom du 'gro/ /sring mo yod tshe ming po med/ /ming pos sleb tshe sring mo 'khyar/ /gnyis ka 'dzom rung snying po med/ /bu nga snying po'i lha chos byed/ /brag dkar rta sor sgom du 'gro/ /dam chos yod tshe zhabs tog med/ /zhabs tog sleb tshe thigs pas gdungs/ /gnyis ka 'dzom rung snying po med/ /bu nga snying po'i lha chos

byed/ brag dkar rta sor sgom du 'gro/ /khang pa yod tshe bdag po med/ /bdag pos sleb tshe khang pa ral/ /gnyis ka 'dzom rung snying po med/ /bu nga snying po'i lha chos byed/ /brag dkar rta sor sgom du 'gro/ /bzhos zhing yod tshe bdag po med/ /bdag pos sleb tshe 'jag skyas 'phyur/ /gnyis ka 'dzom rung snying po med/ /bdag po snying po'i lha chos byed/ /brag dkar rta serdzor 〉rdzom du 'gro/ /pha yul pha khang pha zhing serdzogs/ /'khor ba snying po med pa'i chos/ /snying med sems can su dga' khyer/ /rnal 'gyor nga thar pa sgrub tu 'gro/ /pha drin can mar pa lo tsā ba/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes yid skyo ba'i glu ma dbyangs blangs nas/ dang po klog slob pa'i slob dpon gyi sar phyin pas/ slobe dponi rang ni grongs 'dug /sras po la dkone brtsegs kyi dbu dum phul nas/ chos 'di'i dbu zhabs kun khyodi la 'bul/ nga'i ma rgan mo'i rus pa 'di la tsha tsha zhig

ra༅༅/ /thob la slong byas pas/ khyed kyi chos kyi rjes su chos skyong 'ong bas mi 'dod/ tsha tsha 'debs grogs bya'o zer/ nga rang gis phul ba la chos skyong mi 'ong byas pas/ 'o na legs zer nga rang gis kyang grogs byas nas ma'i rus pa la tsha tsha btab/ rab gnas kyi cho ga byas te mchod rten gyi nang du gdan drangs nas 'gro grabs byas pas/ sras po na re nged kyis zhabs tog ci lcogs byed pas/ 'dir zhag 'ga' bzhugs la gsung gleng mdzod zer/ nga gleng mo lab khom pa med/ sgrub pa la rings pa yod byas pas/ 'o na do nub bzhugs nang par sgrab rgyags mtshon pa zhig 'bul zer bsdad/ khong na re khyed dang po gzhon dus mthus dgra btul/ da dar la bab nas chos rnam dag mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ ma 'ongs pa na grub thob cig 'ong ste yod/ bla ma gang 'dra la gdams ngag ci 'dra thob ces zhib tu 'dri ru byung bas/ rdzogs chen thob lugs dang / khyad par mar pa

dang mjal lugs rnams bshad pas/ ngo mtshar che 'dug /de ltar yin na khyed rang yang khang pa zhig gserdzos byas/ mdzes se khab tu bzhes nas/ bla ma'i rnam thar skyodang ba drag zer bas/ ngas bla ma mar pas 'gro ba'i don du yum bzhes par gda'/ de lta bu'i bsam sbyor dang nus pa bdag la med pas/ seng ge'i phyi bzhin ri bong gis mchongs rung g.yang la lhung nas 'chi bar nges/ spyir gyis nga 'bor ba la yid skyo nas bla ma'i gdams ngag dang sgrub pa min pa gzhan gang gis kyang dgos pa med pa'i bsam pa zhig rtag tu yod cing / nga ri khrod la sgrub pa byed pa 'di bla ma'i zhal ta'i mthil yang yin/ rnam thar yang de kas 'khyongs/ thugs dgongs kyang sgrab pas rdzogs pa yod/ bstan pa dang sems can la yang sgrub pas phan/ pha ma yang sgrub pas 'drongs/ rang doni yang sgrub pas grub/ ngas sgrub pa min pa gzhan shes kyang mi shes/ 'ong yang mi 'ong / sems kyang mi

ra༅༅/ /sems par gda'/ khyad par yul du sleb nas pha mas khang gzhis bzung / nor bsags pa'i rjes rnams kyi dpes gsal btab pas sgrub pa byed pa'i nga bsam pa drag tu rang serdzong bas kherdzong na me 'bar ba tsam gda'/ gzhan sdug bsngal 'di 'dra thog tu ma bab pa dang / 'chi ba dang ngan serdzong gi sdug bsngal ma dran pa rnams la skyid chos kyis chog par gda' ste/ bdag stod bo sa gtam gsum la ma stosnas pa'i sgrub pa byed snyam pa rkyen 'di dag gis bskul zhing don 'di rnams lags byas mchi ma 'khrug bzhin pa'i ngang nas glu 'di blangs so/ /skyes mchog mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sprang mngon zhen ldog par byin gyis rlobs/ /kye ma kye ma kyi hud kyi hud ang / /'khor ba'i chos la blo gtad byed pa rnams/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing yi mug yang yang ldang / /spyad cing spyad cing sdug bsngal gting nas 'khrug /bskor zhing bskor zhing 'khor ba'i gting la 'phen/ /

'di 'dra'i snying rlung las kyis zin pa rnams/ /tsug byed tsug byed chos las drag pa med/ /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag sgya ma'i grong khyer na/ khiñtsal rings kyi mgron yo snying rlung langs/ /yul ya mtshan can gung thang gi snyor lung la/ /nor lug rnams ba ra'i kha zas rtsa/ /dus ding sang 'byung porme bdag tu bzung / /'di yang mi rtag sgya ma'i dpe/ /dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'gror nga sgrab pa byed/ /tshang mang ka bzhi gdung brgyad de/ /dus ding sang seng ge'i ya mgal 'dra/ /mkhar zur bzhi logs brgyad rtse dang prugu/ /dus ding sang bong bu'i rna ba 'dra/ /'asda yang mi rtag sgya ma'i dpe/ /dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'gyor nga sgrab pa byed/ /bzhos zhing 'or ma gru gsum de/ /dus ding sang 'jag ma'i yul du serdzong / /gnyen nye ba pha spun re ba rnams/ /dus dijo sang dgra 'or dmag tu langs/ /'di yang n+ma rtag sgya ma'i dpe/ /dpe 'dis

ra༅༅/ /kyang rnal 'gyor nga sgrub pa byed/ /pha bzang mi la sher rgyal de/ /dus ding sang byung ba'i rjes kyang med/ /a ma myang tsha dkar rgyan de/ /dus ding sang rus krang khog pa zhig /'di yang mi rtag sgya ma'i dpe/ /dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'gyor nga sgrub pa byed/ /bla mchod dkon mchog lha 'bum de/ /dus ding sang mi yi g.yog po byed/ /dam chos dkon mchog brtsegs pa de/ /byes ding sang bya byi'i tshang stan byed/ /'di yang mi rtag sgya ma'i dpe/ /dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'gyor nga sgrab pa byed/ /khyim mtshes a khu g.yung rgyal de/ /dus ding sang sdang ba'i dgra dang bsdongs/ /sring mo pe ta mgon skyid de/ /gare song rjes 'gro'i gtad so med/ /'di yang t+ma rtag sgya ma'i dpe/ /dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor nga sgrub pa byed/ /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can/ /sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes skyo shas kyi gdung dgrangs de rnamale blangs pas/ khong ngo

mtshar che shin tu yang bden zer/ shugs ring nar nar 'dug /yum zhig 'dug pa de mchi ma 'done zhing mang du ngu zhing 'dug /gzhan yang ngas yul gyi snang tshul rnams mthong bas rkyen byas/ sgrub pa byed pa'i dam bca' ngo stosnag med par kha nas kyang mang du rberter/ zhe la yang nar mar bcangs/ don la yang sgrub pa ma byas pa'i 'aspyodad pa med gsungs/ slar yang rkyen gyis 'khor ba snying po med par gsal thebs nas sgrub pa la yid dam bcas pa'i mdzad pa ste drug pa'o// //bdun pa ni/ yang ras chung pas/ rje btsun gyis thog mar dka' spyad dang sgrub pa gnas gang dang gang du mdzad zhus pas/ der slob dponi gyi sras pos nang par 'di rnams la sgrab rgyags kyi rten mdzod la/ nged rnams kyang thugs dam gyi khongs su chud par mdzod cig zer/ phye sgye gang dang / chu sdor bzang po byin byung ba rnams khyer 'ongs te/ nged rang 3 khang pa'i rgyab ri la brag phug bzang po

ra༅༅/ /zhig yod pa der sgom zhing bsdad/ rgyags chu rnams la sris se byes pas lus zungs phal cher zad rung dge sbyor smar bar byung zhing zla ba 'ga' thub/ de nas rgyags chu rnams rdzogs nas zas ye med pa rang la yun ring ma tshugs pas/ bsam mno zhig la phu'i 'brog pa la chu spyo1ra bslangs/ mda'i zhing pa la rgyag bslangs te/ 'tsho ba gta' ma chad tsam la brten nas sgrub pa byed dgos snyam/ 'brog slong la phyin te sbra zhig gi 'gag tu rnal 'gyor pa la chu sdor gyi slong mo zhu byas pas/ a ne'i sbra dang thug ste/ a nes nga ngo shes nas/ snying mi dga' bas thog mar khyi rnams rbad byung ba/ rdo dang ber kas bsrungs pas/ a ne rang sbra'i tshugs shing khyer nas pha bzang gi rkang 'dren po/ nye tshan gyi brla 'tshong po/ yul gyi phung 'dre khyod ci la 'ongs/ pha bzang la bu khyod 'dra skye ba zer zhing mang po brdeg tu byung ba la/ ngas phyir bros pas 'tsho ba ngan pas

lus stobs nyams pa dang / rkang pa rdo la thogs nas ko chu zhig gi nang du 'gyel nas 'chi tshad pa zhig byung dus kyang 'bar zhing 'dug /ngas ci longs shig byas te/ ber ka la lus brten nas a ne la glu 'di blangs so/ /pha drin can mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /yul ngan rtsa yi ko rone na/ /gnyen bshes dgrar langs kyi ma bu gsum/ /sran phung ber kas gtor ba bzhin/ /khyed a khu a nes e btang soms/ /nga sprang po sa mthar 'khyams kyi bar/ /a ma sdug bsngal phongs grir shi/ /sring mo sto gos sprang phyir 'khyar/ /ngas ma sring gi gdung sems ma chod pas/ /pha yul btson rar sleb pa'i tshe/ /brtse ba'i ma dang gtan bral byung / /sring mo sdug pas sa mthar 'khyar/ /nga skyo shas snying rlung khong nas langs/ /nged ma bu gsum gyi sdug bsngal 'di/ /khyed gnyen bshes bgrerdzos nas ma bcol lam/ /bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal des/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i gsal

ra༅༅/ /'debs byung / /drin can mar pa'i gdams ngag rnams/ /stos med ri la bsgoms pa'i tshe/ /sgru ma lus kyi phung po la/ /zas med slong du 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /'bu tshe zad grog ma'i tshang sgo bzhin/ /bdag kyang a ne'i sgo drung sleb/ /gcan gzan khyi yi pho nya balge /stobs mede lus kyis g.yul ngo sprad/ /drag sngags tshig ngan dmod pa yis/ /blo yi mug khong gzer gting nas bslangs/ /tshugs shing ber ka'i mtshon char gyis/ /bdag lus zug rngu na tshas bkang / /rin chen srog dang do bral byung / /zhe sdang ldang bar nga rigs kyang / /ngas ni bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub/ /a ne zhe sdang ma che bar/ /sgrub rgyags 'tsho ba'i slong mo zhu/ /byams snying rje'i mnga' bdag mar pa rje/ /'bangs zhe sdang zhi bar byin gyis rlebes/ /zhes ngu ngag gis glu ma dbyangs de blangs pas/ a ne'i phyi bzhin bu mo zhig 'dug pa de mchi ma nar byung ba dang / a ne yang skyengs nas

gnyis ka nang du song ste/ mar ril gcig dang thud phye rul pa mtshoni pa zhig bu mo de la bskur byung / sbra gzhan rnams la bslangs pas/ ngas ngo shes pa ni mi 'dug /khong tshos nga yin par shes te/ lta nan che ba re byas nas bsod snyoms drag pa re byin byung ba rnams khyer 'ongs nas/ a ne'i byed lugs des a khu yang go bas phyogs tsam la'ang mi 'gro dgos snyam byung ste/ rtsa phu'i zhing pa rnams la bsod snyoms bslangs pas/ a khu sngar gyi khang gzhis 'phos pa'i 〉rdzor sleb pas a khus shes nas/ ro ltar rgas rung khyod ka dgos pa yod do zer gsod rdo 'phangs pa phog tshad pa byung ba ngas kyang ngo shes nas bros phyin pas/ stobs kyis ci 'khyud kyi rdo mang po 'phangs byung / ngas de nas kyang bros pas/ mda' gzhu khyer nas phyir thon byung ste/ brla 'tshong po/ rkang 'dren po khyod kyis yul 'di phung du ma bcug gam/ yul pa rnams dgra lag tu chug yod do/ /myur du 'thoni

ra༅༅/ kho|ga cig zer zhing mda' rgyag tu byung / der yul pa'i pho gzhon 'gas kyang rdo ba re tsam 'phangs byung ba la/ ngas kyang sngar mthu btang ba'i gnong gis gang min byung gis dogs nas mthus sdigs mo byed snyam/ pha bka' brgyud bla ma/ khrag 'thung dam can rgya mtsho/ rnal 'gyor pa chos byed pa la dgra byung ngo / /ra mda' rlogs shig /nga shi rung chos skyong la 'chi rgyu med do byas pas/ khong rnams 'jigs nas kun gyis a khu bzung / nged rang la dkar mi rnams kyis mtshams byas/ rdo brdeg mi rnams kyis bzod gsol byas/ a khus ni bsod snyoms kyang ster ma nyan/ gzhan yul pa spyis bsod snyoms drag pa re byin byung ba rnams khyer te/ da yul 'dir bsdad rung khong tsho'i zhe sdang gserdzog par 'dug pas/ 'gro dgos snyam pa la/ do nub rmi lam du sngar gyi gnas de kar zhag shas bsdad na bzang ba'i brda zhig byung ste zhag 'ga' de rkang bsdad pas mdzes

ses tshor nas/ zas chang bzang po khyer te phrad du byung bas/ bcangs nas mang po ngu zhing 'dug /a ma shi tshul dang sring mo sna'akhyar tshul bshad byung bas shin tu skyod ba zhig byung ste nga rang yang mchi ma mang po shor/ ngas mo la khyod da dung khyim la mi 'gro ba phyi thag ring byas pas/ mo na re/ khyod kyi chos skyong la 'jigs nas dgos zer ba yang ma byung / byung yang 'gro ba yang med/ khyed chos mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ da zhing khang rnams ji ltar byed zer bas/ ngas mo'i bsam pa go ste/ nga khyim thab la ma sbyar ba 'di/ sgra sgyar mar pa'i bka' drin yin/ chos phyogs nas smed lam bzang po btab pas chog /'jig rten phyogs nas mo rang kho thag chod pa'i gtam zhig dgos snyam/ sring mo dang phrad na sh+lau la ster/ de bar zhing khyod rang thob/ sring mo shi bar thag chod na zhing khang gnyis ka khyod rang khyer byas pas/ khyed rang la mi dgos pa lags sam zer bas/ nga lto dka' thub dang bya tshol byi tshol

ra༅༅/ /byed pas zhing gis dgos pa med/ gnas mi med kyi brag phug tu sdod pas khang pas dgos pa med/ 'dzam bu'i gling dbang rung 'chi tshe bzhag dgos 'dug pas/ da lta nas blos btang na 'di phyi kun tu skyid par 'ong ba 'dug /des na spyod pa mi kun dang rgyab log byed pas da nga la mi ma re zhig byas pas/ mo na re 'o na khyed chos pa kun dang yang rgyab log mdzad dam zer ba la/ dang po bsam pa 'jig rten gyi che thabs khong du bcug nas/ sbyor ba po ti 'ga'i tshig bshad bslabs te/ da lta'i bsam pa rang phyogs rgyal na dga' zhing / gzhan phyogs pham na dga' ba khong du 'tshangs pa'i sbyor ba nor ci gsog dang snyan grags ci thob byed pa'i chos par ming btags nas gos ser po rgyani pa tsam pa 'di kun dang rgyab log yin yang yin/ byed kyang byed/ de min pa'i chos pa rnams theg pa so so'i cha lugs su snang rung / bsam sbyor gong ltar med na don la mthun pas

rgyab log mi shes/ nga dang don mi mthun na rgyab log rang yin byas pas/ 'o na khyed kyi cha lugs sprang po bas ngan pa 'di 'dra'i chos pa sngar ma mthong / 'di theg pa chen po gang gi cha lugs yin zer bas/ 'di theg pa kun gyi mchog rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub phyir chos brgyad rlung la bskur ba zhes bya ba'i theg pa'i cha lugs yin byas pas/ mo na re khyed dang khong tsho'i cha lugs dang spyode pa kun khyed rang zer ba bzhin rgyab log rang du 'dug pas gang rung zhig chos min pa 'dra/ yin pa mnyam po la khong tsho'i de dga' bar 'dug zer ba la0/ ngas khyod 'jig rten pa dga' ba'i chos pa de la nga mi dga'/ nga dang don mthun pa'i chos pa na bza' ngur smrig gsol ba rnams la'ang / chos brgyad kyi cha bag tsam re yod pa 'dra/ med rung sangs rgyas thob pa myur mi myur la khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yodi de de khyod kyis mi go/ de bas khyod rang yang nus na chos gyis/ mi nus na khang zhing khyer

ra༅༅/ /lugs sngar ltar gyis la song byas pas/ mo na re/ nga la khyed kyi khang zhing mi dgos/ sring mo la byin mdzod/ chos shig byed de/ khyed kyis 'di 'dra mi nus par gda' zer serdzong ngo / /de nas a nes nga khang zhing la gtsigs med pa thos nas/ zhag 'ga' serdzong ba dang / a ne+e'i bsam pa la/ kho bla ma'i bka' bzhin byed zer bas zhing 'di e khugs lta snyam/ nga'i sar rtsam chang chu sngerdzor mtshon pa zhig khyer nas byung ste/ kha sang ngas mi shes pa zhig byas 'dug ste/ tsha bo chos pa yin pas bzod par mdzod/ da a nes khyed rang gi zhing btab nas rgyags skyel zer ba la/ 'o na a ne+es zla ba re la nas khal re'i phye skyol/ de lhag rnams a nes khyer la zhing thob cig byas pas/ de ltar byed zer/ zla ba gnyis tsam chod don bzhin bskyal/ de nas lan gcig a ne byung nas/ mi rnams na re zhing btab na tsha bo'i chos skyong gis mthu byed zer te/ mthu rang mi byed

las che zer bas/ mthu ci la byed/ dge ba 'ong bas a ne rang zhing thob la rgyags skyol cig byas pas/ 'o na tsha bo la ni khyad med/ a ne blo bde ba 'dug pas/ tsha bos mna' zhig skyome dang zer ba la/ 'di la bsam blo 3 yod mi shes par 'dug ste/ mi dga' ba yang chos yin snyam mna' bskyal bas dga' ste log song / de nas ngas snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms rung lus la bde drod kyi yoni tan tsam skyer ma 'dod par da ci drag snyam zhing yod pa'i tshe/ nub cig gi rmi lam na zhing tha ba zhig rmos pas sra drags ma phed par da 'jog gam snyam pa la/ rje btsun mar pa nam mkhar byone nas/ bu snying rus dang brtson 'grus bskyed la rmos shig /tha ba sra yang phed nas 'ong gis gsung zhing / mar pas sna khrid nas rmos pas/ 'dur phed de lo toge bzang po skyes pa rmis pas/ gnyid sad pa dang sems dga' ba zhig byung ba la / rmi lam bag chags 'khrul pa la blun po rnams kyang bden cher mi

tshes/ ri ne/lon+d+ra na/m+mu po bas snang nga trīn nam snyam skya nga /phyo kyang snying dzo ñtshasa'i bsgomaswā pasdu swo tan skye ba'i ṣ+ṭṛgs su 'adh+rag smiṭā dga' bzhin rmi lam gya dan gzil 'dabs pa' glu sdod blangasasag/zheme/rja zlokani dran can la gsaldu ba ༷dbas/ ༷/nga ra khrad zan ṭār byan snros rlabaso/ /kyāzhaṭānyamapa nyad kya zhang ༵ la/'i/lam n+d+rad ༵ brtanā skya spya lud sbyar//sasnas dkar zlo dra neX mas mi bto/ /gsal 'askyas ṭ+wāṃg tī py-iyu 'byāg ldar/ri/byanadzosasnrokyi du kyarnyi pa babakyi/ /mas yadā gnyam 'id pa' rman daX sa/ོ/thabs sdu rab laXs kya rmas gzhal baXs/ོ/'grul rtagā ོda ༵'a sdu bu yasabye/ /yangs pa mad pa'ari thang spyagadzño na/ /0na 'grus drag ༷'a lha/ gas 'grab/ /nyan mangs dug lnga' tha ba slag/rang rgyud ngan pa' rda ba sal/ /g.ya zal da pa' yur ma da/ /las 'bras bdan pa' ma la/ /rnam thar bzang pa' ba

mabarnga/ /gdamasangag bzang po'i 'bras bu yis/ /gtad so med pa'i bang ba 'gengs/ /mkha' 'gro'i rngod 'thag zas kyimachogo /bdag rnala'agyor sgrub pa'i 'tsho ba yin/ /rmi lam don gyi gsal 'debs yin/ /tshig la don nyid mi skye zhing / /mtshon pa tsam gyis mi rtogs pas/ slad nas byang chub sgrub pa rnams/ /snying rus bskyed nas sgom par zhu/ /dka' thub dang snying rus rtsal bskyed nas/ /dka' bas bsgrabs na darkani pa'ang 'grub/ /pho byang chub kyi skyes bu chos byed rnams/ /sgrub pa la bar chad med par sgortog /ces brjod nas/ nga brag dkar rta so la sgom du 'gro dgos snyam yod pa'i tshe/ a nes nas khal gsum gyi phye/ thul gog gcig /ras bzang po gos ldeng gcig /mar tshil 'dres pa'i chu sdor rnams khyer byung ste/ 'di rnams tsha bo'i zhing btsongs pa'i rin yin pas khyer la nga'i mig gis mi mthong / rna bas mi thos pa'i yul phyogs shig tu 'gro rogs

ra༅༅/ /gyis/ de min yul mi kun gyis nga la dang po thos pa dgas sdug de btang sting / da yang khyed kyi bsten rtsi byas nas/ yul mi lhag ma 'di rnams kyang gsod pa yin na/ khyed rang gnyis ka gsod gtong zer bas/ tsha bo rang yul gzhan du bros pa legs par 'dug /cis kyang mi 'gro na nga gsod don med/ tsha bo rang gsod mi gsod la the tshom mi 'dug go zer byung bas/ nga'i bsam pa la/ yul mis de ltar mi lab pa ngas go/ nga chos bzhin mi byed na spyir gyis zhing phrogs pa la mthu mi byed pa'i mna' skyal ba med/ khyad par rnal 'gyor pa'i mna' rmi lam sgya ma yin pas khyod rkang mthil ser 'ordzog gtong ba la tshegs med de da nga de ltar mi byed/ zhe sdang skye yul med pa'i bzod pa su la bsgom/ nga rang do nub shi na zhing gis mi tshad 'di rnoms kyis kyang ci byed/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs la bzod pa mchog tu gsungs pa yin/ de sgom pa'i rten a ne yin

zhing / dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba yang a khu dang a ne+e'i drin yin/ bka' drin du che bas drin lan du phyi ma sangs rgyas thob pa'i spyod lam rtag tu 'debs/ tshe 'dir zhing du ma zad khang pa yang byin pas chogo snyam pa byung ba ltar/ a ne la yang 〈 snabar lab ste/ nga byang chub sgrub pa la bla ma'i gdams ngag min pa cis kyang dbertes pa med pas/ zhing du ma zad khang pa yang a ne khyer cig byas glu 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma'i bka' drin ri khrod 'grim/ /sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang shes/ /'jig rten 'khor ba las kyi dub/ /'bags na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /skye bo'i so nam sdig pa'i las/ /spyad na ngan song sdug bsngal myong / /nye du'i gdung sems bdud kyi mkhar/ /brtsigs na me 'obs kyi nang du tshud/ /zas nor gyi gsog 'jog mi yi nor/ /bsags tshad dgra bo'i rgyags phye yin/ /skyid 'dod kyi ja chang btsan dug gi chu/ /'thungs na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /a ne'i zhing rin

ra༅༅/ /ser sna'i rdzas/ /zos na yi dwags kyi gnas su skye/ /a ne'i kha ta zhe sdang gi tshig /lab na bdag gzhan gnyis phung 'ong / /bdag gi zhing khang thams cad ni/ /a ne khyer la dga' bar gyis/ /mi kha chos kyis sangs pa yin/ /lha kha snying pos ba'ib pa yin/ /'dre kha snying rjes non pa yin/ /nyes kha rlung la bskur ba yin/ /rang kha gyen la blta ba yin/ /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo sku drin can/ /sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rloms/ /zhes pa'i glu blangs pas/ a ne na re chos pa bzang po bya ba tsha bo 'di 'dra la zer ba yin/ dga' rab yin zer/ dga' nas song / de nas rkyen des bskul bas skyo shas drag po rang zhig byung / zhing khang gi kho thag chod pas blo bde ba zhig kyang byung bas/ nga dang po'i dam bca' ltar brag dkar rta serdzo la sgom du 'grerdzo snyam pa shar/ phug pa der mnyam gzhag gi dge sbyor gyi long tshugs pas rkang tshugs phug tu grags serdzo/ /de

nas nang par zhing rin gyi chas rnams dang / gzhan yang lhag cung zad yod pa rnams khyer te/ mi sus kyang ma tshor bar brag dkar rta sor phyin nas/ rta so na phug pa skyid po rang zhig 'dug pa der bsdad/ 〈snam stan sra ba'i 'bol chung zhig bshams te gnas mal bzung nas/ 11nga yul du mi 'bab pa'i dam bca' byas pa ni/ bdag nyams rtogs khyad par can zhig ma skyes kyi bar du ri khrodi 'dir ltogs grir shi rung dad zas dang gzhin zas kyi thal ba 'gam phyir mi 'bab/ 'khyags grir shi rung gos phyir mi 'bab/ skyo grir shi rung 'du 'dzi dang g.yeng ba'i las mi byed/ na ste shi rung sman thun cig gi phyir yang mi 'bab/ tshe 'di'i bya ba sgrub phyir lus gul ba tsam yang mi byed par sgo gsum yengs med du sangs rgyas bsgrub bo/ /bdag gis dam bca' 'di rnams grub par bla ma yi dam gyi byin gyis rlobes shig /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis phrin las sgrubs shig /gal te dam bca' 'di

ra༅༅/ /rnams las 'gal na sgrub pa mi byed pa'i mi lus bas shi ba skyid pas/ dam can rgya mtshos dam bca' las 'gal ma thag tu nga'i sremeg chod cig /bla ma yi dam rnams kyis phyi ma dam pa'i chos dang mjal nas/ sgrab pa byed nus pa'i mi lus su skye bar byin gyis rlobs shig /ces dam bcas nas dam bca' smone lam gyi glu 'di blangs so/ /rje nā ro'i bu brgyud thar pa'i lam/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdud 'jig rten gyi g.yeng bas mi g.yeng bar/ /sgom mnyam gzhag gi bsam gtan 'phel bar shog /zhi gnas kyi rdzing la ma zhen par/ /lhas/ mthong gi me tog 'khrungs par shog /spros bcas kyi tsab tsob mi ldang bar/ /spros med kyi lo 'dab rgyas par shog /sgrub khang du yid gnyis mi skye bar/ /nyams rtogs kyi 'bras bu smin par cerdzog /bdud rigs kyi bar chad mi nus par/ /rang sems la nges shes 'drongs par ce(ga /thabs lam la the tshom

mi skye bar/ /pha rjes bu yis zin par shog /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes smon lam btab nas 'tsho ba phye'i dri ma yod tsam gyi skyo tsha la brten te ba〉snams pas/ sems la phyag chen gyi gdeng zhig thob rung / lus stosnabs 3snar bas rlung ma 'chun par/ lus la bde drod ye ma byung bas shin tu grang bar byung ste/ bla ma la gserdzol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ nub cig 'od gsal gyi nyams snang la/ bla ma mar pas btang ba yin zer/ bud med mang pos tshogs kyi 'khor 'o/ bzang po bskor te/ kho de mi la ras pa bde drod ma skyes na mar pa'i zhal nas sgo gsum gyi gcun thabs 'di ltar gyis la zer 'khrul 'khor bstan serdzong ba ltar/ me thab drug chings tsog pu'i gnad kyis lus kyi bde ba btsal/ rgya mdud chings sre/ga rtsol rlung gi gnad kyis ngag gi grims cha btsal/ ñdzil mdud chings rang grol gyi gnad kyis sems kyi stodi cha btsal zhing

ra༅༅/ /bsgoms pas/ lus la bde drod dga' rab skyes/ de nas lo gcig tsam song ba'i tshe/ khams sangs la 'gro snying 'dod pa zhig byung ste 'gro grabs byas pas/ sngar gyi dam bca' tur dran nas/ rang la lcag 'debs kyi glu 'di blangs so/ /rdo rje 'chang chen mar pa'i sku/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /pho mtshar po mi la ras pa khyod/ /gros rang gtam rang la phan pa'i dgrangs/ /grogs gtam snyan 'chad pa'i mi dang bral/ /ltad mo blta 'dod kyi lung pa stongs/ /skyo ba sangs 'dod kyi yul rkyen med/ /sems ma spro ma spro rang sar zhog /spros na mi dge sna tshogs dran/ /ma yengs ma yengs dran pa bsten/ /yengs na dge sbyor rlung la 'chor/ /ma 'gro ma 'gro nyal sa gnon/ /phyin na rkang pa rdo la thogs/ /ma gseng ma gseng mgo bo khug /gsengs na done med phyal par 'gro/ /ma nyal ma nyal dge sbyor mdzod/ /nyal na nyon mongs dug

lngas non/ /zhes rang gis rang la lcag btab nas nyin mtshan med par bsgoms pas/ dge sbyor 'phel po rang de lo gsum lhag par byung / de nas lo re la phye khal re'i dmigs gtad yode pa zad nas 'tsho ba'i rgyun ye med pa rang byas na/ srog gi bar chad du 'gro bar 'dug /'jig rten pa rnams gser zho re re rnyed na dga' zhing stor na sdag bsngal ba'i rtsis btang na/ sangs rgyas ma thobe par lus dang bral na de lta min te/ stong gsum gser gyis phyur bur bkang bas kyang / sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i lus 'di gces/ sngar gyi dam bca' dang 'gal ba las ni sgrub pa byed 'phro la shi ba rung da ci drag gam snyam pa dang / grong yul du 'bab pa ni min/ chos phyir yin pas dam bca' yang mi 'gal/ dka' thub kyi zas shig tshol du 'gro dgos snyam/ brag dkar gyi mdun na phar phyin pas de na nyi ma dro ba chu bzang ba/ za mang po skyes pa/ mthong yel che ba'i gnas dang ba spro mo rang zhig 'dug pa

ra༅༅/ /der 'phos te/ za rang la brten nas sgrub pa byed cing bsdad pas/ phyi na gos dang / nang na 'tsho ba phye dang bcud ye med pa'i stabs kyis/ lus keng rus ltar serdzong ba za'i mdog 'dra ba la/ spu sngerdzo zho le ba byung ba'i tshe/ bla mas gnang ba'i be'u bum de la bcang ba re byas/ matre thog tu bzhag pas/ ci yang za rgyu med pa la / gsus pa bde mer ba dang / sgregs pa chil chil ba byung / rgya bzhig nas lta snyam pa la/ da dung re zhig lta ma ran pa'i brda zhig byung nas bzhag /de nas 'o( gcig tsam lon pa dang / gnas der skyid grong tshong 'dus pa'i khyi ra ba ri dwags ma sod pa 'ga' byung ste/ thog mar 'dre 'dug zer bros song / mi dang sgrub pa po yin pa'i lo rgyus byas pas/ yin yin rang mi 'dra ste blta ru rung zer/ tshur byung nas phug pa'i nang thams cad g.yengs te/ khyod kyi sgrub rgyags gang na yod/ nged rnams la skyir thong / phyis skyin pa

smar po ster/ mi gtong na gsod pa yin zer sdigs su byung ba la/ nga la za min pa ci yang med/ yod rung sgrub pa po 'degs pa'ang yod pa la/ phrogs pas byung dogs med byas pas/ 'phrog byas pa min/ sgrub pa po bteg pas ci 'ong ba zer/ bserdzod nams 'ong byas pas/ 'o na 'degs zer/ pang du blangs nas sa la yang yang brdabs pas/ dka' thub byas pa'i lus na tshas gang rung bzod glags med pa'i snying rje drag po skyes/ mchi ma cerdzor bas/ gcig ngan mi byed par bsdad 'dug pa de na re/ kho re tsho/ khong chos pa rnam dag gcig yin par 'dug /de min na'ang mi rid po 'di la de tsug byas pas pho skyes par mi 'gro/ 'u cag ltogs pa khong gis lan pa ni min/ de 'dra ma byed zer nga la rnal 'gyor pa ngo mtshar che/ ngas khyed kyi thugs dkrugs pa med pas/ thugs dam gyi skyabs 'og tu chug cig zer ba la/ gzhan rnams na re nged kyis kyang khyed bteg yod pas nged tsho yang

ra༅༅/ /chug cig zer/ gcig de na re 'jug lugs mi 'dra ba min pa 'jug pa khag theg zer bzhad gad theg ge serdzong bas/ nga la mthu bya snyam pa med rung / dkoni mchog gi bka' chad byung nas/ khyi ra ba rnams la dpon pos chad pa bcad/ drag pa de bsad/ ma byed zer ba de ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyi mig bton 'dug zer/ de nas lo gcig tsam song ba'i tshe/ gos kun zad nas a nes zhing rin la byung ba'i thul gog de'i lhag ro 'dra 'dug pa dang / phye zad pa'i sgye de dang / ras gos rnams btsems nas gdan gos byed snyam pa la/ do nub shi na tshem pos done med de bas bsgom pa dga' snyam bor nas/ thul gog de gdan gyi rnam par bting nas smad la gang khebs byas/ phye sgye'i re tshal des stod g.yogs byas/ ras des gang mkho'i gyoni lugs byas pas/ ras de ye rgyan mi nyan par song ba'i tshe/ ha cang rang yang blos btang drags 'dug

'tshem snyam pa la/ khab skud kyang ma 'gyor bar ras de khal gsum dres rdog bya ba/ stod smad rked pa rnams la khal ba re yode pa la/ dres thag chad pa mdud pa bor zhing mthud pa'i ske rags bcings nas nyin ci 'khyol byas/ thul gog dang re tshal gyi gos gdan gang khebs kyis mtshan ci 'khyol byas bsgoms shing yod pa'i tshe/ lo gcig tsam serdzong ba dang / mi mang po'i skad di ri ri byung / bltas pas khyi ra ba 'ga' sha mang po khyer nas phug pa'i 'gag tu sleb byung ba/ nga mthong ba dang 'dre 'dug zer snga ma rnams bros song / phyi ma rnams na re/ nyin par 'dre byung dogs med dga' mo/ stos dang / da dung 'dug gam zer/ da dung yang 'dug zer bas/ khyi ra ba rgan pa phyi nas 'ong ba rnams kyang 'jigs 'dug pa dang / ngas 'dre min/ ri 'di la sgom pa'i sgom chen yin te/ 'tsho ba med pas lus 'di ltar song ba yin byas lo rgyus rnams rgyas par bshad pas/ bden rdzun blta'o

ra༅༅/ /zer phug pa'i nang du song bas/ zwa min pa ci yang mi 'dug pa dang / kun dad par gyur te sha mang po dang rgyags lhag gi phye rnams phul nas/ 'di 'dra rang mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ nged rnams kyis bsad pa'i sems can rnams kyi yar 'dren mdzod/ nged rang rnams kyi sdig sbyong mdzod cig zer/ gus gus byas nas song / der nga yang mi zas za rgyu yod bsam dga' ru tshor ba byung ste/ sha tshod zos pas lus bde 'bol le ba dang / khams dang sing ba dang / rig pa ngar chil byung bas dge sbyor shed che ting song ste/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i bde stong gi nyams bzang po skyes byung bas/ grong yul du longs spyod la byung rgyal du spyod tshe'i brgya 'bul stong 'bul bas/ ri khrod du dka' ba spyod tshe'i zan changs re bsku1da nams che bar 'dug snyam pa byung / ngas sha rnams bsris nas casnas pas/ mthar 'bus gang byung ba la/ 'bu bsal nas sha za snyam pa dang / nga rang la

bserdzod nams dang dbang res med pa yin/ 'bu'i zas skal phrogs pa'i za ma bzang pos dathosnas pa med snyam sha 'bu rang zar bcug nas/ nga rang gis zwa'i dka' thub byas/ lan zhig mtshan mo mi gcig nga la zas nor yod du re nas byung ste/ phug pa'i nang kun g.yeng gin 'dug pa la/ nga dgod cig shor te/ ngas nyin mo ma rnyed pa'i sa de nas khyod kyis mtshan mo e rnyed stos shig byas pas/ kho rang yang dgod cing thon song / de nas yang lo gcig tsam song ba'i tshe/ rtsa nas kyi khyi ra ba ri dwags ma sod pa 'ga' byung ste/ ngas ras 'ga' khal gsum dres rdog ma de rgyani nas mnyam par bzhag skurdzod pa las/ gzhu maḥrdzog btsugs nas 'di mi yin nam 'dre yin/ gzugs brnyan nam/ bertes sam gang nas bltas kyang 'dre yin pa 'dra zer ba la/ ngas kha tsheg byas nga yin dag mi yin byas pas/ nga'i serdzo zho la ngo shes te/ khyod thos pa dga' yin nam zer/ yin byas pas/ 'o na de

ra༅༅/ /ring nged rnams la gro re slong / sting sor tshab mi pham pa skyel/ khyod dang po lan zhig yul du 'ong ba'i gtam zhig byung nas lo mang du song / de nas da bar 'di kar bsdad pa yin nam zer/ de ka yin te/ khyed rnams zar rung ba'i zas med byas pas/ khyod rang gang za ba de slong de kas 'ong zer/ 'o na khyed rang rnams me thong la zwa tshos shig byas pas/ me btang zwa btsos nas da 'di la 'debs pa'i sngerdzor dgos zer/ sngerdzor yod na zas bcud dang ma bral ba bya ba yin te/ kho bo la de med nas 'o/ 'ga' thal 'ordzo sngerdzor la zwa thob byas pas/ 'o na thalazhig dbordzos pa 'dug zer bas/ thal skurdzod na zas rtsi dang ma bral ba bya ba yin te/ kho bo la de med nas kyang 'ordzo 'ga' thal 'ordzo thal la'ang za ka thob byas pas/ 'o na tshwa zhig med thabs rang mi 'dug zer bas/ tshwa mardzod na zas ro dang ma bral ba bya ba yin te/ kho bo la de med nas kyang 'ordzo 'ga' thal 'o(/ /tshwa la yang za ka

thob cig byas pas/ khong tsho na re/ khyod kyi sto gos 'di la gzugs brnyan dang kha thabs 'di las byung dogs mi 'dug /pho rang ma skyes/ mi g.yog byas rung sto 'grangs la gos dro ba yong / 'dzam bu gling gi mi zhig la khyod las sdug pa dang snying rje ba mi 'ong zer ba la/ ngas kho re tsho de skad ma zer dang / nga mi lus len pa'i drag shos shig yin te/ lho brag mar pa lo tsā lta bu dang mjal/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag thob nas/ dben pa'i ri la tshe 'di blos btang ste sgom zhing nam bzhag gtan gyi don bsgrub/ sto gos gtam gsum la gyong bskur nas nyon mongs pa'i dgra tshe 'dir 'joms par byed pa yin pas/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi gcig la nga bas pho rgod pa dang 'dun ma legs pa med/ de bas khyed rang rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i yul phyogs su skyes rung / sgrub pa byed pa dag a cang che ste/ chos nyan pa tsam gyi 'du shes kyang med par dmyal

༄༅༅/ /ba gting ci zab dang yun ci ring gi thabs su/ sdig pa la bre gsog 'phul gsog byed pa las 'dun ma nyes tshab che ba mi 'ong / nga nam phugs bde zhing skyid pa dag a cang che ste/ 'phral la'ang blo bde ba'i gdengs 'di 'dra yerdzod pas/ nga'i glu 'di nyen cig byas bde ba lnga'i glu 'di blangs serdzo/ /rje drin can mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /brag dkar rta so dbu ma rdzong / /dbu ma rdzong gi rdzong rtse na/ /bod kyi rnal 'gror ras pa nga / /lto gos tshe 'di blos btang nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa la/ /'og na sra ba'i 'bol chung bde/ /steng na bal po'i shing ras bde/ /pus 'khyud 〉snam thag sterdzor gcig bde/ /'grangs 'urdzogs snyoms pa'i sgyu lus bde/ /lta rtog thongs pa'i sems nyid bde/ /mi bde mi gda' bde mor gda'/ /bde bde 'dra na kun kyang mdzod/ /chos byed kyi skal pa mi ldan na/ /nga

bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi/ /gtan gyi bde skyid bsgrub pa la/ /besto 'ordzog gi snying rje mi 'tshal gyis/ /nyi ma zer byung la la serdzong / /khyed rnams rang rang gnas su serdzong / /nga tshe thung nam 'chi cha med la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrab pa la/ /g.yengs gtam lab tu kherdzom pa med/ /de'i phyir mnyam bzhag gi ngang du 'jog /byas pas kherdzong rnams na re/ khyed rang dag bde bde mang po 'dren gyi 'dug ste/ bde nges pa gre ba bde mo zhig 'dug /nged rnams khyod kyi 'di 'dra byed pa rung yang mi rung zer nas song ngo / /de nas skya rnga rtsa na 'o/ re bzhin tsha tsha 'debs pa'i chang sa chen po zhig byed cing 〈snad pa de'i dus su/ khyi ra ba rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas/ bde ba lnga'i dbyangs blangs pas/ de'i sa na pe ta yang slong mo byed cing yod pas thos te/ khong de skad zer mkhan de sangs rgyas shig yod par 'dug byas pas/ khyi ra ba rnams kyi nang nas gcig na re/ he

ra༅༅/ /he mo rang gi jo jo'i bstod ra la zer/ gcig na re sangs rgyas dang sems can gang yin rung / khyod rang gi jo jo ltogs grir 'chi ru cha ba'i glu yin zer bas/ pe tam nga pha ma snga mor shi/ gnyen dgrar langs/ jo jo sa mthar 'khyar ma phrad pa'i sprang mo zhig la snying tshim bya ma dgos 'dug zer mang du ngus pa'i sar mdzes se byung nas/ ma ngu jo jo yin par yod pa 'dug /dang po nga dang yang phrad/ da khyod rang brag dkar rta sor song la e 'dug ltos cerdzog /'dug na rang re gnyis ka phrad du 'gro zer bas bden snyam/ pha 'bab bslangs pa'i chang zo ba gang dang / phye dang zan 'dres pa snod chung zhig 'dug pa de gang khyer nas brag dkar rta serdzor sleb byung ste/ sgo'i phyi nas bltas pas/ nga dka' thub kyis gdungs pa'i lus/ mig gting du lhung ba/ rus pa thams cad sgang du thon pa/ mdog sngerdzo la sha rid pa/ sha rus bral du cha ba'i pags pa la ba spu sngerdzo

zing nge ba skyes pa/ skro yegs la 'dzings pa/ yan lag rnams chag la khad pa de mthong nas/ thog mar 'dre yin pa 'dra snyam 'jigs pa las/ jo jo stogs grir 'chi ru cha ba 'dug zer ba thos pas the tshom zos te/ khyed mi yin nam 'dre yin zer/ nga mi la thos pa dga' yin byas pas skad ngo shes te/ nang du 'ongs nga la 'jus nas/ a jo a jo zer ba'i ngang nas yug cig dran med du brgyal 'dug /ngas kyang pe ta yin par shes te/ dga' ba dang skyo ba gnyis ka byung / gserdzo ba'i thabs ci legs byas pas/ dar cig nas dran pa rnyed de/ pus mo gnyis kyi bar du mgo bo bcug /lag pa gdong la bkab nas/ ngu ba'i smre sngags la/ a ma ni a jo snying la 'dod bzhin pa'i ngang nas sdug grir shi/ gzhan 'khor mi ni ma byung bas/ nga sdug drags khyim du ma tshugs par yul gzhan du sprang du phyin/ a jo yang shi ba yin nam/ ma shi na 'di bas skyid pa zhig yode snyam pa byung ste/ a

ra༅༅/ /khro'i skyid sdug ni 'di kar 'dug /nga sring ma'i kha khos ni 'di ka yin/ 'u cag ming sring bas sdag pa ni sa thog tu mi 'ong zer pha ma'i ming nas bos te/ mang du ngu zhing 'dug pa la ngas sems gserdzo mang po btang rung phan pa ma byung bas/ nga rang yang shin tu skyo ba'i ngang nas sring mo la glu 'di blangs serdzo/ /rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /sring mo 'khor ba'i gdung sems can/ /spyir skyid sdug thams cad mi rtag ste/ /sgos sdug lugs 'di 'dra byas gyur na / /gtan gyi bde skyid yod par nges/ /de phyir a jo'i glu la nyon/ /nga 'gro kun drin can pha ma yi/ /drin lan bsab phyir chos byed pa'i/ /gnas la bltas na ri dwags 'dra/ /gzhan gyis mthong na snying rlung ldang / /zas la bltas na khyi phag 'dra/ /gzhan gyis mthong na smyug bro ldang / /lus la bltas na keng rus 'dra/ /sdang dgras mthong yang mchi ma

'chor/ /spyod lam bltas na smyon pa 'dra/ /sring mo yi mug kha skyengs skye/ /sems la bltas na sangs rgyas dngos/ /rgyal bas gzigs na spro ba skye/ /'og na rdo ba'i grang chal la / kho lpags 'bigs pa'i snying rus byas/ /lus phyi nang zwa yi rang bzhin la/ /mdog sngon po zhig la 'gyur ba med/ /mi med brag gi phug pa na/ /skyed chad de ba la sangs dus med/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /yid dung nge ba la 'bral ba med/ /ngas snying rus 'di ltar ba〉snams pa'i mthus/ /nyams rtogs skye bar the tshom med/ /nyams dang rtogs pa 'khrungs pa na/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid zhor la 'byung / /phyi ma mngon par rdzogs sangs rgya/ /de phyir sring mo pe ta lcam/ /yi chad sdug bsngal ma mang bar/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad 'tshal 'ordzo/ /byas pas/ pe ta na re/ de ltar yin na dag ngo mtshar che ste/ bden pa rang dka' ba 'dra/ bden na chos pa gzhan rnams kyang 'di bzhin rang ma byung

ra༅༅/ /rung 'di'i cha 'dra tsam byed thang ste/ sdug 'di 'dra byed mkhan ma mthong zer/ zan dang chang byin byung ba zos 'thungs pa'i mod la rig pa gsal sing song / de'i nub mo dge sbyor la bogs thon pa byung / nang par pe ta song rjes sngar 'ong ma myong ba'i lus la bde zug dang na zug gnyis ka yod pa dang / sems la dge mi dge'i rtags snang sna tshogs byung tshe snying rus byas ba〉(mas rung / phan gnod ci yang ma byung / de nas zhag 'ga' nas mdzes ses sha mar rnying pa dang / rtsam chang bzang la mang ba khyer te be ta dang gnyis ka phrad du byung ba/ nga chu len du phyin pa dang thug ste/ nga la gos med par sngo hreng hreng 'dug pa de mthong nas/ gnyis ka ngo tsha rung ma phod par ngu zhing 'dug /de nas sha mar dang phye phul chang drangs pa 'thung ba'i bar la/ pe ta na re/ da a jo la gang nas bltas rung mi'i ming rang mi 'dug pas/ bserdzod snyoms re mdzod la mi zas dum re

gsol/ ngas na bza' zhig ci 'gror byas la 'bul du 'ong zer/ mdzes se na re/ 'tsho ba'i bsod snyoms re cis kyang mdzod// na bza' zhig ngas kyang 'bul du 'ong zer bas/ ngas da nam 'chi cha med la bskurdzod snyoms byas 'tsho ba sgrub pa'i 'ordzong dang don med/ grang grir shi yang chos phyir yin pas 'gyode rgyu chung / sgrub pa blos btang nas 'bad pas bsgrub pa'i lto yog tshad dang / gos bzang po brtsegs nas rgyan pa'i mdun du/ gnyen dang dga' grogs 'tshogs nas bag med kyi bza' btung dang / bzhad gad byed pa'i chos des nga'i bsam pa mi rdzogs pas/ khyed kyis gos dang 'ong mkhan yang mi dgos/ kha la yang mi nyan pas bsod snyoms kyang mi byed byas pas/ be ta na re/ 'o na a jo'i bsam pa ci 'dra zhig gis rdzogs pa yin/ 'di las kyang sdug pa zhig gis rdzogs pa 'dug ste bya thabs rang med dam zer ba la/ ngas 'di bas ngan serdzong gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pas

ra༅༅/ /sdug ste/ sdug de myong thabs byed pa'i sems can rang mang ba gda'/ nga'i bsam pa 'di lta bu zhig gis rdzogs pa yin byas/ bsam pa rdzogs lugs kyi glu 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /nga skyid pa gnyen gyis ma tshor zhing / /sdug pa dgra yis ma tshor bar/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'gyor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /rgas pa grogs kyis ma tshor zhing / /na ba sring mos ma sbor bar/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'gror bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ phre ba mi yis ma tshor zhing / /ro rul bya yis ma mthong bar/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'gror bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ kho rul sbrang mas 'jib pa dang / /rtsa rgyus 'bu yis za ba ru/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'gyor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /nga sgo na mi rjes med pa dang / /nang na khrag rjes med pa

ru/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'gyor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /ro la 'khor mi med pa dang / 8 na ngu mi med pa ru/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'gyor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /nga gar song 'dri mi med pa dang / /'dir song gtad so med pa ru/ /ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'gyor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /mi med lung pa'i brag phug tu/ /sprang po 'chi ba'i stsod lam 'di/ /'gro ba'i don du thebs par 3(ga /thebs na bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /byas pas/ mdzes se na re/ dang po'i gsung lugs dang da lta'i mdzad pa rnams mthun par 'dug pas ngo mtshar che zer/ pe ta na re a jo rang ci gsung rung 'asbo ba dang na bza' ye med pa 'di la/ ngas ye mi bzod par 'dug pas/ ngas na bza' zhig ci 'gyor byas skyel du 'ong / lto gos bzang bas sgrub pa bros dogs med/ bsode snyoms mi byed par 'dug /ma byas par a jo rang gi bsam pa ltar ri

ra༅༅/ /khrod 'dir 'khor mkhan med par sdug grir 'chi ba 'dug gis dang / gal te ma shi na ngas so/sa shig ci 'byor byas skyel lo zer khong gnyis song / ngas za ma bzang po rnams zos pas/ lus kyi bde zug dang na zug yid kyi ltas snang rnams je cher song nas sgom mi nus pa byung ba'i tshe/ sgom mi nus pa las gegs che ba mi 'ong snyam/ bla mas gnang ba'i cerdzog ril gyi rgya bshig nas bltas pas/ de'i nang du gegs sel bogs 'don gyi nying khu/ skyedan 'dzin skurdzon tan du bsgyur ba'i man ngag rnams dang / khyad par 'di'i skabs su za ma bzang po bsten bya ba zhig 'dug pas sngar snying rus byas ba〉snams pa'i nus pas/ rtsa nang du khams 'dus su cha ba zas ngan pa'i dzār+shabs kyis slongs ma nus pa la/ pe ta'i chang gis cung zad bslangs/ mdzes ses phul ba rnams kyis rdzogs par bslang bar go nas/ cerdzog ril gyi nang ltar lus gnad/ rlung

gnad/ dmigs pa rnams la 'bad pas/ rtsa phran rnams kyi mdud pa grol/ dbu ma'i yang lte ba man gyi mdud pa grol te/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams sngar go myong ba rnams dang tshig tu 'dra la/ don la rtsal che zhing brtan pas mi 'dra ba'i nyams rtogs kyi yon tan khyad par can skyes te/ gegs las grol nas skyon rnams yone tan du ngo 'phred/ rnam rtog tu bzung ba chos skur shar bas/ spyir 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel du go zhing / de yang kun gzhi rang sems phyogs lhung dang bral ba/ lam 'ordzog ltas drangs pa'i rkyen gyis 'bras bu 'khor ba/ lam lhag bsam gyis drangs pa'i rkyen gyis 'bras bu myang 'das/ de gnyis ka'i snying po stong nyid 'od gsal du kho thag chod la/ khyad par da lan rgyud la skyes pa'i yone tan 'di sngar bsgoms pas rgyu byas/ za ma dang man ngag zab mos rkyen byas pa'i rten 'brel las byung bar go nas/ gsang sngags thabs kyi lam 'dod yone

ra༅༅/ /lam du 'khyer ba la thun mong ma yin pa'i nges shes 'drongs/ pe ta dang mdzes se yang shin tu drin che bar go nas/ byas pa drin gzo dge ba byang chub tu bsngos pa'i mthar/ rten 'brelasnying po'i 'i 'di blangs so/ /lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /yon bdag bzang po'i tshogs gsog la / /don gnyis 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'asgrag /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i lus po 'di/ /zas dang phrad pas sku khams bzang / /dog mo sa yi rtsi bcud dang / /dgung sngon dbyengs kyi sbrang char gnyis/ /'grerdzo la phan pa'i rten 'brel yin/ /rten 'brel gyi snying po lha chos yin/ /pha mas gserdzos pa'i sgya lus dang / /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gnyis/ /lha chos byed pa'i rten 'brel yin/ /rten 'brel gyi snying po snying rus yin/ /mi med lung pa'i brag phug dang / /kha zhe merde pa'i dge sbyor gnyis/ /ci bsam 'grub pa'i rten 'brel

yin/ /rten 'brel gyi snying po stong nyid yin/ /mi la ras pa'i sgom bsran dang / /khams gsum sems can dad pa gnyis/ /'gro ni 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yin/ /rten 'brel gyi snying po snying rje yin/ /brag la sgom pa'i sgom chen dang / /'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag gnyis/ /sangs mnyam por rgya ba'i rten 'brel yin/ /rten 'brel gyi snying po bsngo ba yin/ /bla ma bzang po'i thugs rje dang / /slob ma bzang po'i sgom bsran gnyis/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel yin/ /rten 'brel gyi snying po dam tshig yin/ /byin rlabs myur po'i dbang bskur dang / /dad gus drag po'i gsol 'debs gnyis/ /myur du mjal ba'i rten 'brel yin/ /rten 'brel gyi snying po bkra shis yin/ /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang mkhyen/ /zhes pa'i glu blangs/ de nas yang snying rus byas ba〉(mas pas/ nyin snang la lus 'dodi dgur bsgyar ba dang / mkha' la lding ba

ra༅༅/ /la sogs te rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung dpag med ston nus pa'i nyams shar/ mtshan snang rmi lam du srid pa'i rtsa rtse kun thog med du gsal zhing nyul nus pa dang / lus sems brgya phrag du mar sprul nas/ re res sangs rgyas kyi zhing re rer phyin te chos nyan pa dang / sems can dpag med la chos ston nus pa dang / lus mer 'bar ba dang / chur 'brub pa la serdzogs te/ rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa stone pa byung bas sems la dga' sngerdzo dang dpa' skyes nas brod bzhin ba〉(mas pas/ dngos su nam mkha' la 'phur nus pa byung ste/ res smin khyugs grib ma'i rdzong la phar 'phur te bsgoms pas/ gtum mo'i bde drod kyang sngar bas lhag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes/ res brag dkar rta sor tshur 'ongs pa'i tshe/ rta so'i 'gram na glong mda' bya ba'i yul chung zhig yod pa de na/ dang po a khu'i mna' ma thibs 'og tu shi ba'i ming po pha bu gnyis bus rmos sna

khrid/ phas thong bzung nas zhing mo zhing 'dug pas/ bus nga 'phur ba mthong nas/ a pha ya mtshan la stor+shas dang mi 'phur byung zer/ las 'phro bor nas lta zhing 'dug pa la/ pha na re ya mtshan dang ltad mo che rgyu ci yod/ myang tsha dkar rgyan zer ba'i bud med khram ma zhig gi bu/ g.yon can mi la zer ba'i gog pa lto ma phyid pa zhig yod pa de yin par 'dug /grib ma dang 'gom yug ma phog pa gyis la rmos sna khrid zer/ pha rang grib ma phog gis dogs mgo lus yo byed cing 'dug /bu na re/ 'phur thub na gog na'ang gog ltad mo mi 'phur ba las che ba mi 'ong bas stosnas zer lta zhing 'dug trere/ /de nas nga'i bsam pa la/ da ngas 'gro don byas rung sems can la phan thogs pa 'dug pas byed datre/sa snyam pa'i tshe/ yi dam gyis dngos su tshe 'dir bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa gtso bor thon cig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang sems can gyi 'gro jon la de bas che ba mi 'ong ngo bya

ra༅༅/ /ba'i lung bstan byung bas/ bsam blo la/ tshe gang 'di sgrub pas 'das na/ ma 'ongs pa'i skal ldan gyi skyes bu rnams tshe blos btang ste chos sgrub pa'i mig rkyen mchog tu gyur pas/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs rgya cher 'ong bar tre nas/ sgrub pa rang byed par blo thag chod pa la/ yang bsam blo zhig la/ ngas sngar gnas 'dir yun ring du bsdad/ de bar mi byung ba rnams la chos kyi kha pho yang mang po cerdzor/ khyad par nga'i nyams rtogs shar nas 'phur ba de yang mis mthong / da 'dir bsdad rung 'jig rten pa'i rkyen bzlog dang / 'dod pa sgrub dgos sogs lha'i bu'i bdud dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis sgrub pa la bar chad byung dogs yod pas/ bla mas lung bstan pa'i gnas chu dbar la sgom du 'gro dgos snyam/ /zwa 'tshod pa'i rdza de rgyab tu gtad de brag dkar rta so nas chas 'ongs pas sgrub pa yun ring gi bar la sto gos ngan pa'i stobs kyi

rkang pa la rwa chags pa phug pa'i 'gram du rdo la dred nas 'gyel bas/ rdza'i lung thag chad nas rbab tu 31ra ba 'dzin du phyin pas/ rdza chag pa'i nang nas zwa'i khrud ma gcig khar gcig chags pa rdza rang ji lta ba zhig sngo khor re byung ba la/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa ston cing dran gso ba dang / sgrub pa'i bskul mar yang go ste ya mtshan zhing nges par 'byung ba'i ngang nas/ rdza da lta yod pa da lta med/ /dpe 'dis 'dus byas kyi chos kun mtshon/ /khyad par dal 'gror gyi mi lus mtshon/ /des na rnal 'gyor mi la nga / /yengs med du sgrub la brtsone 'grus byed/ /nor yod rgu 'dus pa mkho ba'i rdza/ /dus da lan chag pa bla mar byung / /chos mi rtag bshad pa ngo mtshar che/ /zer zlu len zhing yodi pa'i tshe/ khyi ra ba 'ga' tsha ba 'debs su nga'i sar byung nas/ rnal 'gror pa khyod la glu len pa'i skad snyan po zhig 'dug /rdza'i khog ma de bcag nas zwa'i khog ma 'dis ci byed pa yin/ lus sngo la rid pa

ra༅༅/ /'di ci las byung zer ba la/ ngas lus zungs zad pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams bshad pas/ ngo mtshar che 'o na yar cerdzog zer tsha ba mnyam du byin pa za ba'i bar la / khyi ra ba gzhon pa cig na re/ khyod rang mi mig rtsa can zhig 'dug pa la/ 'di 'dra'i sdug byed pa bas 'jig rten pa byas na/ rab rta bzang seng phrug 'dra ba zhon/ 'khor gsum tsher ma 'dra ba btags nas/ sdang ba'i dgra btul/ nor 'o/ngas spyod 'dzom pos byams pa'i gnyen bskyangs pas skyid 'ong / de min tshong byas rung rang mgo thon pas skyid 'ong / tha ma mi g.yog byas kyang lto gos bzang po myong bas lus sems 'di 'dra bas skyid pa 'ong ste/ sngar ma shes 'dug /da byas pa drag zer/ rgan pa na re/ khong chos pa sgrub pa po dga' mo rang zhig yin rigs su 'dug pas/ 'u cag 'jig rten pa'i kha la nyan dogs med kha rog sdod/ de bas khyed gre ba bde mo rang zhig 'dug pas/ nged tsho'i sems la

phan pa'i glu zhig 'o/nga dang zer bas/ nga la khyed rnams kyis bltas na nga sdug sdug 'dra ste/ 'jig rten 'di na nga skes skyid pa dang shes pa bsam blo ༄rtongs pa gzhan med pa de khyed rnams kyis ma go/ nga la khyed rnams kyi rab dang mthun pa'i skyid lugs 'di 'dra yodi pas nyon cig byas rnal 'gyor rta rgyug gi glu 'di blangs so/ /pha drin can mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nga rang lus ri bo'i dgon pa na/ /byang khog stod kyi lha khang na/ /zur gsum snying gi dbu rtse na/ /sems kyi rta pho rlung ltar 'gyo/ /rta 'dzin na zhags pa gang gis 'dzin/ /brtod na phur pa gang gis brtod/ /stogs na zas su ci zhig ster/ /snyom na chu ru ci zhig ldud/ /'khyags na rwa ba gang du 'dzud/ /rta 'dzin na gnyis med kyi zhags pas 'dzin/ /brtod na ting 'dzin gyi phur pas brtod/ /ltogs na bla ma'i gdams ngag ster/ /skom na dran pa'i chu rgyun ldud/ /'khyags na stong nyid kyi rwa bar 'jug /thabs shes

ra༅༅/ /gnyis kyi sga srab sprad/'i/'gyur med brtan pa'i gong rmedu btsug /srog rtsol rlung gi mthuzlo mda' rgyus/ /de la rig pa'i khye'u chung wo/ /theg chen sems bskyed rgya rmog gyon/phro/thos bsam sgom pa' 'jol ṭīb rgyan/'i/bzod pa' phub chung rgyazlo snro ༷༷/ /lta ba' mdung rang lag tu thogs/ yes rab kyi ral gri glo la btags/ /kun gzha 'jam paX smyug ma la/ /khong khro med pa' 'khyogā cig bsrang / /tshad med bzha ya sgra zhag bskyon/ khes rab rnon po'i mde'u btsugs/ /stong pa nyid kyi gzhu mo la/ /thabs ༷sna zab snros ltar smir nas/ /zung 'jug yangs zlo' 'dom la 'jal/ /mda' 'phen pa ṇ+ḍal khams yongs la 'phen/ /phog pa dad pa can la phog 8 ba ngar 'dzin gyi 'gong po / /de phyar dgra na wo mongs 'dul/ /gar+sā na 'gro drug sems can skyong / /rta rgyug na bde r+sā thang la rgyug /snyog ni rgyal ba'i go 'phang snyog /dkyus smad

'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa bcad/ /dkyus stod byang chub skam sar sleb/ /rta de ltar rgyugs pas sangs rgyas thob/ /khyed kyi skyid dang 'dra 'am stos/ /'jig rten gyi skyid la smon rgyu med/ /byas paraka khong rnams dad par gyur nas serdzong ngo / /ngas kyang chu dbar la 'grerdzo ba'i lam dpal khud la brgyud nas ding rir sleb ste lam kha zhig tu thad kar nyal te bsdad pas/ snog mo la 'groba'i na chung rgyan gos mchor mo 'ga' byung ba rnams kyis nga dka' thub kyis gdungs pa'i lus de mthong nas/ gcig na re/ kho re tsho ltos dang sdug sdug gi 'dra ba la/ 'di 'dra'i lus su nam yang skye bar ma gyur cig zer/ gcig na re snying rje ba la/ 'di 'dra mthong bas kyang snying rlung ldang bar 'dug zer ba la/ nga yang ma rig pa'i sems can snying rje snyam khong tsho la snying rje lhang ba zhig skyes te tsog langs nas/ bu mo tsho de skad ma zer dang / sems khral de mi dgos pa 'dug gis/ khyed rnams kyis nga 'dra

ra༅༅/ /bar smon lam btab kyang skye bar mi 'dug /snying rje ba ngo mtshar che ste rang mthong dang snying rje go log yin pas nga'i glu 'di nyon cig byas glu 'di blangs serdzo/ /rje gserdzol ba 'debs serdzo bka' drin can/ /byin gyis rlobs shig mar pa'i zhabs/ /sems can las ngan mnar ba rnams/ /rang min gzhan la mthong ba chung / /las ngan bu mo rdzokhyim la dad/ /snang ngan rang rtsis me ltar 'bar/ /sems can bsam brlag snying re rje/ /dus ngan bskal pa'i snyigs ma la/ /khram pa yi dam lha bzhin mchod/ /zog po rin chen gser las brin/ /chos pa lam kha'i rdo bzhin bskyar/ /ma rig sems can snying re rje/ /khyod bu mo mchor mo spun rnams dang / /nga gung thang gi mi la ras pa gnyis/ /zhe yang phar khrel tshur khrel yin/ /snying yang phar rje tshure rje yin/ /snying rje'i mdung kha byas pa la/ /nam phugs su rgyal lta yang lta/ /rmongs pa kha 'chal smra ba la/ /

mi la ras pas gdams ngag bshad/ /de chu lan chang gis 'jal ba yin/ /ngan lan bzang gis bskor ba yin/ /byas pas/ snying rje ba la zer ba'i bu mo de na re/ khong mi la ras pa zer ba de yin par 'dug /'o cag kun rang mthong ches pas kha nas gang min bco brgyad shor/ da bshags pa gyis zer/ smon lam 'debs mkhan gyi bu mo de la ched gnyer gyis bskul bas/ mos kyang dung rdog bdun phul nas/ kun gyis phyag btsal bshags pa phul te/ da dung chos shig gnang bar zhu zer ba'i lan du glu 'di blangs so/ /rje bapokha drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgrangs chung dam pa'i chos su bshad/ /steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang na/ /chos nges don mi brin drang don brin/ /'og ma dros klu yi pho brang na/ /chos zab mo mi brin zang zing brin/ /bar 'dzam bu gling gi mi yul 'dir/ /chos mkhas pa mi brin rdzun pa brin/ /dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams na/ /choso sgom pa mi brin

ra༅༅/ /bshad pa brin/ /dus ngan bskal pa'i snyigs ma la/ /mi bzang po mi brin ngan pa brin/ /bu mo mchor mo'i mig yul du/ /mi rnal 'gror mi brin mchor po brin/ /na chung bu mo'i rna ba ru/ /chos sil ma mi snyan dbyangs chung snyan/ /de gdams ngag glu ru blangs pa yin/ /dung rdog bdun gyi brda lan yin/ /bshags pa tshar ba'i dga' stod yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khong rnams dad par gyur te song ngo / /ngas kyang brin du phyin pas/ chu dbar dang skyid phug gnyis ka'i lo rgyus thos te/ skyid phug nyi ma rdzong du sgom zhing bsdad/ der dge sbyor 'phel ba'i ngang nas zla ba 'ga' song ba dang / brin pa'i mi rnams bza' btung gi mthun rkyen re khyer nas lan re re gnyis gnyis byung bas bsam gtan la cung zad gnod par go nas/ da gnas 'dir yun ring rab kyang skurdzong / dge sbyor yang 'phel rab byung / da yang mi 'dus na bsam gtan gyi gegs su 'grerdzo nyen

'dug pas/ mi med kyi lung stong zhig tu 'gro dgos/ de yang bla ma'i bka' bzhin la phyi la 'gro dgos snyam yod pa'i tshe/ pe tas bal spu byung tshad bsdas nas bzos pa'i snam bu gcig khyer te/ brag dkar rta sor phyin pas/ nga mi 'dug pa dang / kun la 'dri zhing 'tshol du phyin tshe/ gung thang stodi du rnal 'gyor pa zwa'i 'bu 'dra ba zhig dpal khud nas la stode lho phyogs la song zer ba thos te/ nga'i rjes gcod cing phyin pas/ ding ri na bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba khri brtsigs/ gdugs phub/ dar gyi na bza' bzang po gsol/ grwa bu slob rnams kyis dung bus pas/ mi mang po 'dus nas mtha' bskerdzor/ ja chang 'dren cing 'bul ba mang po byed cing 'dug pa mthong bas/ pe ta'i bsam pa la/ mi gzhan gyi chos pa la 'di 'dra yong gi 'dug ste/ nga'i a jo'i chos 'di rang sdug la gzhan gyis brnyas pa/ gnyen tshan rnams ngo tsha ba las mi 'dug pas/ da a jo dang phrad na bla ma 'di'i phyag phyi la ci tshud

ra༅༅/ /kyi thabs dang gros shig byed dgos bsams nas/ der tshogs pa'i mi 'ga' la dris pas/ brin na 'dug zer ba thos te/ brin du 'ongs rtsad bcad nas skyid phug tu nga'i sar byung ste/ a jo'i chos kha la bza' rgyu yang med/ lus la rgyan rgyu yang med pas khrel ngo tsha nas bud pa 'dis mi 'ong bar 'dug /da snam bu 'di la smad g.yogs shig mdzod la/ khong gzhan gyi chos pa bla ma ba ri 'ordzo tsā ba bya ba/ 'og na khri brtsigs steng na gdugs phub pa'i bar du/ sku dar zab kyi sbubs na zhal ja chang gi ngang la 'grerdzo ba/ grwa bu hrīsnab rnams kyis dung kha rjerdzor du bus pas mi mang po 'dus nas/ 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'ong bas 'kherdzor dang rnya tshan la phan pa/ mi la ngom pas chog pa'i chos pa bzang po rang zhig 'dug /de'i phyag phyi la e khrid stos dang / khrid na grwa pa zhan shos shig thob rung skyid po 'ong ba 'dug gis/ de min a jo'i chos 'di dang / nga'i khos

ka 'dis 'o cag ming sring gi tshe mi phyid par 'dug zer ngu zhing 'dug pas/ ngas pe ta de skad ma zer cig /khyod dag nga gos med pa cha lugs lhug par gnas pa 'di la ngo tsha byed par 'dug ste nga'i 'di spyir yod pa rang gis 'tsheng ste chos dang mjal ba yin pas ngo mi tsha/ khyad par a ma las skyes tsam nyid na yod pas ngo tsha rgyu med/ de bas spyir sdig par ngo shes nas mi 'dzem par pha ma'i thugs dkrug /bla ma dang darkani mchog gi dkor la 'bag /rang 'dod sgrub phyir ngan g.yo sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can la gnod 'tshe byed pa rnams/ rang gzhan kun la gnod cing / lha mi dam pa kun gyis khrel bas 'di phyi gnyis kar ngo tsha/ khyad par lus la ngo tsha na/ khyod rang a ma las skyes dus med pa'i brang la skrangs 'bur zhig 'dug pa de ngo tsha mod/ yang khyod kyi yid la nga sto gos la gyong bskur nas sgom pa 'di/ zang zing ma 'gyor ba yin pa 'dug snyam ste de lta min/ spyir gyis nga rang
