ra༅༅/ /'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal 'di la 'jigs drags/ gson por me nang du bcug pa lta bu'i 'jigs skrag yod pas/ 'du 'dzi dang g.yeng ba / chos brgyad kyi 'dor len mthong tshe skyag nad pa la zan byin pa ltar zhe log /pha bsad kyi lag dmar po mthong ba ltar sems mi dga' ba zhig yod pas spangs pa yin/ khyad par nga la lho brag mar pa'i bka' lung la/she 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang 'du 'aci'i g.yeng ba spongs/ gyong sto gos gtam gsum la thong / gnas nges med kyi dben pa 'grims la / tshe 'di blos btang gi bsam sbyor drag pos sgrub pa gtso bor thon cig gsungs pa yodi pas bla ma'i bka' sgrub pa yin/ bka' bzhin bskrubs pas/ rang gi 'khor du byung ba'i sems can 'ga'i tshe 'di'i bde skyid tsam du ma zad/ rang gzhan sems can kun gyi nam bzhag gtan gyi bde skyid yod pa dang / nam 'chi nges med du 'dug pas tshe 'di'i bya ba

'jig rten chos brgyad kyi che thabs spangs pa yin/ bsgrubs na bla ma ba ri ba'i phyag phyi ba zhan 3(sa su ma zad khong rang tsam zhig ngas kyang 'ong ste/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par 'dod nas sgrab pa la nan tan dang brtson 'grus byas pa yin/ da pe ta rang yang chos brgyad spongs la a khro'i phyi bzhin la phyi gangs la sgom du 'gro/ chos brgyad blos btang nas sgom nus na 'di h+phu gnyis ka ru skyid pa'i nyi ma 'char ba yin pas/ a khro'i glu 'di nyon cig byas glu 'di blangs so/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /chos brgyad skyoni gyis ma gos ltar/ /bu rgyud byin gyis rlobs mdzad pa/ /sgra sgyar mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tshe 'di'i 'dod pas gdungs pa yi/ /sring mo nyoni cig pe ta lcam/ /gdugs ya thog gser gyi gañdzir bkrag dang gcig /ma thog rgya mo dar gyi shem bu 'grig dang gnyis/ /bar gdugs rtsibs rma bya'i lding khang mdzes dang gsum/ /seng ldeng dmar po'i yu ba

go༅༅/ /'drongs dang bzhi/ /'di bzhi bshams na a jos shoms tsam gda'/ /chos brgyad du 'dug pa a jos spangs pa yin/ /chos brgyad spangs pas skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /de phyir chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta lcam/ /chos brgyad spongs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /'o skol lcam sring bsdebs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /dkar po dung gi rgyangs grags che dang gcig /dung mkhan mkhas pa'i rkan dbugs bzang dang gnyis/ /rgya mo dar gyi mdud pa khra dang gsum/ /rab byung btsun pa'i 'du 'tshogs mang dang bzhi/ /'di bzhi bshams na a jos shoms tsam gda'/ /chos brgyad du 'dug pa a jos spangs pa yin/ /chos brgyad spangs pas skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /de phyir chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta lcam/ /chos brgyad spongs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /'o skol lcam sring bsdebs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /'jig rten grong ltag gi dgoni chung khra dang

gcig /stone chung sar pa'i smra lce bde dang gnyis/ /yo mar rgya ja'i thab ka bzang dang gsum/ /btsun chung gzhon nu'i lag bde 'khyug dang bzhi/ /'di bzhi bshams na a jos shoms tsam gda'/ /chos brgyad du 'dug pa a jos spangs pa yin/ /chos brgyad spangs pas skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /de phyir chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta lcam/ /chos brgyad spongs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /'o skol lcam srid bsdebs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /mo bon rtsis gsum gyi grong chog brin dang gcig /ma jo'i tshogs dpon tshul 'chos mkhas dang gnyis/ /kha za 'dod 'bar ba'i tshogs 'khor bskor dang gsum/ /nya ma mgo bskor gyi glu chung snyan dang bzhi/ /'di bzhi bshams na a jos cerdzoms tsam gda'/ /chos brgyad du 'dug pa a jos spangs pa yin/ /chos brgyad spangs pas skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /de phyir chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta lcam/ /chos brgyad spongs la la phyi

༷sazi/ ri 'i/gangadṛlastsespya/ /rdo skol dzo pyi bsdebasal la phyi gaḍis lazlokhyegazlo/ོ/sa stir spe'u'i maswo btsan ldegaswā dang gago/༷nasashaṃ nga bzang pa' sa naman+d+ra ma dang ༅sa//ra rkyis bsags ṭī' zas skya 'am dang gsum/'i/'atī zlo la ba' ༷༷sa gsag mang ༷ brnyi/ /༵da bzha spyoXg na a jaswā shams dz+wa gda'///sna brgyad durdzu gh+ra pa a ḍisasparnyis payan/'i/mro brgya/snangs pas skyuḍi pa' ༷ sa shabye//da phyar rdus badzī spangs gā ༷ lcam//chasna brgyad sngings la swā phya kyingaṭ+wāṃ la'igaswā/ /'a skal lcam srang babs la la phya gāngaX sa 'igs/tram̐/ lang rta zlo' mag smophaḍis mthadang gaXsnyu/ khra dīn ༅ rgyan cha zis dang gnyam/ /sdag spyad sa bu' 'khar gsum khra dang gsum//dgra 'dul gnyan skyang ga las la brtsan dang bzha//'ad bzha bshams na a jas shams ma gda'/ /chas brgyad du 'dug pa a

jos spangs pa yin/ /chos brgyad spangs pas skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /de phyir chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta lcam/ /chos brgyad spongs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /'o skol lcam sring bsdebs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /chos brgyad blo yis mi thongs shing / /gnas la phyi gangs la mi 'gro na/ /gnyen nye du'i gdung sems yid la gzan/ /nga tshe 'di'i gleng mos dge sbyor g.yeng / /lar skyes nas nam 'chi cha med la/ /chos long yod kyi phyi cerdzol bya long med/ /yengs med du sgrab la brtson 'grus byed/ /pha bla ma'i gdams ngag sems la phan/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag bsgoms nas kyang / /bde chen thar pa sgrab pa yin/ /de phyir la phyi gangs la 'gro/sno/sring mo chos brgyad 'dor len gyis/ /sdig la bre gsog 'phul gsog gyis/ /spyir khams gsum 'khor bar ci gnas mdzod/ sno/sgos ngan song gsum po ci thob mdzod/ /brgya la 'khor bas 'jigs pa na/ /'jig rten chos

ra༅༅/ /brgyad blos thong la/ /'o ste/la lcam sring bsdebs la la phyi gangs la gshegs/ /lcam sring skal ldan gnyis bsdebs la gangs kyi rwa ba la gshegs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ pe ta na re/ a khro'i 'jig rten chos brgyad de skyid po la zer bar 'dug ste/ de 'o cag ming sring gnyis la spang ma dgos gda'o/ /bla ma ba ri lo ts+tsha ba lta bu mi 'ong bar shes pa'i kha bsnyad la a jo rang gis bden bden mo dang / yin yin mo mang po shes kyin 'dug ste/ nga kha la zas dang lus la gos med pa'i sdug nyo ru la phyi la mi 'gro/gang na yod kyang cha med/ a jo rang yang ri dwags khyis ded pa bzhin bros nas brag ri la 'khres sdod pa las/ sa gcig tu bsdad na thugs dam yang 'phel/ ngas rtsad gcod pa yang sla bar 'dug /'di phyogs kyi mi rnams kyang mos rab yod pa 'dra bar 'dug pas/ rtag tu bzhugs na rab de min na'ang zhag 'ga' cis kyang bzhugs/ snam bu 'di la smad

g.yogs shig kyang 'tshem grogs mdzod cig nga myur du sleb 'ong ngo zer ba la/ ngas zhag shas der sdod par khas blangs/ sring mo ding ri phyogs la slong du song ba'i bar la ngas sring mo'i snam bu de la mgo kun 'thums pa'i zha gcig /lag pa'i sermer mo re re la shubs re/ rkang pa la lham/ 'dom gyi cha lugs la shubs cig bzos te bzhag /zhag 'ga' nas sring mo sleb byung ste/ a jos snam bu ma btsems pa yin nam zer ba la/ btsems skusnad byas shubs rnams yan lag rnams dang cha lugs la se rmeserdzor bskoni nas bstan pas/ da a jos mi ru rang mi 'dug /ngo tsha mi shes pa'i steng du ngas dka' las byas pa'i snam bu de yang chud gzon 'dug /res 'ga' sgrab pa ma gtogs gang yang byed 'ordzong med pa 'dra ba zhig la/ res 'ga' ci 'dra'i dal ba yang byung 'dug zer bas/ ngas nga mi'i dam pa dal 'gror la snying po len mkhan de yin/ ༄ngo tsha shes nas ka spyir dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul

ra༅༅/ /bzhin bsrung / khyod sring gcig ma cha lugs mthong ba la ngo tsha byed cing 'dug pas/ bregs na snyam na'ang 'breg rang ma nus par/ dge sbyor g.yeng rung khyod rang zer ba ltar ngo tsha'i gos bzos/ gzhan rnams kyang lus kyi cha yin par mnyam pas/ cha lugs dang khyad mi 'dug bsam shubs bzos pa yin/ snam bu chud ma zos par ngo mo'i gos byung 'dug pa/ da khyod nga las ngo tsha che bar 'dug pas/ nga'i cha lugs ngo tsha na khyodi kyi de yang ngo tsha/ ngo tsha ba'i nor tshags byed pa bas med pa dga' ba yin pas khyed kyi de med pa zhig rem zhig byas pas ngo nag thug thug 'dug /lar 'jig rten pa rnams ngo mi tsha ba la tsha/ tsha ngo shes pa ngan spyod g.yo sgya la mi tsha ste ngo tsha byed lugs mi shes par 'dug pas/ a jo'i glu 'di nyon cig byas ngo tsha byed lugs dbye ba'i glu 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprang ngo tsha shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngo

tshas bcings pa'i pe ta lcam/ /dar cig a khro'i glu la nyon/ /khyod tha snyad rmongs pa'i ngo tsha mkhan/ /ngo mi tsha la ngo tshar byed/ /nga ngo tsha'i don shes rnal 'gror nga / /sgo gsum lhug par sdod pa la/ /ngo tsho'i sgro skur ga la yod/ /lus pho mor grub pa shes zin nas/ /mtshan ma yod par sus kyang shes/ /khrel dang ngo tsha bsrung ba rnams/ /'jig rten phal la mi 'dug ste/ /ngo mo'i bu mo rin gyis nyos/ /ngo tsha'i bu pho pang du blangs/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta'i 'bras/ /ngan spyod g.yo sgru rku 'phrog dang / /blo gtad nye ba slu ba rnams/ /khrel ngo tsha yin te 'dzem mkhan nyung / /tshe 'di blos btang gi sgom chen kun/ /nyams len gnad kyi man ngag mchog /zab mo rdo rje gsang spyod kyis/ /mi tshe chos la skyel ba la/ /bcos ma'i ngo tsha byed don med/ /de phyir rang sdug ma shom par/ /pe ta shes pa rang sor zhog /byas pas/ ngo nag thug ge ba'i ngang nas slong mo las byung ba'i

ra༅༅/ /rgyags chu sngerdzor rnams phul nas/ gang byas rung ngas mnos pa bzhin a jos mi byed par 'dug ste/ ngas a jo blos mi thongs par 'dug pas/ 'di kun gsol mdzod/ ngas da dung ci rnyed byas 'ong gis zer 'gro grabs byed cing 'dug pa la/ ngas pe ta blo chos la 'gyur du e rung bsam/ khyod rang yang chas 'di rnams ma zad bar chos mi byed rung sdig ma gsog par sdod byas bsdad pa'i bar la/ rna bar rgyu 'bras kyi chos ci 'gro byas pas/ chos la nges shes 'drongs nas blo sna cung zad thung du song ba'i tshe/ a ne yang a khu shi rting kha zhe med pa'i 'grod pa skyes te/ mdzo yu zhig la khal bkal nas brin gyi bar du rtsad gcod cing 'ongs/ brin du sleb pa dang / chas spyi dang mdzo bcol ba'i thog nas/ a ne+e rang gis ci theg cig khyer nas 'ongs pa/ pe ta spo mtho na yod pas mthong ste/ a ne+e yin par shes nas/ a nes 'o cag ma bu la sdug sna dgu btang

bas ma phrad pa drag zer phug pa'i 'gag na bca' zam zhig yod pa de bsngerdzogs pas/ a nes zam snar sleb byung ste/ tsha mo zam pa ma bsdog cig a ne 'ong gin yod do zer ba la /byu de kas sngerdzog pa yin byas pas/ tsha mo bden te da nga 'gyod pa drag po rang zhig skyes nas/ khyed ming sring dang phrad du 'ongs pas zam pa tshugs/ mi 'dzugs na a jo la nga sleb 'dug gyis dang zer bas/ ngas kyang zam pa'i tshur sna brag thog cig gi khar phyin nas bsdad pas/ a ne+e phyag 'tshal zhing phrad dgos pa'i 'ordzo rgyus mang po byed cing 'dug pas/ nga'i bsam pa la/ rting ye ma phrad na chos par yang mi rung / thog mar gzhag cig 'debs dgos snyam/ ngas nga spyir gnyen gyi kho thag chod/ sgos a khu dang a ne'i kho thag chod de/ dang po sdug de btang ba'i khar/ chos byas rting slong mo la 'ongs dus kyang sdug de btang bas/ a khu dang a ne'i kho thag chod do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan glu 'di ltar yin

ra༅༅/ /pas nyon cig byas/ a ner khrel 'debs kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so/ /pha kun la brtse ba'i thugs rje can/ /sgra sgrur mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sprang gar+sā med bdag gi gar+sā mdzod cig /las byas pa dran nam a ne soms/ /mi dran glu yi gsal zhig 'debs/ /ma yengs 'grod sems skyed la nyon/ /skya rnga rtsa yi ko ron na / /pha bzang gis bor ba'i ma bu gsum/ /nor yode dgu phrogs nas sdug dgu bcol/ /mthar sran phung ber kas gtor ba bzhin/ /khyed a khu a nes btang bas na/ /spyir gnyen gyi kho thag de nas chod/ /sgos bu nga sa mthar 'khyar ba'i tshe/ /ma sring dran nas yul du 'ongs/ /ma shi sring mo 'khyar ba des/ /skyo shas snying rlung langs pa'i mthus/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa byed pa'i tshe/ /'tsho ba zas kyis bkres phongs byung / /gasto a ne'i sgo drung slong du 'ongs/ /'khos med kyi rnal 'gror ngo shes nas/ /zhe sdang gnod sems bsalo

sbyor ni/ /khyi phyo phyo zer zhing rbod du byung / /sbra yi tshugs shing ber ka yis/ /lus snyi phung bzhin du brdungs pas na/ /chab rko mo'i nang du kha bub 'gyel/ /rin chen srog dang do bral byung / /brla 'tshong zer zhing 'thab pa dang / /rkang 'dren zer zhing 'bar ba yis/ /tshig rtsub mtshon gyis snying bsnad pas/ /sdug bsngal yi chad snying rlung ldang / /dbugs stod du 'tshangs nas skad ma thon/ /de rjes bdag la dgos med kyang / /g.yo thabs du mas khang zhing phrogs/ /a ne+e'i lus la bdud mo'i sems/ /a ne'i kho thag de nas chod/ /a khu'i sgo ru sleb pa'i tshe/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'ben tshig ni/ /yul gyi phung 'dre sleb yong zer/ /khyim mtshes gsode pa'i ra mdar sbran/ /mi snyan kha nas thon gsum smras/ /gor ma rdo yi char pa phab/ /nyag phran mda' yi zam pa btsugs/ /snying la bzod bral nad kyis btab/ /der yang srog dang do bral byung / /a khu'i lus la gshed ma'i

ra༅༅/ /sems/ /a khu'i kho thag de nas chod/ /rang 'khos med kyi nye ba dgra bas sdang / /de rjes ri la sgom pa'i tshe/ /phyi thag can gyi mdzes se des/ /ma phod brtse bas phrad du byung / /blo dang 'tsham pa'i snying gtam gyis/ /sdug bsngal can la sems gserdzo btang / /ro bcud ldan pa'i kha zas kyis/ /dbul phongs bdag gi bkres skom bsal/ /bka' drin che bar khums lags kyang / /skyes bu chos mdzad ma lags pa/ /mdzes se byung rung phrad don med/ /a ne phrad done de bas chung / /da lta nyid du slar 'ordzog la/ /snga ba'i dus su 'gre rdzo'adug ran/ /byas pas/ a ne mchi ma mang po btang zhing / phyag mang du btsal/ sngar phan chad tsha bo bden bzod pa bzhes par zhu zhes kha zhe med pa'i bshags pa phul/ da phyis nga rang 'grod drags pa dang / gnyen sred ma spongs bar tsha bo la mjal du 'ongs pa yin pas/ khyed ming sring gis mjal kha zhig cis kyang

dgos/ 'dod pa bzhin ma phrad na nga lcebs nas shi sdod zer ba la ma phod par zam pa 'dzugs grabs byas pas/ pe tas lkog shub kyis phrad mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bkod na'ang ma nyan par/ spyir dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang lung pa gcig nas chu 'thungs na yang nyams grib kyis phog pa yin te/ chos kyi dam nyams min pa dang / nga chos pa yin pas phrad pa yin byas zam pa btsugs/ phrad kha 'dod pa bzhin btang / rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang po bshad pas/ blo kha chos la 'gyur nas phyis chos byas/ gdams ngag bsgoms pas rang grole gyi rnal 'gror ma zhig byung ba yin gsungs/ de nas rje btsun la ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis/ rje btsun gyis/ chos zhu tshe bla ma'i drung du mos gus mdzad lugs sam/ thob nas ri la 〉snam pa'i thugs rus sam/ gang nas bsams rung blos mi 'khyud pa gda' bas/ mdzad pa de rnams la bsams na/ bdag cag rnams kyi chos 'di rang byed 'irtor gda'

ra༅༅/ /bas/ 'khor ba mi grol bar 'dug /ci rang drag na zhes mang du ngus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'khor ba dang ngan sesgong gistosdug bsngal la bsams na/ mos gus dang snying rus de yang ches skyoni rang mi 'dug /snying yod rnams kyis rgyu 'bras kyi chos thos nas yid ches sting / de tsam gyi snying rus kun gyis nus par gda' ste/ chos la yid ma ches par berte yul du lus shing / chos brgyad blos ma thongs pa yin pas/ rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa gal che/ rgyu 'bras rags pa tsam la'ang yid ma ches pa'i rtags nar mar bstan sting / stong nyid kyi bshad pa lung rigs dang mthun mthun mo mang po byas rung / stong nyid de bas kyang phra bas go ba dang yid ches pa dka'/ stong nyid la yid ches rting / stong nyid rang rgyu 'bras su shar bar go ba nas/ rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len sdig spong dge sgrub la brtson du rang 'gro ba yin zhing / chos kun gyi rtsa ba rgyu 'bras

la yid ches pa 'di yin pas/ sdig spong dge sgrub kyi phyag len la zhib pa dang brtson pa gal che'o/ /ngas dang po stong nyid kyi don ma rtogs te rgyu 'bras la yid ches pas/ sdig pa tshabs chen de bsags sting / ngan serdzong gsum las btang sa med snyam 'jigs drags/ bla ma la mosnas gus/ 〉snam pa la snying rus mi 'ong dbang med byung ba yin/ khyed rnams kyang nga rang gi ngag ltar gsang sngags kyi nyams len da lta'i 'di bzhin du gyis la ri khrod du gcig pur stodi nus pa gyis shig /'khor ba las thar ba'i khag mi rgan nga rang gis khur ba yin no gsungs/ yang ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dzās/ rje btsun rin po che rang rdo rje 'chang chen mi'i gzugs su sku sprul nas/ mdzad pa de rnams sems can gyi don du ston pa zhig yin pa 'dra/ de min rung / bskal pa dpag tu med pa nas tshogs bsags pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sems dpa' chen po zhig yin par thag chod gda' ste/ chos phyir sretreg kyang

ra༅༅/ /'dor zhing rnal 'byor rab tu brtson/ /zhes bya ba'i rtags rnams rje btsun la tshang gda'/ de min bdag sogs so so skye bo rnams kyis ni/ bla ma'i drung gi dad gus kyi mdzad pa sogs/ chos phyir dka' ba spyod tshul rje btsun gyi de 'dra blo rang gis kyang mi 'khyud na/ phyag len la sus khel/ brgya la phyag len la bkal rung / lus kyis rkyen mi theg par 'dug pas// rje btsun dang po nas sangs rgyas byang sems gang rung zhig yin par thag chod gda'/ des na bdag ni chos ma nus rung rje btsun gyi zhal mthong gsung thos pa'i sems can rnams kyang 'a9rtor ba las grerdzol snyam pa gda' bas/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang ngam/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gi sprul pa lags pa de gsung du gse(la zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga gang gi sprul pa yin nga rang la yang cha med/ ngan song gsum gyi sprul pa yin rung / khyed rang rnams kyis rdo rje 'chang sogs gang du

mthong ba de'i byin rlabs 'jug pas mos gus gyis/ sprul pa yin snyam pa de khyed rang rnams kyis nga la dag snang yin te/ chos la log lta de bas che ba mi 'ong / chos rnam dag byed pa'i che ba ma mthong bas lan/ spyir gyis dam pa'i chos kyi che bas/ tshe stod la nga lta bur sdig pa tshabs can byas pa'i so so skye bo zhig yin rung / phyis rgyu 'bras la yid ches nas/ tshe blos btang ste sgo gsum g.yo med du sgom nus na sangs rgyas thob pa la thag ring mi 'dug /khyad par bla ma mtshan ldan zhig gis rjes su bzung zhing / gsang sngags nye lam gyi man ngag dang snying po'i don/ tha snyad kyi sgrib g.yogs med par gcer mthong du ngo sprod pa'i dbang dang gdams ngag thob nas sgom nus na/ tshe 'dir sangs rgya mi rgya the tshom mi 'dug cing / tshe 'dir mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga'i las tshabs chen byas na shi ma thag dpyal ba mnar med du skye mi skye the tshom mi 'dug ste/ rgyu 'bras la yid ma ches shing

ra༅༅/ /snying rus chung bas lan/ snying thag pa nas rgyu 'bras la yid ches na/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs skrag /sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi sgo nas dang por bla ma la mos gus/ bar du gdams ngag sgom pa la snying rus/ mthar nyams rtogs skyong lugs sogs kyi snying rus nga'i 'di bas mi zhan pa so skye snying rus can kun la 'ong bar 'dug khyung tshe sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprulapar rlom pa 'dug ste/ gsang sngags kyi nye lam la yid ma ches pa'i rtags yin pas/ da khyed rang rnams rgyu 'bras la yid ches par gyis la/ gong ma'i rnam thar las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ dal 'gyor rnyed dka'/ nam 'chi cha med rnams soms la/ gsang sngags kyi nyams len la 'bungs shig /ngas kyang stosna treres gtam gsum la spyodang btang / sems la dpa' bskyed/ lus la bab bskur/ sdug bsngal khyad du bsad nas mi med kyi ri la

bsgoms pas nyams rtogs kyi yoni tan skyes pa yin/ khyed rnams kyang nga'i rjes su zhugs la nyams su longs shig gsungs/ bla ma'i bka' sgrub phyir tshe 'di blos btang ste snying rus dang dka' spyad drag pos yengs med du ri la bsgoms pa'i mdzad pa ste bdun pa'o// //brgyad pa ni/ yang ras chung pas/ rje btsun gyi mdzad pa de rnams done la ya mtshan dang ngo mtshar gong na med du gda' bas dgod la de bas bro ba mi 'ong ste/ rnam pa ngu bro ba kho nar gda'/ rnam pa yang dgod bro ba'i mdzad pa rnams gsung du gsol zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas rnam pa dgod bro ba snying rus kyis sgrab pa byas pa'i 'bras bu/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi gdul bya skal ldan rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkodi pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan btags pa 'di ka yin mod gsungs/༄yang ras chung pas rje btsun gyi gdul bya'i thog mar mi dang mi ma yin gang byung zhus pas/ thogo ma rang mi ma yin

ra༅༅/ /rnams tho 'tsham du byung bas snga/ de rjes mi'i slob ma phal cher 'dus pa'i rjes su tshe ring ma'i cho 'phrul byung / de rjes mi'i bu slob gzhan rnams byung ba yin te/ nga'i bstan pa mi ma yin tshe ring ma dang / mi dbus pa ston pa des spel bar 'dug gsungs/ de'i tshe se ban ras pas/ rje btsun gyi sgrub gnas rnams kyi gtso bo la phyi chu dbar du gda' ba/ de gnyis dang gong gi de rnams min pa gang dang gang du sgrub pa mdzad zhus pas/ bal po'i yol mo gangs rwa/ yongs su grags pa phyi'i rdzong drug /ma grags pa nang gi rdzong drug /gsang ba'i rdzong drug ste bco brgyad/ yang rdzong gnyis dang nyi shu/ yongs su grags pa'i phug chen bzhi/ ma grags pa'i bzhi ste/ de rnams kyi nang du sngar gyi gnas rnams kyang 'thus pa yin/ gzhan yang phug phran dang ri khrod dben la mthun rkyen 'dzom pa rnams su ba〉rtoms pas ba〉phom bya/ 〉rdzom byed/ 〉snam mkhan gsum gcig tu

'dres nas 〉sgom mi shes pa 'dug gsung / yang ras chung pas/ rje btsun gyis chos rnams zad sar skyol ba'i thugs rjes/ bdag slob 'bangs rnams la yang phyin ci ma 'ordzog pa'i bo rdzob dang rgyudang ba 'dres pa cung zad re la brtan pa thobe pas blo bde bar gda' ba bka' drin che lags/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams tshogs gaskusnag pa'i mig rkyen du sgrub gnas phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzong rnams dang / phug chen rnams kyi ngos 'dzin ming re gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ yongs su grags pa phyi'i rdzong drug ni/ brag dkar rta so dbu ma rdzong / smin khyug grib ma rdzong / ling ba brag dmar rdzong / rag ma byang chub rdzong / skyang phan nam mkha' rdzong / brag skya rdo rje rdzong rnams so/ /ma grags pa nang gi rdzong drug ni/ mchong lung khyung gi rdzong / skyid pa nyi ma rdzong / khu byug dben pa rdzong / shel phug chu shing rdzong / be rtse 'dod yon rdzong / rtsig pa rkang mthil rdzong rnams so/ /gsang ba'i rdzong drug ni/ rgya brag

ra༅༅/ /nam mkha' rdzong / stag phug seng ge rdzong / sbas phug ma mo rdzong / la phug pad+ma rdzong / glang sgo klu 'dud rdzong / khro rgyal rdo rje rdzong rnams so/ /yang rdzong gnyis ni/ skyid phug nyi ma rdzong dang / spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong gnyis so/ /yongs su grags pa'i phug chen bzhi ni/ gnya' nang gi grod pa phug /la phyi'i bdud 'dul phug /brin gyi 'bri lce phug /ti se'i rdzu 'phrul phug rnams so/ /ma grags pa bzhi ni/ rtsa'i rkang tshugs phug /ron gyi 'od gsal phug /ra la'i za 'og phug /ku thang gi phug ron phug rnams yin/ de rnams su sgom pa byung na dben la mthun rkyen 'dzom pa yang yode cing / brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'jug pa yin pas sgoms shig gsungs pas/ der tshogs pa'i lha mi'i bu slob chos nyan nya ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa kun la skyo shas dang nges 'byung / dad pa dang snying rje tshad las 'das pa rgyud la skyes te/ chos brgyad tshe 'di'i snang ba la zhen pa

'ordzog nas/ kun dam pa'i chos la dga' mgu yi rangs te/ thugs sras bu chen rnams kyis sgo gsum bstan pa dang sems can gyi done du bsngos nas/ dka' thub dang sdug sgur/ snying rus dang zhe bcad drag pos gaskusna med du ri la sgom pa'i dam bca' phul/ mi ma yin rnams kyis bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs shing dam bcas/ nya ma rnams kyi nang nas kyang rab rnams kyis tshe 'di blos btang ste/ rje btsun gyi phyag phyir 'brangs nas bsgoms pas gnas lugs kyi don mthong ba'i rnal 'gror pho mo mang du byung / 'bring rnams kyis 'ordzo sgrub zla sgrub kyi dam bca' blangs/ tha mas kyang sdig pa sna re rtag tu spong zhing / dge ba sna re rtag tu sgrub pa'i dam bca' ma blangs pa med cing / de thams cad mthar 'gyol ba yin no// 7/ de yan chad rje btsun rang gi gsung ji lta ba yi ger bkod pa lags shing / sgrub 'bras kyis bstan pa dang sems can la phan btags pa'i mdzad pa rje btsun rang

si༅༅/ /gi zhal nas gsungs pa mdor bstan lus rnam gzhag lta bur gyur pa 'di la cung zad cig rgyas par phye na/ skor tsho chen po gsum ste/ mi ma yin rnams kyis tho 'tsham pa dam la btags pa'i skor/ skal ldan thugs sras rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i skor/ kha 'thor ba'i nya ma bu slobe la sna tshogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i skor ro/ /de rnams rgyas par phye na/ dang po mi ma yin rnams dam la btags tshul ni/ brag dmar mchong lung du bgegs 49 75 po bhi na ya ka dam la btags pa bla ma dran drug gi skor gsungs/ de nas bla ma'i bka' sgrab phyir la phyi la byen nas/ lha chen tshogs bdag dam la btags pa la phyi chu bzang gi skor gsungs/ de'i phyi lo la phyi gnas mthil du byon pa la brten nas/ yongs su grags pa'e gangs mgur chen mo gsungs/ de nas bla ma'i bka' sgrub phyir mang yul gyi ri bo dpal 'bar dang / bal yul gyi yol mo gangs rwa

la 'byon dgongs nas slar yang gung thang la byon pas/ ling pa brag la thugs song ste/ der re zhig bzhugs pas/ ling pa brag srin mo'i skor gsungs/ de nas ri so dpal 'bar gyi 'dabs rag ma byang chub rdzong du bse'i lha mo shig dang rag ma'i gzhi bdag dam la btags pa'i sterdzor gsungs/ de nas rkyang phan nam mkha' rdzong du bzhugs nas/ mi ma yin dang mi mang po la phan 'dogs mdzad/ de nas yol mo gangs rwa la phyon nas/ siṅga la'i nags gseb stag phug seng ge rdzong du bzhugs te/ der yang mi ma yin dang mi 'ga'i don mdzad/ der bod la song la ri khrod dang dben par sgom bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'gro ba'i don gyis shig bya ba'i lung bstan byung ba ltar/ ngod la byon nas gung thang gi phug cig tu bzhugs te phug ron gyi snyor gsungs so// //gnyis pa thugs sras rnams dang mjal tshul ni/ de nas brag skya rdo rje rdzong du bzhugs nas sems can mang po'i don

ra༅༅/ /mdzad tshe/ yum rdo rje rnal 'gror mas rje btsun la spyir gyis bu slob rnams 'byung ba'i lung bstan dang / khyad par mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag len pa'i slob ma ras chung rdo rje grags pa gnas dang bcas pa lung bstan te/ gung thang ra la'i phu za 'og phug tu bzhugs pas/ thugs kyi sras ras chung pa dang mjal/ de nas ras chung pa rgya gar la bsnyung gzhi 'chos su byon nas/ yang dpon slob gnyis mjal te ron phu'i 'od gsal phug tu rtsa phu ras pa dang mjal/ de nas rag ma byang chub rdzong du byon pas ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs dang mjal/ de nas byon te gnya' nang grod phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ snga nas dad bzhin pa skyo stoni stodzi gu na la dbang dang gdams pa gnang nas smin grolal bkod/ de nas byang rta sgo la byon tshe pha res gcung gi gad pa gle gsum du nya ma dpal dar 'bum dang mjal/ tshu res g.yas ru byang gi mdzad khang zhig tu se ban ras pa dang

mjal/ de nas la stod rgyal gyi shrī la sgom du byon pas 'bri sgom ras pa dang mjal/ de nas ston ro snyoms kyi ldom bu la byon pas chu mig dngul 'bum du ras pa zhi ba 'od dang mjal/ de nas gcen lung du sba lcag gi 〉snar la ngan rdzong ras pa dang mjal/ de nas la phyi la bzhugs pa'i tshe bla mas lung bstan ltar mkha' 'grerdzos bskul te/ ti se la byoni pa'i lam du dam pa rgyags phu ba dang mjal/ de nas yar byon te glo bo ko re la thog gi skor la mkhar chung ras pa dang mjal/ de nas dgun spu hreng gi rong 'bri rtse'i gangs 'dabs su bzhugs dus ras pa dar ma dbang phyug dang mjal te sos ti se la byon nas na ro bon chung rdzu 'phrul gyi zil gyis mnan pa ti se'i skor/ de nas mar byon slar yang brag skya rdo rje rdzong du bzhugs pas rong chung ras pa dang mjal/ de nas mkha' 'grerdzos bskul te byon pa'i lam du sbas phug ma mo rdzong gzigs/ der zhag shas bzhugs pas rdzi bo zhabs phyir 'brangs pa

ra༅༅/ /la lug rdzi ras pa bya ba'i rtogs ldan bzang po zhig byung / de nas la phug pad+ma rdzong du gshen sgom ras pa dang mjal te/ phyis glang sgo klu bdud rdzong dang / sbas phug ma mo rdzong du bzhugs tshe zhabs tog kyang phul du phyin pa phul ba yin/ de nas co ro 'brig mtshams la byon pa'i skor la ras chung ma dang mjal/ de nas mon gnyi shang 'gur rta la bzhugs tshe khyi ra ras pa dang mjal/ de'i stobs kyis rje btsun gyi snyan grags chen po bal yul khyab pa dang / sgrol mas lung bstan te bskul ba'i ྅snebs kyis kho khom rgyal yos mchod par gyur/ de nas ras chung pa dang gshen sgom ras pas spyan drangs nas la phyi'i mdo snyan g.yon phug tu bzhugs/ de'i phyi 'o/ mchong lung brag la bzhugs/ de nas chu dbar du byon pas/ tshe ring ma'i skor gsum rim par gsungs/ de nas brin sding mar byon pa'i tshe ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug dang mjal/ de nas rje btsun dpon

slob kyis gnya' nang grod phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya gar gyi dharma bo dhi dang / bal po rdzong du mjal bas/ rje btsun la phyag phul/ des sku bsode rgyas pa'i stobs kyis mtshan nyid kyi ston pa dar blos phrag dog gis rtsod pa byas pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang nus pas bzlog pa'i skor/ de'i rkyen gyis ras chung ti phu'i skor/ de'i bar la grod phug tu mes sgom ras pa dang mjal/ gnya' nang gnag khrar ras ma sa le 'od dang mjal/ de nas rje btsun brag dmar ྅rto mthor byone nas bzhugs pa las/ ras chung pa tshur byed pa gzigs nas bsu ru byone te g.yag ru'i skor dang / rkyang mgur gyi skor gsungs/ de nas chu dbar du byon nas dwags po'i glan sgom ras pa dang mjal/ brin gyi spro bde bkra shis sgang du/ sngone bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan pa'i skyes bu chen po thugs kyi sras mchog dam par gyur pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla 'od gzhon nu sems can gyi

ra༅༅/ /don du/ mir sku skye ba bzhes pa mnyam med dwags po lha rje dang mjal/ de nas chu dbar gyi 'om chung na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sngar rgol du byung ba'i 'ordzo ston dge 'dun dang mjal nas rjes su bzung / de nas skyid phug nyi ma rdzong na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ brin gyi 'dre stod bkra shis 'bar dang mjal/ spyod pa mdzad tshe dge 'dun rnams kyi nang nas li skor phya ru ba phyag phyir 'brangs nas mjal ba yin no/ /rje btsun rin po che la mkha' 'gros mi'i bu slob rnams kyi nang nas/ grub thob rang yang nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung bar lung bstan pa de rnams ni thugs kyi sras brgyad/ nye ba'i sras bcu gsum/ de rnams kyi sring bzhi rnams yin zhing / de dag dang mjal tshul kun la skor tsho chen po re re yode pa lags serdzo// //de nas gsum pa kha 'thor ba sna tshogs kyi sterdzor la/ nang dang gsang ba'i rdzong 'ga' zhig tu thugs sras rnams dang mjal ba'i snga phyi nges med du gsungs pa/ grwa bu

slob dang nya ma 'ga'i zhus lan gyi skor 'ga' re/ sgam po pa bzhugs dus ben po ri'i skor/ de nas gnya' nang du byon nas dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi skor/ rtsar mar gshen rdor mo dang legs se 'bum gyi skor/ de nas 'chi grod thigs tshags ma'i skor/ de nas ras chung pa dang dpon slob gnyis la phyi la byon tshe bdud 'dul phug mo che dang skyo sangs la byon pa'i skor/ de nas yar byon te ram sdings gnam phug ma'i 〉snar/ de nas nya ma rnams kyis spyan drangs te/ gnya' nang grod phug tu bzhugs tshe rje btsun rang gi rnam thar gsungs te ras chung dbus bzhud kyi skor/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyis mtshams sbyar te thong lar dam pa dang mjal ba'i skor/ las zhing du gzhin don thugs rje'i lcags kyu dang / yum gyi drin lan bsab pa'i skor/ rtsar ma'i nya ma sogs gnya' nang pa rnams la mjug gi zhal chems kyi skor/ de nas chu dbar du 'byon pa'i zhor la/ ding rir lha rje

ra༅༅/ /g.yang nge'i skor/ chu dbar du phebs nas dbus bzhud phyi ma'i skor/ brin lha bror yon bdag bkra shis brtsegs kyi skor/ brin brag mkhar du mdzes se 'bum dang / khu byug la sogs te nya ma spyi'i skor/ brag dmar spo mthor bdud bzhi las rgyal ba dang / sngags pa'i zhus lan gyi skor/ bu slob yongs la spro ba bskyed pa/ bkod pa sku'i rdzu 'phrul gyi skor la sogs te/ yongs su grags pa dang ma grags pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ skor tsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas/ mtha' yas pa'i skal ldan gyi skyes bu dbang po rab rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad/ dbang po 'bring rnams smin par mdzad cing grol ba'i lam bstan/ tha ma rnams kyis kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya la :snab pa la bsam sbyordzor brtan po la babordzod/ skal med rnams la'ang rnam dkar gyi bag chags bzhag nas/ gnas skabs ma〈sna ris lha

mi'i bde ba la bkod pa'i phrin las dang / thugs rje nam mkha' lta bus/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mor mdzad cing / sems can rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal mtha' dag las skyob par mdzad pa lags serdzo/ /de dag mgur 'bum gyi skabs su shin tu rgyas par phye nas bstan to/ /sgrub 'bras kyis bstan pa dang / sems can la phan gdags pa'i mdzad pa ste brgyad pa'o// //dgu pa ni/ de lta bu'i mdzad pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i mthar/ brin sding ma na dge bshes rtsag phu ba bya ba'i stod pa nor phyug la kha drag nga/ / brin pa rnams sbyogs pa'i gral 'bordzor 'dug pa zhig yerdzod pa de/ rje btsun la 'phral gus gus ltar byed cing / phugs phrag dog gis brgyal bas rje btsun la yoni bdag mang po 'dzom sar rma dbab pa'i bsam pas dogs pa zhu ba ltar byas nas dri ba mang po byed pa zhig yod pa la/ shing pho stag gi lo ston zla ra bar song ba'i tshe/ brin du chang sa chen po zhig gi

ra༅༅/ /sar rje btsun gral dbu la gdan drangs/ de 'og dge bshes rtsag phu ba yang 'byung ste/ rje btsun la phyag phul nas mi mang po tshogs sar phyag lan zhig gnang du re ba las/ rje btsun sngar nas bla ma ma gtogos/ su gang la'ang phyag dang phyag lan mi mdzad pas/ sngar lugs ltar phyag lan ma mdzad pas/ kho'i bsam pa la nga yod tan 'di ka tsam shes pa'i stoni pa bzang po zhig gis kho chi yang mi shes pa'i blun yo zhig la phyag 'tshal bas lan mi byed na/ dma' phab res shig bya'o snyam nas/ tshad ma'i gzhung zhig bton nas/ rje btsun 'di la bdag gi dogs pa sel ba'i 'bru gnon dang / 'phros lugs kyi gleng mo zhig mdzod dang zer byung bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ gzhung rnams kyi tshig rigs kyi 'bru gnon khyed rang gis shes 'ong / don gyi 'bru gnon la 'jig rten chos brgyad blos btang zhing mgo snyoms/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin 'dul/ gsor 'das ro

snyoms nas chos kyi bdag 'dzin 'dul zhing ri la sgom pa 'di ka yin/ de min nyams su mi len pa'i tshig 'di'i lan du 'di zer dang / 'di'i rjes su 'di yod rnams la dgos pa mi 'dug pas/ ngas bslabs kyang ma bslabs/ shes kyang mi shes/ shes rung brjed de thal ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi glu 'di nyone cig gsung mgur 'di gsungs so/ /sgra sgyar mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tha snyad bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rje bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs/ /sems rnam g.yeng chos la 'chor ma myong / /nga byams dang snyingarje bsgoms bsgoms nas/ /rang gzhan 'dzin pa brjed de thal/ /bla ma spyi bor bsgoms bsgoms nas/ /kha drag dponi po brjed de thal/ /yi dam 'bral med du bsgoms bsgoms nas/ /dman pa'i phung khams brjed de thal/ /snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa bsgoms ba〉snams nas/ /yig rigs kyi dpe cha brjed de thal/ /tha mal gyi shes pa bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /ma

ra༅༅/ /rig 'khrul pa brjed de thal/ /sku gsum rang chas bsgoms bsgoms nas/ /re dogs kyi sgom pa brjed de thal/ /tshe 'di phyi mnyam du bsgoms bsgoms nas/ /skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa brjed de thal/ /gcig pur nyams myong bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /mched grogs kyi ngo srung brjed de thal/ /nyams len rgyud la sbyar sbyar nas/ /grub mtha'i kha 'dzin brjed de thal/ /skye 'gag gnas med ba〉rdzoms ba〉phoms nas/ /khas len gyi lta ba brjed de thal/ /snang ba chos skur sems sems nas/ /dmigs bcas kyi sgom pa brjed de thal/ /ma bcos lhug par bzhag bzhag nas/ /tshul 'chos kyi spyod pa brjed de thal/ /lus ngag dman sa 'dzin 'dzin nas/ /mi chen gyi dregs 'gying brjed de thal/ /sgya lus la dgon pa byed byed nas/ /sde mtshams kyi dgon pa brjed de thal/ /tshig bral nyams su len len nas/ /tshig gi 'bru gnyon brjed de thal/ /gzhung gi

'bru gnon ston pas mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ kho na re khyed rang sgom chen rnams kyi lugs la de skad yin pa srid/ nged mtshan nyid pa'i rigs pas ded na chos skad rnams kyis gang du'ang mi phyin par 'dug /rje btsun gang zag bzang po yin du re nas nged kyis kyang phyag btsal ba yin zer bas/ yoni bdag rnams kyi blo la ma 'thad de/ kun kha 'cham par dge bshes ston pa khyed kyis chos ji tsam shes kyang 'dra ste/ khyed lta bu'i chos pas sa steng thams cad gang rung / rje btsun gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig kyang mi do'i de bas khyed rang kha rog par nged rnams kyi gral dbu la bzhugs khyed rang gi nor rnams skyed 'phel du ci 'gro mdzod dang / chos kyi dri mas ma gos gda' yis byas pas/ der kho khong khro skyes spro langs rung kun kha 'cham ste/ 'dzing pas ni ma thub par nag rog ge 'dug /der kho'i bsam pa la/ mi la ras pas ci yang mi shes pa'i smyon spyod dang tho co/ khrobo dang rdzun 'di ka

ra༅༅/ /tsam byed pa zhig gis bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren cing / sems can gyi mgo bskor nas dkor mang po za bar 'dug /ngas yon tan 'di ka tsam zhig bslabs/ yul 'di na nor che cerdzos dang / kha drag 31sa yin rung chos phyogs nas khyi ru yang mi mthong bar 'dug pas 'di la thabs shig byed dgosasnyam/ kho rang dang lus 'brel ba'i bud med cig yodi pa de la g.yu chen po zhig yod pa de ster bar byas nas/ gsol ngan pa zho la sbyar te/ rje btsun brin gyi brag mkhar na bzhugs tshe 'dren du btang byung bas/ rje btsun gyis las 'brel yod pa'i skal ldan rnams smin grol la bkod zin pa dang / mo'i zas ngan med kyang sku tshe'i dus la bab par mkhyen rung / mo la g.yu de thog mar ma byung na phyis mi 'ong ba mkhyen nas/ nga da lan khyod kyi zas de mi za/ rting sor khyer shog cig za ba yin no gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyis dgongs pa yin nam snyam mo 'jigs pa dang kha

skyengs pa'i ngang nas log phyin te/ dge bshes rtsag phu ba la rje btsun gyi mngon mkhyen gyis dgongs nas mi bzhes par 'dug byas lo rgyus rnams bshad pas/ kho na re/ mngon shes yod na rting sor khyer shog mi zer bar khyod rang la sprad nas zar bcug 'ong ste/ de skad mi byed par rting sor khyer shog zer ba de ka maphro shes med pa'i rtags yin/ da khyod rang g.yu 'di khyer la zas 'di kho'i khar song nges pa zhig gyis shig zer g.yu btang bas/ mo na re/ thugs mkhyen mnga' bar kun gyis yid ches byed cing thag chod gda' ba/ thugs mkhyen mnga' bas ka /kha sang yang ma gserdzol ba yin mordzod/ da dung yang mi gserdzol bar khag theg pas/ nga la g.yu yang mi dbertes/ nga 'jigs nas kyang mi tshugs par 'dug pas 'di don la nga 'gro yang mi 'gro byas pas/ kho na re/ mi nag pa rnams mngon shes yod par thag gcod pa de khong tshos dpe cha ma mthong bar kho'i zog gis mgo gsor ba yin

ra༅༅/ /mod/ nged kyi dbe cha'i nang na mngon shes yod pa'i mi de 'di 'dra min pa zhig yod par bshad pa yin/ mngon shes med pa ngas khag theg gis/ da khyod kyis kho la zas 'di byin nas don mthong byung na/ rang re gnyis snga nas lus 'brel rting / da yang sgog pa che zas chung bzas khyad mi 'dug pas rang re gnyis bza' mi byas te/ g.yu 'di ma tshad nga'i phyi nor nang nor kun gyi gnyer khag khyod kyis khur zhing skyid sdug gcig byed pa yin/ des na rang re gnyis mtshang cig pas rem shog cig zer ba la mo yang khos labs pa ltar bden zhing 'ong du re nas/ yang zas ngan de zho zhig la sbyar te/ rje btsun spro bde bkra shis sgang na bzhugs tshe 'dren du byung bas/ rje btsun zhal 'dzum mdzad nas phyag tu bzhes pas/ mo'i bsam pa la dge bshes rtsag phu bas zer ba bzhin mngon mkhyen mi 'ong ba 'dra snyam pa'i tshe/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyodad la las 'di byed pa'i

rngan pa'i g.yu de byung ang gsungs pas/ mo kha skyengs shing 'jigs skrag dang dngangs pa'i ngang nas/ phyag 'tshal zhing ngu ba dang 'dar ba'i skad kyis g.yu byung lags/ da de mi bzhes par ci yang dran pa'i phung mordzo bdag rang la gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ khyod ci byed pa yin gsungs pas/ las ngan can ma bdag rang 'thung ba lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ spyir ngas 'di khyod 'thung phyir btod pa snying rje nas kyang mi bzod pa 'dug cing / byang sems kyi bslab bya dang 'gal zhing / rtsa ltung phog pa yin/ khyad par nga rang gi 'dul skal dang tshe tshad gnyis ka rdzogs nas zhing khams gzhan du 'gro ba'i dus la bab pa yin/ khyod kyi zas 'di rang gis nga la mi gnod pas 'thungs ma 'thungs la khyad med na'ang / sngar 'thungs na khyod kyi sdig gla'i g.yu de mi thob par 'dug pas ma 'thungs pa yin/ da g.yu lag tu byung 'dug pas/ kho'i bsam pa rdzogs pa dang / khyod kyis g.yu

ra༅༅/ /thob phyir 'thung ba yin no/ /lar khyed gnyis 'di byas rting 'di byed bya ba'i grabs shoms mang po byed cing 'dug ste khyod re ba bzhin mi byed/ khos nga'i yin lugs mang po 'chad cing gda' ste/ bden pa tshig gcig kyang med pas rting sor gnyis ka 'grod pa drag po skye ba'i dus shig 'ong / de'i tshe 'gyod tshangs la rab tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ de ma byung na'ang da phyin chad sre ga la bab rung sdig pa'i las chen 'di lta bu ma byed par/ nga dang brgyud pa la snying thag pa nas gasku(la ba thob cig /khyed gnyis dag dus rtag tu skyid spong zhing sdug nyo ba gnyis 'dug ste/ da lan gyi sdig pa 'di ngas 'dag pa zhig e 'ong lta ba yin/ da khyod rang las 'di'i gtam nga ma shi'i bar du su la'ang ma 'chad/ rting sor kun gyis rig pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ mi rgan ngas sngar zlos pa'i gtam rnams bden par mig gis ma mthong rna bas mi thos rung / da lan gyi 'di bden par yid

ches pa'i dus shig 'ong gis rna bar zhog la e bden ltos shig gsungs nas gsol 'o// /de nas mos dge bshes rtsag phu ba la gsung de dag bskyar bas/ kho na re zer tshad mi bden/ 'tsho tshad mi bsha'/ nga la rdzas de kho'i khar song bas ka chog /da kha rog sdod shes pa gyis zer ro/ /de nas rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ gnya' nang dang ding ri'i mis gtso byas pa'i nga dang 'brel ba yod pa'i yon bdag dad pa can rnams la tshogs kyi yo byad re khyer la/ nga dang phrad du ce ga gyis/ 'brel med rgyal khams kyi mi nga dang phrad par 'dod pa rnams la'ang 3rdzog gyis gsungs pa ltar/ bu slob rnams kyis kun la dril bsgrags te/ gtam de thos pa'i mi phal cher rje btsun gyi gsung de la yid ma ches par/ sngar chos 'brel mardzod pa'i nya ma bu :rdzob dad pa can rnams dang / mjal bar 'dod pa'i skal ldan mang po chu dbar du 'dus pa las/ rje btsun gyis drang done las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag

ra༅༅/ /dang / nges don snying po'i don gyi ngo sprod rnams nyi ma mang pe'i bar du gsungs/ de'i bar la chos nyan rnams kyi nang nas skal ldan gyi bu slob 'gas/ nam mkha' lha'i chos nyan gyis gang ba mngon sum du mthong ba dang / 'ga' dang 'ga' la lha mi'i chos nyan gyis sa dang bar snang kun gang skurdzod snyam pa'i ngang nas nyams dga' yal le ba dang / mngon sum kun gyis mthong snang du ltas khyad par can nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang / kha dog sna lnga'i sprin gyi gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs te mchod rdzas dpag med kyis gang ba dang / me tog kha dog sna lnga'i char 'bab pa dang / yid 'phrog pa'i rol mo'i sgra snyan mang po thos pa dang / sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri zhim po tshor ba byung bas/ chos nyan blo 'bring po ltas bzang po nyams la shar ba rnams kyis rje btsun la/ nged rnams kyi nyams la gnam sa thams cad lha mi'i chos nyan gyis gang

yod snyam pa'i nyams dga' yal le ba dang / mngon sum du ltas bzang po 'di 'dra 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyed mi'i chos nyan rnal 'gyor pas thob pa dang / nya ma skal ldan kho nar 'dug pas bzang ba ma gtogs mang po mi 'dug /dkar phyogs kyi lha'i chos nyan gyis bar snang kun gang ba 'dus 'dug pa rnams kyis nga la lha rdzas kyi 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa 'bul zhing khyed mi rnams la'ang spro ba skyed cing 'dug pas/ khyed rnams la nyams dang mngon sum gyi ltas bzang po 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsungs/ 'o na bdag cag rnams kyis mi mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ lha rnams kyi nang na phyir mi ldog pa dang / sa thob pa mang po rang 'dug /de rnams mthong ba la sha'i mig thob nam yang dgos/ de min na'ang tshogs gnyis la 'dun pa drag po dang / sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags srab pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa yin/ lha'i gtso bo sa thob pa

ra༅༅/ /rnams mthong nas 'khor rnams zhar la mthong ba yin pas/ lha mthong bar 'dod na bsag sbyang la 'bad 'tshal/ de ltar 'bad na lha'i dam pa rang sems mthong ba yin gsungs/ lha zhal mthong lugs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /drin chen mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'bangs bu brgyud bzang bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa la/ /dga' ldan la serdzogs lha gnas nas/ /dkar phyogs lha yi josnas nyan 'dus/ /phyogs mtshams med par gang ba de/ /spyan lnga ldan pa ma lags pa / /mi phal pa rnams kyis ga la mthong / /ngas ni thams cad sa ler mthong / /'on kyang kun gyi thun mong du/ /mi bdag lha yi mchod pa'i rdzas/ /nam mkha' 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang / /lha rdzas me tog char pa babs/ /dri zhim spos tshor sgra snyan thos/ /kun la dag snang bde nyams shar/ /de bka' brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje yin/ /thugs rje de yi skyabs

'og nas/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro'i chos nyan kun/ /mthong bar 'dod na glu la nyon/ /khyed sngone nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus/ /ma las skyes nas sdig la dga'/ /cis kyang dge ba mi 'dod cing / /rgas kyang bsam pa mi dge bas/ /las kyi rnam smin myonge nges pas/ /sdig bshags pas e 'dag bsams pa na/ /dge ba dran na 'dag pa yin/ /lar bsam pa shes bzhin sdig spyod pa/ /kham zan dang gtam ngan brje ba yin/ /rang yang gar 'gro mi shes pa'i/ /gzhan gyi lam sna byed pa de/ /rang gzhan gnyis la gnod pa yin/ /nges par sdug bsngal mi 'dod na/ /gzhan la gnod pa thams cad spongs/ /lha dang bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /sngar byas sdig la 'grod tshangs gyis/ /phyin chad mi byed dam bcas na/ /myur du 'dag pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /lar sdig can phal cher dbang po sno/ /gtad tshugs med pa yengs la dga'/ /chos kyi snang ba mi ldan na/ /da dung sdig pa

ra༅༅/ /yod pa'i rtags/ /de la bshags pa yang yang gyis/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong rnam gnyis la/ /g.yel ba med par 'bad 'tshal lo/ /de ltar byas pas dkar phyogs rdzi /chos nyan lha ru ma zad de/ /lha rnams kun gyi dam pa mchog /rang sems chos sku mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nyid mthong na 'khor 'das rdzi /ltad mo thams cad mthong ba yin/ /bya ba thams cad zin pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ der tshogs pa'i lha mir gyur pa'i chos nyan rnams kyi nang nas rab rnams kyis sems chos sku'i don phyin ci ma log pa gtan la phebs/ 'bring rnams la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams khyad par can rgyud la skyes shing lam sna zin/ tha mas kyang byang chub mchogo tu sems ma bskyed pa med do/ /de nas rje btsun gyi zhal nas 'dir tshogs pa'i grwa pa bu slob lha mir bcas pa rnams/ 'o skol tshe sngon smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar bas da lan phrad nas dkar po'i chos

kyis 'brel pa yin no/ /da mi rgan yang na serdzo rgas pa tshun chad kyis yang yang rang e phrad mi shes pas/ ngas khyed rnams la bshad pa'i chos rnams chud ma gseni par nyams su ci longs gyis shig /de ltar byas na nga gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der khyed rnams 'khor gyi thog mar skye ba yin no dga' bar gyis shig ces gsungs pas/ gnya' nang gi nya ma rnams kyis rje btsun gyi gsung rigs 'dis gzhan don la theg dgongs pa ni min 'ong / de ltar lags na mkha' spyod la gnya' nang nas 'byon dgos/ de ltar min rung lan cig cis kyang 'byon dgos zhes dad pa'i gdungs shugs kyi sgo nas zhabs la 'jus te ngu zhing smre sngags mang pos bton nas gsol ba nan cher btab/ de bzhin du ding ri ba sogs nya ma gzhan rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi yul phyogs su 'byon dgos zer gsol ba drag po btab pa las/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ da mi rgan gnya' nang dang ding ri'i phyogs su mi

ra༅༅/ /'gro/ brin dang chu dbar gyi phyogs su 'chi ba sgug cing sdod pa yin/ khyed rang rnams smon lam bzang po thob la song nga dang dag pa mkha' spyod du phrad pa yin gsungs pas/ 'o na rje btsun da mi phebs rung / sngar phebs pa'i yul phyogs bkra shis la sa phyogs byin chags pa/ rje btsun rang gi zhal mthong ba dang / gsung dang mtshan thos pa la sogs te 'brel pa yod tshad kyis thog drangs sems can thams cad la smone lam bzang po rje btsun gyis gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'o na khyed rnams kyis nga la dad pa'i sgo nas rgyags bskyangs pas bka' drin che/ ngas kyang sems bskyed bzang pos khyed rnams la chos bshad pas bka' drin che ba yin/ nga bden tshig grub pa'i rnal 'gror pa yin pas/ rang re kun la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde skyid 'byung ba'i smon lam bzang po zhig ngas 'debs par rigs gsungs/ smon lam gyi mgur 'di

gsungs so/ /pha smon lam mthar phyin 'gro ba'i mgon/ /sgra sgyar mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir tshogs gsoni cig bu slob kun/ /khyed rnams bdag la bka' drin che/ /bdag kyang khyed la bka' drin che/ /bka' drin che mnyam dpon slob snams/ /mngon dga'i zhing du mjal bar shog /'dir bzhugs yon bdag thams cad kyang / /tshe ring bsod nams ldan par cerdzog /bsam pa 'o/ga pa mi skye zhing / /chos mthun bsam pa 'grub par 31ga /yul phyogs 'dir yang bkra shis shing / /mi nad 'khrug pa med pa dang / /'o( legs 'gru 'phel bde skyid ldan/ /kun tu chos la spyod par cerdzog /bdag gi zhal mthong gsung thos dang / /rnam thar yid la dran pa dang / /mtshan nam rnam thar thos tshad rnams/ /mngon dga'i zhing du mjal bar shego /gang zhig bdag gi rnam thar la/ /spyod cing sgrub pa byed pa dang / /'dri zhing 'chad nyan byed pa dang / /klog dang phyag mchod 'bul

ra༅༅/ /ba dang / /rnam thar tshul bzhin skyong ba rnams/ /mngon dga'i zhing du mjal bar shog /ma 'ongs gang zag thams cad la/ /gal te sgom pa nus srid na / /mi kho bos dka' ba spyad spyad pas/ /gegs dang gol sa med par shog /chos phyir dka' thub spyod pa la/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa yod/ /de la 'jug cing bskul ba la0/ /bka' drin dpag tu med pa yod/ /mi kho bo'i rnam thar thos pa la/ /byin rlabs dpag tu med pa yod/ /dpag med gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /thos pa tsam gyis grol gyur nas/ /bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub par 3(ga /bdag gi gnas dang gnas mal dang / /dngos po mchis pa thams cad kyis/ /gar song yul du bde skyid cerdzog /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /nam mkha' 'byung bas gar khyab pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis khyab par cesag /lha klu la sogs sde brgyad dang / /de bzhin gzhi bdag 'byung po'i tshogs/ /

gnod pa skad cig mi skyel zhing / /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par cerdzog /srog chags srin bu la sogs pa/ /gcig kyang 'khor bar mi ltung zhing / /ma lus nga yis 'dren par cerdzog /ces gsungs pas/ nya ma rnams dga' bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ rje btsun grongs pa ni min las che snyam pa'i blo the tshom log ge ba zhig la gnyi' nang dang ding ri'i nya ma kun byin rlabs zhu ba dang / stsod lam 'debs pa sngar bas nan che ba byas te/ chos nyan rnams rang rang serdzo so'i gnas su gyes pa las/ nam mkha'i 'ja' 'od la serdzogs pa'i ltas rnams kyang rang yal la song ngo / /de nas brin pa rnams kyis ras pa zhi ba 'od la sogs pa'i thugs sras rnams ngo chen du sbran nas zhu ba nan gyis phul te/ brin gyi klu gdol pa nag po'i kha gnon du klu kho rang gi spyi bo sprul mgo'i gdengs ka pha bong reg pa dug can gyi rtse mor brtsigs pa'i sgrub phug der bzhugs nas/ brin gyi yon bdag rnams la chos gsungs pa'i

ra༅༅/ /mthar/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas grwa pa rnams la gdams ngag gi sgro 'dogs bcad dgos yod pa rnams myur du chod cig /kho bo yun ring e sdod mi shes so gsungs pas/ grwa pa rnams kyis kyang tshogs 'khor bskor nas gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par zhus pa'i tshogs gral du/ 'bri sgom dang se ban gnyis kyis/ rje btsun gyi gsung rigs 'di la brtags na/ bdag rnams yid cig ma ches pas myur du mya ngan las 'da' ba ni min 'ong / sku tshe'i 'phen pa ni ma rdzogs las che zhus pas/ da kho bo'i tshe tshad dang 'dul skal gnyis ka rdzogs pas skyes pa'i rtags shig ston pa yin gsungs/ de nas zhag 'ga' nas rje btsun chen po sku bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan/ de'i tshe ngan rdzong ras pas rje btsun sku bsnyung ba 'di la bdag slobe 'bangs rnams kyis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la tshogs gtor phul/ rje btsun rang la yang gdan bzhugs kyi sku rim dang sman

dpyad phul ba legs pa 'dug zhus nas yon bdag rnams la skad btang ste sta gone byed par brtsams pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas spyir rnal 'gyor pa na ba dge sbyodar gyi bskul ma yin pas rim grerdzo mi byed par ci byung lam du khyer te/ na nus 'chi nus shig dgos pa yin/ khyad par nga mi la ras pas drin can mar pa'i lugs kyi rim grerdzo sngar nas byas zin pa'i don/ da dpung dang bar pa ma dgos par rkyen gyi dgra bo snying gi grogs su khugs pas rkyen la rim gro mi dgos/ glud dang dza brdungs ma dgos par ltas ngan rnam rtog gi gdon gyi rang zhal bstan nas/ phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i chos skyong du gyur pas gdon la rim gro mi dgos/ bzang drug sogs kyi sman sbyor ma dgos par dug lnga'i nad ye shes lnga'i bde bar shar bas sman dpyad mi dgos/ da dus la bab nas lus bskyed rim sgya ma lta bu'i lha sku rdzogs rim 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim 'gro ba lagadan bzhugs bya don med/ 'jig rten

ra༅༅/ /pa rnams rang sdig pa sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu skye rga na 'chi sogs kyi sdug bsngal tshe 'dir myong ba sman dpyad rim gro byas rung bzlog pa'i thabs med de/ rgyal po'i dbang / dpa' bo'i rtsal/ mdzes ma'i gzugs/ phyug po'i nor/ dar ma'i bang / smra mkhas kyi shags la sogs pa'i thabs zhi rgyas dbang drag gang gis kyang mi bzlog par rang gis nges par myong dgos par 'dug /sdug bsngal la 'jigs shing bde ba 'dod na phyis sdug bsngal mi myong zhing / rtag tu bde bar 'gyur ba'i thabs rim gro zab mo shig nga la yod de gsung / de gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ 'o na 'khor ba'i bya ba bsags na 'dzad/ bcos na 'jig /'dus na 'bral/ skyes na 'chi ba serdzogs kyi sdug bsngal yod nges pa rang sdug rang gis shom pa'i las 'di dang po nas blos btang ste/ mi gsog /mi 'chos/ mi 'du bar mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin/ skye med kyi don nyams su

len pa rnams thabs dang rim gro mchog yin/ de min kha chems gnad chen yod pa de sting sor 'chad pas ma brjed par gyis shig gsungs pas/ ras pa zhi ba 'od dang ngan rdzong ras pa gnyis kyis rje btsun sku khams bzang na da dung sems can mang po'i don 'ong ba lags shing / brgya la gsol ba ma thebs rung bdag rnams mi 'grode pa lags pas/ gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga zhig mdzad pa dang / gdan bzhugs dang sman dgrad cig cis kyang bzhes par zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas da dus la ma bab na khyed gnyis zer ba bzhin byas pas chog /de min gzhan phan sems bskyed kyis ma zin pa'i rang gi tshe 'di'i ched du/ gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga byed pa ye shes kyi lha rnams rgyal po khri'i steng nas phyag dar gyi las la spyan 'dren pa lta bu'i nyes pa yod pas/ khyed rnams kyang rang don tshe 'di kho na'i ched du gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga ma byed/ so so'i skye bo rnams la rgyad med/ ngas

ra༅༅/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du/ gsang sngags don gyi cho ga dben gnas su rgyun du byas pas rim gro de kas chog par gda'/ des na nga'i sems chos nyid kyi gdan las g.yo mi shes par 'dug pas/ gdan bzhugs kyang de kas chogo par gda'/ mar pa'i sman dgrad kyis dug lnga'i nad rtsa ba nas bud 'dug pas sman dpyad kyang de kas chog par gda'/ khyed rang rnams rkyen ngan lam du mi longs na chos pa yin pa rang gis mi chog pas/ dus la ma bab par rkyen gyis byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs su gyur na sman dpyad dang rim gro byas kyang mi skyon/ 'phral gyi rkyen rten 'brel gyi che bas ldog nyung yon tan du 'gyur ba'i skabs yod/ de lta bu'i gdul bya dman pa rnams la dgongs nas/ sngone bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'tsho byed gzhene nu la phyag bstan pa dang sman gsol ba la sogs pa'i rnam pa mdzad pa yin/ dus la bab nas sangs rgyas kyang mya ngan las

'da' ba'i tshul bstan/ da nga yang dus la bab pas sman dang rim gro mi byed gsungs ma gnang bas/ yang thugs sras ras pa gnyis kyis/ nges par rje btsun gzhan done la thegs na rjes su thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs kyi mchod 'bul sku gdung gi zhabs tog /tsha tsha dang mchod rten bzhengs lugs/ gdan sa sus 'dzin dang dus mchod 'bul lugs/ bdag slob ma rnams kyi thos bsam 〉rdzom pa'i nyams len byed lugs rnams kyi zhal bkod cig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ngas drin can mar pa'i bka' drin gyis/ 'khor 'das kyi bya ba thams cad zin pa yin/ sgo gsum chos nyid du grol ba'i rnal 'gror pa la/ ro 'ong ba'i nges pa med pas/ 'jim pa'i tsha tsha dang mchod rten bzhengs mi dgos/ nga la bdag tu bzung ba'i dgon pa med pas gdan sa 'di gyis bya rgyu med/ g.ya' ri dang gangs ri la sogs pa mi med kyi dben gnas rnams khyed kun gyis

ra༅༅/ /zungs la bu slob rigs drug gi sems can rnams brtse bas skyongs/ tsha tsha thun bzhi'i rnal 'gyor ma bcag pa mchod rten chos thams cad la dag snang sbyongs la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ dus mchod kha zhe ngo lkog med par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba thob/ nyams len byed lugs bdag 'dzin dang nyon mongs pa 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gro zhing sems can la gnod na dge ba'i rnam pa yang spongs/ dug lnga'i gnyen por 'gro zhing sems can la phan na rnam pa sdig par snang yang ngo bo dam pa'i chos yin pas byas pas chog /go nas nyams su mi len par khyad du gsod na thos pa rgya che yang shes bzhin gyis sgrib pas ngan serdzong gting zab tu gtang bas tshe thung nam 'chi cha med kyi sgom la dril/ rang gis shes pa'i dge sdig rnams srog dang bsdos la 'dor len gyis/ don hril gyis dril ba la rang la rang gis ma khrel ba zhig dgos pa yin pas/ de ltar

gyis shig /de ltar byas na yig nag gi dpe cha 'ga' zhig dang 'gal rung / rgyal ba gong ma'i datre ngas pa dang mi 'gal bas/ thos bsam thams cad kyi datrerengs pa 'dir 'dus pa yin zhing / mi rgan nga'i bsam pa yang 'di kas rdzogs pa yin no/ /nga'i bsam pa rdzogs na khyed rnams kyi 'khor 'das kyi bya ba thams cad tshar ba yin no/ /de min 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i bsam pa rdzogs thabs gang gis kyang phan pa med de 'di ltar yin gsung ci la phan gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /sgra sgrur mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir tshogs dad 'dus bu slob rnams/ /pha rgan mi la res pa nga'i/ /tha tshig kha chems glu la nyon/ /rnal 'gyor mi la ras pa ngas/ /rnyasna brag mor pa'i bka' drin gyis/ /bya ba thams cad tshar nas yode/ /khyed rjes 'jug grwa pa bu slob rnams/ /kha la nyan na gong bzhin mdzod/ /nga dang rgyal ba gong ma yi/ /thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir rang gzhan rdzi /don chen

ra༅༅/ /tshe 'dir 'grub pa yin/ /de min bya ba thams cad ni/ /rang gzhan don du mi 'gro bas/ /kho bo'i bsam pa mi rdzogs te/ /brgyud ldan gyi bla ma ma bsten pa'i/ /dbang bskur zhus pas ci la phan/ /rang rgyud chos dang mi bsre ba'i/ /rgyud sde bzung bas ci la phan/ /'jig rten bya ba ma btang ba'i/ /gdams ngag ba〉snams pas ci la phan/ /sgo gsum chos dang mi bstun pa'i/ /cho ga byas pas cil phan/ /tshig ngan gnyen pos mi zin pa'i/ /bzod pa bsgoms pas ci la phan/ /phyogs ris chags sdang ma spangs pa'i/ /mchod pa phul bas ci la phan/ /rang 'dod rtsa ba ma spangs pa'i/ /sbyin pa btang bas ci la phan/ /'gro drug pha mar ma shes pa'i/ /gdan sa bzung bas ci la phan/ /sems la dag snang ma skyes pa'i/ /mchod rten bzhengs pas ci la phan/ /thun bzhi'i rnal 'gyor mi nus pa'i/ /tsha tsha btab pas ci la phan/ /gserdzol ba snying nas mi

'debs pa'i/ /dus mchod phul bas ci la phan/ /gdams ngag rna bar mi 'jog pa'i/ /sdug bsngal byed pas ci la phan/ /gsede tshe dad gus ma skyes pa'i/ /gdung zhalabaltas pas ci la phan/ /skyo shas nges 'byung ma skyes pa'i/ /spong dag byas pas ci la phan/ /bdag pas gzhan gces mi bsgom pa'i/ /kha bzang snying rjes ci la phan/ /nyon mongs 'dod pa ma spangs pa'i/ /zhabs tog byed los ci la phan/ /ci gsung tshad mar mi 'dzin pa'i/ /bu slob mang pos ci la phan/ /phan pa med pa'i bya byed de/ /gnod par 'gyur bas cog ge zhog /bya ba byas pa'i rnal 'gror la/ /brel ba mang pos dgos pa med/ /ces gsungs pa de bu slob rnams kyi thugs la shin tu gcags par gyur to/ /de nas rje btsun cher bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ dge bshes rtsag phu bas sha chang gi 'bul ba mtshon pa zhig khyer te snyun dri ba ltar byas byung ba na re/ rje btsun lta bu'i grub thob la yang snyung gzhi 'di

ra༅༅/ /lta bu yong ma 'thad lags te byung // 'di la bgo thabs yod na bu slob rnams la bgo/ spo thabs yod na bdag lta bu la'ang spos pas chog par 'dug ste/ thabs ni med da ci drag na zhu ba la/ rje btsun zhal 'dzum mdzad nas/ nga la nad 'di 'ong don med de mi 'ong dbang med cig byung ba khyed rang la gsal las che/ spyir gang zag phal pa'i nad dang chos pa'i nad mi 'dra rkyen thog tu bzhag pas chog pa yin/ khyad par nga'i nad rgyan yin gsung ste mgur 'di gsungs so/ /'khor 'das 'od gsal gyi dbyengs su gsal/ /phyag gi rang sa zin pa la/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rgyas btab pas/ /gnyis su med pa'i che ba yod/ /thogs rdugs med pa'i spobs pa can/ /nad dang gdon dang sdig sgrib rnams/ /rnal 'gyor nga yi rgyan du mdzes/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum rnam par gnas/ /sbyin sogs mtshan dbe'i rgyan du sbyordzor/ /bsam ngan gyi sdig pa 'dag par

shog /rgyan du che ba'i na tsha 'di/ /spo thabs yod de spo 43 med/ /ces gsungs pas/ kho'i bsam pa la dug gi dogs pa de nga la za bar 'dug ste/ thag chod pa med/ nad spo don yod rung sngerdzo thabs med pa khag theg snyam nas bdag la rje btsun gyi bsnyung gzhi de rgyus 〈snad na dag 'dre gdon gyi yin na brdung / sku khams 'khrugs pa yin na 'chos pa lags te/ rgyus ka med lags/ snyung gzhi spor rung na bdag la sperdzo bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas sems can gcig gi rgyad la gdon che cerdzos bdag 'dzin gyi 'gong po gnod pa'i rkyen gyis nga'i 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad 'di byung ba yin te/ da 'di la khyed kyis brdung thabs dang 'chos thabs med/ je'i nad 'di khyed la spos rung skad cig kyang mi theg pas/ mi spo gsungs pas kho'i yid la nad spo mi thub pa'i thob byed par 'dug snyam nas/ cis kyang bdag la spo bar zhu zhes nan gyis zhus pas/ 'o na khyed la mi spo sgo pha gi la spo

ra༅༅/ /yis stos shig gsung sgrub khang gi sgo la spos pas/ sgo tsheg tsheg skad 'don cing zhig 'gro ba tsam du mer mer shig shig byed cing 'dug /de bar rje btsun snyun med du bzhugs pa la/ yang kherdzo yi yid la mig 'khrul yin nam snyam ngo mtshar che bdag rang la sperdzo bar zhu zhus pas/ 'o na dge bshes la tshad stso(na pa yin gsungs/ sgo'i nad tshur bzhes te slar rtsag phu ba la spos pas/ kho zug rngus brgyal te 'gul mi nus shing dbugs mi thon par dran med du 'chi tshad pa'i tshe/ rje btsun gyis nad phal cher tshur bzhes te/ khyed la nad kyi phyed tsam spos pa yin e bzod par 'dug gsungs pas/ kho rang gis sdug bsngal de myong ba'i mthus 'gyod pa drag po bzod glags med pa zhig skyes nas/ rje btsun gyi zhabs spyi bor blangs/ snying thag pa'i mchi ma drag po gtong zhing smre sngags kyi tshig gis/ rje btsun rin po che/ skyes bu dam pa khyed kyi snyung gzhi

'di/ khyed rang gsung pa bzhin phung po bdag gi blo phung 'gong gis bskyod nas bgyis pa lags/ da bdag rang gi nor khang gzhis dang bcas pa thams cad rje btsun la 'bul/ 'di'i rnam smin mi myong ba zhig rje btsun mkhyen mkhyen zhes zhu zhing / kha zhe med pa'i bshags pa phul bas/ rje btsun yang thugs shin tu mnyes te/ nad lhag ma rnams kyang tshur bzhes nas/ nga tshe gang la yul gzhis khang nor mi dgos pa'i 'chi khar yul gzhis khang nor gyis dgos pa med pas 'bul ba rnams khyed rang khyer la/ da phyin chad srog la bab rung chos 'gal gyi las ma byed cig /da lan gyi 'di'i rnam smin mi myong ba'i smone lam nga rang gis byed pa yin gsung mgur 'di gsungs so/ /mtshan ldan mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa yang / /'phral du bshags pas 'dag par cesag /nga yi dge ba bde skyid dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas dge ba yis/ /'gro kun

ra༅༅/ /sdig pa 'dag par ce ga /khyod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad kyang / /bdag gis blangs nas sbyong bar ce ga /bla ma slob dpon pha ma la/ /gnod pa byed pa snying re rje/ /de yi las kyi rnam smin de/ /bdag gis blangs nas sbyong bar shog /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /sdig pa'i grogs dang bral bar shog /skye zheng skye ba thams cad du/ /dge ba'i grogs po rnyed par ce ga /bsod nams 'dzad thabs bsam ngan dang / /sbyor rtsub su yang mi byedagog /bsam pa bzang po'i byang chub sems/ /sems can kun gyis thob par cerdzog /ces gsungs pas/ kho dga' spro dpag tu med pa thob nas/ rje btsun gyi bka' bzhin da phyin chad chos min gyi las mi bgyid par tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms lags/ sngar gyi sdig pa yang khang gzhis dang nor gyis lan pa lags pas/ da bdag rang la'ang khang zhing dang nor gyis dadurdzos pa med pas/ rje btsun mi bzhes rung bu 〉snab

rnams kyi sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen du cis kyang bzhes dgos zhes zhu ba nan gyis phul rung rje btsun gyis ma bzhes pa phyis bu slobo rnams kyis bzhes nas/ rje btsun gyi dus mchod kyi gzhi rkyen du btsugs pa'i mchod pa chu dbar na dus da lta yang yod do/ /dge bshes rtsag phu ba de la yang phyis tshe 'di blos btang ba'i chos pa dga' mo zhig byung ba yin no/ /de nas rje btsun gyi zhal nas gnas 'dir bsdad pa'i dgos pa sdig po ches 'grod tshangs phul nas sdig pa las grol ba de yin/ nga ya nga sgom chen grong yul du 'chi ba rgyal po dmangs khyim du 'chi ba dang 'dra bas/ da chu dbar du dur sa rnyesnag tu 'grerdzo gsung ba la/ se ban ras pas/ 'o na bsnyung gzhi 'dis 'byon pa 'o brgyal ba gda' bas mdo li la gdan 'dren datre sa zhus pas/ nga na yi yode pa'i nges pa yang med/ 'chi ba'i nges pa yang med de/ na tshul 'dir bstan/ 'chi tshul ston du chu dbar du 'gro de la mdo li mi dgos ras pa gzhes pa

ra༅༅/ /'ga' chu dbar du sngone la song gsungs/ der gzhon pa rnams kyis chu dbar du phyin pas/ rje btsun 'bri lce phug na sngone la phebs 'dug /grwa pa bgres pa rnams la phyag phyi byas 'ong rgyu gcig byung / pha bong reg pa dug can gyi steng na bsnyung tshul stoni mkhan gcig /chu dbar du phyis mjal du 'gro ba'i nya ma dad pa can rnams la phyag phyi byed rgyu gcig /sdings ma'i yod bdag phyi na yod pa rnams la brag mkhar steng du chos gsung mkhan gcig /nang na gnas pa rnams re re'i mdun na bsnyen bkur gsol mkhan re re byung / de'i tshe chu dbar du sngone la phyin pa rnams na re/ rje btsun sngon la chu dbar na phebs 'dug zer/ bgres pa rnams na re rje btsun nged kyis phyag phyi byas nas phebs zer/ phyi nas 'ong mkhan rnams re re zhing phyag phyi nged rnams kyis byas 'ongs pa yin zer/ kha cig na re gzim khang na bzhugs zer/ chos nyan rnams na re de'i nyin brag mkhar du

chos gsung zhing bzhugs zer/ bsnyen bkur zhu mi rnams re re zhing de'i nyin rje btsun nged kyi nang du bsnyen bkur la spyan drangs yod zer/ kun tha dad nas yus dag pas kha ma 'cham ste/ rje btsun la zhus pas/ kun bden ngas rtsed mosna byas pa yin gsungs/ de na sa rje btsun chu dbar gyi 'bri lce phug tu bsnyun tshul bstan nas bzhugs serdzo/ /de'i tshe sngar chos gsung dus byung ba'i ltas 'ja' 'od la serdzogs pa rnams chu dbar gyi nam mkha' dang ri rtse lung pa kun khyab pa byung ngo / /de nas rje btsun zhing khams gzhan du 'byon par kun gyis thag chod pa dang / ras pa zhi ba 'od ngan rdzong ston pa/ se ban ras pa rnams kyis rje btsun zhing khams gang du 'byon pa'i thugs 'dun yod/ bdag cag rnams gsol ba gang du 'debs/ sting serdzor zhal ta gnang rgyu zhig skusnad gsungs pa de gang lags/ da dung bdag rnams la nyams/ len byed lugs kyi zhal ta re yang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun

ra༅༅/ /gyi zhal nas gse la ba khyed rang rnams gang resnas su thob dang / gang dang gang du dad gus dang ldan pas gserdzol ba btab pa de'i mdun na nga yerdzod cing / gang 'dod pa'i don stsol ba yin pas gsol ba zhe thag pa nas thob cig /da lan re zhig mngon dga'i zhing du bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa dang mjal du 'gro dgos par 'dug /rting se ra la ba zer ba'i kha chems la/ nga mi la ras pa shi ba'i rjes su khyed rang rnams la rgyus yodad pa'i nor sba 'khar 'di dang / ras be sa 'di ras chung pa myur du sleb 'ong bar 'dug pas kho la sprod/ rlung byedam pa'i rten 'brel yod pa yin/ ras chung pa ma sleb bar du nga'i ro la ma reg par zhog /mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i dbu zhwa 'di dang / a ga ru nag po'i 'khar ba 'di la/ lta sgom bzang pos bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel yod pas dbus pa ston pa la cis kyang 'phrod par gyis/ shing phor 'di zhi ba 'od khyer/ thod phor

'di ngan rdzong ston pa khyer/ me lcags 'di se ban ras pa khyer/ rus pa'i thur ma 'di 'bri sgom ras pa khyer/ gzhan khrid btab pa'i bu slob rnams ras gos 'di dum bur gyis la khyer/ nor chen po min te rten 'brel sna re yod pa yin/ da gnad che ba'i kha chems kun la rgyus med pa'i grwa bu slob nya ma dang bcas pa kun gyi skal bar 'gyed rgyu la/ nga mi la ras pas tshe gang du bsags pa'i gser thams cad gcig tu dril nas 'gyed lugs kyi yi ge dang bcas te/ thab kha 'di'i 'og na sbas yodi pas/ nga shi ba'i rjes su stos la yi ge'i nang bzhin gyis/ khyed rnams kyi nyams len byed lugs la/ da lta chos pa bzang por rlom pa'i mi bsod nams can 'ga' bsam pa tshe 'di'i che thabs kho nas/ sbyor ba rang la mi dgos pa dang / dgos pa brgya bzhig nas stong 'gugs thabs kyi sbyin gtong dang / ye shes spyan can rnams thugs khrel rung nyon mongs pa so skye rnams kyis lkog tu spyad nas tshe

ra༅༅/ /'di'i rtsi zhus dogs kyi dge ba la brtson brtson mo mang yang gtam la gyong ma thongs par zas bzang po btsan dug dang bsres nas za ba yin no/ /des na khyed rnams tshe 'dir snyan grags 'dod pa'i dug chu ma 'thung bar/ chos su ming btags pa'i 'jig rten 'di'i che thabs sgrub pa'i bya ba spros pa thams cad blos thong la dge sbyor la 'bungs shig gsungs pas/ ras pa rnams kyis gzhan don du 'gyur na spros pa cung zad re bgyis pas chog lags sam zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba ye med na chog ste/ de ka dka' mo yin/ rang gi tshe 'di'i 'dod pa dang ldan pas/ 'gro dzin byed pa des gzhan don dag lta ci smos te/ rang don yang mi 'grub/ stobs med chus khyer bas chus khyer gzhan sgrol zer ba dang 'dra bas/ gnas lugs ma rtogs kyi bar du gzhan don la ma rings/ long bas long ba khrid pa dang 'dra zhing rang 'dod du shor nyen yod

do/ /nam mkha' ma zad bar du sems can zad pa med pas/ nyams len nus na 'grerdzo doni byas pas chog pa'i dus shig 'ong gis/ de bar khyed rang rnams bsam pa bdag pas gzhan gces sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyis/ sbyor ba dman pa'i sa zung / hrul po'i gos gyon/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la thong / lus la bab skur/ sems la khur bskur la nyams su longs shig /sems can gyi don de ka yin no/ /de yang nyams len lam du gtong ba la 'di kun yid la zungs shig gsung mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje sgra sgrur mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos mdzad nyams len byed 'dod rnams/ /mtshan ldan bla ma ma bsten pa'i/ /mos gus byas kyang byin rlabs chung / /dbang bskur zab mo ma zhuso pa'i/ /rgyud rkyang tshig gis rang nyid 'ching / /rgyud sde dpang por ma bzhag pa'i/ /lag len thams cad gol sa'i rgyu/ /man ngag zab mo mi sgom

༄༅༅/ /pa'i/ /bya ba btang zer rang sdug yin/ /nyon mongs gnyen pos mi can pa'i/ /kha bshad skam po stong sgra yin/ /zab mo'i thabs lam mi shes pa'i/ /brtson 'grus byas kyang snying po chung / /gnang bkag zab mo mi shes pa'i/ /snying rus byas kyang lam yun ring / /bserdzod nams mang du ma bsags pa'i/ /rang don gcig pu 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /bsags pa chos la ma btang pa'i/ /bsgoms kyang yon tan skye ba med/ /chog shes nang nas ma skyes pa'i/ /mang po gsog 'dod mi yi nor/ /nang gi bde skyid ma shar ba'i/ /phyi yi bde skyid sdug bsngal rgyu/ /che 'dod 'gong po ma thul ba'i/ /grags 'dod rang phung kha mchu'i rten/ /legs 'dod nyon mongs dug lnga 'khrug /dngos 'dod byams pa'i grerdzogs dang bral/ /nga che re 'kheng mang ba'i rgyu/ /kha rog bzhugs dang kha mchu med/ /ma yengs skye ngas dang g.yeng ba bral/ /gcig pur sngerdzod dang grerdzogs dang

mjal/ /dman sa zung dang mtho sar sleb/ /ga le skyong dang mgyogs par sleb/ /bya ba btang na done chen 'grub/ /zab lam skyongs dang myur lam 'grub/ /stong nyid rtogs na snying rje skye/ /snying rje skyes na bdag gzhan med/ /bdag gzhan med na 'gro done 'grub/ /'gro don 'grub na nga dang mjal/ /nga dang mjal bas sangs rgyas thob/ /bdag dang sangs rgyas bu slob gsum/ /dbyer med gcig tu gsol ba thob/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ da nga yun ring e sdod mi shes pas/ khyed rnams nga la nyan nas nga bzhin byed na nga phyir 'brangs shig gsung mnyam gzhag gi ngang du bzhag pa las/ dgung 'ordzo brgyad cu rtsa bzhir phebs pa/ shing resna skusnas kyi lo'i dgun zla tha chung / skar ma skag la bab pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma lhag shar ba la rje btsun chen po'i gzugs sku chos dbyengs su thim pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de'i tshe lha dang mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i rtags rnams

ra༅༅/ /sngar bas kyang rgya che zhing ya mtshan pa/ nam mkha' dag pa la gzung du rung ba lta bu'i 'ja'i ri mo mig mangs ris su bris pa'i re mig rnams kyi dbus/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang / phyogs mdog tu yod pa'i 'dab ma bzhi pas gang ba'i steng du/ bris pa dang blos bslangs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzo bo mkhas pas byas pa bas kyang ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar bas gang ba dang / bar snang la 'ja' dang sprin kha dog sna lnga'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ yol ba dang bla re/ dar dpyangs dang lda ldi/ 'phan dang ba dan la sogs te/ mchod rdzas dpag med snang ba dang / dbyebs dang kha dog sna tshogs kyi me tog gi char chen po 'bab pa dang / ri mgo thams cad sprin kha dog lnga'i mchod rten gyis mdzes pa de thams cad kyi dbu chu dbar gyi phyogs su phyogs pa dang / yid 'phrog pa'i rol mo'i sgra dgrangs kyi bstod tshig dang / spos kyi dri bzang po mchog tu gyur pas sa

steng khyab pa kun gyis mthong ba byung / lha dang mkha' 'gro'i gdan 'dren mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchodi pa 'bul ba rnams mi phal cher gyis mthong ba las/ mi rnams kyis lha'i lus gcer bu skyon du mi mthong ba dang / lha rnams kyi mi'i lus kyi dri nga ba mi tshor ba dang / phan tshun gtam smra ba dang / rtsed 'jo byed pa la sogs pa'i ltas khyad par can rnams pur gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du byung ngo / /de'i tshe gnya' nang gi yoni bdag rnams kyis rje btsun sku yal ba thos nas/ chu dbar du phyin nas thugs sras bu chen rnams dang / brin pa'i yone bdag rnams la pur gnya' nang du gdan 'dren dbordzos pa'i 'o rdzorgyus byas pas/ brin pa rnams kyis gdan 'dren du ma bcug par bzhu ba'i sta goni byas pa la/ gnya' nang pa rnams kyis 'o na nged gnya' nang gi yode bdag rnams pur zhal blta ru 'ong bas de bar ma bzhu zhig byas myur du log nas/ dmag drangs 'ongs te/ pur la rtsod pa byas pas/ bu

ra༅༅/ /chen rnams kyis gnya' brin gyi yon bdag kun rje btsun la mos gus can mnyam po yin na'ang / sku yal sa chu dbar du byung bas pur gnya' nang du gdan 'dren pa mi rigs/ gnya' nang pa rnams kyang pur bzhu sar sngerdzod la/ gdung skal mnyam por khyer sku(nga byas 'cham pa btang bas/ gnya' nang pa rnams dmag dpung che ba'i snyems kyis 'thab rtsod byed grabs byas pas/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyi dbus su lha'i bu/ rje btsun gyi gsung 'dra ba zhig byung bas/ dbyangs 'di skad do/ /kyai 'dir tshogs thugs sras dang / /yon bdag pur la rtsod pa rnams/ /nga yis zhal lce gcad kyis nyon/ /nga rje btsun slob ma lha yi bu/ /zhal lces 'thab rtsod sdum mkhan yin/ /skyes mchog mi la ras pa de'i/ /thugs ni skye med chos skur thim/ /thugs las gzhan pa'i sku med pas/ /gzugs sku chos skur thim pa'i tshe/ /dngos po'i sku gdung mi 'byung na/ /pur la rtsed pa

rmongs pa yin/ /rmongs pa'i skyes bu thams cad ni/ /mi la ras pa'i gdung la rtsod/ /rtsod pas thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /mos gus gyis la gsol ba thob/ /gsol ba snying nas btab pa na/ /chos sku skye ba med gyur kyang / /rnyed lam thugs rjes 'gag med 'char/ /rang rang skal pa dang mthun pa'i/ /sprul sku'i gdung skal thob par 'gyur/ /zer nas 'ja' yal ba ltar serdzong ngo / /de nas nya ma rnams kyang rje btsun dang mjal snyam pa'i dga' spro byung ste/ 'thab rtsodi bor nas gsole ba btab pas/ bu chen rnams dang brin pa rnams la pur 〈snar ba'i 'du shes med pa'i ngang nas/ gnya' nang pa rnams la pur thobe pa'i 'du shes dang / gdan drangs 'ong rgyu zhig byung ba/ la phyi'i bdud 'dul phug re che'i khyung gi sgo nga'i steng du bzhu bas/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ me tog gi char/ dri bzang dang rol mo'i sgra la sogs pa'i ltas rnams chu dbar dang khyad med du byung ngo / /chu dbar gyi pur de

ra༅༅/ /la / thugs sras rnams dang nya ma rnams kyis gso la ba btab ste/ zhag drug song ba dang bltas pas/ lha sku'i rnam pa lta bu 'od yal le ba lo brgyad lon pa'i khye'u tsam zhig tu gyur pa las/ thugs sras bu chen rnams kyis bka' bgros te/ rje btsun ras chung pa mi 'byone pa yin/ da pur zhag yun ring na rang re tsho la mchod pa 'bul ba dang gserdzol ba 'debs pa'i rten ye ma lus pa'i nyen 'dug pas/ bzhu ba legs pa 'dug ces zhal 'chams nas/ kun la pur zhal bstan nas/ 'bri lce phug gi mdo na chos khri'i brag gcig yod pa de'i steng du pur khang brtsigs pa'i nang du pur gdan drangs/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ lha rdzas kyi mchod pas zil gyis mnan rung / mi rang gi lugs kyi mchod pa bzang po bshams nas/ nam smad pur mchod 'phul bar brtsams te/ pur la me mchod phul bas me bzhes su ma 'dod do/ /de'i tshe nam mkhar yang

'ja' 'od sprin gyi gur khang gi nang nas/ ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lngas mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas dgrangs 'di skad do/ /ram̐ ye shes gtum mo lha yi me/ /skyes bus rtag tu bsgoms bsgoms pas/ /las kyi me yis ci zhig bya/ /mtshan ma lus kyi phung po de/ /snga nas lha skur bsgoms bsgoms pas/ /de ring phung po ci la lus/ /mdzes pa lha yi dkyil 'khor de/ /rnal 'gror lus la rdzogs pa la/ /sa yi ri mos ci zhig bya/ /rlung sems dbyer med mar me de/ /rgyun chad med par 'bar ba la/ /ser sna'i kong bus ci zhig bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi zhal zas de/ /rgyun chad med par gsol ba la/ /zan gyi bzhos bu su la 'dren/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i gos rgyani pas/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags dag pa la/ /de ring khrus bum su la 'cha'/ /dud pa'i sprin tshogs spos dris gang / /bar snang mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /de ring bdug spos byed rgyu med/ /mkha' 'gro sde

༄༅༅/ /bzhis mchod da/grangs mdzod/ /ye shes ḍā kis mchod pa 'bul/ /de ring cho ga ji ltar brjod/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /dpa' bo yongs kyis zhabs tog byed/ /de ring pur la reg don med/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i skyes bu'i pur/ /bcas bcos mi dgos bzhag pas chog /lha mi kun gyis mchod rten la/ /bdag po mi dgos dge sbyor mdzod/ /lha dang bla ma'i dam tshig la/ /kha ta mi dgos thugs dam skyongs/ /rin chen gter gyi phung po la/ /nga bdag ma byed mnyam par zhog /bla ma sangs rgyas gsang tshig la/ /bshad 'dodi ma mang smra bcad mdzod/ /gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs la/ /grib kyis phog gis sku mtshams spyo(mas/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rnam thar la/ /'gal rkyen mang bas gsang sgrub mdzod/ /ya mtshan pha yi pham 'bab la/ /dngos grub 'byung bas the tshom chod/ /bla ma rje btsun rnam thar la/ /snyan pa khyed kyis

bsgrags mi dgos/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i glu dbyangs la/ /byin rlabs 'byung ngo mos gus skyed/ /mi la ras pa'i ngu brgyud la/ /grub thob mang ngo skal ldan kun/ /yul phyogs 'di yi mi phyugs la/ /nad yams med do lha mi rnams/ /de ring 'dir tshogs sems can la/ /ngan song med do skyes bu kun/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /snang sems gcig go gnyis 'dzin bzhig /rje btsun 'da' ka'i zhal chems la/ /dgos pa che 'o bka' bzhin sgrubs/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i lha chos la/ /kun kyang rtag tu spyod par 3snag /ces gsungs byung bas/ ngan rdzong stod pa na re/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ras chung pa ma sleb bar du pur la ma reg gsungs pa de dang / mkha' 'gro'i dgrangs de mthun par 'dug ste/ ras chung pa e 'byon mi shes pa'i pur bzhag rung dngos med la 'gro bar 'dug zer/ ras pa zhi ba 'od na re/ rje btsun dang mkha' 'gro'i gsung pur me mchod mi

ra༅༅/ /bzhes lugs kyis rje btsun ras chung pa myur du phebs 'thi thag chod/ de bar rang re rnams gsol ba thob zer ba ltar gsol ba btab bo/ /de'i tshe ras chung pa lo ro dol gyi dbod pa na bzhugs pa'i nam phyed yol gyi mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i nyams la chu dbar na shel gyi mchod rten 'od kyis nam mkha' gang ba zhig mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bteg nas zhing khams gzhan du gdan drangs 'gro grabs su 'dug pa de la/ mched grogs rdo rje spun rnams dang / rje btsun gyi yoni bdag rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i mi sa gzhi gang ba dang / lha dang mkha' 'grerdzo nam mkha' gang bas dbyangs len cing / mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bul zhing 'dug pa la/ ras chung pas kyang mchod rten de la phyag phul bas/ mchod rten gyi nang nas rje btsun dbu rnyed byung ste/ bu ras chung pa khyod shog byas pa'i dus la ma sleb rung / pha bu phrad pa 'di sems spro/ da rang re pha bu gnyis

yang yang e 'phrad mi shes pas daskad pa'i 'du shes bskyed la gleng mo gyis shig gsungs/ phyag ras chung pa'i dbu la zhul zhul dang mnyes mnyes mdzad pa la/ shin tu daskad pa'i 'du shes kyis sngar ma skyes pa'i dad pa skyes pa zhig shar ro/ /de nas mnal sad pa dang / sngar gyi gsung rnams rjes su dran nas/ bla ma grongs yod pa ni min nam snyam pa dang / bzod glags med pa'i mos gus kyi ngang nas gserdzol ba btab ste/ dus la ma sleb rung myur du mjal ba la 'gro dgos snyam yod pa'i tshe/ nam mkhar bud med gnyis byung ste/ ras chung pa myur du bla ma dang mjal du ma phyin na/ bla ma dag pa mkha' khyodad du gshegs nas tshe 'dir mi mjal bar 'dug tre// /da lta rang serdzong zhig zer ba dang / nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba dang rmi ltas des bskul nas bla ma dran du rang song ste/ da lta rang 'gro snyam bzhengs te byon pas/ lo ro dol gyi bya skad rnams o tshe re re ba la 'dug /ras

ra༅༅/ /chung pas kyang mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'gyor gyi ngang nas/ rlung dpag chen gyi mda' 'phangs pa 'dra ba zhig bzung snye bla ma dang mjal du byon pas/ bong 'gros pa'i zla lam gnyis kyi sa snga dro gcig la chod de/ ding ri dang brin gyi so mtshams spo ze la'i rtse mor nyi ma rtse shar la phebs/ der cung zad cig bzhugs pas/ nam mkha' dang bar snang ri mgo dang sa gzhi thams cad ltas bzang pos gang ba'i gzigs mo mtha' yas pa des thugs spro ba dang skyo ba gnyis ka byung / khyad par jo bo ra bzangs kyi rtse na 'ja' 'od sprin gyi gur khang la brten pa'i lha'i bu dang bu mo dpag tu med pa 'dod yon lnga'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs pa de rnams chu dbar gyi phyogs la gus gus kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul zhing smon lam 'debs pa de dag mthong nas/ rje btsun ras chung pa the tshom zos te/ lha rnams la ltas bzang po 'di lta bu dang / khyad par khyed rnams kyi mchod

pa 'di su la 'bul ba yin gsungs pas/ de'i nang nas lha mo 'ga' zhig na re/ skyes bu khyod kyis mig dang rna ba bkag nas bsdad pa yin nam/ ltas 'di dag sa steng na lha mi kun gyi mchod gnas dam par gyur pa mi la bzhad pa rdo rje dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams su 'byon pa la dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul ba yin/ mi rnams kyang chu dbar na tshogs nas mchod pa 'bul zhing yod zer ba thos nas thugs thon 'gro ba lta bu zhig byung ste/ myur du byon pas/ chu dbar gyi nye 'khor gyi lam kha na pha bong mchod rten gyi zhabs 'dra ba zhig yod pa de'i steng na rje btsun phebs 'dug ste/ nga'i bu ras chung pa 'ongs pa yin nam gsung rmi lam ltar mnyes mnyes mdzad cing 'dug pa la/ rje btsun sku yal ba mi bden par 'dug snyam dga' ྅sgo dpag tu med pa zhig byung ste zhabs spyi bor blangs/ gaskurdzol ba btab pas gang zhus kyi lan thams cad gnang bar mdzad do/ /de nas rje btsun gyi
