ra༅༅/ /zhal nas/ bu ras chung pa rang phyi nas shog cig ngas khyod kyi sna len grabs byas 'ong gis gsung sngon la phebs song ba skad cig la mi snang bar gyur to/ /der ras chung pas lam la zhugs te chu dbar du byon pas/ rje btsun gyi gzim phug na grwa pa bu slob nya ma dang bcas pa rnams ོgas te mya ngan gyi ngang nas pur la mchod pa 'bul ba dang thug byung ba/ ras chung pa rgyus med pa'i ras pa gzheni pa 'gas ras chung pa bzung nas pur gyi drung du ma btang ba las thugs shin tu skyod ba zhig byung nas/ bla ma la smre sngags kyi gdung dbyangs kyis yan lag bdun pa 'di phul lo/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgoni/ /thugs mkhyen brtse chen po'i ngang nyid nas/ /'bangs skal med ras chung rdor grags nga'i/ /nyam thag pa'i smre sngags gsan lags sam/ /'o dod gdung dbyangs thal 'ordzo bla ma rje/ /pha mjal bar 'dod nas zhabs drung snyegs/ /bu bsod

nams med pas zhal ma mthong / /pha thugs rjes gzigs shig bka' drin can/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa kun ldan pa'i/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas khyod nyid la/ /sprang 〉 snagasum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /mi dge log lta'i sdig pa bshags/ /mdzad mchog rnams la rjes yi rang / /zab don chos 'khor bskor bzhin du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /sgom sgrub la sogs dge rtsa rnams/ /rje btsun thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo/ /bsngo ba grub na skaladaman ngas/ /rje btsun pur zhal mthong bar shog /dang po bla ma'i thugs zin nga / /da lta pur la mjal dbang med/ /dngos su mjal ba'i skal med kyang / /pur zhal mngon sum mthong bar shog /pur zhal mngon sum mthong nas kyang / /dngos sam nyams kyi snang ba la/ /rim gnyis nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /gegs sel gces pa'i gdams ngag zhu/ /zhu don gsol ba

ra༅༅/ /btab pa bzhin/ /bu la brtse bas mi skyong na/ /pha yi mkhyen brtses su la skyong / /pha thugs rje'i lcags kyus ma btang bar/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /'bangs blo dzasnas rmongs pa'i ras chung la/ /rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rjes gzigs/ /bu dug lngas gzir ba'i ras chung la/ /pha ye shes lnga ldan khyed kyis gzigs/ /spyir sems can yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgos ras chung bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /zhes pa'i smre sngags kyi mgur de phul bas/ ras chung pa'i gsung lhang byung ma thag pur gyi zhal ras mdangs yal 'ong ba dang pur la me rang 'bar du 'ong ba dus mnyam du byung ngo / /der ras chung pa'i gsung thos ma thag ras pa zhi ba 'od dang / ngan rdzong ston pa/ se ban ras pa la sogs te rdo rje'i spun rnams dang / nya ma rnams kyis bsu ru byon rung / zhal mi mtshon pa'i ras pa rnams kyis pur gyi drung du ma

btang bas thugs yus te/ dgrangs ma rdzogs kyi bar du 'byon ma nyan/ ras chung pa'i mos gus chen po'i gdung dbyangs des rje btsun chen po 'od gsal du thim tshar tshar ba slar yang bzhengs te gsung 'byon pa ni/ ras pa gzhon pa rnams la/ kho re tsho sngar gyi de skad ma byed dang / 'bag brgya bas seng ge gcig dga' ba de ras chung pa yin pas yar thong zhig gsungs/ ras chung pa la/ bu ras chung yang de tsam yi chad mi dgos/ yus kyis ma brnang par pha'i gam du 6rdzog cig gsungs pa'i tshe/ kun ya mtshan zhing ha las pa ltar dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas ras chung pas rje btsun la mchongs nas mang du bzhums shing thugs 'od gsal du thim pa dran sos pa dang / grwa pa bu slob kun pur khang gi mdun na phar bsgrigs te bzhugs pa la/ rje btsun gyis snyun bral zung 'jug rdo rje'i skur bzhengs nas me lce rnams phyag gis mnan pas/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad lta bu'i dbus na/ sku ze'u 'bru lta

ra༅༅/ /bu'i zhabs phyed krung log ge ba dang / phyag g.yas brkyang ba'i chos 'chad kyis me lce mnan zhing g.yon zhal 'gram bskyor ba'i ngang nas/ bu slob rnams la ras chung pa'i glu len/ mi rgan nga'i tha tshig 'di nyon cig gsungs/ pur khang nang nas rdo rje'i glu'i mgur nas byung ba'i gsung gi tha ma snying po gnad drug gi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bu snying dang 'dra ba'i ras chung pa/ /kha chems gdams ngag glu 'di nyon/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas/ /sgru lus kyi phung po sdig po che/ /sto gos kyi zhen pa bsgrab bsgrubs nas/ /'jig rten bya ba thongs dus med/ /'jig rten bya ba thongs shig ras chung pa/ /sgru ma lus kyi grong khyer na/4 /rang sems dngos med sdig po che// /lus sha khrage gi rjes su 'brang 'brang nas/ /chos nyid don la rtogs dus med/ /sems nyid brdar sha chod cig rame chung pa/ /bem rig gnyis kyi so mtshams na/ /rang byung ye shes sdig

po che/ /glo bur gyi rnyen kha 'grim 'grim nas/ /skye med kyi don la rtogs dus med/ /skye med btsan sa zungs shig ras chung pa/ /tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi so mtshams na/ /bar do'i rnam shes sdig po che/ /lus med lus dang 'grog 'grogs nas/ /gnas lugs don la rtogs dus med/ /gnas lugs gtan la phob cig ras chung pa/ /rigs drug 'khrul ba'i grong khyer na/ /las ngan sdig sgrib tshan po che/ /chags sdang rjes su 'brang 'brangs nas/ /mnyam pa nyid la rtogs dus med/ /chags sdang spongs shig ras chung pa/ /mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyengs shig na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhal rdzun mkhan/ /drang don gyi bslu khrid gsung gsungs nas/ /nges pa'i don la rtogs dus med/ /tha snyad spongs shing ras chung pa/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/ /gcig tu dril la gsol ba thob/ /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum/ /gcig tu dril la nyams su long / /tshe 'di dang phyi ma

ra༅༅/ /bar do gsum/ /gcig tu dril la 'dris su chug /de gdams ngag kun gyi tha ma yin/ /kha chems kun gyi mjug ma yin/ /don de las med do ras chung pa/ /de nyams su 'ordzong zhig pha yi bu/ /zhes gsungs nas/ yang 'od gsal du thim resna/ /thim ma thag pur khang 'ja' 'od las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi 〉rdzo bzhi rgyan rta bab dang bcas pa'i steng du 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang bla re/ pu shu'i rtse mor gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mchod rdzas dpag med kyis gang ba zhig tu gyur pa dang / me lce'i yang rtsa ba thams cad pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ rtse mo bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas su 'bar ba/ me stag thams cad mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo mang yo 'phro zhing / mchod pa 'bul ba dang me 'bar ba'i sgra thams cad pi waṃ gling bu dung dang ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra snyan sna tshogs su 'byung ba

dang / dud pa rnams la dri bzang 'byung zhing / 'ja'i gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod sprin sna tshogs su 'khrigs par gyur to/ /de'i tshe pur khang steng gi nam mkha' la lha'i bu dang bu mo bum pa thogs pas bdud rtsi'i char rgyun dang / 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pas lha mi'i mchod 'os kun tshim par byas so/ /de'i tshe grwa pa bu slob nya mar bcas pa kun gyi mthong snang la pur khang gzhal yas khang du gcig pa la/ pur dgyes pa rdo rje/ 'khor lo sdom pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i mthong snang mi gcig pa du ma byung ngo / /de'i tshe mkha' 'gro mang pos mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /rje yid bzhin nor bu gshegs shul du/ /la la ngu zhing la la 'bog /brgyal te mya ngan byed dus 'dir/ /rang byung me ni rang 'bar gyur/ /me lce pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang / /bkra shis brgyad dang rin chen bdun/ /yid 'ong mchod rdzas du ma 'bar/ /me sgra dung

ra༅༅/ /dang cha lang dang / /pi wang gling bu ting ting shags/ /cang te'u rnga chung sgra snyan 'khrol/ /me stag skar 'da' 'bros pa las/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lha mor gyur/ /bkod legs mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul/ /du ba 'ja' 'od mchod sprin 'khrigs/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil/ /yid 'ong mkha' 'gro du ma yis/ /pur sbyangs gdung ni bzhig nas khyer/ /phung po lhag med grub pa la/ /khyed rnams gdung la bzhu sbyangs mtshar/ /bla ma chos sku'i nam mkha' la/ /longs sku smon lam chos sprin 'thibs/ /sprul sku phrin las me tog char/ /rgyun chad med par 'bab pa yis/ /gdul bya'i lo togo smin par mdzad/ gang yang skye ba med pa yi/ /chos nyide skye med stong pa nyid/ /stong pa nyid la skye 'gag med/ /skye zhing 'gag pa'ang stong nyid ngang / /yin phyir the tshom som nyi spongs/ /zhes pa'i dgrangs

de'i rjes su nyi ma dgongs mor song ba dang / me 'bar ba'i rnam pa de yang zhi nas pur khang phyi gsal nang gsal kun gyis thogs med du mthong ba la/ grwa bu slob nya ma dang bcas pa kun gyis pur gdung la bltas pas/ pur khang nang du la las 'od kyi mchod rten chen po zhig mthong / de bzhin du la las dgyes rdor bde mchog /gsang 'dus phag mo la sogs pa'i lha sku dang / rdo rje dril bu bum pa la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dang / sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon la sogs te yig 'bru dang / pur khang 'od kyis gang ba dang / gser btso ma gar bus gang ba dang / mtsho 'khyil ba/ me 'bar ba/ rlung g.yo ba/ ci yang mi snang ba dang / 'dod yon lnga'i mchod rdzas kyis gang ba la sogs te/ mthong snang mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo / /de nas grwa pa bu slob nya ma dang bcas pa rnams nang par pur khang zhal phye ste/ gdung dang ring bsrel la serdzogs pa'i mos gus kyi rten rnams 'gyed

ra༅༅/ /de ngo mtshar can mang po 'byon par 'dug snyam dga' yal le ba'i ngang nas/ pur khang la mgo bstan nas gzims pas thams cad mnal du serdzong ba'i tshe/ tho rengs ras chung pa mnal sad pa'i gzigs snang la/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga dar gyi na bza' gsol zhing / rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rang 'dra ba'i 'khor sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba du mas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs nas pur khang la mchod pa 'bul zhing / gtso mo rnams kyis dar dkar gyi yol bas pur khang bsgribs pa'i nang nas 'od dkar po gcig ril gyis spyan 'dren zhing 'dug pa'i gzigs mo la cung zad yengs/ de nas mkha' 'gros gdung ring bsrel rnams gdan 'dren pa srid snyam der byon pas/ mkha' 'dzasna rnams nam mkhar byone serdzong / mched grerdzogs rdo rje spun rnams bos te pur khang la gzigs pas/ gdung thal tsam yang ma lus par gdan drangs

tshar 'dug pa la/ ras chung pa thugs skyed nas/ mkha' 'grerdzo rnams la nged mi rnams kyi gdung skal datre sa gsungs pas/ mkha' 'grerdzo rnams na re/ khyed bu chen rnams la gdung dang ring bsrel gyi dam pa sems chos skur ngo sprad pas mi chog na/ gsol ba thob dang rje btsun gyi thugs rjes gnang ste 'ong / gzhan mi rnams kyis rje btsun nyi zla lta bu la me khyer gyi mthong tsam yang ma byas pas gdung dang ring bsrel mi 'ong / 'di nged rang rnams kyi skal ba yin zer nam mkha' na bsdad 'dug pa la/ bden snyam gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'di ltar btab bo/ /rje bla ma'i drung na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /dad pas ci gsung bka' bsgrabs pas/ /zab dgu done gyi gdams ngag thob/ /skal ldan smin cing grol mdzad pa /0 /gdung dang ring bsrel mos pa'i rten/ /sems can yongs la thugs rjes zungs/ /rje gcug pur ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /zhe bcad drag pos bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /grub

ra༅༅/ /rtags rdzu 'phrul mngon gyur pas/ /rgyal khams yongs la grags gyur pa/ /gdung dang ring bsrel mos pa'i rten/ /mthong thos rnams la thugs rjes zungs/ /rje bu slob nang na bzhugs tsa na/ /nye ring med pa'i thugs rje can/ /mngon shes rig pa'i ye shes rgyas/ /'gro ba'i don la brtse ba to/ /gdung dang ring bsrel mos pa'i rten/ /skal ldan bu la thugs rjes zungs/ /rje mang po'i khrod du bzhugs tsa na/ /byang sems rgyas pa'i bka' drin can/ /'brelatshad thar pa'i lam la 'dren/ /sdug bsngal can la lhag par brtse/ /gdung dang ring bsrel mos pa'i rten/ /nus pa med la thugs rjes zungs/ /rje sgru ma'i sku lus 'dor ba'i tshe/ /mkha' spyod grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /snang srid chos skur bsgyar mdzad cing / /mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso bo yis/ /gdung dang ring bsrel moso pa'i rten/ /'dir tshogs bu la thugs rjes zungs/ /zhes ngu 'bod kyi gdung

dbyangs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi 'od de'i nang nas/ 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phro ba'i ring bsrel bya mo'i sgo nga tsam zhig pur khang gi steng du 'od mer 'phros byung ba la/ bu chen rnams kyis phyag rub mdzad nas/ nga'i yin gsung zhing gdan 'dren du phyin pa la/ ring bsrel de slar yang nam mkhar byon nas mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi 'od de la thim pas 'od de cha gnyis su bye ste/ cha gcig seng ge'i khri pad ma nyi zla dang bcas pa'i gdan du gyur pa'i steng du/ cha gcig shel dkar lta bu'i mchod rten phyi gsal nang gsal khru gang tsam la 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba'i mtha' sangs rgyas sngerdzong rtsa gnyis kyis bskerdzor ba/ bang rim rnams na rim pa bzhin rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams khra lam mer gsal ba zhig tu gyur pa'i nang nas rje btsun mtho gang tsam zhig la mkha' 'gre rdzornams kyisaphyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul ba zhig gi ram 'degs mchod rten de'i dkone gnyer gyi tshul du 'dug pa'i

ra༅༅/ /mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis byas nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bu bde ba skyong dang zhi ba 'od/ /ngan rdzong ston pa la sogs pa'i/ /skal ldan ras pa'i bu slob rnams/ /mos gus gdung ba drag po yis/ /pha yi ming nas 'bod bzhin du/ /gdung dang ring bsrel mos pa'i rten/ /sems can yongs la gnang dgos zhes/ /gsol ba snying nas btab pa'i mthus/ /thugs rjes sku gsum sprul pa'i rten/ /mthong bas 'khor bar mi ltung ste/ /dad pa byas na rdzogs sangs rgya/ /chos sku thig le nyag gcig la/ /ring bsrel bya mo'i sgo nga tsam/ /'gro ba yongs kyi mos pa'e rten/ /bdag gir byas pas mi thob cing / /phal pa'i yul du ga la sdod/ /'on kyang gsolab btab gyur na/ /thugs rje chung du mi 'gro ba/ /sangs rgyas spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /yi dam bde mchog yab yum la/ /dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /nam mkhar dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa la/ /

dpa' bo dpa' mo'i mchod sprin 'khrigs/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ye shes lha/ /dbang bskur dngos grub myur du 'byung / /'di la gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /byin rlabs chung du mi 'gro ba/ /mkha' 'gro spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /thub pa chos sku'i phrin las kyis/ /sprul sku sna tshogs cir yang stod/ yel gyi mchod rten khru gang la/ /mdo yi sangs rgyas stong rtsa dang / /rgyud sde bzhi yi phra btab ste/ /dngos su byon pa dzo mtshar che/ /ma yengs gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /phrin las chung du mi 'gro ba/ /chos skyong spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /bla ma sku gsum dbyer med ni/ /rdzu 'phrul bkod pa cir yang ston/ /chung la dod pa'i sku 'bras can/ /dngos su 'byon pa ngo mtshar che/ /mos gus gdung ba drag po yis/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /dngos grub chung du mi 'gro ba/ /grub thob yongs kyi dam tshig yin/ /dam tshig dngos su srung ba na/ /dam can yongs kyis dngos

ra༅༅/ /grub ster/ /gcig pur ri khrod zin pa na/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro ngang gis 'khor/ /chos la ngo lkog ma byas na/ /myur du grub pa'i snga ltas yin/ /nang du skyid 'dod mi 'dug na/ /snyan mongs rtsa ba bud pa yin/ /bdag dang dngos por mi 'dzin na/ /'dre bdud bar chad sod pa yin/ /phyogs dang ris su mi 'dug na/ /lta ba yongs su dag pa yin/ /'khor 'das stong par 'char nus na/ /sgom pa yongs su dag pa yin/ /brtul shugs khong nas rdol ba na/ /spyod pa yongs su dag pa yin/ /bla ma'i lung bstan thob pa na/ /dam tshig yongs su dag pa yin/ /sems can kun gyi don grub na/ /'bras bu yongs su dag pa yin/ /dpon slob thugs yid 'dres pa na/ /'brel pa yongs su dag pa yin/ /rtags dang dngos grub mthong ba na/ /snang ba yongs su dag pa yin/ /dam tshig nyams myong drod rtags chos/ /khyed bu stsoreb rnams kyi gdung skal

ma dzod/ /ces gsungs pa'i mthar/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mchod rten de bu slob rnams la legs par bstan nas/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du bzhag ste/ zhing khams gzhan du gdan 'dren pa'i grabs byed cing 'dug pa'i tshe/ ras pa zhi ba 'od kyi bsam pa la/ mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten 'di nged mi'i bu slob rnams tshogs gsog pa'i rten du zhu dgos snyam nas gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'di ltar btab bo/ /pha gzhan don sprul pa'i mi gzugs can/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /mi mngon chos dbyengs thams cad khyab/ /rje chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje grub thob rnams dang mjal dus na/ /rin chen gser gyi sgrom bu 'dra/ /rje rin thang med pa'i rnal 'gror pa/ /sbyangs pa can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar

ra༅༅/ /zhu/ /rje bla ma'i zhabs tog byed dus su/ /g.yang dkar lug gi bal dang 'dra/ /kun la phan pa'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje 'jig rten bya ba btang ba'i tshe/ /drang srong rig pa'i rgyal po 'dra/ /'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /snying stobs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje bla ma'i gdams ngag sgom tsa na/ /stag mo mi ro za ba 'dra/ /the tshom med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /snying rus can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje mi med lung pa 'grim tsa na/ /lcags kyi pha bong srubs med 'dra/ /'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'gror pa/ /bcos ma spangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten

de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje rtags dang cho 'phrul stoni tsa na/ /glang chen dar seng dkar mo 'dra/ /nyam nga med pa'i rnal 'gror pa/ /'jigs pa bral la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje nyams dang drod rtags bskyed tsa na/ /bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas 'dra/ /'dzam gling khyab pa'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /gces 'dzin med la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje skal ldan slob ma skyong tsa na/ /nyi ma me shel phrad pa 'dra/ /grub thob mdzad pa'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /bka' drin can la gserdzol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu :snab rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje zang zing nor dang phrad tsa na/ /dngul chu sa la lhung ba 'dra/ /dri mas ma gos rnal 'gror pa/ /nyes skyone med la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten

ra༅༅/ /de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje mang po'i tshogs pa skyong tsa na/ /'dzam gling nyi ma shar ba 'dra/ /mun pa sel ba'i rnal 'gror pa/ /mkhyen brtse can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje 'dzam gling mi yis mjal tsa na/ /ma dang bu gnyis phrad pa 'dra/ /ci phan mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /byams pa can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs tsa na/ /dngos grub gter gyi bum pa 'dra/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rnal 'gror pa/ /ngo mtshar can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje mngon shes lung bstan mdzad tsa na/ /kha dang lag pa sprod pa 'dra/ /'phyug pa med pa'i rnal 'gror pa/ /dus gsum mkhyen la

gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slobe rnams la gnang bar zhu/ /rje dngos grub myur du gnang tsa na/ /pha yis bu la nor 'bogs 'dra/ /phangs pa med pa'i rnal 'gyor pa/ /thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten de/ /nged bu slob rnams laganang bar zhu/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ yang mchod rten nang gi rje btsun gyi sku des/ ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis zhus pa'i lan du 'dra min gol sa gcod pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ /'o na skal ldan dad pa can/ /lhang lhang gdung bas gsol 'debs pa/ /ya mtshan ras pa'i bu slob nyon/ /kho bo mi la ras pa nga'i/ /chos sku kun la khyab pa yis/ /stong pa nyid la shor thob med/ /gzugs sku dbyings su thim pa yis/ /kun rdzob gdung dang ring bsrel rnams/ /ril po gcig tu gyur pa de/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i mchod rten gcig /'di 'gro ba yongs kyi tshogs kyi zhing / /bzhugs

ra༅༅/ /gnas dag pa'i zhing du byed/ /daskadan gnyer mkha' 'grerdzo sde lngas byed/ /phyag mchod lha dang mkha' 'grerdzos 'bul/ /mi yul bzhag kyang yal nas 'gro/ /khyed bu slob rnams kyi skal ba la/ /rang sems chos skur ngo sprad pas/ /gdung dang ring bsrel dam pa yod/ /de nyams su len pa'i lam dus su/ /'dra min gol sa 'di 'dra 'byung / /ma brjed zung la spong len gyis/ /pha mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa dang / /mi bsod nams can la brten pa gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /ye stong sems la shar ba dang / /mi rtog blo yis bcos pa gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /sgom gnyug ma'i rang sa zin pa dang / /zhi gnas rtsi la 'byar ba gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /rang byung lhug pa'i rang shar dang / /mthong mthong mang po'i dran pa gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /sems nyid dri med gcer mthong

dang / /bsam pa bzang po'i phan dogs gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /dngos grub rten 'brel shar ba dang / /zang zing mang po'i bsod nams gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang / /sa bla 'byung po'i lhang 'bod gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /mkha' 'dzatos sgrub pa'i phrin las dang / /bdud kyis sgrub pa'i bar chad gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /chos sku dri med gong bu dang / /mtshan ma rdzas kyi ring bsrel gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dral nor dogs mdzod/ /sprul pa dbyengs kyi me tog dang / /'dod khams lha yi me tog gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /gdon las skyes pa'i mchod rten dang / /sprul pa lha yi mchod rten gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /snang srid 'ja' 'od gur khang dang / /'byung ba rkyen gyi 'ja' 'odacaganyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /sngoni

ra༅༅/ /gyi las 'phros dad pa dang / /rkyen las skyes pa'i dad pa gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /dad pa snying nas skyes pa dang / /ngo tsha khrel gyi dad pa gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /snying nas sgrub pa byed pa dang / /tshe 'di bla ma'i ngo srung gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /bsam don lag tu 'gel ba dang / /kha don rlung la bskur ba gnyis/ /'dra dang 'dra la nor dogs mdzod/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i mchod rten 'di/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas zhing khams yin/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs khang yin/ /bla ma rje btsun sgom khang yin/ /nga ni shar phyogs zhing khams su/ /mkha' 'gro mang po 'dus pa'i nang / /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing de na / /bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor lo dang / /spyan ras gzigs mgoni sgrol ma'i tshogs/ /kun bzang bde ba'i gnas de ru/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i sun ma yod/ /khyod gsol

ba snying nas 'debs nus na/ /kha zhe med pa'i mchi ma 'khrug /bcos ma med pa'i phyag rten mtshar/ khes rab snani po'i me tog 'thor/ /byang chub sems kyi bum khrus gyis/ /dad pa 'gyur med srung ba bzang / /ye shes gnyis med dbang zhu na/ /mgo bo 'di yi 'og tu zhugs/ /zhes gsungs shing / mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mchod rten bu chen rnams kyi steng gi nam mkhar khyer byung ste/ mchod rten las bu chen re re'i dbu thog tu 'od zer re re 'phros te dbang bskur mdzad do/ /de nas phal cher gyis mchod rten de'i nang nas rje btsun gyi sku de phyir 'phros te/ nam mkha' na la las dgyes pa rdo rje/ 'khor lo bde mchog /gsang ba 'dus pa/ rje btsun ma'i dkyil 'khor/ lha dang lha mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba dngos su mthong ba zhig gi gtso bo'i thugs kar thim pa dang / dkyil 'khor de yang nam mkhar 'od du hril 'dril nas mthar shar phyogs su tal song ba la/ mchod rten de la

ra༅༅/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol nas rin po che'i sgrom bu zhig gi nang du bcug ste/ mchod pa dang rol cha dpag med dang bcas te shar phyogs su gdan drangs song ba mthong / la las rje btsun longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha byad can/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i seng ge la chibs pa'i rkang lag nas mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis btegs 'gro ba'i chibs mthur rdo rje phag mos khrid de/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas gdugs rgyal mtshan la serdzogs pa'i mchod pa dang rol cha sna tshogs 'bul ba'i 'khor gyis bskor nas shar phyogs su 'byon pa mthong ba dang / mchod rten de yang mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo zhig gis dar dkar gyi mdo li la gdan drangs par mthong ba la sdur+shags te/ ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar ba'i rtags bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de nas grwa pa bu slob rnams kyis/ gdung skal chad pa'i mya ngan byas/ smre sngags kyis gserdzol ba drag tu

btab pas/ sku med pa'i rje btsun gyi gsung 'dra ba zhig nam mkhar byung nas/ bu rnams de tsam sdag bsngal byed mi dbordzos/ khyed rang rnams kyi mtshan ma'i gdung skal du/ rdo a mo li ka'i ngos la yig 'bru bzhi byon pa mos gus kyi rten yod pas brag gi 'og tu tshol zhig bya ba thos nas/ pur bzhu ba'i brag stegs kyi skor la btsal bas/ lung bstan ji lta ba bzhin pur rdo rnyed pas/ gdung skal chad pa'i mya ngan sangs par gyur to/ /ngo mtshar can gyi pur rdo de/ dus da lta'i bar du yang 'gro ba'i don la dben gnas dpal gyi chu dbar na bzhugs pa yin no/ /de nas bu chen rnams 'phral rje btsun zhing khams gzhan du thegs pas thugs skyo rung / phugs rje btsun gang du sangs rgya ba'i zhing der 'khor gyi thog mar skye bar thag chod cing / rje btsun gyi mdzad pa thams cad kyis kyang bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen grub pa dang / rang rang gi thugs dam gyis kyang doni gnyis grub pa'i gdengs

ra༅༅/ /dang ldan pa'i ngang nas kun zhal 'cham ste da zhalachems ltar/ thab kha'i 'og gi gser lta dgos te/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa de la gser 'ong don rang med na'ang / bka' yin pas lta dgos zer thab kha grus te bltas pas/ kā shi ka'i ras kha gang la/ gri chung rtse mos myung 'ong ba/ ltag pas me thon pa/ sos gri 'ong ba gcig dang / bu ram rdog po gcig /yi ge zhig dril 'dug pa bklags pas/ stod na bur rdog 'di dang ras 'di gri chung 'dithe gtubs pas zad par mi 'gyur gyis gtubs la sems can la ci khyed gyis/ bu ram myong tshad ras la reg tshad ngan song las thar ba yin te/ mi la ras pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi zas dang / gos la rgyalab gong ma rnams kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /sems can su gang gi rna bar nga'i ming lan cig thos pa la dad pa skyes pa de rnams la/ skye ba bdun gyi bar du ngan song med cing / tshe rabs bdun dran par

'gyur ba rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis lung bstan yin no/ /mi la ras pa la gser yod zer ba'i mi rnams kyi khar skyag gong zhig chug cig bya ba zhig 'dug pas/ bu chen rnams thugs khral dang mya ngan che bar yod pa'i tshe yang / gsung de byung ba'i mod la/ kun bzhad gad theg pa zhig byung ngo / /smad na/ rnal 'gror nga yi ting 'dzin zas/ /mi tshe'i ring la zos zos pa/ /dngos grub gnyis 'byung snying rje'i zas/ /kha ru song ba'i sems can rnams/ /yi dwags skye ba'i sgo gcad do/ /ras dkar gtum mo shes rab gos/ /lus sam mgul du btags pa rnams/ /tsha grang dpyal ba'i skye 〉pho gcad/ /byin rlabs thobe pa thams cad ni/ /ngan serdzong gsum gyi gnas las thar/ /chos 'brel yode pa thams cad ni/ /deng nas ngan song mi skye zhing / /rim gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob/ /ming tsam rna bar song ba la/ /dad pa skyes pa'i sems can kun/ /tshe rabs bdun du ming rus

ra༅༅/ /dran/ /pho rgod mi la ras pa nga / /snang srid gser du song ba la/ /phur thums thig pos dgos pa med/ /bu slob kho bo'i bka' bzhin sgrabs/ /de yis gnas skabs mthar thug gi/ /dgos don mchog rab grub pa yin/ /zhes bya ba 'dug pas/ gri des bur rdog grangs med kyi bar du gtubs pas/ dang yo dang che chung rnyesnams pa re re byung / de bzhin du ras gtubs pas kyang kha re re byung ba sems can rnams la bkye ba sems can rnams kyis 'ordzongs spyad pas/ nad pa dang sdug bsngal can rnams nad dang sdag bsngal las grol/ blo ngan nyon mongs can rnams kyang dad brtson shes rab snying rje che bar gyur cing mthar ngan song las thar ba dang / bu ram dang ras mi rabs re re'i bar du zarde mi shes pa byung ngo / /pur la mchod pa phul ba'i tshe/ me tog gi char kha dog lnga ldan dang bzhi ldan babs pa rnams ni/ sa la mi 'bab par mis mi zin tsam nas slar gyen

du log nas nam mkhar yal 'gro zhing / re re gnyis gnyis sa la babs pa rnams kyang mis reg ma thag yal 'gro ba mang zhing / ma yal ba rnams blta bas chog mi shes so/ /kha dog gsum ldan man sbrang ma'i gshog pa lta bu sa la chags pas chu dbar du bol nub tsam dang / sa phyogs gzhan du sa'i mdog 'gyur ba tsam du gyur to/ /pur mchod phul zin pa'i rjes su nam mkha'i 'ja' 'od la sogs pa'i ltas rnams je phra je phra la song na/sa yal ba yin zhing / sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus chen rnams su/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la me tog gi char 'ja' 'od dang dri bzang / rol mo'i sgra la sogs pa'i ltas rnams sngar ji lta ba bzhin du byung zhing / gzhan yang nam zla dgun du gyur kyang / sa las me tog sna tshogs 'khrungs pa dang / 'jig rten du lo legs dang skya rgyal byung zhing / dus kyi 'khrug pa dang yams dang rims nad zhi ba la sogs te/ ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar ba'i rtags rnams rgyas

ra༅༅/ /par brjod na bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang bar 'dug pas/ yi ge mang ba la 'jigs nas ma bkod do/ /don dril ba la/ rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug chen po mi la ras pa dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i mthar rnam thar mchog gi mig rkyen/ thugs rje chen po dang smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ slobe brgyud rnams la grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu nam mkha'i skar ma lta bu dang / phyir mi ldog pa sa'i dreg pa lta bu/ lam zhugs kyi skyes bu rnal 'gyor pho mo dpag gis mi lang zhing / gzhal du med pa byung bas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin resnar byas shing / sems can rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa las sngerdzog cing / bde ba rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa la bkod pa 'di yin no/ /rnal 'gror gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal mi la ras pa'i rnam byang gi mdzad pa dang / phrin las rnams rdzogs nas/ 'gro rnams chos la bskul

phyir gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim zhing / phrin las rgya chen po srid mtha'i bar du rgyun mi chad pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i mdzad pa ste dgu pa'o// //rje btsun rang la yi dam mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa ltar gyi bu slob las ras pa zhi ba 'od dang mjal dus kyi mnal ltas ltar gyi nyi ma lta bu'i mnyam med dwags po rin po che/ zla ba lta bu'i gung thang gi ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rgyu skar lta bu'i gcen lung gi ngan rdzong ston pa byang chub rgyal po/ rgyal khrom smad kyi ras pa zhi ba 'od/ mdo bkra'i se ban ras pa/ gnyi shang gi khyi ra ras pa/ mus kyi 'bri 〉snam ras pa/ rag ma'i ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs te thugs kyi sras brgyad/ gshen 〉snam ras pa/ glen 〉phom ras pa / mes 〉rdzom ras pa/ rtsa phu ras pa/ mkhar chung ras pa/ rong chung ras pa/ stag :rdzom ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug /jo 〉sgom ras pa dar ma dbang phyug /dam pa rgyags phu

ra༅༅/ /pa / li skor phya ru pa/ lo ston dge 'dun/ skyo ston shākya gu na/ 'dre ston bkra shis 'bar te nye ba'i sras bcu gsum/ thugs sras dwags po rin po che dang / nye ba'i sras phyi ma lnga ni skerdzon sgom so thar gyi cha lugs can yin no/ /mtsho lnga'i ras chung ma/ lgenya' nang gi sa le 'od/ gcung gi dpal dar 'bum/ lcam mo pe ta mgon skyid rnams ni sras rnams kyi sring bzhi ste/ sa lam mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'gyor pho mo nyer lnga/ rdzi bo ras pa la se gas te skar phran lta bu'i gnas lugs rang zhal mthong ba'i rtogs ldan phyir mi ldog pa brgya/ rang byung gi sgom nyams bzang po 'khrungs pa gong 'phel du gyur cing lam la drod thob pa'i skyes chen brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'jig rten 'di'i bya ba btang ba'i chos dang mthun nges kyi sgom chen pho mo lam sna zin pa stong rtsa gcig /chos 'brel thob pas ngan song gi lam rgyun chad pa'i gdul bya skal ldan skye bo phal pa rtsis las 'das pa ste

mi'i bu slob rnams dang / tshe ring mched lnga dang ling ba brag srin ma la sogs te dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mi ma yin gyi bu slob dpag gis mi lang ba rnams byung ba yin no/ /de rnams kyi nang nas zhi bar gshegs tshe bzhugs pa rnams pur gyi bya ba rnams rdzogs pa'i mthar/ rje btsun gyi bka' bzhin/ phyogs bcu dben pa'i ri khrod so so la byon nas kun gyis sku tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa yin zhing / khyad pa ras chung pa dwags po rin po che'i sku skal rnams bsnams nas slar yang dbus phyogs su byone pa dang / sgam po pa yang cung zad 'phyis rung bla ma'i bka' dran nas yar byon pa yar lungs phu shar du mjal te mai tri pa'i dbu zhwa dang / a ka ru'i phyag 'khar phul/ 'ordzo rgyus rnams btang bas yug cig thugs dran med du serdzong ba bzhengs pa'i mthar/ bla ma la smre sngags kyi gserdzol 'debs mang po mdzad pa rnams/ sgam po pa'i rnam thar na gsal 'o(/ /sgam po pas ras chung pa khong rang gi bzhugs gnas

ra༅༅/ /su gdan drangs te/ bde mchog snyan rgyud kyi chos skor rnams rdzogs par gsan/ ras chung pas kyang chos dang khong rang gi sku skal ras kyi na bza' rnams phul nas lo ro dol gyi dgone par byon te bzhugs pa'i mthar sku lus 'di nyid kyis mkha' spyod du byon pa yin no/ /gzhan yang thugs sras zhi ba 'od dang khyi ra ras pa/ sring bzhi'i ras chung ma dpal dar 'bum sa le 'od rnams kyang sku lus 'di nyid kyis mkha' spyod du byon pa yin zhing / gzhan rnams sku yal tshul bstan pa'i mthar mkha' spyod du byon pa yin no/ /thugs sras sku tshe 'di nyid la mkha' spyod du byone pa rnams kyi ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar ba'i che ba dang / sku yal tshul bstan pa rnams kyi sku gdung ring bsrel mdzad pa dang phrin las rnams kyi 'bras bu mchog gis bstan pa dang sems can gyi don nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bgyis pa yin no/ /de ltar thun mosnang srid pa 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa gsum

dang / mchog gyur zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa dgu ste/ ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas/ tshe gcig dang lus gcig gis sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang brnyes te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i skyes bu mchogo rab dam pa mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam stod/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams la srid zhi'i dpal 'gyor rgyun mi chad du stsol bar mdzad pa'i dge legs kyi dga' ston chen po 'di nyid/ dge zhing bkra shis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur to// 7/ //skyes bu mchog rab rje btsun mi la de'i/ /rnam thar nor bu phrin las 'od 'phro bas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa nyin mor mdzad/ /sems can kun gyi dgos 'dod re ba bskangs/ /rgyal ba gong ma mnyes pa'i mchod mchog

ra༅༅/ /mdzod/ /rnam thar thog mtha' snyan dngags rgyan gyi mdzes/ /mkhas pa spros pa can tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar tshig gis dad gus spu long g.yo/ /btsun po nges 'byung can tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar don gyis bden gnyis dbyer med sten/ /bzang po nyams myong can tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar mthong bas chos brgyad sgrog las grol/ /bya btang mngon zhen spangs pa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar thos pas dad pa dbang med skye/ /skal ldan las 'phro can tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar dran pas 'khri ba btsan thabs chod/ /kun mkhyen tshe 'dir bsgrab pa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar reg pas don gnyis lhan gyis grub/ /bstan 'dzin 'gro den mdzad pa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar bskyangs pas brgyud pa'i dgongs pa rdzorgos/ /brgyud 'dzin bka' bzhin sgrub tsho'i dga' ston mdzod/ /rnam thar thugs rjes sdug bsngal

ma lus skyob/ /khams gsum sems can kun gyi dga' stone mdzod/ /dga' stoni 'byung gnas thub bstan rgyal mtshan tog tu gyur pa'i bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam thar nor bu tshad med rnam bzhi'i dpal gzi ldan pas 'gro ba kun la srid zhi'i dgos 'dod dga' stod 'gyed byed be+e ḍār+ya de la/ /lhag bsam rnam dag mchod pa phul zhing dgos 'dod stsol bar gsol ba btab pas 'khor ba'i mal du dug lnga'i nad kyis mnar ba rnams la nad do cog gi gnyen por rmyur pa ye shes lnga yi sman mchog char dang ni/ /zag med nor gyis phongs par gyur nas sdug bsngal chen pos brel bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams la 'dod yon 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis dga' ston bkye ba'i dge ba mchog des 'gro kun srid zhi'i dbul phongs kun bsal nas/ /mi la ras pa'i mtshan thos pas kyang tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang dbang thob nas dpag med sprul pas mkha' khyab 'gro kun sku bzhi'i dpal la 'gode pa'i mthu dang nus pa

༄༅༅/ /thob phyir bsngo bas bsngos pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig/ //rnal 'gyor gyi dbang phyug dam pa rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam par thar pa/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam stone mgur chings dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ rje btsun gyi rnam thar du ma mthong na'ang / thun mong ma yin pa'i slob dpon gyi zhal nas byung ba ji lta ba bzhin dur khrod nyul ba'i rnal 'gyor pa rus pa'i rgyan can gyis/ phur bu'i lo stod zla 'bring po'i yar tshes brgyad la/ ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas chen 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar dag cing rdzogs par yi ger bkod me 'dis kyang / bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde rgya chen po 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung bar gyur cig/ // lto/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /bde chen chang gis myos pa'i brtul zhugs glu/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mdun sa ru/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po la/ /ci dgar rgyu ba'i grub rigs rgya mtsho'i mgone/ /rnal 'byor dbang

phyug rje btsun mi la mchog /gang zhig bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gad mo'i sgra/ /srid zhi'i rgud tshogs srog la ches rgol mod/ /lus can skal bzang yongs kyi bdud rtsinyid/ /de yi rnam thar mdzad pa rgya masbo las//chos kyi dzol mtshan dad pa'i dpag bsam rtser/ /legs bshad 'bras mang chags pa'i me tog gsar/ /rnam kun 'dzin pa'i rgyal ba kun mnyes 31ga /de mthus tshe rabs kun tu 'khore lo bzhi'i/ /rten bzang mi la'i snying rus rnam thar dang / /'jam mgone rgyal ba gnyis pa'i mdzad bzang ltar/ /rgyal bstan phan bde'i dbyed du 'dzin par shog/ //ces pa'ang mdo khams yangs pa'i sa chen po la spyod pa'i mi'i bdag po b.lakha blon sman stod pa mchog gi mdun 'khod rang bzhin gser bzhun ma'i ngang tshul la 'gran pa'i drung yig dhame dh+wa dzas rnam thar 'di nyid spar gsar du bskrun skabs 'jam dpal rol pa'i blo gros kyis spar byang smed tshig tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nyi mas bgyis pa dge'o// //spar 'di la stod ding ri'i nye 'dabs rang gnas bde skyid khang gsar du bzhugs pa'i ma phyi la gzhi bcol te/ slar yang bal yul 'phags pa shing kun rang byung mchod
ci dzetshosna dzeritsho / sa —tsho ri — — ci 3
